question: The inner radius of a dog's large artery is 4 mm, and the blood flow rate is $1 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} / \mathrm{s}$. Given that the blood viscosity is $2.084 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~Pa} \cdot \mathrm{~s}$, consider a segment of the artery that is 0.1 m long. Find: (1) the pressure difference $\Delta p$ between the two ends, and (2) the power $P$ required to maintain the blood flow in this segment of the artery.
solution:
Solution (1) From Equation (6.27), substituting the given data, we can calculate

$$
\Delta p = p_{1} - p_{2} = \frac{8 \eta L Q_{V}}{\pi R^{4}} = 2.07 \mathrm{~Pa}
$$

(2) Assume the flow velocity on an element with cross-sectional area $\mathrm{d} S$ inside the pipe is $v$. The net force provided by the pressure difference $\Delta p$ is

$$
\mathrm{d} F = \Delta p \cdot \mathrm{~d} S
$$

The work done over time $\Delta t$ is

$$
\mathrm{d} W = \mathrm{d} F \cdot v \Delta t = \Delta p \cdot v \mathrm{~d} S \cdot \Delta t
$$

The total work done by the pressure difference on the fluid in time $\Delta t$ is

$$
\Delta W = \iint_{S} \mathrm{~d} W = \Delta p \left[\iint_{S} v \mathrm{~d} S\right] \Delta t
$$

where $S$ is the cross-sectional area of the pipe. Clearly, we have

Thus,

$$
\begin{gathered}
\iint_{S} v \mathrm{~d} S = Q_{V} \\
\Delta W = \Delta p \cdot Q_{V} \Delta t
\end{gathered}
$$

The power provided by the pressure difference $\Delta p$ is

$$
P = \Delta W / \Delta t = \Delta p \cdot Q_{V}
$$

The power $P$ required to maintain blood flow in the blood vessel is equal to the power provided by the pressure difference $\Delta p$. Substituting the relevant data, we can calculate

$$
P = 2.07 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{~W}
$$

question: 试由 $t=0$ 时振子的位置 $x_{0}$ 和速度 $v_{0}$ ，确定过阻尼振动（7.57）式中的常量 $A_{1}$ 和 $A_{2}$ 。
solution:
解: 据（7.57）式，有
$$ v_{x}=\left(-\beta+\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\right) A_{1} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta t} \mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}+\left(-\beta-\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\right) A_{2} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta t} \mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}} $$
结合初条件，可得
$$ A_{1}+A_{2}=x_{0} $$
$$ -\beta\left(A_{1}+A_{2}\right)+\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\left(A_{1}-A_{2}\right)=v_{0} $$
解得
$$ A_{1}=\frac{1}{2}\left(x_{0}+\frac{\beta x_{0}+v_{0}}{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}\right) $$
$$ A_{2}=\frac{1}{2}\left\{x_{0}-\frac{\beta x_{0}+v_{0}}{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}\right\} $$

question: Determine the constants $A_{1}$ and $A_{2}$ in the overdamped oscillation equation (7.57) based on the position $x_{0}$ and velocity $v_{0}$ of the oscillator at $t=0$.
solution:
Solution: According to equation (7.57), we have  
$$ v_{x}=\left(-\beta+\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\right) A_{1} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta t} \mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}+\left(-\beta-\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\right) A_{2} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta t} \mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}} $$  
Combining with the initial conditions, we obtain  
$$ A_{1}+A_{2}=x_{0} $$  
$$ -\beta\left(A_{1}+A_{2}\right)+\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}\left(A_{1}-A_{2}\right)=v_{0} $$  
Solving these, we get  
$$ A_{1}=\frac{1}{2}\left(x_{0}+\frac{\beta x_{0}+v_{0}}{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}\right) $$  
$$ A_{2}=\frac{1}{2}\left\{x_{0}-\frac{\beta x_{0}+v_{0}}{\sqrt{\beta^{2}-\omega_{0}^{2}}}\right\} $$.

question: 质量为 $m_{1}$ 的质点用长为 $l_{1}$ 的、不可伸长的轻绳系于固定点 $O$ ，另一质量为 $m_{2}$ 的质点用长为 $l_{2}$ 不可伸长的轻绳系于前一质点上，求此系统做小振动的简正模式和相应的角频率。
solution:
解 取图 10.2 的坐标， $\theta 、 \varphi$ 为广义坐标，
$$\begin{gathered}x_{1}=l_{1} \sin \theta, \quad y_{1}=l_{1} \cos \theta \\x_{2}=l_{1} \sin \theta+l_{2} \sin \varphi \\y_{2}=l_{1} \cos \theta+l_{2} \cos \varphi\end{gathered}$$
系统的动能（做小振动近似）为
$$\begin{aligned}T & =\frac{1}{2} m_{1}\left(\dot{x}_{1}^{2}+\dot{y}_{1}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{2} m_{2}\left(\dot{x}_{2}^{2}+\dot{y}_{2}^{2}\right) \\& =\frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} l_{2}^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \dot{\theta} \dot{\varphi} \cos (\varphi-\theta) \\& \approx \frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} l_{2}^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \dot{\theta} \dot{\varphi}\end{aligned}$$
系统的势能（做小振动近似）为
$$\begin{aligned}V & =-m_{1} g y_{1}-m_{2} g y_{2} \\& =-\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} \cos \theta-m_{2} g l_{2} \cos \varphi \\& \approx V_{0}+\frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} \theta^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} g l_{2} \varphi^{2}\end{aligned}$$
其中 $V_{0}$ 是常量，势能的零点可以任意选取， $V_{0}$ 值无关重要，故不必具体写出。 惯性矩阵和刚度矩阵分别为
$$\begin{aligned}& \boldsymbol{M}=\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} & m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \\m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} & m_{2} l_{2}^{2}\end{array}\right) \\& \boldsymbol{K}=\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} & 0 \\0 & m_{2} g l_{2}\end{array}\right)\end{aligned}$$
系统有两个自由度，有两个简正频率，
$$\begin{gathered}\theta=u_{1} \cos (\omega t+\alpha), \quad \varphi=u_{2} \cos (\omega t+\alpha) \\\left(K-\omega^{2} M\right) \cdot u=0\end{gathered}$$
即
$$\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}\left(g-l_{1} \omega^{2}\right) & -m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} \\-m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} & m_{2} l_{2}\left(g-l_{2} \omega^{2}\right)\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{l}u_{1} \\u_{2}\end{array}\right)=0$$
$u_{1} 、 u_{2}$ 要得非零解，必须
$$\left|\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}\left(g-l_{1} \omega^{2}\right) & -m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} \\-m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} & m_{2} l_{2}\left(g-l_{2} \omega^{2}\right)\end{array}\right|=0$$
可得
$$\begin{gathered}m_{1} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{4}-\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right) g \omega^{2}+\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g^{2}=0 \\omega_{1}, \omega_{2}=\left\{\frac{g}{2 m_{1} l_{1} l_{2}}\left[\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right) \pm \sqrt{\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left[m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}\right.}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2}\end{gathered}$$
其中 $\omega_{1}$ 的式子用式中的 " +" 号， $\omega_{2}$ 的式子用式中的 "-" 号。用 $\omega_{1}$ 代入（1）式，解出的 $u_{1} 、 u_{2}$ 标为 $u_{1}^{(1)} 、 u_{2}^{(1)}$ ，
$$\frac{u_{1}^{(1)}}{u_{2}^{(1)}}=\frac{1}{2 l_{1}}\left[l_{1}-l_{2}-\sqrt{\frac{m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}}{m_{1}+m_{2}}}\right]$$
用 $\omega_{2}$ 代入（1）式，得
$$\frac{u_{1}^{(2)}}{u_{2}^{(2)}}=\frac{1}{2 l_{1}}\left[l_{1}-l_{2}+\sqrt{\frac{m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}}{m_{1}+m_{2}}}\right]$$
可以考虑以下极限情况得到熟知的结果，作为上述计算的正确性的一种检验。当 $m_{1} \rightarrow 0$ 时，
当 $l_{1} \rightarrow 0$ 时，
当 $l_{2} \rightarrow 0$ 时，
$$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$$
$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$
$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$
$\omega_{1}$ 均为无穷大，系统不运动，这也是合理的，因为上述几个极限情况，都只有一个自由度，只存在一个简正频率。

question: A particle of mass $m_{1}$ is attached to a fixed point $O$ by a light, inextensible string of length $l_{1}$, and another particle of mass $m_{2}$ is attached to the previous particle by a light, inextensible string of length $l_{2}$. Determine the normal modes of oscillation and the corresponding angular frequencies for small oscillations of this system.
solution:
Solution: Take the coordinates of Figure 10.2, with $\theta$ and $\varphi$ as generalized coordinates,
$$\begin{gathered}x_{1}=l_{1} \sin \theta, \quad y_{1}=l_{1} \cos \theta \\x_{2}=l_{1} \sin \theta+l_{2} \sin \varphi \\y_{2}=l_{1} \cos \theta+l_{2} \cos \varphi\end{gathered}$$
The kinetic energy of the system (under the small oscillation approximation) is
$$\begin{aligned}T & =\frac{1}{2} m_{1}\left(\dot{x}_{1}^{2}+\dot{y}_{1}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{2} m_{2}\left(\dot{x}_{2}^{2}+\dot{y}_{2}^{2}\right) \\& =\frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} l_{2}^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \dot{\theta} \dot{\varphi} \cos (\varphi-\theta) \\& \approx \frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} l_{2}^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \dot{\theta} \dot{\varphi}\end{aligned}$$
The potential energy of the system (under the small oscillation approximation) is
$$\begin{aligned}V & =-m_{1} g y_{1}-m_{2} g y_{2} \\& =-\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} \cos \theta-m_{2} g l_{2} \cos \varphi \\& \approx V_{0}+\frac{1}{2}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} \theta^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{2} g l_{2} \varphi^{2}\end{aligned}$$
where $V_{0}$ is a constant, and the zero point of potential energy can be chosen arbitrarily, so the value of $V_{0}$ is unimportant and need not be specified. The inertia matrix and stiffness matrix are
$$\begin{aligned}& \boldsymbol{M}=\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}^{2} & m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \\m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} & m_{2} l_{2}^{2}\end{array}\right) \\& \boldsymbol{K}=\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g l_{1} & 0 \\0 & m_{2} g l_{2}\end{array}\right)\end{aligned}$$
The system has two degrees of freedom and two normal frequencies,
$$\begin{gathered}\theta=u_{1} \cos (\omega t+\alpha), \quad \varphi=u_{2} \cos (\omega t+\alpha) \\\left(K-\omega^{2} M\right) \cdot u=0\end{gathered}$$
That is,
$$\left(\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}\left(g-l_{1} \omega^{2}\right) & -m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} \\-m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} & m_{2} l_{2}\left(g-l_{2} \omega^{2}\right)\end{array}\right)\left(\begin{array}{l}u_{1} \\u_{2}\end{array}\right)=0$$
For $u_{1}$ and $u_{2}$ to have non-zero solutions, it is necessary that
$$\left|\begin{array}{ll}\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) l_{1}\left(g-l_{1} \omega^{2}\right) & -m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} \\-m_{2} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{2} & m_{2} l_{2}\left(g-l_{2} \omega^{2}\right)\end{array}\right|=0$$
From this, we obtain
$$\begin{gathered}m_{1} l_{1} l_{2} \omega^{4}-\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right) g \omega^{2}+\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right) g^{2}=0 \\omega_{1}, \omega_{2}=\left\{\frac{g}{2 m_{1} l_{1} l_{2}}\left[\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right) \pm \sqrt{\left(m_{1}+m_{2}\right)\left[m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}\right.}\right]\right\}^{1 / 2}\end{gathered}$$
where the expression for $\omega_{1}$ uses the "+" sign in the formula, and the expression for $\omega_{2}$ uses the "-" sign. Substituting $\omega_{1}$ into equation (1), the solutions for $u_{1}$ and $u_{2}$ are denoted as $u_{1}^{(1)}$ and $u_{2}^{(1)}$,
$$\frac{u_{1}^{(1)}}{u_{2}^{(1)}}=\frac{1}{2 l_{1}}\left[l_{1}-l_{2}-\sqrt{\frac{m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}}{m_{1}+m_{2}}}\right]$$
Substituting $\omega_{2}$ into equation (1), we get
$$\frac{u_{1}^{(2)}}{u_{2}^{(2)}}=\frac{1}{2 l_{1}}\left[l_{1}-l_{2}+\sqrt{\frac{m_{2}\left(l_{1}+l_{2}\right)^{2}+m_{1}\left(l_{1}-l_{2}\right)^{2}}{m_{1}+m_{2}}}\right]$$
We can consider the following limiting cases to obtain well-known results, as a check on the correctness of the above calculations. When $m_{1} \rightarrow 0$, 
when $l_{1} \rightarrow 0$, 
when $l_{2} \rightarrow 0$, 
$$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$$
$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$
$\omega=\omega_{2} \rightarrow \sqrt{\frac{g}{l_{1}}}$
$\omega_{1}$ is infinite in all cases, and the system does not move, which is reasonable because in each of these limiting cases, there is only one degree of freedom and only one normal frequency exists.

question: 质量均为 $m$ 、荷电均为 $e$ 的两金属小球，用同样长度为 $l$ 的、不可伸长的轻绝缘绳系在同一水平线上，两悬点相距为 $a$ 。让两球在其平衡位置附近做小振动，求简正频率（设电场力比重力小得多）。
solution:
解

$$
\begin{gathered}
T=\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m l \dot{\theta}_{2}^{2} \\
V=m g l\left(1-\cos \theta_{1}\right)+m g l\left(1-\cos \theta_{2}\right)+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{\prime}}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a}
\end{gathered}
$$

其中

$$
r^{\prime}=\left\{\left(a+l \sin \theta_{2}-l \sin \theta_{1}\right)^{2}+\left[l\left(1-\cos \theta_{1}\right)-l\left(1-\cos \theta_{2}\right)\right]^{2}\right\}^{1 / 2}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \approx a\left[1+\frac{l}{a}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)\right] \\
& r^{r-1}=\frac{1}{a}\left[1-\frac{l}{a}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)+\frac{l^{2}}{a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)^{2}\right] \\
& V \approx \frac{1}{2} m g l \theta_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta_{2}^{2}-\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)^{2} \\
& =\left(\frac{1}{2} m g l+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}\right)\left(\theta_{1}^{2}+\theta_{2}^{2}\right)-\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}} \theta_{1} \theta_{2}-\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right) \\
& L=\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{2}^{2}-\left(\frac{1}{2} m g l+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}\right)\left(\theta_{1}^{2}+\theta_{2}^{2}\right)+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}} \theta_{1} \theta_{2}+\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

由 $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}_{i}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial \theta_{i}}=0$ ，得

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \ddot{\theta}_{1}+\left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{1}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{2}+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0 \\
& \ddot{\theta}_{2}+\left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{2}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{1}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0
\end{aligned}
$$

在势能函数中出现 $\theta_{1} 、 \theta_{2}$ 的一次方项，是二阶微分方程中出现非齐次项的原因，而这种情况的产生是因为 $\theta_{1}=0 、 \theta_{2}=0$ 不是平衡位置，平衡位置 $\theta_{10} 、 \theta_{20}$ 是这个非齐次方程的一个特定的特解，它们满足下列代数方程：

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{10}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{20}+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0 \\
& \left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{20}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{10}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0
\end{aligned}
$$

由对称性可知， $\theta_{20}=-\theta_{10}$ ，可解出

$$
\theta_{20}=-\theta_{10}=\frac{e^{2} a}{4\left(\pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3} g+e^{2} l\right)}
$$

如取 $\theta_{1}^{\prime}=\theta_{1}-\theta_{10}, \theta_{2}^{\prime}=\theta_{2}-\theta_{20}$ ，二阶微分方程将是齐次的。不论用 $\theta_{1} 、 \theta_{2}$ 还是用 $\theta_{1}^{\prime} 、 \theta_{2}^{\prime}$作广义坐标，不仅简正频率相同，而且简正频率满足的特征方程也是相同的，特征方程为

$$
\left|\begin{array}{cc}
\frac{g}{l}+A-\omega^{2} & -A \\
-A & \frac{g}{l}+A-\omega^{2}
\end{array}\right|=0
$$

其中

$$
A=\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}
$$

解出

$$
\omega_{1}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}, \quad \omega_{2}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+2 A}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{\pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}}
$$

question: Two metallic small spheres, each with mass $m$ and charge $e$, are tied on the same horizontal line with non-extendable light insulating strings of the same length $l$. The distance between the two suspension points is $a$. Allow the two spheres to perform small oscillations near their equilibrium positions and find the normal frequency (assuming that the electric force is much smaller than the gravitational force).
solution:
Solution:

$$
\begin{gathered}
T=\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m l \dot{\theta}_{2}^{2} \\
V=m g l\left(1-\cos \theta_{1}\right)+m g l\left(1-\cos \theta_{2}\right)+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{\prime}}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a}
\end{gathered}
$$

where

$$
r^{\prime}=\left\{\left(a+l \sin \theta_{2}-l \sin \theta_{1}\right)^{2}+\left[l\left(1-\cos \theta_{1}\right)-l\left(1-\cos \theta_{2}\right)\right]^{2}\right\}^{1 / 2}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \approx a\left[1+\frac{l}{a}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)\right] \\
& r^{r-1}=\frac{1}{a}\left[1-\frac{l}{a}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)+\frac{l^{2}}{a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)^{2}\right] \\
& V \approx \frac{1}{2} m g l \theta_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta_{2}^{2}-\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)^{2} \\
& =\left(\frac{1}{2} m g l+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}}\right)\left(\theta_{1}^{2}+\theta_{2}^{2}\right)-\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}} \theta_{1} \theta_{2}-\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right) \\
& L=\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} m l^{2} \dot{\theta}_{2}^{2}-\left(\frac{1}{2} m g l+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}}\right)\left(\theta_{1}^{2}+\theta_{2}^{2}\right)+\frac{e^{2} l^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{3}} \theta_{1} \theta_{2}+\frac{e^{2} l}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} a^{2}}\left(\theta_{2}-\theta_{1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

From $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}_{i}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial \theta_{i}}=0$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \ddot{\theta}_{1}+\left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{1}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{2}+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0 \\
& \ddot{\theta}_{2}+\left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{2}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{1}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0
\end{aligned}
$$

The linear terms of $\theta_{1}, \theta_{2}$ appearing in the potential energy function are the reason for the non-homogeneous terms in the second-order differential equation, and this situation arises because $\theta_{1}=0, \theta_{2}=0$ are not equilibrium positions. The equilibrium positions $\theta_{10}, \theta_{20}$ are a particular solution of this non-homogeneous equation, and they satisfy the following algebraic equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{10}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{20}+\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0 \\
& \left(\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}\right) \theta_{20}-\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}} \theta_{10}-\frac{e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m l a^{2}}=0
\end{aligned}
$$

By symmetry, we know $\theta_{20}=-\theta_{10}$, and we can solve

$$
\theta_{20}=-\theta_{10}=\frac{e^{2} a}{4\left(\pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3} g+e^{2} l\right)}
$$

If we take $\theta_{1}^{\prime}=\theta_{1}-\theta_{10}, \theta_{2}^{\prime}=\theta_{2}-\theta_{20}$, the second-order differential equations will be homogeneous. Whether using $\theta_{1}, \theta_{2}$ or $\theta_{1}^{\prime}, \theta_{2}^{\prime}$ as generalized coordinates, not only are the normal frequencies the same, but the characteristic equation satisfied by the normal frequencies is also the same. The characteristic equation is

$$
\left|\begin{array}{cc}
\frac{g}{l}+A-\omega^{2} & -A \\
-A & \frac{g}{l}+A-\omega^{2}
\end{array}\right|=0
$$

where

$$
A=\frac{e^{2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}
$$

Solving gives

$$
\omega_{1}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}, \quad \omega_{2}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+2 A}=\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}+\frac{e^{2}}{\pi \varepsilon_{0} m a^{3}}}
$$

解 （1）取系统的质心坐标 $x 、 y 、 z$ 和一个原子相对于另一个原子的球坐标 $r 、 \theta 、 \varphi$为广义坐标.

$$
\begin{aligned}
L= & \frac{1}{2} \times 2 m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+2 \times \frac{1}{2} m\left[\left(\frac{\dot{r}}{2}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right]+\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}-\frac{B}{r^{12}} \\
= & m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{4} m\left(\dot{r}^{2}+r^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right)+\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}-\frac{B}{r^{12}} \\
& p_{x}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}}=2 m \dot{x} \\
& p_{y}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{y}}=2 m \dot{y} \\
& p_{z}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}}=2 m \dot{z} \\
& p_{r}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{r}}=\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r} \\
& p_{\theta}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}=\frac{1}{2} m r^{2} \dot{\theta} \\
& p_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}}=\frac{1}{2} m r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi} \\
H= & p_{x} \dot{x}+p_{y} \dot{y}+p_{z} \dot{z}+p_{r} \dot{r}+p_{\theta} \dot{\theta}+p_{\varphi} \dot{\varphi}-L \\
= & \frac{1}{4 m}\left(p_{x}^{2}+p_{y}^{2}+p_{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{m}\left(p_{r}^{2}+\frac{p_{\theta}^{2}}{r^{2}}+\frac{p_{\varphi}^{2}}{m r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta}\right)-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}
\end{aligned}
$$

(2) 最低的经典态, $T=0, V$ 取最小值,
$$
\begin{gathered}
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} r}\left(-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}\right)=0 \\
\frac{12 A}{r^{7}}-\frac{12 B}{r^{13}}=0 \\
r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}} \\
E_{\min }=V_{\min }=\left.\left(-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}\right)\right|_{r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}}=-\frac{A^{2}}{B}
\end{gathered}
$$

（3）将 $V(r)$ 在 $r=r_{0}=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}$ 处作泰勒展开，或令 $r^{\prime}=r-r_{0}$ ，在 $r^{\prime}=0$ 处作泰勒展开，只保留二级小量，

$$
\begin{aligned}
V\left(r^{\prime}\right) & \approx V\left(r_{0}\right)+\left.\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} V}{\mathrm{~d} r^{2}}\right|_{r=r_{0}} r^{\prime 2} \\
& =-\left.\frac{A^{2}}{B}+\frac{1}{2}\left(-84 \frac{A}{r^{8}}+156 \frac{B}{r^{14}}\right)\right|_{r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}} r^{\prime 2} \\
& =-\frac{A^{2}}{B}+36 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime 2}
\end{aligned}
$$

在最低能态附近，

$$
\begin{aligned}
L= & m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{4} m\left[\dot{r}^{\prime 2}+\left(r_{0}+r^{\prime}\right)^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}\right. \\
& \left.+\left(r_{0}+r^{\prime}\right)^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right]-36 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime 2}+\frac{A^{2}}{B}
\end{aligned}
$$

注意： $r^{\prime} 、 \dot{r}^{\prime} 、 \ddot{r}^{\prime} 、 \dot{\theta} 、 \dot{\varphi} 、 \ddot{\theta} 、 \ddot{\varphi}$ 均为小量，由 $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}_{i}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial q_{i}}=0$ 得运动微分方程，只保留微分方程中的一级小量，可见只有关于 $r^{\prime}$ 的微分方程是振动的方程。可得

$$
\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{\prime}+72 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime}=0
$$

在最低能态附近做小振动的角频率为

$$
\omega=\sqrt{72 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} / \frac{1}{2} m}=12 m^{-1 / 2} A^{7 / 6} B^{-2 / 3}
$$

Solution (1) Take the system's center of mass coordinates $x, y, z$ and the spherical coordinates of one atom relative to another atom $r, \theta, \varphi$ as generalized coordinates.

$$
\begin{aligned}
L= & \frac{1}{2} \times 2 m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+2 \times \frac{1}{2} m\left[\left(\frac{\dot{r}}{2}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right]+\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}-\frac{B}{r^{12}} \\
= & m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{4} m\left(\dot{r}^{2}+r^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}+r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right)+\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}-\frac{B}{r^{12}} \\
& p_{x}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}}=2 m \dot{x} \\
& p_{y}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{y}}=2 m \dot{y} \\
& p_{z}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}}=2 m \dot{z} \\
& p_{r}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{r}}=\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r} \\
& p_{\theta}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}=\frac{1}{2} m r^{2} \dot{\theta} \\
& p_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}}=\frac{1}{2} m r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi} \\
H= & p_{x} \dot{x}+p_{y} \dot{y}+p_{z} \dot{z}+p_{r} \dot{r}+p_{\theta} \dot{\theta}+p_{\varphi} \dot{\varphi}-L \\
= & \frac{1}{4 m}\left(p_{x}^{2}+p_{y}^{2}+p_{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{m}\left(p_{r}^{2}+\frac{p_{\theta}^{2}}{r^{2}}+\frac{p_{\varphi}^{2}}{m r^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta}\right)-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}
\end{aligned}
$$

(2) The lowest classical state, $T=0, V$ takes the minimum value,

$$
\begin{gathered}
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} r}\left(-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}\right)=0 \\
\frac{12 A}{r^{7}}-\frac{12 B}{r^{13}}=0 \\
r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}} \\
E_{\min }=V_{\min }=\left.\left(-\frac{2 A}{r^{6}}+\frac{B}{r^{12}}\right)\right|_{r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}}=-\frac{A^{2}}{B}
\end{gathered}
$$

(3) Perform a Taylor expansion of $V(r)$ at $r=r_{0}=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}$, or let $r^{\prime}=r-r_{0}$, and perform a Taylor expansion at $r^{\prime}=0$, keeping only second-order small quantities,

$$
\begin{aligned}
V\left(r^{\prime}\right) & \approx V\left(r_{0}\right)+\left.\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} V}{\mathrm{~d} r^{2}}\right|_{r=r_{0}} r^{\prime 2} \\
& =-\left.\frac{A^{2}}{B}+\frac{1}{2}\left(-84 \frac{A}{r^{8}}+156 \frac{B}{r^{14}}\right)\right|_{r=\left(\frac{B}{A}\right)^{\frac{1}{6}}} r^{\prime 2} \\
& =-\frac{A^{2}}{B}+36 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime 2}
\end{aligned}
$$

Near the lowest energy state,

$$
\begin{aligned}
L= & m\left(\dot{x}^{2}+\dot{y}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)+\frac{1}{4} m\left[\dot{r}^{\prime 2}+\left(r_{0}+r^{\prime}\right)^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2}\right. \\
& \left.+\left(r_{0}+r^{\prime}\right)^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta \dot{\varphi}^{2}\right]-36 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime 2}+\frac{A^{2}}{B}
\end{aligned}
$$

Note: $r^{\prime}, \dot{r}^{\prime}, \ddot{r}^{\prime}, \dot{\theta}, \dot{\varphi}, \ddot{\theta}, \ddot{\varphi}$ are all small quantities. From $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}_{i}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial q_{i}}=0$, the equations of motion are obtained. Keeping only first-order small quantities in the differential equations, it can be seen that only the differential equation concerning $r^{\prime}$ is an oscillatory equation. We obtain

$$
\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{\prime}+72 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} r^{\prime}=0
$$

The angular frequency of small oscillations near the lowest energy state is

$$
\omega=\sqrt{72 \frac{A^{7 / 3}}{B^{4 / 3}} / \frac{1}{2} m}=12 m^{-1 / 2} A^{7 / 6} B^{-2 / 3}
$$

question:
已知
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \varphi=f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
& \psi=f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
计算泊松括号 $[\varphi, \psi]$.
solution:
解
$$
\begin{gathered}
\varphi=f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
\psi=f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
{\left[\varphi, \psi^{\prime}\right]=\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial q_{1}} \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial p_{1}}-\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial p_{1}} \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial q_{1}}+\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial q_{2}} \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial p_{2}}-\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial p_{2}} \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial q_{2}}}
\end{gathered}
$$
这是用泊松括号的定义进行直接计算，更方便的办法是利用泊松括号运算的性质，
$$
\begin{aligned}
{[\varphi, \psi] } & =\left[f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right), f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right), f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\right] \\
& =f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\left[f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right), f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right)\right] f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
& +f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right)\left[f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right), f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\right] f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) \\
& =f_{2} f_{4}\left[f_{1}, f_{3}\right]+f_{1} f_{3}\left[f_{2}, f_{4}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

question:
Given
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \varphi=f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
& \psi=f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
calculate the Poisson bracket $[\varphi, \psi]$.
solution:
The solution is directly calculated using the definition of the Poisson bracket. A more convenient method is to use the properties of the Poisson bracket operation,
$$
\begin{aligned}
{[\varphi, \psi] } & =\left[f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right), f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right), f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\right] \\
& =f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\left[f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right), f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right)\right] f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right) \\
& +f_{1}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right)\left[f_{2}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right), f_{4}\left(q_{2}, p_{2}\right)\right] f_{3}\left(q_{1}, p_{1}\right) \\
& =f_{2} f_{4}\left[f_{1}, f_{3}\right]+f_{1} f_{3}\left[f_{2}, f_{4}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$.

question: 试用哈密顿原理求复摆做微振动的周期.
solution:
解
$$
\begin{gathered}
L=\frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-m g l(1-\cos \theta) \approx \frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta^{2} \\
S[\theta(t)]=\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}} L \mathrm{~d} t=\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(\frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta^{2}\right) \mathrm{d} t
\end{gathered}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta S & =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(I \dot{\theta} \delta \dot{\theta}-m g l \theta \delta \theta\right) \mathrm{d} t \\
& =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(I \dot{\theta} \frac{\mathrm{~d}}{\mathrm{~d} t} \delta \theta-m g l \theta \delta \theta\right) \mathrm{d} t \\
& =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left\{\frac{\mathrm{~d}}{\mathrm{~d} t}(I \dot{\theta} \delta \theta)-\left[\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} t}(I \dot{\theta})+m g l \theta\right] \delta \theta\right\} \mathrm{d} t \\
& =I \dot{\theta} \delta \theta \int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}-\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}(I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta) \delta \theta \mathrm{d} t \\
& =-\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}(I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta) \delta \theta \mathrm{d} t=0
\end{aligned}
$$
这里用了在 $t=t_{0}$ 和 $t=t_{1}, \delta \theta=0$,
$$
\frac{I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta=0}{\omega}=\sqrt{\frac{m g l}{I}}, \quad T=\frac{2 \pi}{\omega}=2 \pi \sqrt{\frac{I}{m g l}}
$$

question: Use Hamilton's principle to find the period of small oscillations of a compound pendulum.
solution:
Solution:
$$
\begin{gathered}
L=\frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-m g l(1-\cos \theta) \approx \frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta^{2} \\
S[\theta(t)]=\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}} L \mathrm{~d} t=\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(\frac{1}{2} I \dot{\theta}^{2}-\frac{1}{2} m g l \theta^{2}\right) \mathrm{d} t
\end{gathered}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta S & =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(I \dot{\theta} \delta \dot{\theta}-m g l \theta \delta \theta\right) \mathrm{d} t \\
& =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left(I \dot{\theta} \frac{\mathrm{~d}}{\mathrm{~d} t} \delta \theta-m g l \theta \delta \theta\right) \mathrm{d} t \\
& =\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}\left\{\frac{\mathrm{~d}}{\mathrm{~d} t}(I \dot{\theta} \delta \theta)-\left[\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} t}(I \dot{\theta})+m g l \theta\right] \delta \theta\right\} \mathrm{d} t \\
& =I \dot{\theta} \delta \theta \int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}-\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}(I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta) \delta \theta \mathrm{d} t \\
& =-\int_{t_{0}}^{t_{1}}(I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta) \delta \theta \mathrm{d} t=0
\end{aligned}
$$
Here, it is used that at $t=t_{0}$ and $t=t_{1}, \delta \theta=0$,
$$
\frac{I \ddot{\theta}+m g l \theta=0}{\omega}=\sqrt{\frac{m g l}{I}}, \quad T=\frac{2 \pi}{\omega}=2 \pi \sqrt{\frac{I}{m g l}}
$$.

question: 质量为 $m$ 的粒子在势场 $V(r)=\frac{k}{r^{2}}(k>0$ 且为常量)中运动，用拉格朗日-沙比方法求轨道方程。
solution:
解
$$ H=\frac{1}{2 m}\left(p_{r}^{2}+\frac{1}{r^{2}} p_{\varphi}^{2}\right)+\frac{k}{r^{2}} $$
因为 $\frac{\partial H}{\partial t}=0$ ，可令
$$ S=-h t+W(r, \varphi) $$
$W$ 满足的偏微分方程为
$$ \frac{1}{2 m}\left[\left(\frac{\partial W}{\partial r}\right)^{2}+\frac{1}{r^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}\right)^{2}\right]+\frac{k}{r^{2}}=h $$
用拉格朗日-沙比方法, 取 $r=x, \varphi=y$, 则
$$ \frac{\partial W}{\partial r}=p, \quad \frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}=q $$
F=\frac{1}{2 m}\left(p^{2}+\frac{1}{x^{2}} q^{2}\right)+\frac{k}{x^{2}}-h
$$
X=\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=-\frac{q^{2}}{m x^{3}}-\frac{2 k}{x^{3}}$$
$$Y=\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=0 $$
$$P=\frac{\partial F}{\partial p}=\frac{1}{m} p $$
Q=\frac{\partial F}{\partial q}=\frac{1}{m x^{2}} q$$
由 $\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{P}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{Q}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{X}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} q}{Y}$ ，得
$$ \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\frac{1}{m} p}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\frac{1}{m x^{2}} q}=\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{\frac{q^{2}}{m x^{3}}+\frac{2 k}{x^{3}}}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} q}{0} $$
$$\mathrm{~d} q=0 $$
所以
$$q=\alpha $$
$$\frac{1}{m} p \mathrm{~d} p=\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m x^{3}}+\frac{2 k}{x^{3}}\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m}+2 k\right) \frac{1}{x^{3}} \mathrm{~d} x $$
$$\frac{1}{2 m} p^{2}=-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m}+2 k\right) \frac{1}{x^{2}}+h $$
$$p=\frac{1}{x} \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)} $$
$$\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\frac{1}{m} \cdot \frac{1}{x} \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)}}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\frac{1}{m x^{2}} \alpha} $$
$$\mathrm{~d} y=\frac{\alpha}{x \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)}} \mathrm{d} x$$

question: A particle with mass $m$ moves in a potential field $V(r)=\frac{k}{r^{2}}$ (where $k>0$ and is a constant). Use the Lagrange-Jacobi method to find the equation of the orbit.
solution:
Solution:  
Since \(\frac{\partial H}{\partial t}=0\), let  
\[ S=-h t+W(r, \varphi) \]  
The partial differential equation that \(W\) satisfies is  
\[ \frac{1}{2 m}\left[\left(\frac{\partial W}{\partial r}\right)^{2}+\frac{1}{r^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}\right)^{2}\right]+\frac{k}{r^{2}}=h \]  
Using the Lagrange-Charpit method, let \(r=x, \varphi=y\), then  
\[ \frac{\partial W}{\partial r}=p, \quad \frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}=q \]  
\[ F=\frac{1}{2 m}\left(p^{2}+\frac{1}{x^{2}} q^{2}\right)+\frac{k}{x^{2}}-h \]  
\[ X=\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=-\frac{q^{2}}{m x^{3}}-\frac{2 k}{x^{3}} \]  
\[ Y=\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=0 \]  
\[ P=\frac{\partial F}{\partial p}=\frac{1}{m} p \]  
\[ Q=\frac{\partial F}{\partial q}=\frac{1}{m x^{2}} q \]  
From \(\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{P}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{Q}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{X}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} q}{Y}\), we have  
\[ \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\frac{1}{m} p}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\frac{1}{m x^{2}} q}=\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{\frac{q^{2}}{m x^{3}}+\frac{2 k}{x^{3}}}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} q}{0} \]  
\[ \mathrm{d} q=0 \]  
Therefore,  
\[ q=\alpha \]  
\[ \frac{1}{m} p \mathrm{~d} p=\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m x^{3}}+\frac{2 k}{x^{3}}\right) \mathrm{d} x=\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m}+2 k\right) \frac{1}{x^{3}} \mathrm{~d} x \]  
\[ \frac{1}{2 m} p^{2}=-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\alpha^{2}}{m}+2 k\right) \frac{1}{x^{2}}+h \]  
\[ p=\frac{1}{x} \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)} \]  
\[ \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\frac{1}{m} \cdot \frac{1}{x} \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)}}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\frac{1}{m x^{2}} \alpha} \]  
\[ \mathrm{d} y=\frac{\alpha}{x \sqrt{2 m h x^{2}-\left(\alpha^{2}+2 m k\right)}} \mathrm{d} x \]

question: 实验表明：在靠近地面处有相当强的电场， $\boldsymbol{E}$ 垂直于地面向下，大小约为 $100 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$ ；在离地面 $1.5 \mathrm{~km}$ 高的地方， $\boldsymbol{E}$ 也是垂直于地面向下，大小约为 $25 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$ 。 (1) 试计算从地面到此高度大气中电荷的平均体密度； (2) 如果地球的电荷均匀分布在表面，求地面上电荷的面密度。
solution:
解 （1）可以作一柱面，其高度 $h=1.5 \mathrm{~km}$ ，下底 $\Delta S_{1}$ 贴近地面，上底 $\Delta S_{2}$ 在高空 $h$ 处，且 $\Delta S_{1}=\Delta S_{2} \equiv \Delta S$ 。兹对此柱面应用电场通量定理，
且
即
$$\iint E \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{0}} \bar{\rho}(h \cdot \Delta S)$$
$$\iint E \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=E_{1} \Delta S-E_{2} \Delta S=\left(E_{1}-E_{2}\right) \Delta S$$
$$\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{0}} \bar{\rho}(h \cdot \Delta S)=\left(E_{1}-E_{2}\right) \Delta S$$
求得该区域大气层中的平均体电荷密度为
$$\begin{aligned} \bar{\rho} & =\varepsilon_{0} \frac{E_{1}-E_{2}}{h} \\ & =8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times \frac{(100-25)}{1.5 \times 10^{3}} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \approx 4.4 \times 10^{-13} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \end{aligned}$$
（2）据地面邻近电场值 $E_{0}=100 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$ ，且方向朝下，可判定地面上有面电荷，且为负值；另外，须知，大气层中的体电荷对地面的电场无贡献。采取球形近似，设地表的面电荷密度为 $\sigma_{0}$ ，根据电场边值关系
$$E_{0}=\frac{\sigma_{0}}{\varepsilon_{0}}$$
得
$$\sigma_{0}=\varepsilon_{0} E_{0}=8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times(-100) \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}=-8.85 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$$

question: Experiments show that there is a fairly strong electric field near the ground, with $\boldsymbol{E}$ directed downward perpendicular to the ground, and its magnitude is approximately $100 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$; at a height of $1.5 \mathrm{~km}$ above the ground, $\boldsymbol{E}$ is also directed downward perpendicular to the ground, with a magnitude of approximately $25 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$. (1) Try to calculate the average volume charge density in the atmosphere from the ground to this height; (2) If the Earth's charge is uniformly distributed on the surface, find the surface charge density on the ground.
solution:
Solution (1) A cylindrical column can be constructed with height $h=1.5 \mathrm{~km}$, with the bottom surface $\Delta S_{1}$ close to the ground and the top surface $\Delta S_{2}$ at a height $h$, where $\Delta S_{1}=\Delta S_{2} \equiv \Delta S$. Applying Gauss's law for electric flux to this cylinder, we have

$$\iint E \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{0}} \bar{\rho}(h \cdot \Delta S)$$

$$\iint E \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=E_{1} \Delta S-E_{2} \Delta S=\left(E_{1}-E_{2}\right) \Delta S$$

$$\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{0}} \bar{\rho}(h \cdot \Delta S)=\left(E_{1}-E_{2}\right) \Delta S$$

The average volume charge density in the atmospheric region is obtained as

$$\begin{aligned} \bar{\rho} & =\varepsilon_{0} \frac{E_{1}-E_{2}}{h} \\ & =8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times \frac{(100-25)}{1.5 \times 10^{3}} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \approx 4.4 \times 10^{-13} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \end{aligned}$$

(2) Given the electric field value near the ground $E_{0}=100 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$, directed downward, it can be determined that there is a surface charge on the ground, and it is negative. Additionally, it is known that the volume charge in the atmosphere does not contribute to the electric field at the ground. Assuming a spherical approximation, let the surface charge density on the ground be $\sigma_{0}$, and using the boundary condition for the electric field,

$$E_{0}=\frac{\sigma_{0}}{\varepsilon_{0}}$$

we obtain

$$\sigma_{0}=\varepsilon_{0} E_{0}=8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times(-100) \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}=-8.85 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$$.

question:
金属中传导电子的漂移速度

以金属铜为例. 铜 $(\mathrm{Cu})$ 的质量密度为 $8.9 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, 铜的原子量为 $63.75 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mol}$, 金属铜里每个铜原子提供一个自由电子 $(-e), e=1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, 阿伏伽德罗常量 $N_{\mathrm{A}}=6.02 \times 10^{23} / \mathrm{mol}$, 铜的电阻率 $\rho$在 $18^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 时为 $1.68 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}$. 据这些基本数据, 请作出以下推算.
(1) 金属铜中传导电子数密度 $n_{0}$ 为多少 $\left(1 / \mathrm{cm}^{3}\right)$ ?
(2) 金属铜中传导电荷体密度 $\rho_{0}$ 为多少 $\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}\right)$ ?
(3) 金属铜中传导电子迁移率 $\mu$ 为多少 $\left(\mathrm{m}^{2} /(\mathrm{V} \cdot \mathrm{s})\right)$ ?
(4) 金属铜中传导电子漂移速度 $v$ 为多少 $(\mathrm{mm} / \mathrm{s})$ ? 设$j=10 \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{mm}^{2}$.
（5）从微观上看，金属铜中传导电子平均自由漂移时间 $\bar{\tau}$ 为多少（ms）？

Drift velocity of conduction electrons in metals

Take copper as an example. The mass density of copper (\(\mathrm{Cu}\)) is \(8.9 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}\), the atomic mass of copper is \(63.75 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mol}\), and each copper atom in metallic copper provides one free electron \((-e), e=1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}\), Avogadro's constant is \(N_{\mathrm{A}}=6.02 \times 10^{23} / \mathrm{mol}\), and the resistivity \(\rho\) of copper at \(18^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\) is \(1.68 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}\). Based on this basic data, please make the following calculations.
(1) What is the conduction electron number density \(n_{0}\) in metallic copper \(\left(1 / \mathrm{cm}^{3}\right)\)?
(2) What is the conduction charge density \(\rho_{0}\) in metallic copper \(\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}\right)\)?
(3) What is the electron mobility \(\mu\) in metallic copper \(\left(\mathrm{m}^{2} /(\mathrm{V} \cdot \mathrm{s})\right)\)?
(4) What is the drift velocity \(v\) of conduction electrons in metallic copper \((\mathrm{mm} / \mathrm{s})\)? Assume \(j=10 \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{mm}^{2}\).
(5) From a microscopic perspective, what is the average free drift time \(\bar{\tau}\) of conduction electrons in metallic copper (ms)?
求地面大气的电导率 $\sigma$ 。
solution:
解 根据电导率 $\sigma$ 与迁移率 $\mu$ 之关系式
$$\sigma=n_{+} q_{+} \mu_{+}+n_{-} q_{-} \mu_{-}$$
算出
$$\begin{aligned}\sigma & =5 \times 10^{6} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times(1.37+1.91) \times 10^{-4}(\Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m})^{-1} \\
& \approx 2.62 \times 10^{-16}(\Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m})^{-1}\end{aligned}$$

question: etermine the electrical conductivity ($\sigma$) of the Earth's atmosphere.
solution:
Solution: According to the relationship between conductivity $\sigma$ and mobility $\mu$ 
$$\sigma=n_{+} q_{+} \mu_{+}+n_{-} q_{-} \mu_{-}$$
calculate
$$\begin{aligned}\sigma & =5 \times 10^{6} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times(1.37+1.91) \times 10^{-4}(\Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m})^{-1} \\
& \approx 2.62 \times 10^{-16}(\Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m})^{-1}\end{aligned}$$.

question: 一均匀磁化磁棒，体积为 $0.01 \mathrm{~m}^{3}$，磁矩为 $500 \mathrm{~A} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{2}$，棒内沿轴某处的磁感应强度 $B=5.0 \mathrm{Gs}$，求该处磁场强度为多少 $\mathrm{A} / \mathrm{m}$。

A uniformly magnetized rod, with a volume of $0.01 \mathrm{~m}^{3}$ and a magnetic moment of $500 \mathrm{~A} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{2}$, has a magnetic induction $B=5.0 \mathrm{Gs}$ at a certain point along the axis inside the rod. Find the magnetic field strength at that point in $\mathrm{A} / \mathrm{m}$.
含 $LR$ 暂态电路一个自感为 0.50 mH 、电阻为 $0.01 \Omega$ 的线圈连接到内阻可以忽略、电动势为 12 V 的电源上. 开关接通多长时间, 电流达到终值的 $90 \%$ ？到此时线圈中储存了多少能量？电源消耗了多少能量？
solution: 解 $(L, R, \mathscr{E})$ 电路充磁过程的时间常数为$$\tau=\frac{L}{R}=\frac{0.50 \times 10^{-3}}{0.01} \mathrm{~s}=50 \mathrm{~ms}(\text { 毫秒 })$$当时长 $t_{0} \approx 2.3 \tau$, 其电流 $i(t)$ 便达到终值 $i(\infty)=\frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}$ 的 $90 \%$, 即$$t_{0} \approx 2.3 \times 50 \mathrm{~ms}=115 \mathrm{~ms}, \quad I\left(t_{0}\right)=0.90 \times \frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}$$此时线圈中储能为$$\begin{aligned} W_{L}\left(t_{0}\right) & =\frac{1}{2} L I^{2}\left(t_{0}\right)=\frac{1}{2} L\left(0.90 \frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}\right)^{2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \times 0.5 \times 10^{-3} \times\left(0.9 \times \frac{12}{0.01}\right)^{2} \mathrm{~J} \approx 292 \mathrm{~J} \end{aligned}$$电源在 $t \in\left(0, t_{0}\right)$ 时段提供的能量为$$\begin{aligned} W_{\mathscr{E}} & =\int_{0}^{t_{0}} \mathscr{E} i \mathrm{~d} t=\frac{\mathscr{E}^{2}}{R} \int_{0}^{t_{0}}\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{t}{\tau}}\right) \mathrm{d} t=\frac{\mathscr{E}^{2}}{R}\left(t_{0}+0.1 \tau\right) \\ & =\frac{12^{2}}{0.01} \times 2.4 \times 50 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~J} \approx 1728 \mathrm{~J} \end{aligned}$$

question: A transient $LR$ circuit with an inductance of 0.50 mH and a resistance of $0.01 \Omega$ is connected to a power supply with negligible internal resistance and an electromotive force of 12 V. How long does it take for the current to reach $90\%$ of its final value after the switch is closed? How much energy is stored in the coil by this time? How much energy has the power supply consumed?
solution: To solve the problem of the time constant for the magnetization process of the $(L, R, \mathscr{E})$ circuit, we have $$\tau=\frac{L}{R}=\frac{0.50 \times 10^{-3}}{0.01} \mathrm{~s}=50 \mathrm{~ms}(\text{ milliseconds })$$ When the duration $t_{0} \approx 2.3 \tau$, the current $i(t)$ reaches $90\%$ of its final value $i(\infty)=\frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}$, i.e., $$t_{0} \approx 2.3 \times 50 \mathrm{~ms}=115 \mathrm{~ms}, \quad I\left(t_{0}\right)=0.90 \times \frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}$$ At this time, the energy stored in the coil is $$\begin{aligned} W_{L}\left(t_{0}\right) & =\frac{1}{2} L I^{2}\left(t_{0}\right)=\frac{1}{2} L\left(0.90 \frac{\mathscr{E}}{R}\right)^{2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \times 0.5 \times 10^{-3} \times\left(0.9 \times \frac{12}{0.01}\right)^{2} \mathrm{~J} \approx 292 \mathrm{~J} \end{aligned}$$ The energy supplied by the power source during the period $t \in\left(0, t_{0}\right)$ is $$\begin{aligned} W_{\mathscr{E}} & =\int_{0}^{t_{0}} \mathscr{E} i \mathrm{~d} t=\frac{\mathscr{E}^{2}}{R} \int_{0}^{t_{0}}\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{t}{\tau}}\right) \mathrm{d} t=\frac{\mathscr{E}^{2}}{R}\left(t_{0}+0.1 \tau\right) \\ & =\frac{12^{2}}{0.01} \times 2.4 \times 50 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~J} \approx 1728 \mathrm{~J} \end{aligned}$$.

question: 现需绕制一个电源变压器，其输入端电压为 $220 \mathrm{~V}, 50 \mathrm{~Hz}$ ，要求其输出电压分别有 6 V 和 40 V ，试求出原线圈匝数 $N_{0}$ 和两组副线圈匝数 $N_{1}$ 和 $N_{2}$ 。已知其铁芯面积 $S$ 为 $8.0 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ ，其最大磁感 $B_{\mathrm{M}}$ 为 $1.2 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{Gs}$ ，作理想变压器近似。
solution:
解 一匝线圈所能承载的最大交流电动势 $\mathscr{E}_{\mathrm{IM}}$ ，受制于铁芯所能提供的最大磁感值 $B_{\mathrm{M}}$ ，设 $B_{1}(t)=B_{\mathrm{M}} \cos \omega t$ ，则 $\Phi_{1}(t)=$ $S B_{\mathrm{M}} \cos \omega t$ ，于是，

即

$$
\mathscr{E}_{1}(t)=-\frac{\mathrm{d} \Phi_{1}}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}} \sin \omega t
$$

$$
\mathscr{E}_{\mathrm{M}}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}
$$

设输人端电压为 220 V （有效值），其相应峰值为 $U_{0}=220 \sqrt{2} \mathrm{~V}$ ，则原
线圈匝数 $N_{0}$ 应当满足

$$
\frac{U_{0}}{N_{0}} \leqslant \delta_{\mathrm{M}}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}
$$

得

$$
N_{0} \geqslant \frac{U_{0}}{\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}}=\frac{220 \sqrt{2}}{2 \pi \times 50 \times 8 \times 10^{-4} \times 1.2} \approx 1032(\text { 匝 }) .
$$

根据理想变压器的电压变比公式，得

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N_{1}=\frac{6 \mathrm{~V}}{220 \mathrm{~V}} \times 1032 \approx 28(\text { 匝 }) \\
& N_{2}=\frac{40 \mathrm{~V}}{220 \mathrm{~V}} \times 1032 \approx 188(\text { 匝 })
\end{aligned}
$$

question: It is required to wind a power transformer with an input voltage of $220 \mathrm{~V}, 50 \mathrm{~Hz}$, and output voltages of 6 V and 40 V, respectively. Determine the number of turns for the primary coil $N_{0}$ and the two sets of secondary coil turns $N_{1}$ and $N_{2}$. The core area $S$ is known to be $8.0 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$, and the maximum magnetic induction $B_{\mathrm{M}}$ is $1.2 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{Gs}$. Assume the transformer is ideal.
solution:
The maximum alternating electromotive force $\mathscr{E}_{\mathrm{IM}}$ that a single turn coil can withstand is limited by the maximum magnetic flux density $B_{\mathrm{M}}$ that the iron core can provide. Given $B_{1}(t)=B_{\mathrm{M}} \cos \omega t$, then $\Phi_{1}(t)= S B_{\mathrm{M}} \cos \omega t$, thus,

i.e.,

$$
\mathscr{E}_{1}(t)=-\frac{\mathrm{d} \Phi_{1}}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}} \sin \omega t
$$

$$
\mathscr{E}_{\mathrm{M}}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}
$$

Assuming the input terminal voltage is 220 V (rms), the corresponding peak value is $U_{0}=220 \sqrt{2} \mathrm{~V}$, then the number of turns $N_{0}$ of the primary coil should satisfy

$$
\frac{U_{0}}{N_{0}} \leqslant \delta_{\mathrm{M}}=\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}
$$

Thus,

$$
N_{0} \geqslant \frac{U_{0}}{\omega S B_{\mathrm{M}}}=\frac{220 \sqrt{2}}{2 \pi \times 50 \times 8 \times 10^{-4} \times 1.2} \approx 1032(\text { turns }) .
$$

According to the voltage transformation ratio formula of an ideal transformer, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N_{1}=\frac{6 \mathrm{~V}}{220 \mathrm{~V}} \times 1032 \approx 28(\text { turns }) \\
& N_{2}=\frac{40 \mathrm{~V}}{220 \mathrm{~V}} \times 1032 \approx 188(\text { turns })
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 实验上测得 NaCl 晶体的比重为 $2.16 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$ ，弹性模量为 $2.41 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~N} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$ ，试求其结合能。（已知 NaCl 晶体结构的马德隆常数 $M=1.7476, \mathrm{Na}$ 和 Cl 原子量分别为 23和 35.45. )
solution:
解 由 $N$ 个 $\mathrm{Na}^{+}, \mathrm{Cl}^{-}$离子组成的 NaCl 晶体的相互作用能

$$
U(r)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}-\frac{B}{r^{n}}\right)
$$
在热平衡条件下
$$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d} U(r)}{\mathrm{d} r}\right|_{r_{0}}=-\left.\frac{N}{2}\left(-\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{2}}+\frac{n B}{r^{n+1}}\right)\right|_{r_{0}}=0
$$
得

$$r_{0}=\left(\frac{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}{M e^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n+1}}
$$
$r_{0}$ 是平衡下最近邻离子间距，代入（1）式， NaCl 晶体结合能

$$U_{0}=U\left(r_{0}\right)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}-\frac{B}{r_{0} \cdot r_{0}^{n-1}}\right)=-\frac{N M e^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)
$$
由上式得知，只需知道 $r_{0}$ 和 $n$ 值，就可求出 NaCl 晶体结合能。首先由 NaCl 晶体比重求 $r_{0}$ 值. NaCl 晶体是由 $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$与 $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$离子各自构成的而心立方结构的子晶体各沿坐标轴移动 $\frac{a}{2}$ ( $a$ 是晶格常数) 套构而成的, $a=2 r$, 而 NaCl 晶体一个晶胞内含有 8 个离子 $\left(\mathrm{Na}^{+}\right.$和 $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$各 4 个)，故其体积

$$V=\frac{N}{8} \cdot 8 r^{3}=N r^{3}
$$
每摩尔 NaCl 晶体中含有 $N_{0}$ (阿伏伽德罗常量) 个 NaCl 分子, 每个分子质量应为

$$\frac{23+35,45}{N_{0}}(\mathrm{~g})
$$
NaCl 晶体每一晶胞中有 4 个 NaCl 分子，故一个晶胞质量为

$$4 \times \frac{23+35,45}{N_{0}}(\mathrm{~g})
$$
NaCl 晶体比重

$$D=\frac{4 \times \frac{23+35,45}{N_{0}}}{8 r_{0}^{3}}=\frac{58,45}{2 N_{0} r_{0}^{3}}=\frac{29,225}{N_{0} r_{0}^{3}}
$$
所以

$$r_{0}=\sqrt[3]{\frac{29,225}{N_{0} D}}=\sqrt[3]{\frac{29,225}{6,02 \times 10^{23} \times 2,16}}=2,82 \times 10^{-8}(\mathrm{~cm})=2,82 \times 10^{-10}(\mathrm{~m})
$$
$n$ 则能由实验测得的弹性模量 $K$ 和晶体结构算出. NaCl 晶体弹性模量 $K$ (参考题解 $1,24):$

$$K=\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial V^{2}}\right)_{V_{0}} \cdot V_{0}=\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} r}{\mathrm{~d} V}\right)_{r_{0}}^{2} \cdot\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}} \cdot V_{0}
$$
由（3）式，则

$$\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} V}{\mathrm{~d} r}\right)_{r_{0}}=3 N r_{0}^{2}
$$
在 $r=r_{0}$ 处，对（1）式求出二次偏导

$$\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}}=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{n+2}}\right)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{3} \cdot r_{0}^{n-1}}
$$
把 $r_{0}=\left(\frac{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}{M e^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n+1}}$ 代入

$$\begin{aligned}
\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}} & =-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{3}} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}\right)=-\frac{N}{2} \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}[2-(n+1)] \ & =\frac{N}{2} \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}(n-1)
\end{aligned}
$$
把（5）、（6）式和 $V_{0}=N r_{0}^{3}$ 代入（4）式得出

$$K=\left(\frac{1}{3 N r_{0}^{2}}\right)^{2} \cdot \frac{N}{2} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}} \cdot(n-1) r_{0}^{3} N=\frac{1}{9 r_{0}^{3}} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}(n-1)
$$
所以

$$\begin{aligned}
n & =1+\frac{72 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}{M e^{2}} K \ & =1+\frac{72 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times\left(2.82 \times 10^{-10}\right)^{4} \times 2.41 \times 10^{10}}{1.7476 \times\left(1.602 \times 10^{-12}\right)^{2}} \ & =1+6.8=7.8
\end{aligned}
$$
故由（2）式得到 1 mol NaCl 晶体结合能应为（注意， $N=2 N_{0}$ ）

$$\begin{aligned}
U_{0} & =-\frac{2 N_{0}}{2} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)=-\frac{N_{0} M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right) \ & =-\frac{6.02 \times 10^{29} \times 1.7476 \times\left(1.6 \times 10^{-19}\right)^{2}}{4 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.82 \times 10^{-10}} \times\left(1-\frac{1}{7.8}\right) \ & =-7.51 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{mol})=-179.3(\mathrm{kcal} / \mathrm{mol})
\end{aligned}
$$
同时也计算出每离子对间相互作用能

$$\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{b}} & =-\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right) \ & =-\frac{1.7476 \times\left(1.6 \times 10^{-19}\right)^{2}}{4 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.82 \times 10^{-10}} \times\left(1-\frac{1}{7.8}\right) \ & =-1.24 \times 10^{-18}(\mathrm{~J})
\end{aligned}
$$
与实验值 $-1.27 \times 10^{-18} \mathrm{~J}$ 相当接近。

question: The experimentally measured specific gravity of NaCl crystal is $2.16 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, and the elastic modulus is $2.41 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~N} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$. Try to find its binding energy. (It is known that the Madelung constant for the NaCl crystal structure is $M=1.7476$, and the atomic masses of Na and Cl are 23 and 35.45, respectively.)
solution:
Solve the interaction energy of an NaCl crystal composed of $N$ $\mathrm{Na}^{+}, \mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ ions

$$
U(r)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}-\frac{B}{r^{n}}\right)
$$
Under thermal equilibrium conditions
$$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d} U(r)}{\mathrm{d} r}\right|_{r_{0}}=-\left.\frac{N}{2}\left(-\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{2}}+\frac{n B}{r^{n+1}}\right)\right|_{r_{0}}=0
$$
yielding

$$r_{0}=\left(\frac{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}{M e^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n+1}}
$$
$r_{0}$ is the equilibrium nearest-neighbor ion distance. Substituting into equation (1), the binding energy of the NaCl crystal is

$$U_{0}=U\left(r_{0}\right)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}-\frac{B}{r_{0} \cdot r_{0}^{n-1}}\right)=-\frac{N M e^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)
$$
From the above equation, it is known that the binding energy of the NaCl crystal can be calculated if $r_{0}$ and $n$ are known. First, determine the value of $r_{0}$ from the density of the NaCl crystal. The NaCl crystal is composed of sub-crystals of body-centered cubic structures formed by $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ and $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ ions, each shifted by $\frac{a}{2}$ along the coordinate axes ($a$ is the lattice constant), with $a=2 r$, and each unit cell of the NaCl crystal contains 8 ions (4 each of $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ and $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$), so its volume is

$$V=\frac{N}{8} \cdot 8 r^{3}=N r^{3}
$$
Each mole of NaCl crystal contains $N_{0}$ (Avogadro's constant) NaCl molecules, and the mass of each molecule should be

$$\frac{23+35.45}{N_{0}}(\mathrm{~g})
$$
Each unit cell of the NaCl crystal contains 4 NaCl molecules, so the mass of one unit cell is

$$4 \times \frac{23+35.45}{N_{0}}(\mathrm{~g})
$$
The density of the NaCl crystal is

$$D=\frac{4 \times \frac{23+35.45}{N_{0}}}{8 r_{0}^{3}}=\frac{58.45}{2 N_{0} r_{0}^{3}}=\frac{29.225}{N_{0} r_{0}^{3}}
$$
Thus

$$r_{0}=\sqrt[3]{\frac{29.225}{N_{0} D}}=\sqrt[3]{\frac{29.225}{6.02 \times 10^{23} \times 2.16}}=2.82 \times 10^{-8}(\mathrm{~cm})=2.82 \times 10^{-10}(\mathrm{~m})
$$
The value of $n$ can be calculated from the experimentally measured elastic modulus $K$ and the crystal structure. The elastic modulus $K$ of the NaCl crystal (refer to solution 1.24) is:

$$K=\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial V^{2}}\right)_{V_{0}} \cdot V_{0}=\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} r}{\mathrm{~d} V}\right)_{r_{0}}^{2} \cdot\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}} \cdot V_{0}
$$
From equation (3), we have

$$\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} V}{\mathrm{~d} r}\right)_{r_{0}}=3 N r_{0}^{2}
$$
At $r=r_{0}$, the second partial derivative of equation (1) is

$$\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}}=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{n+2}}\right)=-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{3} \cdot r_{0}^{n-1}}
$$
Substituting $r_{0}=\left(\frac{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}{M e^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n+1}}$, we get

$$\begin{aligned}
\left(\frac{\partial^{2} U}{\partial r^{2}}\right)_{r_{0}} & =-\frac{N}{2}\left(\frac{2 M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}-\frac{n(n+1) B}{r_{0}^{3}} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} n B}\right)=-\frac{N}{2} \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}[2-(n+1)] \ & =\frac{N}{2} \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}(n-1)
\end{aligned}
$$
Substituting equations (5), (6), and $V_{0}=N r_{0}^{3}$ into equation (4), we get

$$K=\left(\frac{1}{3 N r_{0}^{2}}\right)^{2} \cdot \frac{N}{2} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}} \cdot(n-1) r_{0}^{3} N=\frac{1}{9 r_{0}^{3}} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}(n-1)
$$
Therefore,

$$\begin{aligned}
n & =1+\frac{72 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}^{3}}{M e^{2}} K \ & =1+\frac{72 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times\left(2.82 \times 10^{-10}\right)^{4} \times 2.41 \times 10^{10}}{1.7476 \times\left(1.602 \times 10^{-12}\right)^{2}} \ & =1+6.8=7.8
\end{aligned}
$$
Thus, from equation (2), the binding energy of 1 mol of NaCl crystal should be (note that $N=2 N_{0}$)

$$\begin{aligned}
U_{0} & =-\frac{2 N_{0}}{2} \cdot \frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)=-\frac{N_{0} M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right) \ & =-\frac{6.02 \times 10^{29} \times 1.7476 \times\left(1.6 \times 10^{-19}\right)^{2}}{4 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.82 \times 10^{-10}} \times\left(1-\frac{1}{7.8}\right) \ & =-7.51 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{mol})=-179.3(\mathrm{kcal} / \mathrm{mol})
\end{aligned}
$$
Meanwhile, the interaction energy per ion pair is also calculated as

$$\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{b}} & =-\frac{M e^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right) \ & =-\frac{1.7476 \times\left(1.6 \times 10^{-19}\right)^{2}}{4 \times 3.1416 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.82 \times 10^{-10}} \times\left(1-\frac{1}{7.8}\right) \ & =-1.24 \times 10^{-18}(\mathrm{~J})
\end{aligned}
$$
which is quite close to the experimental value of $-1.27 \times 10^{-18} \mathrm{~J}$.

question: 一种二元合金由 $N_{A}$ 个金属原子 $A$ 和 $N_{B}$ 个金属原子 $B$ 组成, 这些原子组成一简单的立方晶格, 其中每个原子只和六个最近邻原子有相互作用, 对应于 $A-A$ 或 $B-B$ 结合和 $A-B$ 结合情况, 相互作用能分别是 $-J(J>0)$ 和 $+J$. (1) 计算合金的位形熵, 假定 $N=N_{A}+N_{B} \gg 1$; (2) 计算总的相互作用能, 假设原子是随机无规的分布在各个位置上的; (3) 计算系统的自由能 $F$ (作为 $x$ 的函数), 其中 $N_{A}=N(1+x) / 2, N_{B}=N(1-x) / 2$,展开 $F(x)$ 到 $x$ 的 4 次方, 证明存在一临界温度 $T_{c}$, 在此温度以上和以下, 曲线 $F(x)$ 具有特征不同的形状, 确定 $T_{c}$, 并对 $T>T_{c}$ 和 $T<T_{c}$, 画出 $F$ 作为 $x$ 的函数曲线; (4) 对 $T<T_{c}$, 具有成分 $|x|<x_{p}(T)$ 的系统不稳定, 并且分裂成具有不同成分的两个相. 根据 (3) 解答的结果, 求出 $x_{P}(T)$ 和两个分开相的成分.
solution:
解 (1) 按题设, 用极小量 $x$ 表示 $A B$ 二元合金中金属原子 $A$ 和原子 $B$ 数量对等量 $A, B$ 原子的偏离, 即 $x=0, N_{A}=N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}$, 故
$$N_{A}=\frac{N}{2}(1+x), \quad N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}(1-x)$$
有
$$\begin{gathered}N_{A}+N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}(1+x)+\frac{N}{2}(1-x)=N \\ \frac{N_{A}}{N_{B}}=\frac{1+x}{1-x}\end{gathered}$$
二元合金位形熵
$$S=k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln W$$
其中
$$W=\frac{N!}{N_{A}!N_{B}!}$$
利用斯特林公式 (当 $M$ 很大时)
$$\ln M!\approx M \ln M$$
得到
$$\ln W=N_{A} \ln \left(1+\frac{N_{B}}{N_{A}}\right)+N_{B} \ln \left(1+\frac{N_{A}}{N_{B}}\right)$$
代人 $N_{A}, N_{B}$ 表达式, 体系位形熵
$$S=N k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln 2-\frac{N}{2} k_{\mathrm{B}}[(1+x) \ln (1+x)+(1-x) \ln (1-x)]$$
$$=N k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln 2-\frac{N_{A}}{2} k_{\mathrm{B}}\left[\ln \left(1-x^{2}\right)+x \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}\right]$$
（2）先求出一个原子与周围最近邻 6 个原子的平均相互作用能 $u$ 。由于假设金属原子 $A, B$ 是随机无规的分布在各个位置上，所以平均来说，二元合金每一格点上都有 $\frac{N_{A}}{N}$ 比率的 $A$ 原子和 $\frac{N_{B}}{N}$ 比率的 $B$ 原子作为它的最近邻，而原子 $A$ 和 $B$ 本身在某一格点上出现比率也分别是 $\frac{N_{A}}{N}$ 和 $\frac{N_{B}}{N}$ 。故原子与最近邻原子平均相互作用能
$$\begin{aligned}u & =6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{A}}{N}+J \frac{N_{B}}{N}\right] \frac{N_{A}}{N}+6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{B}}{N}+J \frac{N_{A}}{N}\right] \frac{N_{B}}{N} \\ & =6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{A}^{2}+N_{B}^{2}}{N^{2}}+J \frac{2 N_{A} N_{B}}{N^{2}}\right]=-\frac{6 J}{N^{2}}\left(N_{A}-N_{B}\right)^{2}\end{aligned}$$
这样，由 $N_{A}$ 个金属原子 $A$ 和 $N_{B}$ 个金属原子 $B$ 组成的二元合金总的相互作用能为
$$U=\frac{N}{2} u=-\frac{3 J}{N}\left(N_{A}-N_{B}\right)^{2}=-3 N J x^{2}$$
（3）二元系统（体系）自由能
$$\begin{aligned}F & =U-T S \\ & =-3 N T x^{2}-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T \ln 2+\frac{N k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{2} x \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}+\frac{N k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{2} \ln \left(1-x^{2}\right) \\ & =-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T \ln 2+\left(\frac{1}{2} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-3 N J\right) x^{2}+\frac{1}{12} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{4}+\cdots\end{aligned}$$
推导中应用下列展开式:
$$\begin{aligned}& \ln (1+x)=x-\frac{1}{2} x^{2}+\frac{1}{3} x^{3}-\frac{1}{4} x^{4}+\cdots \\ & \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}=2\left(x+\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\frac{x^{5}}{5}+\cdots\right)\end{aligned}$$
为了找出在临界温度 $T_{c}$ ，系统自由能的变化性状。考虑 $x=0$ 时 $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}$ 和 $\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}$ ，由 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=0$ ，得出
$$2\left(\frac{1}{2} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-3 N J\right)=0$$
即
$$T_{c}=\frac{6 J}{k_{\mathrm{B}}}$$
故
$$\left(\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}\right)_{x=0}\left\{\begin{array}{l}=0, T=T_{c} \\ >0, T>T_{c}, F(0)=F_{\min } \\ <0, T<T_{c}, F(0)=F_{\max }\end{array}\right.$$可见 $T_{c}$ 即为临界转变温度，图1.45分别画出 $T>T_{c}$ 和 $T<T_{c}$ 情况下 $F(x)$ 曲线.
（4）如图1.45所示，在 $T<T_{c}$ 时， $x=x_{p}(T)$ 时的自由能 $F$ 具有极小值。而当 $|x|<x_{p}(T)$ 时系统自由能大于此极小值. 因此系统不稳定, 为求 $x_{p}(T), \diamond \frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=0$, 则
$$N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-6 N J+\frac{1}{3} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{2}=0$$
用 $T_{\mathrm{v}}=\frac{6 J}{k_{\mathrm{B}}}$ 来置换, 上式为
$$N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T_{\mathrm{v}}+\frac{1}{3} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{2}=0$$
由此得
$$x_{p}(T)= \pm \sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$
则两个分开相的成分分别为
$$x_{1}(T)=+\sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$
和
$$x_{2}(T)=-\sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$

question: A binary alloy consists of $N_{A}$ metal atoms of type $A$ and $N_{B}$ metal atoms of type $B$. These atoms form a simple cubic lattice, where each atom interacts with six nearest neighbor atoms, corresponding to $A-A$ or $B-B$ bonding and $A-B$ bonding situations. The interaction energies are $-J(J>0)$ and $+J$, respectively. (1) Calculate the configurational entropy of the alloy, assuming $N=N_{A}+N_{B} \gg 1$; (2) Calculate the total interaction energy, assuming the atoms are randomly distributed across the positions; (3) Calculate the free energy $F$ of the system (as a function of $x$), where $N_{A}=N(1+x) / 2, N_{B}=N(1-x) / 2$. Expand $F(x)$ to the fourth power of $x$, and prove that there exists a critical temperature $T_{c}$, above and below which the curve $F(x)$ has characteristically different shapes. Determine $T_{c}$ and plot the curve of $F$ as a function of $x$ for $T>T_{c}$ and $T<T_{c}$; (4) For $T<T_{c}$, the system with composition $|x|<x_{p}(T)$ is unstable and splits into two phases with different compositions. Based on the results of (3), find $x_{P}(T)$ and the compositions of the two separate phases.
solution:
Solution (1) According to the problem, using the small quantity \(x\) to represent the deviation from the equal number of metal atoms \(A\) and \(B\) in the binary alloy \(AB\), i.e., when \(x=0\), \(N_{A}=N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}\), we have
$$N_{A}=\frac{N}{2}(1+x), \quad N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}(1-x)$$
Thus,
$$\begin{gathered}N_{A}+N_{B}=\frac{N}{2}(1+x)+\frac{N}{2}(1-x)=N \\ \frac{N_{A}}{N_{B}}=\frac{1+x}{1-x}\end{gathered}$$
The configurational entropy of the binary alloy
$$S=k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln W$$
where
$$W=\frac{N!}{N_{A}!N_{B}!}$$
Using Stirling's approximation (when \(M\) is large)
$$\ln M!\approx M \ln M$$
we obtain
$$\ln W=N_{A} \ln \left(1+\frac{N_{B}}{N_{A}}\right)+N_{B} \ln \left(1+\frac{N_{A}}{N_{B}}\right)$$
Substituting the expressions for \(N_{A}\) and \(N_{B}\), the configurational entropy of the system becomes
$$S=N k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln 2-\frac{N}{2} k_{\mathrm{B}}[(1+x) \ln (1+x)+(1-x) \ln (1-x)]$$
$$=N k_{\mathrm{B}} \ln 2-\frac{N_{A}}{2} k_{\mathrm{B}}\left[\ln \left(1-x^{2}\right)+x \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}\right]$$
(2) First, find the average interaction energy \(u\) of one atom with its 6 nearest neighboring atoms. Since it is assumed that metal atoms \(A\) and \(B\) are randomly distributed across all positions, on average, each lattice point in the binary alloy has a ratio of \(\frac{N_{A}}{N}\) of atom \(A\) and a ratio of \(\frac{N_{B}}{N}\) of atom \(B\) as its nearest neighbors. The probabilities of atoms \(A\) and \(B\) themselves appearing at any lattice point are also \(\frac{N_{A}}{N}\) and \(\frac{N_{B}}{N}\), respectively. Therefore, the average interaction energy between an atom and its nearest neighbors is
$$\begin{aligned}u & =6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{A}}{N}+J \frac{N_{B}}{N}\right] \frac{N_{A}}{N}+6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{B}}{N}+J \frac{N_{A}}{N}\right] \frac{N_{B}}{N} \\ & =6\left[(-J) \frac{N_{A}^{2}+N_{B}^{2}}{N^{2}}+J \frac{2 N_{A} N_{B}}{N^{2}}\right]=-\frac{6 J}{N^{2}}\left(N_{A}-N_{B}\right)^{2}\end{aligned}$$
Thus, the total interaction energy of the binary alloy composed of \(N_{A}\) metal atoms \(A\) and \(N_{B}\) metal atoms \(B\) is
$$U=\frac{N}{2} u=-\frac{3 J}{N}\left(N_{A}-N_{B}\right)^{2}=-3 N J x^{2}$$
(3) The free energy of the binary system (system)
$$\begin{aligned}F & =U-T S \\ & =-3 N T x^{2}-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T \ln 2+\frac{N k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{2} x \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}+\frac{N k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{2} \ln \left(1-x^{2}\right) \\ & =-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T \ln 2+\left(\frac{1}{2} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-3 N J\right) x^{2}+\frac{1}{12} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{4}+\cdots\end{aligned}$$
The following expansion is used in the derivation:
$$\begin{aligned}& \ln (1+x)=x-\frac{1}{2} x^{2}+\frac{1}{3} x^{3}-\frac{1}{4} x^{4}+\cdots \\ & \ln \frac{1+x}{1-x}=2\left(x+\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\frac{x^{5}}{5}+\cdots\right)\end{aligned}$$
To find the behavior of the system's free energy at the critical temperature \(T_{c}\), consider \(\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}\) and \(\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}\) when \(x=0\). From \(\left.\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=0\), we obtain
$$2\left(\frac{1}{2} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-3 N J\right)=0$$
which gives
$$T_{c}=\frac{6 J}{k_{\mathrm{B}}}$$
Thus,
$$\left(\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}}\right)_{x=0}\left\{\begin{array}{l}=0, T=T_{c} \\ >0, T>T_{c}, F(0)=F_{\min } \\ <0, T<T_{c}, F(0)=F_{\max }\end{array}\right.$$ It can be seen that \(T_{c}\) is the critical transition temperature. Figure 1.45 shows the curves of \(F(x)\) for \(T>T_{c}\) and \(T<T_{c}\).
(4) As shown in Figure 1.45, at \(T<T_{c}\), the free energy \(F\) has a minimum value when \(x=x_{p}(T)\). When \(|x|<x_{p}(T)\), the system's free energy is greater than this minimum value. Therefore, the system is unstable. To find \(x_{p}(T)\), solve \(\diamond \frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=0\), then
$$N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-6 N J+\frac{1}{3} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{2}=0$$
Using \(T_{\mathrm{v}}=\frac{6 J}{k_{\mathrm{B}}}\) to substitute, the above equation becomes
$$N k_{\mathrm{B}} T-N k_{\mathrm{B}} T_{\mathrm{v}}+\frac{1}{3} N k_{\mathrm{B}} T x^{2}=0$$
From this, we obtain
$$x_{p}(T)= \pm \sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$
The compositions of the two separate phases are
$$x_{1}(T)=+\sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$
and
$$x_{2}(T)=-\sqrt{\frac{3\left(T_{\mathrm{v}}-T\right)}{T}}$$.

question:
试证在磁场中运动的布洛赫电子，在 $\boldsymbol{k}$ 空间中轨迹面积 $S_{n}$ 和在 $\boldsymbol{r}$ 空间的轨迹面积 $A_{n}$ 之间关系为
$$A_{n}=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} S_{n}$$
式中， $B$ 是磁场强度.
solution:
解 在磁场中电子受到洛仑兹力的作用. 由晶体电子准经典运动方程.
$$\hbar \frac{\mathrm{d} k}{\mathrm{~d} t}=-e(\boldsymbol{v} \times \boldsymbol{B})=-e\left(\frac{\mathrm{~d} r}{\mathrm{~d} t} \times \boldsymbol{B}\right)$$
两边对时间 $t$ 积分得
$$\hbar \boldsymbol{k}=-e \boldsymbol{r} \times \boldsymbol{B}$$
在垂直 $\boldsymbol{B}$ 的平面内，线元 $\Delta r$ 与 $\Delta k$ 的关系为
$$\Delta r=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right) \Delta k$$
所以电子在 $\boldsymbol{k}$ 空间中的轨道面积和在 $\boldsymbol{r}$ 空间中的轨道面积之间有如下关系：
$$A_{n}=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} S_{n}$$

question:
Prove that for Bloch electrons moving in a magnetic field, the relationship between the trajectory area $S_{n}$ in $\boldsymbol{k}$ space and the trajectory area $A_{n}$ in $\boldsymbol{r}$ space is

$$A_{n}=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} S_{n}$$

where $B$ is the magnetic field strength.
solution:
Solution: In a magnetic field, electrons are subject to the Lorentz force. According to the semiclassical equation of motion for electrons in a crystal:
$$\hbar \frac{\mathrm{d} k}{\mathrm{~d} t}=-e(\boldsymbol{v} \times \boldsymbol{B})=-e\left(\frac{\mathrm{~d} r}{\mathrm{~d} t} \times \boldsymbol{B}\right)$$
Integrating both sides with respect to time $t$, we get
$$\hbar \boldsymbol{k}=-e \boldsymbol{r} \times \boldsymbol{B}$$
In the plane perpendicular to $\boldsymbol{B}$, the relationship between the line element $\Delta r$ and $\Delta k$ is
$$\Delta r=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right) \Delta k$$
Therefore, the relationship between the orbit area in $\boldsymbol{k}$ space and the orbit area in $\boldsymbol{r}$ space for electrons is as follows:
$$A_{n}=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} S_{n}$$.

question:
(1) 根据自由电子模型计算钠的德哈斯-范阿尔芬效应的周期 $\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)$ （钠是体心立方结构，晶格常数为 $a=5.22 \AA$ ）；
(2) 对于 $B=1 \mathrm{~T}$ ，在其实空间中电子运动轨迹面积有多大？
solution:
解 （1）德哈斯-范阿尔芬效应的振荡周期
$$\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)=\frac{e \hbar}{m E_{\mathrm{F}}}$$
先求得钠金属费米能 $E_{\mathrm{F}}$ ，在自由电子模型下
$$E(\boldsymbol{k})=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m}$$
设费米球半径为 $k_{\mathrm{F}}$ ，则有
$$2 \cdot \frac{V}{(2 \pi)^{3}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi}{3} k_{\mathrm{F}}^{3}=N$$
$N$ 是钠晶体中电子数目, 故
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=2 \pi\left(\frac{3}{8 \pi}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}\left(\frac{N}{V}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}$$
其中, $n=\frac{N}{V}$ 为电子浓度, 即
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(3 n \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}$$
Na 金属是体心结构，一个原胞中含有 2 个电子， $n=\frac{2}{a^{3}}$ ，故
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(3 n \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(3 \frac{2}{a^{3}} \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(\frac{6}{\pi}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} \frac{\pi}{a}=1.240\left(\frac{\pi}{a}\right)$$
钠金属费米能
$$\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{F}} & =\frac{\hbar^{2} k_{\mathrm{F}}^{2}}{2 m}=\frac{\hbar^{2} \cdot 1.24^{2} \cdot \pi^{2}}{2 m a^{3}}=\frac{\left(1.05 \times 10^{-34}\right)^{2} \times 1.24^{2} \times 3.14^{2}}{2 \times 9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times\left(5.22 \times 10^{-15}\right)^{2}} \\
& =3.37 \times 10^{-19}(\mathrm{~J})=2.10(\mathrm{eV})
\end{aligned}$$
由德哈斯-范阿尔芬效应周期公式
$$\begin{aligned}
\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right) & =\frac{e \hbar}{m E_{\mathrm{F}}}=\frac{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.05 \times 10^{-34}}{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 2.1 \times 1.9 \times 10^{-19}} \\
& =4.62 \times 10^{-5}\left(\frac{\mathrm{~m}^{2}}{\mathrm{~V} \cdot \mathrm{~s}}\right)=4.62 \times 10^{-5}(\mathrm{~T})
\end{aligned}$$
（2）电子在 $k$ 空间运动轨迹面积
$$\begin{aligned}
S_{\mathrm{F}} & =\frac{2 \pi e}{\hbar \Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)}=\frac{2 \times 3.14 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19}}{1.05 \times 10^{-34} \times 4.62 \times 10^{-2}} \\
& =2.08 \times 10^{20}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{-2}\right)=2.08 \times 10^{18}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-2}\right)
\end{aligned}$$
电子在实空间运动轨迹面积由题解 1.104
$$A=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} \cdot S_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(\frac{1.05 \times 10^{-34}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1}\right) \times 2.08 \times 10^{20}=8.96 \times 10^{-11}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{2}\right)$$

question:
(1) Calculate the period of the de Haas-van Alphen effect $\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)$ for sodium using the free electron model (sodium has a body-centered cubic structure with a lattice constant of $a=5.22 \AA$);

(2) For $B=1 \mathrm{~T}$, what is the area of the electron orbit in k-space?
solution:
Solution:

(1) The oscillation period of the de Haas-van Alphen effect is given by
$$\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)=\frac{e \hbar}{m E_{\mathrm{F}}}$$
First, we find the Fermi energy $E_{\mathrm{F}}$ of sodium metal under the free electron model
$$E(\boldsymbol{k})=\frac{\hbar^{2} k^{2}}{2 m}$$
Assuming the radius of the Fermi sphere is $k_{\mathrm{F}}$, we have
$$2 \cdot \frac{V}{(2 \pi)^{3}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi}{3} k_{\mathrm{F}}^{3}=N$$
where $N$ is the number of electrons in the sodium crystal. Thus,
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=2 \pi\left(\frac{3}{8 \pi}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}\left(\frac{N}{V}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}$$
Here, $n=\frac{N}{V}$ is the electron concentration, so
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(3 n \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}$$
Na metal has a body-centered cubic structure, with 2 electrons per unit cell, so $n=\frac{2}{a^{3}}$, thus
$$k_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(3 n \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(3 \frac{2}{a^{3}} \pi^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(\frac{6}{\pi}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} \frac{\pi}{a}=1.240\left(\frac{\pi}{a}\right)$$
The Fermi energy of sodium metal is
$$\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{F}} & =\frac{\hbar^{2} k_{\mathrm{F}}^{2}}{2 m}=\frac{\hbar^{2} \cdot 1.24^{2} \cdot \pi^{2}}{2 m a^{3}}=\frac{\left(1.05 \times 10^{-34}\right)^{2} \times 1.24^{2} \times 3.14^{2}}{2 \times 9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times\left(5.22 \times 10^{-15}\right)^{2}} \\
& =3.37 \times 10^{-19}(\mathrm{~J})=2.10(\mathrm{eV})
\end{aligned}$$
According to the period formula of the de Haas-van Alphen effect,
$$\begin{aligned}
\Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right) & =\frac{e \hbar}{m E_{\mathrm{F}}}=\frac{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.05 \times 10^{-34}}{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 2.1 \times 1.9 \times 10^{-19}} \\
& =4.62 \times 10^{-5}\left(\frac{\mathrm{~m}^{2}}{\mathrm{~V} \cdot \mathrm{~s}}\right)=4.62 \times 10^{-5}(\mathrm{~T})
\end{aligned}$$

(2) The area of the electron trajectory in $k$-space is
$$\begin{aligned}
S_{\mathrm{F}} & =\frac{2 \pi e}{\hbar \Delta\left(\frac{1}{B}\right)}=\frac{2 \times 3.14 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19}}{1.05 \times 10^{-34} \times 4.62 \times 10^{-2}} \\
& =2.08 \times 10^{20}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{-2}\right)=2.08 \times 10^{18}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-2}\right)
\end{aligned}$$
The area of the electron trajectory in real space is given by
$$A=\left(\frac{\hbar}{e B}\right)^{2} \cdot S_{\mathrm{F}}=\left(\frac{1.05 \times 10^{-34}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1}\right) \times 2.08 \times 10^{20}=8.96 \times 10^{-11}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{2}\right)$$

question:
一块补偿硅材料. 已知掺人受主杂质浓度 $N_{\mathrm{A}}=1 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$, 室温下测得其费米能级位置恰好与施主能级重合，并测得热平衡时电子浓度 $n=5 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ 。已知室温下硅本征载流子浓度 $n_{i}=1.5 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ 。试问
（1）平衡时少子浓度为多少?
（2）掺人材料中施主杂质浓度为多少?
（3）电离杂质及中性杂质散射中心各为多少?
solution:
解 （1）由杂质全电离得知，平衡时少子——空穴浓度

$$
p=\frac{n_{i}^{2}}{n}=\frac{n_{i}^{2}}{N_{\mathrm{D}}}=\frac{\left(1.5 \times 10^{10}\right)^{2}}{5 \times 10^{15}}=4.5 \times 10^{4}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right)
$$

（2）由电中性方程

$$
p+N_{\mathrm{D}}+p_{\mathrm{A}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}+n_{\mathrm{D}}
$$

其中， $p=0, p_{\mathrm{A}}=0$ ，又电子占据施主杂质能级的概率

$$
\begin{gathered}
f_{\mathrm{D}}=\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{E_{\mathrm{C}}-E_{\mathrm{C}}}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}}} \\
n_{\mathrm{D}}=N_{\mathrm{D}} \cdot \frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{E_{\mathrm{D}} E_{\mathrm{C}}}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}}}=N_{\mathrm{D}} \frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{0}}=\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}
\end{gathered}
$$

代人电中性方程， $N_{\mathrm{D}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}+\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}$ ，即

$$
\frac{1}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}=5 \times 10^{15}+1 \times 10^{15}=6 \times 10^{15}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right)
$$

故掺人材料中施主杂质浓度

$$
N_{\mathrm{D}}=1.8 \times 10^{16} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
$$

（3）受主杂质全电离，故电离受主散射中心

$$
N_{\mathrm{A}}^{\circ}=1 \times 10^{15}
$$

费米能级与施主能级重合，施主杂质部分电离，故电离施主散射中心

$$
N_{\mathrm{D}}^{\circ}=N_{\mathrm{D}}-n_{\mathrm{D}}=N_{\mathrm{D}}-\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=\frac{1}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=6 \times 10^{15}
$$

中性散射中心，即未电离的施主杂质浓度

$$
\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=n_{\mathrm{D}}=1.2 \times 10^{16}
$$

question:
The material to be translated is a piece of compensated silicon material. The concentration of acceptor impurities is known to be $N_{\mathrm{A}}=1 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$. At room temperature, the Fermi level is measured to coincide with the donor energy level, and the electron concentration at thermal equilibrium is measured to be $n=5 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$. The intrinsic carrier concentration of silicon at room temperature is known to be $n_{i}=1.5 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$. Please determine:
(1) What is the minority carrier concentration at equilibrium?
(2) What is the donor impurity concentration in the doped material?
(3) What are the concentrations of ionized impurity and neutral impurity scattering centers?
solution:
Solution:

(1) From the full ionization of impurities, at equilibrium, the minority carrier—hole concentration is

$$
p=\frac{n_{i}^{2}}{n}=\frac{n_{i}^{2}}{N_{\mathrm{D}}}=\frac{\left(1.5 \times 10^{10}\right)^{2}}{5 \times 10^{15}}=4.5 \times 10^{4}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right)
$$

(2) From the charge neutrality equation

$$
p+N_{\mathrm{D}}+p_{\mathrm{A}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}+n_{\mathrm{D}}
$$

where $p=0, p_{\mathrm{A}}=0$, and the probability of electrons occupying donor impurity energy levels is

$$
\begin{gathered}
f_{\mathrm{D}}=\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{E_{\mathrm{C}}-E_{\mathrm{C}}}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}}} \\
n_{\mathrm{D}}=N_{\mathrm{D}} \cdot \frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{E_{\mathrm{D}} E_{\mathrm{C}}}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}}}=N_{\mathrm{D}} \frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{0}}=\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}
\end{gathered}
$$

Substituting into the charge neutrality equation, $N_{\mathrm{D}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}+\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}$, i.e.,

$$
\frac{1}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=n+N_{\mathrm{A}}=5 \times 10^{15}+1 \times 10^{15}=6 \times 10^{15}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right)
$$

Therefore, the donor impurity concentration in the doped material is

$$
N_{\mathrm{D}}=1.8 \times 10^{16} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
$$

(3) The acceptor impurities are fully ionized, thus the ionized acceptor scattering centers are

$$
N_{\mathrm{A}}^{\circ}=1 \times 10^{15}
$$

The Fermi level coincides with the donor level, and the donor impurities are partially ionized, thus the ionized donor scattering centers are

$$
N_{\mathrm{D}}^{\circ}=N_{\mathrm{D}}-n_{\mathrm{D}}=N_{\mathrm{D}}-\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=\frac{1}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=6 \times 10^{15}
$$

Neutral scattering centers, i.e., the concentration of non-ionized donor impurities, are

$$
\frac{2}{3} N_{\mathrm{D}}=n_{\mathrm{D}}=1.2 \times 10^{16}
$$

question: 给出一个对磁化率 $\chi=M / B$ 的数值估计（精度 $60 \%$ ），其中 $B$ 是实际磁场. (1) $N=4.7 \times 10^{22} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ 的自由电子费米气, 在 $T=300 \mathrm{~K}$ 和 $T=350 \mathrm{~K}$ 时; (2) 在临界温度以下的第一类超导体.
solution: 解 (1) $\chi=M / B=\frac{3}{2} \frac{N \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{2}}{E_{\mathrm{F}}}$ 在题中所给精度范围内, 可认为 $$\begin{aligned} E_{\mathrm{F}} & \approx E_{\mathrm{F}}^{0}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 m}\left(3 N \pi^{2}\right)^{2 / 3} \\ & =\frac{\left(1.055 \times 10^{-34}\right)^{2}}{2 \times 9.1 \times 10^{-35}} \times\left(3 \pi^{2} \times 4.7 \times 10^{22}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} \\ & =7.618 \times 10^{-19}(\mathrm{~J})=4.76(\mathrm{eV})=4.76 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-12}(\mathrm{erg}) \end{aligned}$$ 又, $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}=9.27 \times 10^{-21} \mathrm{erg} \cdot \mathrm{G}^{-1}$, 代人后得 $$\chi=\frac{3 N \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{2}}{2 E_{\mathrm{F}}}=\frac{3 \times 4.7 \times 10^{22} \times\left(9.27 \times 10^{-21}\right)^{2}}{2 \times 4.76 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-12}}=8.0 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{CGS} \text { 制) }$$ 由于自由电子费米气的顺磁磁化率不依赖于温度, 所以 $$\chi_{T=300 \mathrm{~K}}=\chi_{T=350 \mathrm{~K}}=0.80 \times 10^{-6}(\text { CGS 制 })$$ (2) 对于第一类超导体 $$\chi \leqslant-\frac{1}{4 \pi}(\text { CGS 制 })$$

question: Provide an estimate of the magnetic susceptibility $\chi = M / B$ (with an accuracy of $60\%$), where $B$ is the actual magnetic field. (1) For a free electron Fermi gas with $N = 4.7 \times 10^{22} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ at $T = 300 \mathrm{~K}$ and $T = 350 \mathrm{~K}$; (2) For a type I superconductor below the critical temperature.
solution: Translate the expression (1) $\chi=M / B=\frac{3}{2} \frac{N \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{2}}{E_{\mathrm{F}}}$ within the precision range given in the problem, it can be considered that $$\begin{aligned} E_{\mathrm{F}} & \approx E_{\mathrm{F}}^{0}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 m}\left(3 N \pi^{2}\right)^{2 / 3} \\ & =\frac{\left(1.055 \times 10^{-34}\right)^{2}}{2 \times 9.1 \times 10^{-35}} \times\left(3 \pi^{2} \times 4.7 \times 10^{22}\right)^{\frac{2}{3}} \\ & =7.618 \times 10^{-19}(\mathrm{~J})=4.76(\mathrm{eV})=4.76 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-12}(\mathrm{erg}) \end{aligned}$$ Also, $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}=9.27 \times 10^{-21} \mathrm{erg} \cdot \mathrm{G}^{-1}$, substituting in gives $$\chi=\frac{3 N \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{2}}{2 E_{\mathrm{F}}}=\frac{3 \times 4.7 \times 10^{22} \times\left(9.27 \times 10^{-21}\right)^{2}}{2 \times 4.76 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-12}}=8.0 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{CGS} \text { units })$$ Since the paramagnetic susceptibility of a free electron Fermi gas does not depend on temperature, $$\chi_{T=300 \mathrm{~K}}=\chi_{T=350 \mathrm{~K}}=0.80 \times 10^{-6}(\text { CGS units })$$ (2) For type I superconductors $$\chi \leqslant-\frac{1}{4 \pi}(\text { CGS units })$$.

question: 球形玻璃容器中充满水, 折射率为 $n$. 从外面观察球中心的物体, 试问放大率为多少? 假设玻璃容器壁厚可忽略.
solution:
