解 应用近轴光线折射率 $n i=i^{\prime}$, 用作图法 (如题图 1.3), 物 $A C$, 顶点 $A$ 发出一束光 $A O$, 在 $O$ 点折射, 折射光反向延长线与物 $A C$ 的延长线相交于 $A^{\prime}$. 像长为 $A^{\prime} C$ 。
$$
\text { 放大率 } \beta=\frac{A^{\prime} C}{A C}=\frac{R i^{\prime}}{R i}=n \text {. }
$$

question: A spherical glass container is filled with water, with a refractive index of $n$. When observing an object at the center of the sphere from outside, what is the magnification? Assume the thickness of the glass container wall is negligible.
solution:
Solve the application of paraxial ray refractive index $n i = i^{\prime}$ using a graphical method (as in Figure 1.3). An object $A C$ emits a beam of light $A O$ from vertex $A$, which refracts at point $O$. The extended line of the refracted light intersects the extended line of the object $A C$ at $A^{\prime}$. The image length is $A^{\prime} C$.

$$
\text{Magnification } \beta = \frac{A^{\prime} C}{A C} = \frac{R i^{\prime}}{R i} = n \text{.}
$$

question: 一组合显微镜物镜焦距为 0.5 cm , 目镜焦距 2 cm , 如果两透镜间距为 22 cm , 观察者看到的像在 $\infty$ 处，那么物体到物镜的距离应是多少？放大倍数是多少？误差在 $\pm$ $10 \%$ 之内，由透镜公式 $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=\frac{1}{f}$ ，推出所有必要的公式。眼睛的正常近点是 15 cm 。
solution:
解 以下标 1 代表物镜， 2 代表目镜，物距为 $p$ ，像距 $q$ 和焦距 $f$ 均取正值。由 $q_{2}=\infty$知， $p_{2}=f_{2}=2 \mathrm{~cm}$ ，即经物镜所成的像在目镜的前焦面上，所以

$$
q_{1}=d-p_{2}=20 \mathrm{~cm} \quad(d \text { 为两透镜间距 })
$$

代人

$$
\frac{1}{p_{1}}+\frac{1}{q_{1}}=\frac{1}{f_{1}}
$$

得

$$
p_{1}=0.51 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

即物体应放在物镜前 0.51 cm 处。
设物体高为 $y$ ，则经物镜所成像的高度为

$$
y^{\prime}=\frac{q_{1}}{p_{1}} y
$$

所以，经显微镜所成像的视角为

$$
\alpha^{\prime}=\frac{y^{\prime}}{p_{2}}=\frac{q_{1}}{p_{1}} \frac{y}{f_{2}}
$$

无显微镜时，人眼近点观察物体，视角为

$$
\alpha=\frac{y}{15}
$$

所以显微镜的放大倍数为

$$
M=\frac{\alpha^{\prime}}{\alpha}=\frac{15 q_{1}}{p_{1} f_{1}}=2.9 \times 10^{2}
$$

question: The focal length of the objective lens of a compound microscope is 0.5 cm, and the focal length of the eyepiece is 2 cm. If the distance between the two lenses is 22 cm, and the observer sees the image at $\infty$, what should be the distance from the object to the objective lens? What is the magnification? The error is within $\pm$ $10\%$. Using the lens formula $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=\frac{1}{f}$, derive all necessary formulas. The normal near point of the eye is 15 cm.
solution:
The subscript 1 represents the objective lens, 2 represents the eyepiece. The object distance is $p$, and the image distance $q$ and focal length $f$ are both taken as positive values. From $q_{2}=\infty$, we know $p_{2}=f_{2}=2 \mathrm{~cm}$, which means the image formed by the objective lens is on the front focal plane of the eyepiece, so

$$
q_{1}=d-p_{2}=20 \mathrm{~cm} \quad(d \text{ is the distance between the two lenses })
$$

Substitute into

$$
\frac{1}{p_{1}}+\frac{1}{q_{1}}=\frac{1}{f_{1}}
$$

to get

$$
p_{1}=0.51 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

This means the object should be placed 0.51 cm in front of the objective lens. Let the height of the object be $y$, then the height of the image formed by the objective lens is

$$
y^{\prime}=\frac{q_{1}}{p_{1}} y
$$

Therefore, the angular size of the image formed by the microscope is

$$
\alpha^{\prime}=\frac{y^{\prime}}{p_{2}}=\frac{q_{1}}{p_{1}} \frac{y}{f_{2}}
$$

Without the microscope, when the human eye observes the object at the near point, the angular size is

$$
\alpha=\frac{y}{15}
$$

Thus, the magnification of the microscope is

$$
M=\frac{\alpha^{\prime}}{\alpha}=\frac{15 q_{1}}{p_{1} f_{1}}=2.9 \times 10^{2}
$$

question:
一天文望远镜的物镜直径等于 18 cm ，透光系数为 0.50 ，已知肉眼可直接观察到六等星. 求: (1) 用此望远镜所能看到的最高星等; （2）最适宜观察星的放大率（正常放大率）；（3）当放大率为 10 倍时可见到星的等次. 设眼睛的瞳孔直径可取 $3.0 \mathrm{~mm}$.
（注：星等增加一等，其亮度减少到 $1 / \sqrt[3]{100} \approx 1 / 2.5$ ）
solution:
解 （1）此题应将星体当作点光源处理，视网膜上像点的亮度直接取决于进入眼瞳的全部光通量. 无望远镜时，进入眼瞳的光通量为
$$
\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}} \propto D_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}
$$
有望远镜时，进入物镜的光通量为
$$
\Delta \Phi \propto D^{2}
$$
考虑系统的透光系数 $k$ ，从出瞳通过的光通量减为
$$
\Delta \Phi^{\prime}=k \Delta \Phi \propto k D^{2}
$$
当 $D^{\prime}<D_{\mathrm{e}}$ 时，显然从望远镜出瞳通过的光通量全部进入眼瞳，故此时
$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}}}=k\left(\frac{D}{D_{\mathrm{e}}}\right)^{2}=0.50 \times\left(\frac{180}{3.0}\right)^{2}=1800
$$
按天文学上关于星等划分标准，此时所能看到的最高星等（弱星）为
$$
N=N_{0}+\log _{2.5} 1800 \approx 6+8=14(\text { 等 })
$$
式中 $N_{0}$ 是裸眼可见的最高星等，为 6 等。
（2）为满足 $D^{\prime}<D_{\mathrm{e}}$ 条件，合理的设计应是望远镜的放大率 $M$ 满足
$$
D^{\prime}=\frac{D}{M}=D_{\mathrm{e}}
$$
算出
$$
M=\frac{D}{D_{\mathrm{e}}}=\frac{180}{3.0}=60(\text { 倍 })
$$
（3）若放大率过小，以致 $D^{\prime}>D_{\mathrm{e}}$ ，显然从望远镜出瞳通过的光通量只有部分进入眼瞳，按比例应为
$$
\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime} \propto k\left(\frac{D_{\mathrm{e}}}{D^{\prime}}\right)^{2} D^{2}
$$
故
$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}}}=k M^{2}
$$
当该望远镜的放大率 $M=10$ 时， $D^{\prime}=D / 10=18 \mathrm{~mm}>D_{\mathrm{e}}$ ，故按上式算出
$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{0}}=50 \text { 倍 }
$$
此时可见到的星等为
$$
N^{\prime}=N_{0}+\log _{2.5} 50 \approx 6+4.3 \approx 10(\text { 等 })
$$

question: The diameter of the objective lens of an astronomical telescope is 18 cm, and the light transmission coefficient is 0.50. It is known that the naked eye can directly observe sixth magnitude stars. Find: (1) The highest magnitude of stars that can be observed with this telescope; (2) The most suitable magnification for observing stars (normal magnification); (3) The magnitude of stars visible when the magnification is 10 times. Assume the diameter of the pupil of the eye is $3.0 \mathrm{~mm}$. (Note: When the magnitude increases by one, its brightness decreases to $1 / \sqrt[3]{100} \approx 1 / 2.5$.)
solution:
Solution:

(1) In this problem, the star should be treated as a point light source, and the brightness of the image point on the retina directly depends on the total luminous flux entering the pupil. Without a telescope, the luminous flux entering the pupil is

$$
\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}} \propto D_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}
$$

With a telescope, the luminous flux entering the objective lens is

$$
\Delta \Phi \propto D^{2}
$$

Considering the system's transmittance coefficient $k$, the luminous flux passing through the exit pupil is reduced to

$$
\Delta \Phi^{\prime}=k \Delta \Phi \propto k D^{2}
$$

When $D^{\prime}<D_{\mathrm{e}}$, it is clear that all the luminous flux passing through the telescope's exit pupil enters the eye's pupil, so at this time

$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}}}=k\left(\frac{D}{D_{\mathrm{e}}}\right)^{2}=0.50 \times\left(\frac{180}{3.0}\right)^{2}=1800
$$

According to the astronomical standard for star magnitude classification, the highest magnitude (faintest star) that can be seen at this time is

$$
N=N_{0}+\log _{2.5} 1800 \approx 6+8=14(\text { magnitude })
$$

where $N_{0}$ is the highest magnitude visible to the naked eye, which is 6 magnitudes.

(2) To satisfy the condition $D^{\prime}<D_{\mathrm{e}}$, a reasonable design is that the magnification $M$ of the telescope satisfies

$$
D^{\prime}=\frac{D}{M}=D_{\mathrm{e}}
$$

Calculate

$$
M=\frac{D}{D_{\mathrm{e}}}=\frac{180}{3.0}=60(\text { times })
$$

(3) If the magnification is too small, resulting in $D^{\prime}>D_{\mathrm{e}}$, it is evident that only part of the luminous flux passing through the telescope's exit pupil enters the eye's pupil, and proportionally it should be

$$
\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime} \propto k\left(\frac{D_{\mathrm{e}}}{D^{\prime}}\right)^{2} D^{2}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{\mathrm{e}}}=k M^{2}
$$

When the magnification of the telescope $M=10$, $D^{\prime}=D / 10=18 \mathrm{~mm}>D_{\mathrm{e}}$, so according to the above formula, we calculate

$$
\frac{\Delta \Phi^{\prime \prime}}{\Delta \Phi_{0}}=50 \text { times }
$$

The magnitude visible at this time is

$$
N^{\prime}=N_{0}+\log _{2.5} 50 \approx 6+4.3 \approx 10(\text { magnitude })
$$

question: 将一个金属框放入肥皀液中浸一下，然后取出保持垂直，于是形成一个楔形膜，用氨离子激光 $(\lambda=514.53 \mathrm{~nm})$ 近似垂直照射，每厘米可观察到 12 个条纹，求顶角. 肥皀液 $n=1.33$.
solution:
解

$$
\theta=\frac{\lambda}{2 n \Delta x}, \quad \Delta x=\frac{1}{12} \mathrm{~cm}
$$

代人 $\lambda, n$ 值得

$$
\theta=2.3 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad}
$$

question: Immerse a metal frame in soap solution and then take it out, keeping it vertical, thus forming a wedge-shaped film. It is illuminated approximately vertically with ammonia ion laser $(\lambda=514.53 \mathrm{~nm})$, and 12 fringes can be observed per centimeter. Find the apex angle. Soap solution $n=1.33$.
solution:
Substitute the values of $\lambda$ and $n$ into

$$
\theta=\frac{\lambda}{2 n \Delta x}, \quad \Delta x=\frac{1}{12} \mathrm{~cm}
$$

to get

$$
\theta=2.3 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad}
$$.

question:
用钠光 $5893 \AA$ 观察迈克耳孙干涉条纹，先看到干涉场中有 12 个亮环，且中心是亮的，移动平面镜 $M_{1}$ 后，看到中心吞（吐）了 10 环，而此时干涉场中还剩有 5 个亮环。试求：
(1) $M_{1}$ 移动的距离;
（2）开始时中心亮斑的干涉级；
（3） $M_{1}$ 移动后，从中心向外数第 5 个亮环的干涉级。
solution:
解 本题的意义在于通过条纹的移动，由条纹相对级别的变化来确定条纹的绝对级别。

（1）首先定性分析一下，等效空气膜的厚度是增加了还是减少了。在相同视场（角范围）之内，条纹数目变小，条纹变稀，说明膜厚变薄，条纹向里吞了 10 环，因而位移绝对值为

$$
\Delta h=N \frac{\lambda}{2}=2.947 \mu \mathrm{~m}
$$

（2）中心级别的绝对数 $k$ 取决于膜层厚度 $h$ ，而 $k 、 h$ 以及视场角范围 $\theta$ 开始时都是未知的。为此，考虑镜面移动前有

$$
\begin{aligned}
2 h & =k \lambda \\
2 h \cos \theta & =(k-12) \lambda
\end{aligned}
$$

镜面移动后有

$$
\begin{aligned}
2(h-\Delta h) & =(k-10) \lambda \\
2(h-\Delta h) \cos \theta & =(k-15) \lambda
\end{aligned}
$$

由式（1）和式（2），式（3）和式（4），分别得

$$
\begin{gathered}
k \lambda \cos \theta=(k-12) \lambda \\
(k-10) \lambda \cos \theta=(k-15) \lambda
\end{gathered}
$$

以上两式相比，消去 $\cos \theta$ 得方程

$$
\frac{k-10}{k}=\frac{k-15}{k-12}
$$

解出

$$
k \approx 17
$$

（3）显然，移动后中心亮环级别为 7 ，向外数第 5 个亮环的干涉级别为 2 。

The significance of solving this problem lies in determining the absolute level of the fringes by observing their movement and relative level changes.

(1) First, let's qualitatively analyze whether the thickness of the equivalent air film has increased or decreased. Within the same field of view (angle range), the number of fringes decreases, and they become sparser, indicating that the film thickness has reduced, with the fringes moving inward by 10 rings. Therefore, the absolute value of the displacement is

$$
\Delta h=N \frac{\lambda}{2}=2.947 \mu \mathrm{~m}
$$

(2) The absolute number $k$ of the central level depends on the film thickness $h$, and $k$, $h$, and the field of view angle range $\theta$ are all unknown initially. Therefore, consider the situation before the mirror moves:

$$
\begin{aligned}
2 h & =k \lambda \\
2 h \cos \theta & =(k-12) \lambda
\end{aligned}
$$

After the mirror moves:

$$
\begin{aligned}
2(h-\Delta h) & =(k-10) \lambda \\
2(h-\Delta h) \cos \theta & =(k-15) \lambda
\end{aligned}
$$

From equations (1) and (2), and equations (3) and (4), we respectively obtain:

$$
\begin{gathered}
k \lambda \cos \theta=(k-12) \lambda \\
(k-10) \lambda \cos \theta=(k-15) \lambda
\end{gathered}
$$

Comparing the above two equations and eliminating $\cos \theta$, we get the equation:

$$
\frac{k-10}{k}=\frac{k-15}{k-12}
$$

Solving this gives

$$
k \approx 17
$$

(3) Clearly, after moving, the central bright ring level is 7, and the interference level of the 5th bright ring counted outward is 2.

question:
迈克耳孙干涉仪中的一臂（反射镜）以速度 $v$ 勾速推移，用透镜接收干涉条纹，将它会聚到光电元件上，把光强变化转换为电讯号。
（1）若测得电讯号的时间频率为 $\nu$ ，求人射光的波长 $\lambda$ ；
（2）若人射光波长在 $0.6 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ 左右，要使电讯号频率控制在 50 Hz ，反射镜平移的速度应为多少?
（3）按以上速度移动反射镜，钠黄光产生电讯号的拍频为多少？（钠黄光双线波长为 $5890 \AA$ 和 $5896 \AA$ 。)
solution:
解 (1) 根据

$$
\Delta h=\Delta N \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

将上式两边除以时间间隔 $\Delta t$, 即

$$
\frac{\Delta h}{\Delta t}=\frac{\Delta N}{\Delta t} \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

得

$$
v=\nu \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

故

$$
\lambda=\frac{2 v}{\nu}
$$

(2) 根据以上关系, 可按

$$
v=\frac{1}{2} \mu
$$

估算动镜速度. 若 $\lambda=0.6 \mu \mathrm{~m}, \nu=50 \mathrm{~Hz}$, 则

$$
v=15 \mu \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}
$$

若 $\lambda=40 \mu \mathrm{~m}, \nu=100 \mathrm{~Hz}$, 则

$$
v=2 \mathrm{~mm} / \mathrm{s}
$$

快速扫描型傅里叶变换光谱仪的动镜速度属于这一量级。
（3）设纳黄光双线波长为 $\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$ ，则干涉仪中产生电讯号的时间频率分别为

$$
\nu_{1}=\frac{2 v}{\lambda_{1}}, \quad \nu_{2}=\frac{2 v}{\lambda_{2}}
$$

合成结果，产生电讯号的拍频为

$$
\Delta \nu=\nu_{1}-\nu_{2}=2 v\left(\frac{1}{\lambda_{1}}-\frac{1}{\lambda_{2}}\right) \approx 2 v \frac{\Delta \lambda}{\lambda^{2}}
$$

若取 $v=15 \mu \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ ，平均波长 $\lambda=5893 \AA ， \Delta \lambda=6 \AA$ ，算出拍频数值为

$$
\Delta \nu=5.2 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~Hz} \ll \nu_{1}, \nu_{2}
$$

question:
One arm (mirror) of the Michelson interferometer is shifted at a speed $v$. The interference fringes are received using a lens and focused onto a photoelectric element, which converts the variations in light intensity into an electrical signal.

(1) If the time frequency of the measured electrical signal is $\nu$, find the wavelength $\lambda$ of the incident light.

(2) If the wavelength of the incident light is approximately $0.6 \mu \mathrm{~m}$, what should be the speed of the mirror's translation to keep the frequency of the electrical signal at 50 Hz?

(3) When moving the mirror at the above speed, what is the beat frequency of the electrical signal produced by sodium yellow light? (The doublet wavelengths of sodium yellow light are $5890 \AA$ and $5896 \AA$.)
solution:
Solution:

(1) According to

$$
\Delta h=\Delta N \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

divide both sides of the above equation by the time interval $\Delta t$, i.e.,

$$
\frac{\Delta h}{\Delta t}=\frac{\Delta N}{\Delta t} \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

we get

$$
v=\nu \frac{\lambda}{2}
$$

Thus,

$$
\lambda=\frac{2 v}{\nu}
$$

(2) Based on the above relationship, the speed of the moving mirror can be estimated as

$$
v=\frac{1}{2} \mu
$$

If $\lambda=0.6 \mu \mathrm{~m}, \nu=50 \mathrm{~Hz}$, then

$$
v=15 \mu \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}
$$

If $\lambda=40 \mu \mathrm{~m}, \nu=100 \mathrm{~Hz}$, then

$$
v=2 \mathrm{~mm} / \mathrm{s}
$$

The speed of the moving mirror in a rapid-scan Fourier transform spectrometer is of this order of magnitude.

(3) Let the wavelengths of the sodium yellow doublet be $\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$, then the time frequencies of the electrical signals generated in the interferometer are respectively

$$
\nu_{1}=\frac{2 v}{\lambda_{1}}, \quad \nu_{2}=\frac{2 v}{\lambda_{2}}
$$

The resultant beat frequency of the electrical signals is

$$
\Delta \nu=\nu_{1}-\nu_{2}=2 v\left(\frac{1}{\lambda_{1}}-\frac{1}{\lambda_{2}}\right) \approx 2 v \frac{\Delta \lambda}{\lambda^{2}}
$$

If we take $v=15 \mu \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, average wavelength $\lambda=5893 \AA, \Delta \lambda=6 \AA$, the calculated beat frequency value is

$$
\Delta \nu=5.2 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~Hz} \ll \nu_{1}, \nu_{2}
$$.

question: 焦距 $f=50 \mathrm{~cm}$. 直径 $D=5 \mathrm{~cm}$ 的凸透镜. 将 $\lambda=6328 \AA$ 的激光束聚焦, 光束截面 $D_{1}=2 \mathrm{~cm}$. 求焦点处光强是激光束光强的多少倍？估计焦点光斑之大小。
solution: 解 由上题，激光截面相对于焦点能分割成多少菲涅耳半波带？（光束截面小于透镜截面，所以选二者中较小的参与计算.） $$ n=\frac{D_{1}^{2}}{4 \lambda f} $$ 由透镜使所有人射光线到焦点都具等光程性，因此每个半波带的振幅都是原振幅的 $\pi$ 倍.焦点的振幅为 $$ \begin{aligned} A & =A_{0} n \pi \\ I & =I_{0}\left(\frac{D_{1}^{2}}{4 \lambda f}\right)^{2} \pi^{2}=10^{2} I_{0} \end{aligned} $$ 光斑大小由艾里斑决定，半径为 $$ r=\frac{1.22 \lambda}{D_{1}} f=18 \mu \mathrm{~m} $$

question: The focal length $f=50 \mathrm{~cm}$. The diameter $D=5 \mathrm{~cm}$ of a convex lens. Focus a laser beam with $\lambda=6328 \AA$, beam cross-section $D_{1}=2 \mathrm{~cm}$. Find how many times the intensity at the focus is compared to the intensity of the laser beam. Estimate the size of the focal spot.
solution:
Solution: From the previous question, how many Fresnel half-wave zones can the laser cross-section be divided into relative to the focus? (The cross-section of the beam is smaller than that of the lens, so the smaller of the two is chosen for the calculation.)

$$ n=\frac{D_{1}^{2}}{4 \lambda f} $$

The lens makes all incident light rays have equal optical path lengths to the focus, so the amplitude of each half-wave zone is $\pi$ times the original amplitude. The amplitude at the focus is

$$ \begin{aligned} A & =A_{0} n \pi \\ I & =I_{0}\left(\frac{D_{1}^{2}}{4 \lambda f}\right)^{2} \pi^{2}=10^{2} I_{0} \end{aligned} $$

The size of the light spot is determined by the Airy disk, with a radius of

$$ r=\frac{1.22 \lambda}{D_{1}} f=18 \mu \mathrm{~m} $$.

question: 一架 35 mm 照相机有 50 mm 焦距的透镜，用于拍摄 175 cm 高的目标，像高是 30 mm 。(1) 被摄者要离相机多远? （2）若透镜进光孔直径为 1 cm ，光波长用 $\lambda=5000 \AA$ ，估算在胶片上能得到的最好分辨率。
solution: 解 （1）由成像公式，距离以 cm 为单位 $$ \frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}=\frac{1}{5}, \quad \frac{u}{v}=\frac{175}{3} $$ 解得 $$ u=296.7 \mathrm{~cm}, \quad v=50.9 \mathrm{~mm} $$ 所以被摄者要离相机 296.7 cm 远. （2）由瑞利判据，分辨率用最小分辨距离表示为 $$ \begin{aligned} \Delta x=v \cdot \theta & =1.22 \frac{\lambda}{d} \cdot v=1.22 \times \frac{5000 \times 10^{-6}}{1} \times 50.9 \\ & =0.31 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~mm}) \end{aligned} $$

question: A 35 mm camera has a lens with a focal length of 50 mm, used to photograph a 175 cm tall object, and the image height is 30 mm. (1) How far should the subject be from the camera? (2) If the lens aperture diameter is 1 cm and the wavelength of light is $\lambda=5000 \AA$, estimate the best resolution that can be achieved on the film.
solution: Solution: (1) Using the lens formula, with distances in cm, $$ \frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}=\frac{1}{5}, \quad \frac{u}{v}=\frac{175}{3} $$ Solving gives $$ u=296.7 \mathrm{~cm}, \quad v=50.9 \mathrm{~mm} $$ Therefore, the subject should be 296.7 cm away from the camera. (2) According to the Rayleigh criterion, the resolution expressed as the minimum resolvable distance is $$ \begin{aligned} \Delta x=v \cdot \theta & =1.22 \frac{\lambda}{d} \cdot v=1.22 \times \frac{5000 \times 10^{-6}}{1} \times 50.9 \\ & =0.31 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~mm}) \end{aligned} $$

question: 一架对可见光敏感的照相机 (焦距 50 cm , 孔径 $D$ ), 对恒星清楚地聚焦后, 在不重新调焦的情况下, 拍摄 100 m 处的一个物体. 孔径 $D$ 大致为多大时, 对物体分辨得最清楚? $D$ 以 cm 为单位.
solution: 解 光轴上的一发光点在底板上的像是一直径为 $d$的光斑 (如题图 2.98). 又由波动光学, 经圆孔的衍射将在底板上产生一艾里斑, 当艾里斑直径与 $d$ 相等时, 对物体的分辨率最高. 这时有 ![img-216.jpeg](images/img-216.jpeg) 题图 2.98 $$ 2 \times 1.22 \frac{\lambda}{D} \cdot f=d $$ 其中, $v$ 决定于 $$ \frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}=\frac{1}{f} \quad(u \text { 为物距 }=100 \mathrm{~m}) $$ 或 $$ \frac{1}{u}=\frac{v-f}{f v} $$ 由三角形相似有 $$ \frac{d}{D}=\frac{v-f}{v} $$ 所以 $$ \begin{aligned} D & =\sqrt{2.44 \lambda u} \approx \sqrt{2.44 \times 0.5 \times 10^{-4} \times 100 \times 10^{2}} \\ & =1.1(\mathrm{~cm}) \end{aligned} $$

question: A camera sensitive to visible light (focal length 50 cm, aperture $D$) is focused clearly on a star. Without refocusing, it is used to photograph an object at a distance of 100 m. What is the approximate aperture $D$ that allows the object to be resolved most clearly? $D$ is in cm.
solution:
The image of a luminous point on the optical axis on the base plate is a light spot with a diameter of $d$ (as shown in Figure 2.98). According to wave optics, diffraction through a circular aperture will produce an Airy disk on the base plate. The resolution for the object is highest when the Airy disk diameter equals $d$. At this point, we have:

$$ 2 \times 1.22 \frac{\lambda}{D} \cdot f = d $$

where $v$ is determined by

$$ \frac{1}{u} + \frac{1}{v} = \frac{1}{f} \quad (u \text{ is the object distance } = 100 \mathrm{~m}) $$

or

$$ \frac{1}{u} = \frac{v-f}{fv} $$

By the similarity of triangles, we have

$$ \frac{d}{D} = \frac{v-f}{v} $$

Therefore,

$$ \begin{aligned} 
D & = \sqrt{2.44 \lambda u} \approx \sqrt{2.44 \times 0.5 \times 10^{-4} \times 100 \times 10^{2}} \\
& = 1.1(\mathrm{~cm}) 
\end{aligned} $$

question: 某种玻璃对不同波长的折射率在 $\lambda=4000 \AA$ 时, $n=1.63 ; \lambda=5000 \AA$ 时, $n=$ 1. 58. 假定柯西公式 $n=A+\frac{B}{\lambda^{2}}$ 适用, 求此种玻璃在 $6000 \AA$ 时的色散 $\mathrm{d} n / \mathrm{d} \lambda$.

the refractive index of a certain glass at different wavelengths: when $\lambda=4000 \AA$, $n=1.63$; when $\lambda=5000 \AA$, $n=1.58$. Assuming Cauchy's equation $n=A+\frac{B}{\lambda^{2}}$ is applicable, find the dispersion $\mathrm{d} n / \mathrm{d} \lambda$ of this glass at $6000 \AA$.

同时考虑介质对光的吸收和散射时，吸收系数 $\alpha=\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}$ ，其中 $\alpha_{0}$ 为真正吸收系数， $\alpha_{s}$ 为散射系数。朗伯定律为 $I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$ ，若光经过一定厚度的某种介质后，只有 $20 \%$ 的光强透过，已知该介质的散射系数 $\alpha_{s}$ 为真正吸收系数 $\alpha_{0}$ 的 $1 / 2$ ，若不考虑散射，则透射光强增加到多少？
solution:
解 由 $I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$ ，有 $\frac{I}{I_{0}} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$ 将 $\alpha_{s}=\frac{1}{2} \alpha_{0} ， \frac{I}{I_{0}}=20 \%=0.2$ 代入，得
$$
\mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\frac{1}{2} \alpha_{0}\right) I}=\frac{I}{I_{0}}=0.2
$$
故 $\alpha_{0}=\frac{2 \ln 5}{3 I}$ ，若消除散射，则 $\alpha_{s}=0$ ，于是
$$
\frac{I^{\prime}}{I_{0}}=\mathrm{e}^{-\alpha_{0} I}=\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{3} \alpha_{0}}=0.34=34 \%
$$
即透射光强增加到 $34 \%$ 。

question: When considering both the absorption and scattering of light by a medium, the absorption coefficient $\alpha=\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}$, where $\alpha_{0}$ is the true absorption coefficient and $\alpha_{s}$ is the scattering coefficient. According to Lambert's law, $I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$. If only $20\%$ of the light intensity is transmitted after passing through a certain thickness of the medium, and it is known that the scattering coefficient $\alpha_{s}$ is $1/2$ of the true absorption coefficient $\alpha_{0}$, what would the transmitted light intensity increase to if scattering is not considered?
solution:
Solution: Given $I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$, with $\frac{I}{I_{0}} \mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\alpha_{s}\right) I}$, substitute $\alpha_{s}=\frac{1}{2} \alpha_{0}$ and $\frac{I}{I_{0}}=20\%=0.2$, we have
$$
\mathrm{e}^{-\left(\alpha_{0}+\frac{1}{2} \alpha_{0}\right) I}=\frac{I}{I_{0}}=0.2
$$
Thus, $\alpha_{0}=\frac{2 \ln 5}{3 I}$. If scattering is eliminated, then $\alpha_{s}=0$, and therefore
$$
\frac{I^{\prime}}{I_{0}}=\mathrm{e}^{-\alpha_{0} I}=\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{3} \alpha_{0}}=0.34=34 \%
$$
That is, the transmitted light intensity increases to $34 \%$.

question:
一正弦光栅的屏函数为
$$
\bar{t}(x, y)=t_{0}+t_{1} \cos 2 \pi f x
$$
现将它沿 $x$ 方向平移 $\Delta x=d / 6, d / 4, d / 2, d, 3 d / 2$ 。写出移动后的屏函数表达式（ $d$ 为屏函数的空间周期)。
solution:
解 位移 $\Delta x$ 引起相移 $\Delta \varphi$ ，两者的定量关系为
$$
\Delta \varphi=-2 \pi f \Delta x=-\frac{2 \pi}{d} \Delta x
$$
屏函数的表达式写成
$$
t(x, y)=t_{0}+t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x+\Delta \varphi)
$$
当
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \Delta x=\frac{d}{6} \text { 时, } \Delta \varphi=-\frac{\pi}{3}, t(x, y)=t_{0}+t_{1} \cos \left(2 \pi f x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right) \\
& \Delta x=\frac{d}{4} \text { 时, } \Delta \varphi=-\frac{\pi}{2}, t(x, y)=t_{0}+t_{1} \cos \left(2 \pi f x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=t_{0}+t_{1} \sin (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x=\frac{d}{2} \text { 时, } \Delta \varphi=\pi, t(x, y)=t_{0}-t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x=d \text { 时, } \Delta \varphi=2 \pi, t(x, y)=t_{0}+t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x=\frac{3}{2} d \text { 时, } \Delta \varphi=3 \pi, t(x, y)=t_{0}-t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x)
\end{aligned}
$$

question:
The transmission function of a sinusoidal grating is given by
$$
\bar{t}(x, y) = t_{0} + t_{1} \cos 2 \pi f x
$$
Now, translate it along the $x$ direction by $\Delta x = d / 6, d / 4, d / 2, d, 3 d / 2$. Write down the expression for the transmission function after the translation (where $d$ is the spatial period of the transmission function).
solution:
To solve the quantitative relationship between displacement $\Delta x$ and phase shift $\Delta \varphi$, we have:
$$
\Delta \varphi = -2 \pi f \Delta x = -\frac{2 \pi}{d} \Delta x
$$
The expression for the screen function is written as:
$$
t(x, y) = t_{0} + t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x + \Delta \varphi)
$$
When
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \Delta x = \frac{d}{6}, \Delta \varphi = -\frac{\pi}{3}, t(x, y) = t_{0} + t_{1} \cos \left(2 \pi f x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \\
& \Delta x = \frac{d}{4}, \Delta \varphi = -\frac{\pi}{2}, t(x, y) = t_{0} + t_{1} \cos \left(2 \pi f x - \frac{\pi}{2}\right) = t_{0} + t_{1} \sin (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x = \frac{d}{2}, \Delta \varphi = \pi, t(x, y) = t_{0} - t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x = d, \Delta \varphi = 2 \pi, t(x, y) = t_{0} + t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x) \\
& \Delta x = \frac{3}{2} d, \Delta \varphi = 3 \pi, t(x, y) = t_{0} - t_{1} \cos (2 \pi f x)
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 根据巴比涅原理求不透明圆盘中心轴线上一点的光强. 设该圆盘被轴线上一点光源照明, 观察点距圆盘的距离比盘的半径大得多.
solution:
解 由上题. 圆孔中心轴线上一点上光场为
$$u_{1}(P)=u_{0}(P)\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} \omega p}\right)$$
式中 $u_{0}(P)$ 为不存在任何衍射屏时 $P$ 点的光场, $p$ 为该孔整个面积相对观察点所划分的半波带数.

用 $u_{2}(P)$ 代表不透明圆盘衍射在 $P$ 点造成的光场. 由巴比涅原理
$$u_{2}(P)=u_{0}(P)-u_{1}(P)=u_{0}(P) \mathrm{e}^{-i \omega p}$$
所以在 $P$ 点衍射光强为
$$I_{2}(P)=\left|u_{2}(P)\right|^{2}=I_{0}(P)$$
即不透明圆盘轴线上距盘足够远时, 各点光强与没有该盘时的光强完全相等.

question: Calculate the light intensity at a point on the central axis of an opaque disk based on Babinet's principle. Assume that the disk is illuminated by a point light source on the axis, and the distance from the observation point to the disk is much greater than the radius of the disk.
solution:
Solution: From the previous problem. The light field at a point on the central axis of the circular hole is given by
$$u_{1}(P)=u_{0}(P)\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} \omega p}\right)$$
where $u_{0}(P)$ is the light field at point $P$ when there is no diffraction screen, and $p$ is the number of half-wave zones that the entire area of the hole subtends at the observation point.

Let $u_{2}(P)$ represent the light field at point $P$ due to the diffraction of an opaque disk. According to Babinet's principle,
$$u_{2}(P)=u_{0}(P)-u_{1}(P)=u_{0}(P) \mathrm{e}^{-i \omega p}$$
Therefore, the diffraction light intensity at point $P$ is
$$I_{2}(P)=\left|u_{2}(P)\right|^{2}=I_{0}(P)$$
That is, at a point on the axis of the opaque disk far enough from the disk, the light intensity at each point is exactly equal to the light intensity when the disk is not present.

question: 一近视患者不戴眼镜时，只能看清距眼晴 $a=20 \mathrm{~cm}$ 以内的物体。他发现，如果在眼前靠近眼晴处放一带小圆孔的卡片，通过小圆孔不戴眼镜看远处物体时也能清晰些。 (1) 若小圆孔的直径为 $D$ ，试根据几何光学的原理求出当近视眼直视远处的一个点物时，在眼晴的视网膜上产生的光斑的直径； (2) 再考虑小孔的衍射效应，求小圆孔直径最恰当的大小。 提示：可将眼睛简化成一个焦距 $f$ 可调的薄透镜和一个可成像的视网膜，透镜两侧介质均为空气，视网膜与透镜的距离为 $b$ 。
solution: 解 近视眼眼轴过长，为看清远处物体，使晶状体焦距为最大，记为 $f_{\mathrm{M}}$ $$ \frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{a}=\frac{1}{f_{\mathrm{M}}} \text { 或者 } f_{\mathrm{M}}=\frac{a b}{a+b} $$ 远处物体，像距 $f_{\mathrm{M}}$ 。圆孔几何光学成像的光斑直径 $$ d=\frac{b-f_{\mathrm{M}}}{f_{\mathrm{M}}} D=\frac{b-\frac{a b}{a+b}}{\frac{a b}{a+b}}=\frac{b}{a} \mathrm{D} $$ 相应的角直径 $$ \Delta \theta_{b}=\frac{d}{b-f_{\mathrm{M}}}=\frac{D}{a} $$ 而圆孔衍射的角直径 $$ 2 \Delta \theta_{d}=2.44 \frac{\lambda}{D} $$ 当 $2 \Delta \theta_{d}=\Delta \theta_{b}$ 时，最大光强落在小孔在视网膜上的投影区，此时 $$ D=\sqrt{2.44 a \lambda}=\sqrt{2.44 \times 200 \times 0.5 \times 10^{-3}}=0.49(\mathrm{~mm}) $$

question: A person with myopia can only see objects clearly within a distance of $a = 20 \mathrm{~cm}$ from the eyes without wearing glasses. He finds that by placing a card with a small circular hole close to the eyes, he can see distant objects more clearly through the small hole without wearing glasses. (1) If the diameter of the small circular hole is $D$, try to determine the diameter of the light spot formed on the retina when the myopic eye looks directly at a distant point object, based on the principles of geometrical optics. (2) Consider the diffraction effect of the small hole and determine the most appropriate size for the diameter of the small circular hole. Hint: The eye can be simplified as a thin lens with an adjustable focal length $f$ and an image-forming retina, with air as the medium on both sides of the lens. The distance between the retina and the lens is $b$.
solution: Solution: For myopia, where the axial length of the eye is too long, to see distant objects clearly, the focal length of the lens is maximized, denoted as $f_{\mathrm{M}}$. The equation is given by $$ \frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{a}=\frac{1}{f_{\mathrm{M}}} \text{ or } f_{\mathrm{M}}=\frac{a b}{a+b} $$. For distant objects, the image distance is $f_{\mathrm{M}}$. The diameter of the light spot in geometrical optics imaging through a circular aperture is $$ d=\frac{b-f_{\mathrm{M}}}{f_{\mathrm{M}}} D=\frac{b-\frac{a b}{a+b}}{\frac{a b}{a+b}}=\frac{b}{a} \mathrm{D} $$. The corresponding angular diameter is $$ \Delta \theta_{b}=\frac{d}{b-f_{\mathrm{M}}}=\frac{D}{a} $$. The angular diameter of diffraction through a circular aperture is $$ 2 \Delta \theta_{d}=2.44 \frac{\lambda}{D} $$. When $2 \Delta \theta_{d}=\Delta \theta_{b}$, the maximum light intensity falls on the projection area of the small aperture on the retina, at this point $$ D=\sqrt{2.44 a \lambda}=\sqrt{2.44 \times 200 \times 0.5 \times 10^{-3}}=0.49(\mathrm{~mm}) $$.

question: 空气中有一直径为 10 cm 的导体球, 它的电势为 8000 V , 试问它外面靠近表面处, 电场能量密度是多少?
solution:
设球的半径为 $R$, 球上的电荷量为 $Q$, 则由对称性和高斯定理得, 球外靠近表面处,电场强度的大小 $E$ 和电势 $U$ 分别为
$$
\begin{aligned}
E & =\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R^{2}} \\
U & =\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R} \\
E & =\frac{U}{R}
\end{aligned}
$$
故所求的电场能量密度为
$$
w=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_{0} E^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_{0}\left(\frac{U}{R}\right)^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \times 8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times\left(\frac{8000}{\frac{10}{2} \times 10^{-2}}\right)^{2}=0.11\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right)
$$

question: A conductor sphere with a diameter of 10 cm in the air has a potential of 8000 V. What is the energy density of the electric field near its surface?
solution:
Let the radius of the sphere be $R$, and the charge on the sphere be $Q$. By symmetry and Gauss's theorem, the magnitude of the electric field $E$ and the electric potential $U$ near the surface outside the sphere are given by
$$
\begin{aligned}
E & =\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R^{2}}, \\
U & =\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}, \\
E & =\frac{U}{R}.
\end{aligned}
$$
Therefore, the desired electric energy density is
$$
w=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_{0} E^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \varepsilon_{0}\left(\frac{U}{R}\right)^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \times 8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times\left(\frac{8000}{\frac{10}{2} \times 10^{-2}}\right)^{2}=0.11\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right).
$$

question: 电荷量 $Q$ 均匀分布在半径为 $R$ 的球体内, 试求它的静电能量.
solution:
设球体的电荷量 $Q$ 是从无穷远处（电势为零处）一点一点地移来，一层一层地逐渐分布而成的. 当移来的电荷量为 $q$ 时, 形成一个半径为 $r$ 的球体, 其中电荷量的密度 $\rho$ 与最后的密度相同. 这时球面上的电势为
$$
u=\frac{q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}$$
再从无穷远处移来电荷量 $\mathrm{d} q$, 故到这球面上, 外力反抗 $q$ 的电场力所要做的功便为 $\nu \mathrm{~d} q$, 因而静电能量的增量为
$$
\mathrm{d} W=\nu \mathrm{~d} q=\frac{q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r} \mathrm{~d} q
$$
因为
$$
q=\frac{4 \pi}{3} r^{3} \rho
$$
所以
$$
\mathrm{d} q=4 \pi \rho r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r
$$
将式(3) 、(4)代人式(2)得
$$
\mathrm{d} W=\frac{4 \pi}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} r^{4} \mathrm{~d} r
$$
积分便得所求的静电能量为
$$
W=\frac{4 \pi}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} \int_{0}^{R} r^{4} \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}=\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(\frac{Q}{\frac{4 \pi R^{4}}{3}}\right)^{2} R^{5}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
$$
【别解】 用静电能量的公式
$$
W=\frac{1}{2} \int U \mathrm{~d} q
$$
计算. 根据对称性和高斯定理得出电场强度为
$$
\begin{gathered}
\boldsymbol{E}_{i}=\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \boldsymbol{r}, \quad r \leqslant R \\
\boldsymbol{E}_{0}=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{\boldsymbol{r}}{r^{3}}, \quad r \geqslant R
\end{gathered}
$$
球内离球心为 $r$ 处的电势为
$$
\begin{aligned}
U & =\int_{r}^{\infty} \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{r}=\int_{r}^{R} \boldsymbol{E}_{i} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}+\int_{R}^{\infty} \boldsymbol{E}_{0} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r} \\
& =\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{r}^{R} \boldsymbol{r} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}+\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{R}^{\infty} \frac{\boldsymbol{r} \cdot \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{r}}{r^{2}}=\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)+\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{1}{R} \\
& =\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)+\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} R^{2}=\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
将式（10）代人式（7）得
$$
\begin{aligned}
W & =\frac{1}{2} \int U \mathrm{~d} q=\frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{R} \frac{\rho^{2}}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right) \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{\pi \rho^{2}}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{0}^{R}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right) r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
\end{aligned}
$$
【别解】 用场能的公式
$$
W=\frac{1}{2} \iiint \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \boldsymbol{D} \mathrm{d} V
$$
计算. 利用 $\boldsymbol{D}=\varepsilon_{0} \boldsymbol{E}$, 将式(8)、(9)代人式(12)得
$$
\begin{aligned}
W & =\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \iiint E^{2} \mathrm{~d} V=\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \int_{0}^{R}\left(\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} r\right)^{2} \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r+\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \int_{R}^{\infty}\left(\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{2}}\right)^{2} \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{2 \pi}{45 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}+\frac{Q^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}=\frac{Q^{2}}{40 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}+\frac{Q^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
\end{aligned}
$$

question: The charge $Q$ is uniformly distributed within a sphere of radius $R$. Find its electrostatic energy.
solution:
Let the charge quantity $Q$ of the sphere be moved from infinity (where the potential is zero) bit by bit, gradually distributed layer by layer. When the moved charge quantity is $q$, a sphere with a radius of $r$ is formed, where the charge density $\rho$ is the same as the final density. At this time, the potential on the sphere is
$$
u=\frac{q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}
$$
Then, move an infinitesimal charge $\mathrm{d} q$ from infinity. Therefore, the work done by the external force against the electric field force of $q$ to this sphere is $\nu \mathrm{~d} q$, thus the increment of electrostatic energy is
$$
\mathrm{d} W=\nu \mathrm{~d} q=\frac{q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r} \mathrm{~d} q
$$
Because
$$
q=\frac{4 \pi}{3} r^{3} \rho
$$
So
$$
\mathrm{d} q=4 \pi \rho r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r
$$
Substitute equations (3) and (4) into equation (2) to get
$$
\mathrm{d} W=\frac{4 \pi}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} r^{4} \mathrm{~d} r
$$
Integrating yields the required electrostatic energy
$$
W=\frac{4 \pi}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} \int_{0}^{R} r^{4} \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}=\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(\frac{Q}{\frac{4 \pi R^{4}}{3}}\right)^{2} R^{5}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
$$
[Alternative Solution] Use the formula for electrostatic energy
$$
W=\frac{1}{2} \int U \mathrm{~d} q
$$
to calculate. According to symmetry and Gauss's theorem, the electric field strength is
$$
\begin{gathered}
\boldsymbol{E}_{i}=\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \boldsymbol{r}, \quad r \leqslant R \\
\boldsymbol{E}_{0}=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{\boldsymbol{r}}{r^{3}}, \quad r \geqslant R
\end{gathered}
$$
The potential at a point inside the sphere at a distance $r$ from the center is
$$
\begin{aligned}
U & =\int_{r}^{\infty} \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{r}=\int_{r}^{R} \boldsymbol{E}_{i} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}+\int_{R}^{\infty} \boldsymbol{E}_{0} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r} \\
& =\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{r}^{R} \boldsymbol{r} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}+\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{R}^{\infty} \frac{\boldsymbol{r} \cdot \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{r}}{r^{2}}=\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)+\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{1}{R} \\
& =\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)+\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} R^{2}=\frac{\rho}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$
Substitute equation (10) into equation (7) to get
$$
\begin{aligned}
W & =\frac{1}{2} \int U \mathrm{~d} q=\frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{R} \frac{\rho^{2}}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right) \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{\pi \rho^{2}}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} \int_{0}^{R}\left(3 R^{2}-r^{2}\right) r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{4 \pi}{15 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
\end{aligned}
$$
[Alternative Solution] Use the formula for field energy
$$
W=\frac{1}{2} \iiint \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \boldsymbol{D} \mathrm{d} V
$$
to calculate. Using $\boldsymbol{D}=\varepsilon_{0} \boldsymbol{E}$, substitute equations (8) and (9) into equation (12) to get
$$
\begin{aligned}
W & =\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \iiint E^{2} \mathrm{~d} V=\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \int_{0}^{R}\left(\frac{\rho}{3 \varepsilon_{0}} r\right)^{2} \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r+\frac{\varepsilon_{0}}{2} \int_{R}^{\infty}\left(\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r^{2}}\right)^{2} \cdot 4 \pi r^{2} \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{2 \pi}{45 \varepsilon_{0}} \rho^{2} R^{5}+\frac{Q^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}=\frac{Q^{2}}{40 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}+\frac{Q^{2}}{8 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}=\frac{3 Q^{2}}{20 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R}
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 假定电子是球形的, 并且它的静止能量 $m c^{2}$ ( $m$ 是它的静质量, $c$ 是真空中光速) 就是来自它的静电能量. 这样就可以由它的电荷分布算出它的半径来. (1) 假定电子的电荷量 $e$ 均匀分布在球面上, 试计算电子的半径; (2) 假定电子的电荷量 $e$ 均匀分布在球体内, 试计算电子的半径; (3) 由于假定电荷分布情况不同, 算出的电子半径便稍有不同. 目前把 $r_{e}=\frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{e^{2}}{m c^{2}}$ 称为经典电子半径. 已知电子电荷的大小为 $e=1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, 静质量为 $m=9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$, 光速 $c=3.0 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$. 试计算 $r_{e}$ 的值.

Assume that the electron is spherical, and its rest energy $m c^{2}$ (where $m$ is its rest mass, and $c$ is the speed of light in a vacuum) comes from its electrostatic energy. In this way, its radius can be calculated from its charge distribution. (1) Assume the electron's charge $e$ is uniformly distributed on the surface of the sphere, try to calculate the electron's radius; (2) Assume the electron's charge $e$ is uniformly distributed within the sphere, try to calculate the electron's radius; (3) Due to the different assumptions of charge distribution, the calculated electron radius will vary slightly. Currently, $r_{e}=\frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{e^{2}}{m c^{2}}$ is referred to as the classical electron radius. Given that the magnitude of the electron charge is $e=1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, the rest mass is $m=9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$, and the speed of light is $c=3.0 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$. Try to calculate the value of $r_{e}$.
一铜线直径为 1.0 cm , 载有 200 A 的电流, 已知铜的电阻率为 $\rho=$ $1.72 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}$, 试求这铜线里电场强度的大小 $E$. 这铜线上相距 100 m 的两点电势差是多少?
solution:
铜线里电场强度的大小为
$$
E=\frac{j}{\sigma}=\rho j=\rho \frac{I}{\pi r^{2}}=1.72 \times 10^{-8} \times \frac{200}{\pi\left(\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-2}}{2}\right)^{2}}=4.4 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
$$
相距 100 m 两点的电势差为
$$
U=E I=4.4 \times 10^{-2} \times 100=4.4(\mathrm{~V})
$$

question: The diameter of a copper wire is 1.0 cm, carrying a current of 200 A. Given that the resistivity of copper is $\rho = 1.72 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}$, find the magnitude of the electric field $E$ inside this copper wire. What is the potential difference between two points 100 m apart on this copper wire?
solution:
The magnitude of the electric field strength in the copper wire is
$$
E=\frac{j}{\sigma}=\rho j=\rho \frac{I}{\pi r^{2}}=1.72 \times 10^{-8} \times \frac{200}{\pi\left(\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-2}}{2}\right)^{2}}=4.4 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
$$
The potential difference between two points 100 m apart is
$$
U=E I=4.4 \times 10^{-2} \times 100=4.4(\mathrm{~V})
$$.

question: 有一个标明 $1 \mathrm{k} \Omega 40 \mathrm{~W}$ 的电位器, 试问: (1) 允许通过它的最大电流是多少?（2）允许加在它两端的最高电压是多少?（3）在它两端加上 10 V 电压时, 它消耗的功率是多少?
solution:
(1) 允许通过它的最大电流为
$$I_{\max }=\sqrt{\frac{P}{R}}=\sqrt{\frac{40}{10^{3}}}=0.2(\mathrm{~A})$$
(2) 允许加在它两端的最高电压为
$$U_{\max }=\frac{P}{I}=\frac{40}{0.2}=200(\mathrm{~V})$$
(3) 消耗的功率为
$$P=\frac{U^{2}}{R}=\frac{10^{2}}{10^{3}}=0.1(\mathrm{~W})$$

question: There is a potentiometer marked with $1 \mathrm{k} \Omega 40 \mathrm{~W}$. Questions: (1) What is the maximum current allowed through it? (2) What is the highest voltage allowed across it? (3) What is the power consumed when a 10 V voltage is applied across it?
solution:
(1) The maximum current allowed through it is
$$I_{\max }=\sqrt{\frac{P}{R}}=\sqrt{\frac{40}{10^{3}}}=0.2(\mathrm{~A})$$

(2) The maximum voltage allowed across it is
$$U_{\max }=\frac{P}{I}=\frac{40}{0.2}=200(\mathrm{~V})$$

(3) The power consumed is
$$P=\frac{U^{2}}{R}=\frac{10^{2}}{10^{3}}=0.1(\mathrm{~W})$$.

question: 一条铝线的横截面积为 $0.10 \mathrm{~mm}^{2}$, 在室温 300 K 时载有 $5.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~A}$的电流. 设每个铝原子有三个电子参加导电. 已知铝的原子量为 27 , 室温下铝的密度为 $2.7 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, 电阻率为 $2.8 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}$, 电子电荷量的大小为 $1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, 电子质量 $m=9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$, 阿伏伽德罗常量为 $6.0 \times 10^{23} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$, 玻尔兹曼常量 $k=$ $1.38 \times 10^{-23} \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{K}$. 试求这铝线内: (1) 电子定向运动的平均速率 $\bar{u}$; (2) 电子热运动的方均根速率 $\sqrt{v^{2}}=\sqrt{3 k T / m}$; (3) 电场强度的大小 $E$; (4) 使 $\bar{u}=\sqrt{v^{2}}$ 所需的电场强度。
solution:
(1)参加导电的电子数密度为
$$
n=3 \times \frac{2.7 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3} \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~cm}^{3} / \mathrm{m}^{3}}{27} \times 6.0 \times 10^{23}=1.8 \times 10^{29}\left(\mathrm{个} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right)
$$
电子的平均定向速率为
$$
\begin{aligned}
\bar{u} & =\frac{j}{n e}=\frac{I}{n e S}=\frac{5.0 \times 10^{-4}}{1.8 \times 10^{29} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 0.10 \times 10^{-6}} \\
& =1.7 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s})
\end{aligned}
$$
（2）电子热运动的方均根速率为
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqrt{v^{2}} & =\sqrt{3 k T / m}=\sqrt{3 \times 1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300 / 9.1 \times 10^{-31}} \\
& =1.2 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s})
\end{aligned}
$$
(3)电场强度的大小为
$$
E=\rho j=\rho \frac{I}{S}=2.8 \times 10^{-8} \times \frac{5.0 \times 10^{-4}}{0.10 \times 10^{-8}}=1.4 \times 10^{-4}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
$$
(4) 使 $\bar{u}=\sqrt{v^{2}}$ 所需的电场强度为
$$
\begin{aligned}
E & =\rho n e \sqrt{v^{2}}=2.8 \times 10^{-8} \times 1.8 \times 10^{29} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.2 \times 10^{5} \\
& =9.7 \times 10^{7}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}
$$

question: The cross-sectional area of an aluminum wire is $0.10 \mathrm{~mm}^{2}$, carrying a current of $5.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~A}$ at room temperature 300 K. Assume that each aluminum atom has three electrons participating in conduction. The atomic mass of aluminum is 27, the density of aluminum at room temperature is $2.7 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, and the resistivity is $2.8 \times 10^{-8} \Omega \cdot \mathrm{~m}$. The magnitude of the electron charge is $1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, the electron mass $m=9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$, Avogadro's constant is $6.0 \times 10^{23} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$, and the Boltzmann constant $k=1.38 \times 10^{-23} \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{K}$. Find in this aluminum wire: (1) the average velocity of electron drift $\bar{u}$; (2) the root mean square velocity of electron thermal motion $\sqrt{v^{2}}=\sqrt{3 k T / m}$; (3) the magnitude of the electric field intensity $E$; (4) the electric field intensity required to make $\bar{u}=\sqrt{v^{2}}$.
solution:
(1) The electron number density participating in conduction is
$$
n=3 \times \frac{2.7 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3} \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~cm}^{3} / \mathrm{m}^{3}}{27} \times 6.0 \times 10^{23}=1.8 \times 10^{29}\left(\mathrm{per} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right)
$$
The average drift velocity of the electron is
$$
\begin{aligned}
\bar{u} & =\frac{j}{n e}=\frac{I}{n e S}=\frac{5.0 \times 10^{-4}}{1.8 \times 10^{29} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 0.10 \times 10^{-6}} \\
& =1.7 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s})
\end{aligned}
$$
(2) The root mean square speed of the electron's thermal motion is
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqrt{v^{2}} & =\sqrt{3 k T / m}=\sqrt{3 \times 1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300 / 9.1 \times 10^{-31}} \\
& =1.2 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s})
\end{aligned}
$$
(3) The magnitude of the electric field strength is
$$
E=\rho j=\rho \frac{I}{S}=2.8 \times 10^{-8} \times \frac{5.0 \times 10^{-4}}{0.10 \times 10^{-8}}=1.4 \times 10^{-4}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
$$
(4) The electric field strength required to make $\bar{u}=\sqrt{v^{2}}$ is
$$
\begin{aligned}
E & =\rho n e \sqrt{v^{2}}=2.8 \times 10^{-8} \times 1.8 \times 10^{29} \times 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.2 \times 10^{5} \\
& =9.7 \times 10^{7}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 电荷量 $Q$ 均匀地分布在半径为 $R$ 的球体内, 这球体以匀角速度 $\omega$ 绕它的一个固定的直径旋转. 试求: (1) 球内离转轴为 $r$ 处电流密度 $j$ 的大小; (2) 轴线上离球心为 $r$ 处的磁感强度 $\boldsymbol{B}$; (3) 磁矩.
solution:
【解】（1）离转轴为 $r$ 处的电流密度为
$$\boldsymbol{j}=\rho \boldsymbol{
u}=\frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{2}} \boldsymbol{\omega} \times \boldsymbol{r}$$
$j$ 的大小为
$$j=\frac{3 Q \omega r}{4 \pi R^{3}}$$
（2）先考虑球内. 如图5.1.49, $P$ 为转轴上离球心为 $r(r<R)$ 的一点, 这点的磁感强度 $\boldsymbol{B}$ 由两部分叠加而成, 一部分是半径为 $r$ 的小球在小球外产生的 $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$, 另一部分是内半径为 $r$ 、外半径为 $R$ 的球壳在壳内产生的 $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$. 下面依次求 $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$ 和 $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$.
先求 $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$.
在小球内取一半径为 $x$ 、厚为 $\mathrm{d} x$ 的球壳,这壳内的电荷量为
$$\mathrm{d} Q=\rho \mathrm{d} V=\frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{3}} \cdot 4 \pi x^{2} \mathrm{~d} x=\frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} x^{2} \mathrm{d} x$$
根据前面 5.1.48题的式（9），它在 $P$ 点产生的磁感强度为
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{0}=\frac{\mu_{0} \mathrm{~d} Q}{6 \pi x}\left(\frac{x}{r}\right)^{3} \boldsymbol{\omega}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{3}} r^{2} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x$$
积分便得
$$\boldsymbol{B}_{0}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2} r^{2}} \int_{0}^{r} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x=\frac{\mu_{0} Q r^{2}}{10 \pi R^{3}} \boldsymbol{\omega}$$
再求 $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$.
在球壳内取一半径为 $y$ 、厚为 $\mathrm{d} y$ 的球壳, 这壳内的电荷量为
$$\mathrm{d} Q=\rho \mathrm{d} V=\frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{2}} \cdot 4 \pi y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y=\frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y$$
根据前面 5.1.48 题的式（7），它在 $P$ 点产生的磁感强度为
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{i}=\frac{\mu_{0} \mathrm{~d} Q}{6 \pi y} \boldsymbol{\omega}=\frac{\mu_{0}}{6 \pi y} \frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y \boldsymbol{\omega}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2}} y \mathrm{~d} y$$
积分便得
$$\boldsymbol{B}_{i}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2}} \int_{r}^{R} y \mathrm{~d} y=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{4 \pi R^{2}}\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)$$
于是得 $P$ 点的磁感强度为
$$\boldsymbol{B}=\boldsymbol{B}_{0}+\boldsymbol{B}_{i}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q}{4 \pi R}\left(1-\frac{3}{5} \frac{r^{2}}{R^{2}}\right) \boldsymbol{\omega}, \quad r<R$$
再考虑球外. 这时 $r>R$. 由式(4)积分得
$$\boldsymbol{B}=\frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2} r^{2}} \int_{0}^{R} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x=\frac{\mu_{0} Q R^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}}{10 \pi r^{2}}, \quad r>R$$
（3）求磁矩 $m$.
在球内取半径为 $x$ 、厚为 $\mathrm{d} x$ 的球壳, 根据前面 5.1.48题的式(12), 这球壳的磁矩为
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{m}=\frac{1}{3}(\mathrm{d} Q) x^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}=\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} x^{2} \mathrm{~d} x\right) x^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}=\frac{Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{R^{2}} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x$$
积分便得
$$\boldsymbol{m}=\frac{Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{R^{2}} \int_{0}^{R} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x=\frac{1}{5} Q R^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}$$

question: The charge amount $Q$ is uniformly distributed within a sphere of radius $R$, and this sphere rotates around one of its fixed diameters with a uniform angular velocity $\omega$. Find: (1) the magnitude of the current density $j$ at a distance $r$ from the rotation axis inside the sphere; (2) the magnetic induction $\boldsymbol{B}$ at a distance $r$ from the center of the sphere along the axis; (3) the magnetic moment.
solution:
Solution:

(1) The current density at a distance $r$ from the axis of rotation is
$$\boldsymbol{j} = \rho \boldsymbol{u} = \frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{2}} \boldsymbol{\omega} \times \boldsymbol{r}$$
The magnitude of $j$ is
$$j = \frac{3 Q \omega r}{4 \pi R^{3}}$$

(2) First consider inside the sphere. As shown in Figure 5.1.49, $P$ is a point on the axis of rotation at a distance $r (r<R)$ from the center of the sphere. The magnetic induction $\boldsymbol{B}$ at this point is composed of two parts: one part is $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$ produced outside the small sphere of radius $r$, and the other part is $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$ produced inside the spherical shell with inner radius $r$ and outer radius $R$. We will now find $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$ and $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$ in sequence.

First, find $\boldsymbol{B}_{0}$.
Consider a spherical shell inside the small sphere with radius $x$ and thickness $\mathrm{d} x$. The charge in this shell is
$$\mathrm{d} Q = \rho \mathrm{d} V = \frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{3}} \cdot 4 \pi x^{2} \mathrm{~d} x = \frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} x^{2} \mathrm{d} x$$
According to equation (9) from problem 5.1.48, the magnetic induction it produces at point $P$ is
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{0} = \frac{\mu_{0} \mathrm{~d} Q}{6 \pi x}\left(\frac{x}{r}\right)^{3} \boldsymbol{\omega} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{3}} r^{2} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x$$
Integrating gives
$$\boldsymbol{B}_{0} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2} r^{2}} \int_{0}^{r} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x = \frac{\mu_{0} Q r^{2}}{10 \pi R^{3}} \boldsymbol{\omega}$$

Now, find $\boldsymbol{B}_{i}$.
Consider a spherical shell inside the shell with radius $y$ and thickness $\mathrm{d} y$. The charge in this shell is
$$\mathrm{d} Q = \rho \mathrm{d} V = \frac{3 Q}{4 \pi R^{2}} \cdot 4 \pi y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y = \frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y$$
According to equation (7) from problem 5.1.48, the magnetic induction it produces at point $P$ is
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{i} = \frac{\mu_{0} \mathrm{~d} Q}{6 \pi y} \boldsymbol{\omega} = \frac{\mu_{0}}{6 \pi y} \frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} y^{2} \mathrm{~d} y \boldsymbol{\omega} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2}} y \mathrm{~d} y$$
Integrating gives
$$\boldsymbol{B}_{i} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2}} \int_{r}^{R} y \mathrm{~d} y = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{4 \pi R^{2}}\left(R^{2} - r^{2}\right)$$

Thus, the magnetic induction at point $P$ is
$$\boldsymbol{B} = \boldsymbol{B}_{0} + \boldsymbol{B}_{i} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q}{4 \pi R}\left(1 - \frac{3}{5} \frac{r^{2}}{R^{2}}\right) \boldsymbol{\omega}, \quad r<R$$

Now consider outside the sphere. In this case $r>R$. Integrating equation (4) gives
$$\boldsymbol{B} = \frac{\mu_{0} Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{2 \pi R^{2} r^{2}} \int_{0}^{R} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x = \frac{\mu_{0} Q R^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}}{10 \pi r^{2}}, \quad r>R$$

(3) Calculate the magnetic moment $m$.
Consider a spherical shell inside the sphere with radius $x$ and thickness $\mathrm{d} x$. According to equation (12) from problem 5.1.48, the magnetic moment of this shell is
$$\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{m} = \frac{1}{3}(\mathrm{d} Q) x^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega} = \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{3 Q}{R^{2}} x^{2} \mathrm{~d} x\right) x^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega} = \frac{Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{R^{2}} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x$$
Integrating gives
$$\boldsymbol{m} = \frac{Q \boldsymbol{\omega}}{R^{2}} \int_{0}^{R} x^{4} \mathrm{~d} x = \frac{1}{5} Q R^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}$$

question: 两无穷大的平行平面上都有均匀分布的电流, 面电流密度分别为 $\boldsymbol{k}_{1}$ 和 $\boldsymbol{k}_{2}, \boldsymbol{k}_{1}$ 和 $\boldsymbol{k}_{2}$ 的夹角为 $\theta$. (1) 试求两面之间的磁感强度; (2) 试求两面之外的磁感强度; (3) 当 $\theta=\pi$, 且 $\left|\boldsymbol{k}_{1}\right|=\left|\boldsymbol{k}_{2}\right|$ 时, 结果如何?

There are uniformly distributed currents on two infinitely large parallel planes, with surface current densities of $\boldsymbol{k}_{1}$ and $\boldsymbol{k}_{2}$, and the angle between $\boldsymbol{k}_{1}$ and $\boldsymbol{k}_{2}$ is $\theta$. (1) Try to find the magnetic field intensity between the two planes; (2) Try to find the magnetic field intensity outside the two planes; (3) What is the result when $\theta=\pi$ and $\left|\boldsymbol{k}_{1}\right|=\left|\boldsymbol{k}_{2}\right|$?
一介质球均匀磁化，磁化强度为 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 。试求沿 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 的直径上离球心为 $r$ 处的磁感强度。
solution:
用分子电流观点求解。
根据前面 7.21 题，球内磁化电流密度为零，球面上有一层磁化面电流
$$ \boldsymbol{k}_{m}=M \sin \theta \boldsymbol{e}_{M} $$
式中 $\boldsymbol{e}_{M}$ 为 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 的右手螺旋方向上的单位矢量. 球内的磁场便是这层面电流产生的。
过球心 $O$ 取沿 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 方向的直径 $A B, P$ 为这直径上的一点，到 $O$ 的距离为 $r$ 。如图7.22，球面上 $\theta$ 处的环带 $R \mathrm{~d} \theta$ 上的磁化电流为
$$ \mathrm{d} I_{m}=k_{m} R \mathrm{~d} \theta=R M \sin \theta \mathrm{~d} \theta $$
式中 $R$ 为球的半径. 根据前面 5.1.20题的式（2），这 $\mathrm{d} I_{m}$在 $P$ 点产生的磁感强度为
$$ \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0}(R \sin \theta)^{2} \mathrm{~d} I_{m}}{2\left[(r+R \cos \theta)^{2}+(R \sin \theta)^{2}\right]^{3 / 2}} \boldsymbol{e}_{M} $$
![img-576.jpeg](images/img-576.jpeg)

图 7.22
式中 $\boldsymbol{e}$ 为 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 方向上的单位矢量. 将式（2）代人式（3）得
$$ \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0} R^{3} \boldsymbol{M}}{2} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} $$
积分便得
$$ \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0} R^{3} \boldsymbol{M}}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} $$
其中积分在 $r<R$ 时为
$$ \begin{aligned} & \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} \\ = & \frac{1}{4 r^{2} R^{2}}\left[-2\left(r^{2}+R^{2}\right) \sqrt{r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta}\right. \\ & \left.+\frac{1}{3}\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}-\frac{\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)^{2}}{\sqrt{r^{2}+R^{2}-2 r R \cos \theta}}\right]_{\theta=0}^{R=\pi} \\ = & \frac{4}{3 R^{2}} \end{aligned} $$
代人式（5）便得所求的磁感强度为
$$ \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{2}{3} \mu_{0} \boldsymbol{M} $$
这个结果表明， $\boldsymbol{B}_{P}$ 与 $r$ 无关. 这就告诉我们， $A B$ 直径上每一点的磁感强度都相同，都由式 (7) 表示.
【讨论】 一、本题也可用磁荷观点,仿前面1.2.29 题的方法求解.
二、根据前面 5.2.21题的方法, 可以论证球内磁场是均匀磁场.

question: A medium sphere is uniformly magnetized with a magnetization intensity of $\boldsymbol{M}$. Find the magnetic induction at a distance $r$ from the center of the sphere along the diameter in the direction of $\boldsymbol{M}$.
solution:
To solve this problem from the perspective of molecular current:

According to problem 7.21, the magnetization current density inside the sphere is zero, and there is a layer of magnetized surface current on the surface of the sphere:

$$ \boldsymbol{k}_{m}=M \sin \theta \boldsymbol{e}_{M} $$

where $\boldsymbol{e}_{M}$ is the unit vector in the right-handed helical direction of $\boldsymbol{M}$. The magnetic field inside the sphere is generated by this layer of surface current.

Consider a diameter $AB$ passing through the center $O$ of the sphere along the direction of $\boldsymbol{M}$, and let $P$ be a point on this diameter at a distance $r$ from $O$. As shown in Figure 7.22, the magnetization current on the circular band at $\theta$ on the sphere's surface, $R \mathrm{~d} \theta$, is:

$$ \mathrm{d} I_{m}=k_{m} R \mathrm{~d} \theta=R M \sin \theta \mathrm{~d} \theta $$

where $R$ is the radius of the sphere. According to equation (2) from problem 5.1.20, the magnetic induction at point $P$ generated by this $\mathrm{d} I_{m}$ is:

$$ \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0}(R \sin \theta)^{2} \mathrm{~d} I_{m}}{2\left[(r+R \cos \theta)^{2}+(R \sin \theta)^{2}\right]^{3 / 2}} \boldsymbol{e}_{M} $$

where $\boldsymbol{e}$ is the unit vector in the direction of $\boldsymbol{M}$. Substituting equation (2) into equation (3) gives:

$$ \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0} R^{3} \boldsymbol{M}}{2} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} $$

Integrating gives:

$$ \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{\mu_{0} R^{3} \boldsymbol{M}}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} $$

where the integral for $r<R$ is:

$$ \begin{aligned} & \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin ^{3} \vartheta \mathrm{~d} \vartheta}{\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}} \\ = & \frac{1}{4 r^{2} R^{2}}\left[-2\left(r^{2}+R^{2}\right) \sqrt{r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta}\right. \\ & \left.+\frac{1}{3}\left(r^{2}+R^{2}+2 r R \cos \theta\right)^{3 / 2}-\frac{\left(R^{2}-r^{2}\right)^{2}}{\sqrt{r^{2}+R^{2}-2 r R \cos \theta}}\right]_{\theta=0}^{R=\pi} \\ = & \frac{4}{3 R^{2}} \end{aligned} $$

Substituting into equation (5) gives the required magnetic induction:

$$ \boldsymbol{B}_{P}=\frac{2}{3} \mu_{0} \boldsymbol{M} $$

This result indicates that $\boldsymbol{B}_{P}$ is independent of $r$. This tells us that the magnetic induction at every point on the diameter $AB$ is the same and is given by equation (7).

[Discussion] 1. This problem can also be solved using the concept of magnetic charge, similar to the method used in problem 1.2.29.
2. According to the method from problem 5.2.21, it can be demonstrated that the magnetic field inside the sphere is a uniform magnetic field.

question: 在一电子感应加速器中, 电子加速的时间是 4.2 ms . 电子轨道内磁通量的最大值为 1.8 Wb . (1) 试求电子沿轨道加速时, 平均每绕行一圈所获得的能量; (2) 设电子开始时速度为零, 最后的动能为 100 MeV , 试问它共绕行了多少圈? (3) 若轨道半径为 84 cm , 试问它在加速过程中共走了多少路程?
solution:
【解】（1）电子加速过程中，感应电场强度的平均值为
$$E_{i}^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2 \pi R} \frac{\mathrm{~d} \Phi}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\frac{1}{2 \pi R} \frac{\Phi_{\max }}{t}$$
式中 $R$ 是电子轨道半径, $\Phi_{\max }$ 是电子轨道内磁通量的最大值, $t$ 是电子加速的时间.
电子加速时, 平均每圈获得的能量为
$$\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon & =e \cdot 2 \pi R E_{i}^{\prime}=\frac{e \Phi_{\max }}{t}=\frac{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.8}{4.2 \times 10^{-3}} \\
& =6.9 \times 10^{-17}(\mathrm{~J})=4.3 \times 10^{2}(\mathrm{eV})
\end{aligned}$$
(2) 电子绕行的圈数为
$$N=\frac{100 \times 10^{8}}{4.3 \times 10^{2}}=2.3 \times 10^{5}$$
(3) 电子所走过的路程为
$$\begin{aligned}
s & =2 \pi R N=2 \pi \times 84 \times 10^{-2} \times 2.3 \times 10^{5} \\
& =1.2 \times 10^{6}(\mathrm{~m})=1.2 \times 10^{3}(\mathrm{~km})
\end{aligned}$$

question: In an electron induction accelerator, the acceleration time for the electron is 4.2 ms. The maximum magnetic flux within the electron orbit is 1.8 Wb. (1) Calculate the average energy gained by the electron per revolution along the orbit during acceleration. (2) If the initial speed of the electron is zero and the final kinetic energy is 100 MeV, how many revolutions did it complete in total? (3) If the orbit radius is 84 cm, what is the total distance traveled by the electron during the acceleration process?
solution:
Solution:

(1) During the electron acceleration process, the average value of the induced electric field strength is

$$E_{i}^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2 \pi R} \frac{\mathrm{~d} \Phi}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\frac{1}{2 \pi R} \frac{\Phi_{\max }}{t}$$

where $R$ is the radius of the electron orbit, $\Phi_{\max }$ is the maximum magnetic flux within the electron orbit, and $t$ is the time of electron acceleration. The energy gained by the electron per orbit on average is

$$\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon & =e \cdot 2 \pi R E_{i}^{\prime}=\frac{e \Phi_{\max }}{t}=\frac{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1.8}{4.2 \times 10^{-3}} \\
& =6.9 \times 10^{-17}(\mathrm{~J})=4.3 \times 10^{2}(\mathrm{eV})
\end{aligned}$$

(2) The number of orbits the electron completes is

$$N=\frac{100 \times 10^{8}}{4.3 \times 10^{2}}=2.3 \times 10^{5}$$

(3) The total distance traveled by the electron is

$$\begin{aligned}
s & =2 \pi R N=2 \pi \times 84 \times 10^{-2} \times 2.3 \times 10^{5} \\
& =1.2 \times 10^{6}(\mathrm{~m})=1.2 \times 10^{3}(\mathrm{~km})
\end{aligned}$$

question: 一同轴传输线由很长的两个同轴导体薄圆筒构成，内筒半径为 $R_{1}=$ 40 mm ，外筒半径为 $R_{2}=120 \mathrm{~mm}$ ，两筒间是空气。在两筒间加上 $U=10 \mathrm{~V}$ 电压时，电流由一筒流去，由另一筒流回，大小为 $I=10 \mathrm{~mA}$ ，电流在两筒上都是均匀分布的。 $a$是两筒间很靠近内筒的一点， $b$ 是两筒间很靠近外筒的一点。试求：（1） $a 、 b$ 两点电场强度和电位移的值；（2） $a 、 b$ 两点磁场强度和磁感强度的值；（3）单位长度的电容；（4）单位长度的自感。
solution:
(1) 设内筒上单位长度的电荷量为 $\lambda$ ，两筒间的电场强度为 $\boldsymbol{E}$ ，则由对称性和高斯定理得 $\boldsymbol{E}$ 的方向沿径向外， $\boldsymbol{E}$ 的大小为

$$E=\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}, \quad R_{1}<r<R_{2}$$

两筒的电势差为

$$\begin{aligned}
U=U_{1}-U_{2} & =\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}=\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} E \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \ln \frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}} \\
\lambda & =\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} U}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}
\end{aligned}$$

由式(1)、(3)得所求的电场强度为

$$\begin{aligned}
E_{a} & =\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1}}=\frac{U}{R_{1} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{10}{40 \times 10^{-3} \ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =2.3 \times 10^{2}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}) \\
E_{b} & =\frac{U}{R_{2} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{10}{120 \times 10^{-3} \ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =76(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}$$

电位移为

$$\begin{aligned}
D_{a} & =\varepsilon_{0} E_{a}=8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.3 \times 10^{2} \\
& =2.0 \times 10^{-3}\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}\right) \\
D_{b} & =\varepsilon_{0} E_{b}=8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times 76 \\
& =6.7 \times 10^{-10}\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}\right)
\end{aligned}$$

（2）根据对称性和安培环路定理得， $a 、 b$ 两点的磁场强度分别为

$$H_{a}=\frac{I}{2 \pi R_{1}}=\frac{10 \times 10^{-3}}{2 \pi \times 40 \times 10^{-3}}=4.0 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m})$$

$$H_{b}=\frac{I}{2 \pi R_{2}}=\frac{10 \times 10^{-3}}{2 \pi \times 120 \times 10^{-3}}=1.3 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m})$$

磁感强度分别为

$$\begin{aligned}
& B_{a}=\mu_{0} H_{a}=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times 4.0 \times 10^{-2}=5.0 \times 10^{-4}(\mathrm{~T}) \\
& B_{b}=\mu_{0} H_{b}=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times 1.3 \times 10^{-2}=1.6 \times 10^{-8}(\mathrm{~T})
\end{aligned}$$

（3）由式（1）、（3）得，长为 $l$-段的电容为

$$C=\frac{Q}{U}=\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} l}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}$$

故单位长度的电容为

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{C}{l} & =\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{2 \pi \times 8.854 \times 10^{-12}}{\ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =5.1 \times 10^{-11}(\mathrm{~F} / \mathrm{m})=51(\mathrm{pF} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}$$

（4）长为 $l$ 一段的磁通量为（参见前面图8.3.26）

$$\begin{aligned}
\Phi & =\iint_{S} \boldsymbol{B} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=\iint_{S} B \mathrm{~d} S=\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \frac{\mu_{0} I}{2 \pi r} l \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{\mu_{0} I l}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}\right)
\end{aligned}$$

这一段的自感为

$$L=\frac{\Phi}{I}=\frac{\mu_{0} I}{2 \pi} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)$$

故单位长度的自感为

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{L}{l} & =\frac{\mu_{0}}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}\right)=\frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7}}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{120}{40}\right) \\
& =2.2 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{H})
\end{aligned}$$

question: A coaxial transmission line consists of two very long coaxial conductive thin cylinders, with the inner cylinder having a radius of $R_{1} = 40 \text{ mm}$ and the outer cylinder having a radius of $R_{2} = 120 \text{ mm}$. The space between the cylinders is filled with air. When a voltage of $U = 10 \text{ V}$ is applied between the cylinders, a current of $I = 10 \text{ mA}$ flows from one cylinder to the other and back, with the current being uniformly distributed over both cylinders. Point $a$ is located very close to the inner cylinder, and point $b$ is located very close to the outer cylinder. Determine: (1) the electric field intensity and electric displacement at points $a$ and $b$; (2) the magnetic field intensity and magnetic flux density at points $a$ and $b$; (3) the capacitance per unit length; (4) the inductance per unit length.
solution:
(1) Let the charge per unit length on the inner cylinder be $\lambda$, and the electric field strength between the two cylinders be $\boldsymbol{E}$. By symmetry and Gauss's theorem, the direction of $\boldsymbol{E}$ is radially outward, and the magnitude of $\boldsymbol{E}$ is

$$E=\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} r}, \quad R_{1}<r<R_{2}$$

The potential difference between the two cylinders is

$$\begin{aligned}
U=U_{1}-U_{2} & =\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \boldsymbol{E} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{r}=\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} E \mathrm{~d} r=\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \ln \frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}} \\
\lambda & =\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} U}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}
\end{aligned}$$

From equations (1) and (3), the required electric field strength is

$$\begin{aligned}
E_{a} & =\frac{\lambda}{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1}}=\frac{U}{R_{1} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{10}{40 \times 10^{-3} \ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =2.3 \times 10^{2}(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}) \\
E_{b} & =\frac{U}{R_{2} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{10}{120 \times 10^{-3} \ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =76(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}$$

The electric displacement is

$$\begin{aligned}
D_{a} & =\varepsilon_{0} E_{a}=8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times 2.3 \times 10^{2} \\
& =2.0 \times 10^{-3}\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}\right) \\
D_{b} & =\varepsilon_{0} E_{b}=8.854 \times 10^{-12} \times 76 \\
& =6.7 \times 10^{-10}\left(\mathrm{C} / \mathrm{m}^{2}\right)
\end{aligned}$$

(2) According to symmetry and Ampere's circuital law, the magnetic field strength at points $a$ and $b$ are respectively

$$H_{a}=\frac{I}{2 \pi R_{1}}=\frac{10 \times 10^{-3}}{2 \pi \times 40 \times 10^{-3}}=4.0 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m})$$

$$H_{b}=\frac{I}{2 \pi R_{2}}=\frac{10 \times 10^{-3}}{2 \pi \times 120 \times 10^{-3}}=1.3 \times 10^{-2}(\mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m})$$

The magnetic flux densities are respectively

$$\begin{aligned}
& B_{a}=\mu_{0} H_{a}=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times 4.0 \times 10^{-2}=5.0 \times 10^{-4}(\mathrm{~T}) \\
& B_{b}=\mu_{0} H_{b}=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times 1.3 \times 10^{-2}=1.6 \times 10^{-8}(\mathrm{~T})
\end{aligned}$$

(3) From equations (1) and (3), the capacitance of a segment of length $l$ is

$$C=\frac{Q}{U}=\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0} l}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}$$

Thus, the capacitance per unit length is

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{C}{l} & =\frac{2 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}{\ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)}=\frac{2 \pi \times 8.854 \times 10^{-12}}{\ln (120 / 40)} \\
& =5.1 \times 10^{-11}(\mathrm{~F} / \mathrm{m})=51(\mathrm{pF} / \mathrm{m})
\end{aligned}$$

(4) The magnetic flux of a segment of length $l$ is (refer to the previous figure 8.3.26)

$$\begin{aligned}
\Phi & =\iint_{S} \boldsymbol{B} \cdot \mathrm{~d} \boldsymbol{S}=\iint_{S} B \mathrm{~d} S=\int_{R_{1}}^{R_{2}} \frac{\mu_{0} I}{2 \pi r} l \mathrm{~d} r \\
& =\frac{\mu_{0} I l}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\right)
\end{aligned}$$

The self-inductance of this segment is

$$L=\frac{\Phi}{I}=\frac{\mu_{0} I}{2 \pi} \ln \left(R_{2} / R_{1}\right)$$

Thus, the self-inductance per unit length is

$$\begin{aligned}
\frac{L}{l} & =\frac{\mu_{0}}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{R_{2}}{R_{1}}\right)=\frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7}}{2 \pi} \ln \left(\frac{120}{40}\right) \\
& =2.2 \times 10^{-7}(\mathrm{H})
\end{aligned}$$

question: 两线圈的自感分别为 $L_{1}=5.0 \mathrm{mH}$ 和 $L_{2}=3.0 \mathrm{mH}$ ，当它们顺串联时 （即磁场互相加强时），总自感为 11.0 mH （1）试求它们之间的互感 $M_{\mathrm{I}}$ （2）设这两线圈的形状和位置都不改变，只将其中一个反向串联（反串联），试求它们反串联后的总自感 $L$ 。

The self-inductances of two coils are $L_{1}=5.0 \mathrm{mH}$ and $L_{2}=3.0 \mathrm{mH}$ respectively. When they are connected in series in such a way that their magnetic fields reinforce each other, the total inductance is 11.0 mH. (1) Find the mutual inductance $M_{\mathrm{I}}$ between them. (2) Assuming the shapes and positions of the two coils remain unchanged, but one of them is connected in reverse (anti-series connection), find the total inductance $L$ after they are connected in reverse.
solution:
Solution: (1) The formula for the total inductance in series aiding is [see previous problem 8.3.37, equation (4), equation (13), or equation (22)]

$$
L = L_{1} + L_{2} + 2M
$$

Thus, the mutual inductance is

$$
M = \frac{1}{2} \left(L - L_{1} - L_{2}\right) = \frac{1}{2} \times (11.0 - 5.0 - 3.0) = 1.5 (\mathrm{mH}) = 1.5 \times 10^{-3} (\mathrm{H})
$$

(2) The formula for the total inductance in series opposing is [see previous problem 8.3.37, equation (8), equation (18), or equation (24)]

$$
L = L_{1} + L_{2} - 2M
$$

Substituting the values, we get

$$
L = 5.0 + 3.0 - 2 \times 1.5 = 5.0 (\mathrm{mH}) = 5.0 \times 10^{-3} (\mathrm{H})
$$

question: 两线圈顺串联（磁场互相加强）后总自感为 1.00 H ；在它们的形状和位置都不变的情况下，反串联（磁场互相削弱）总自感为 0.40 H . 试求它们之间的互感。

When two coils are connected in series (with magnetic fields reinforcing each other), the total inductance is 1.00 H; when connected in series opposition (with magnetic fields opposing each other) without changing their shape and position, the total inductance is 0.40 H. Find the mutual inductance between them.
solution:
Solution: The total inductance formula for two coils connected in series aiding is [see previous problem 8.3.37, equation (4), equation (13), or equation (22)]
$$
L = L_{1} + L_{2} + 2M = 1.00
$$
The total inductance formula for two coils connected in series opposing is [see previous problem 8.3.37, equation (8), equation (18), or equation (24)]
$$
L^{\prime} = L_{1} + L_{2} - 2M = 0.40
$$
Subtracting the two equations gives
$$
M = \frac{1}{4}(1.00 - 0.40) = 0.15(\mathrm{H})
$$

question: 一螺线管长 30 cm ，横截面的直径为 12 cm ，由 600 匝表面绝缘的细导线密绕而成. 管内是空气. 当它的导线中通有 1.0 A 的电流时, 试分别求管中心和管口轴线上的磁场能量密度。
solution: 由圆电流在轴线上产生磁场的公式[参见前面 5.1.20题的式（2）］，经积分得螺线管中心的磁感强度为[参见前面 5.1.29题的式（6）] $$ B_{0}=\frac{\mu_{0} n I}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{2 R}{l}\right)^{2}}} $$ 螺线管口轴线上的磁感强度为[参见前面 5.1.30题的式（3）] $$ B_{v}=\frac{1}{2} \frac{\mu_{0} n I}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{R}{l}\right)^{2}}} $$ 以上两式中 $n$ 为单位长度匝数， $I$ 为电流， $l$ 为螺线管长度， $R$ 为横截面半径。 由式（1）得管中心的磁场能量密度为 $$ \begin{aligned} w_{m} & =\frac{1}{2} H_{0} B_{0}=\frac{1}{2 \mu_{0}} B_{0}^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \frac{\mu_{0} n^{2} I^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{2 R}{l}\right)^{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times\left(\frac{600}{30 \times 10^{-2}} \times 1.0\right)^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{12}{30}\right)^{2}}=2.2\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right) \end{aligned} $$ 由式（2）得管口轴线上的磁场能量密度为 $$ \begin{aligned} w_{m} & =\frac{1}{2} H_{v} B_{v}=\frac{1}{2 \mu_{0}} B_{v}^{2}=\frac{1}{8} \frac{\mu_{0} n^{2} I^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{R}{l}\right)^{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{8} \frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times\left(\frac{600}{30 \times 10^{-2}} \times 1.0\right)^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{12}{2 \times 30}\right)^{2}}=0.60\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right) \end{aligned} $$

question: A solenoid is 30 cm long with a cross-sectional diameter of 12 cm, and it is tightly wound with 600 turns of thin, surface-insulated wire. The interior of the solenoid is filled with air. When a current of 1.0 A flows through the wire, calculate the magnetic energy density at the center and on the axis at the end of the solenoid.
solution:
The formula for the magnetic field produced by a circular current on its axis [refer to equation (2) in problem 5.1.20] is integrated to obtain the magnetic induction intensity at the center of the solenoid [refer to equation (6) in problem 5.1.29]:

$$ B_{0}=\frac{\mu_{0} n I}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{2 R}{l}\right)^{2}}} $$

The magnetic induction intensity on the axis at the mouth of the solenoid is [refer to equation (3) in problem 5.1.30]:

$$ B_{v}=\frac{1}{2} \frac{\mu_{0} n I}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{R}{l}\right)^{2}}} $$

In the above two equations, $n$ is the number of turns per unit length, $I$ is the current, $l$ is the length of the solenoid, and $R$ is the radius of the cross-section. From equation (1), the magnetic energy density at the center of the solenoid is:

$$ \begin{aligned} w_{m} & =\frac{1}{2} H_{0} B_{0}=\frac{1}{2 \mu_{0}} B_{0}^{2}=\frac{1}{2} \frac{\mu_{0} n^{2} I^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{2 R}{l}\right)^{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times\left(\frac{600}{30 \times 10^{-2}} \times 1.0\right)^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{12}{30}\right)^{2}}=2.2\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right) \end{aligned} $$

From equation (2), the magnetic energy density on the axis at the mouth of the solenoid is:

$$ \begin{aligned} w_{m} & =\frac{1}{2} H_{v} B_{v}=\frac{1}{2 \mu_{0}} B_{v}^{2}=\frac{1}{8} \frac{\mu_{0} n^{2} I^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{R}{l}\right)^{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{8} \frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \times\left(\frac{600}{30 \times 10^{-2}} \times 1.0\right)^{2}}{1+\left(\frac{12}{2 \times 30}\right)^{2}}=0.60\left(\mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{m}^{3}\right) \end{aligned} $$

question: 半径为 $a$ 的无限长直圆柱面均匀带电，单位面积的电荷量为 $\sigma$. 当这圆柱面以匀角速度 $\omega$ 绕它的几何轴旋转时，试求圆柱内单位长度的磁场能量。
solution: 单位长度的电流为 $$ \frac{I}{l}=\frac{Q}{l T}=\frac{Q \omega}{2 \pi l}=\frac{2 \pi a l \sigma \omega}{2 \pi l}=\sigma \omega a $$ 由对称性和安培环路定理得出，这时圆柱面内的磁场是均匀磁场[参见前面 5.2.17题]，磁场强度的方向平行于轴线，其大小为 $$ H=\frac{I}{l}=\sigma \omega a $$ 于是得单位长度的磁场能量为 $$ \frac{W_{m}}{l}=\frac{\mu_{0} H^{2} V}{2 l}=\frac{\mu_{0} \sigma^{2} \omega^{2} a^{2} \cdot \pi a^{2} l}{2 l}=\frac{1}{2} \pi \mu_{0} \sigma^{2} \omega^{2} a^{4} $$

question: An infinitely long straight cylindrical surface with a radius of $a$ is uniformly charged, with a charge per unit area of $\sigma$. When the cylindrical surface rotates about its geometric axis with a constant angular velocity $\omega$, find the magnetic energy per unit length inside the cylinder.
solution: The current per unit length is given by $$ \frac{I}{l}=\frac{Q}{l T}=\frac{Q \omega}{2 \pi l}=\frac{2 \pi a l \sigma \omega}{2 \pi l}=\sigma \omega a $$ By symmetry and Ampère's circuital law, the magnetic field inside the cylindrical surface is a uniform magnetic field [refer to problem 5.2.17], with the direction of the magnetic field strength parallel to the axis, and its magnitude is $$ H=\frac{I}{l}=\sigma \omega a $$ Therefore, the magnetic energy per unit length is $$ \frac{W_{m}}{l}=\frac{\mu_{0} H^{2} V}{2 l}=\frac{\mu_{0} \sigma^{2} \omega^{2} a^{2} \cdot \pi a^{2} l}{2 l}=\frac{1}{2} \pi \mu_{0} \sigma^{2} \omega^{2} a^{4} $$.

question: 一个 $C=1.0 \mu \mathrm{~F}$ 的电容器, 條有能量 $W=0.50 \mathrm{~J}$, 现在让它通过 $R=$ $1.0 \times 10^{6} \Omega$ 的电阻放电. 试求: (1) 放电前电容器上所容的电荷量 $Q_{0}$; (2) 开始放电 ( $t=0$ ) 时的电流 $I_{0}$; (3) $t$ 时电容器上的电压 $U_{C}(t)$ 和 $R$ 上的电压 $U_{R}(t)$; (4) $t$ 时刻 $R$ 所消耗的功率 $P(t)$.
solution: （1）由公式 $$W=\frac{1}{2} \frac{Q^{2}}{C}$$ 得所求电荷量为 $$\begin{aligned} Q_{0} & =\sqrt{2 C W}=\sqrt{2 \times 1.0 \times 10^{-6} \times 0.50} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3}(\mathrm{C}) \end{aligned}$$ （2）放电时，电路方程为 $$I R-U_{C}=0$$ 因为 $$U_{C}=\frac{Q}{C}$$ 所以 $$I R-\frac{Q}{C}=0$$ 于是得 $t=0$ 时, $$\begin{aligned} I_{0} & =\frac{Q_{0}}{R C}=\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{6} \times 1.0 \times 10^{-6}} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3}(\mathrm{~A}) \end{aligned}$$ （3）时刻的 $U_{C}(t)$ 和 $U_{R}(t)$ 因为是放电，故 $$I=-\frac{\mathrm{d} Q}{\mathrm{~d} t}$$ 由式(5)、(7)得 $$R \frac{\mathrm{~d} I}{\mathrm{~d} t}+\frac{I}{C}=0$$ 利用初始条件式（6），解式（8）得 $$I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-} \mathrm{~K}=1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~A})$$ 于是得 $$\begin{aligned} U_{R}(t) & =R I=1.0 \times 10^{6} \times 1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~V}) \end{aligned}$$ 将式（9）代人式（7），积分，并利用 $t=0$ 时， $Q=Q_{0}$ ，便得 $$\begin{aligned} Q & =-\int I \mathrm{~d} t=-1.0 \times 10^{-3} \int \mathrm{e}^{-t} \mathrm{~d} t \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{C}) \end{aligned}$$ 于是得 $$\begin{aligned} U_{C}(t) & =\frac{Q}{C}=\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}}{1.0 \times 10^{-6}} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~V}) \end{aligned}$$ (4) $t$ 时刻 $R$ 所消耗的功率为 $$\begin{aligned} P(t) & =I^{2}(t) R=\left(1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}\right)^{2} \times 1.0 \times 10^{6} \\ & =1.0 \mathrm{e}^{-2 t}(\mathrm{~W}) \end{aligned}$$

question: You need to A capacitor with $C=1.0 \mu \mathrm{~F}$ has energy $W=0.50 \mathrm{~J}$, and it is now discharging through a resistor with $R=1.0 \times 10^{6} \Omega$. Find: (1) the charge $Q_{0}$ stored in the capacitor before discharging; (2) the current $I_{0}$ at the beginning of the discharge ($t=0$); (3) the voltage across the capacitor $U_{C}(t)$ and the voltage across $R$ $U_{R}(t)$ at time $t$; (4) the power $P(t)$ consumed by $R$ at time $t$.
solution: (1) From the formula $$W=\frac{1}{2} \frac{Q^{2}}{C}$$, the required charge amount is obtained as $$\begin{aligned} Q_{0} & =\sqrt{2 C W}=\sqrt{2 \times 1.0 \times 10^{-6} \times 0.50} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3}(\mathrm{C}) \end{aligned}$$. (2) During discharge, the circuit equation is $$I R-U_{C}=0$$. Because $$U_{C}=\frac{Q}{C}$$, we have $$I R-\frac{Q}{C}=0$$. Thus, at $t=0$, $$\begin{aligned} I_{0} & =\frac{Q_{0}}{R C}=\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{6} \times 1.0 \times 10^{-6}} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3}(\mathrm{~A}) \end{aligned}$$. (3) At time $t$, $U_{C}(t)$ and $U_{R}(t)$, since it is discharging, $$I=-\frac{\mathrm{d} Q}{\mathrm{~d} t}$$. From equations (5) and (7), we get $$R \frac{\mathrm{~d} I}{\mathrm{~d} t}+\frac{I}{C}=0$$. Using the initial condition equation (6), solving equation (8), we obtain $$I=I_{0} \mathrm{e}^{-t}=1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~A})$$. Thus, we have $$\begin{aligned} U_{R}(t) & =R I=1.0 \times 10^{6} \times 1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~V}) \end{aligned}$$. Substituting equation (9) into equation (7), integrating, and using $t=0$, $Q=Q_{0}$, we get $$\begin{aligned} Q & =-\int I \mathrm{~d} t=-1.0 \times 10^{-3} \int \mathrm{e}^{-t} \mathrm{~d} t \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{C}) \end{aligned}$$. Thus, we have $$\begin{aligned} U_{C}(t) & =\frac{Q}{C}=\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}}{1.0 \times 10^{-6}} \\ & =1.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}(\mathrm{~V}) \end{aligned}$$. (4) The power consumed by $R$ at time $t$ is $$\begin{aligned} P(t) & =I^{2}(t) R=\left(1.0 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{e}^{-t}\right)^{2} \times 1.0 \times 10^{6} \\ & =1.0 \mathrm{e}^{-2 t}(\mathrm{~W}) \end{aligned}$$.

question: 一个 $R$ 和 $L$ 串联电路，接在电压为 100 V 的交流电源上.（1）—交流伏特计不论接在 $R$ 两端还是接在 $L$ 两端，其读数都相等，试问读数是多少？（2）若改变 $R$ 和 $L$ 的大小，使交流伏特计接在 $L$ 两端时读数为 $50 \mathrm{~V}$； 若将它接在 $R$ 两端，试问读数是多少?
solution:
【解】（1）因 $R 、 L$ 串联，故

因为

$$U_{R}=I R=\frac{U R}{\sqrt{R^{2}+\omega^{2} L^{2}}}$$

$$U_{L}=I \omega L=\frac{U_{\omega} L}{\sqrt{R^{2}+\omega^{2} L^{2}}}$$

$$U_{L}=U_{R}$$

于是得

$$U_{L}=U_{R}=\frac{U}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{100}{\sqrt{2}}=71(\mathrm{~V})$$

（2）这时伏特计的读数为

$$U_{R}=\sqrt{U^{2}-U_{L}^{2}}=\sqrt{100^{2}-50^{2}}=87(\mathrm{~V})$$
