question:
空间光滑连续曲线上取三个点, 可确定一个平面, 这三个点无限靠近时确定的极限平面记为 $\sigma$, 曲线上由这三个点的两个端位点界定的无穷小曲线段必定都在 $\sigma$ 平面内, 并可逼近处理成无穷小圆弧段, 圆半径便是这一空间曲线在此位置处的曲率半径.

等距螺旋线的曲率半径必定处处相同, 试用运动学方法, 求解旋转圆半径和螺距分别为 $R$ 和 $H$ 的等距螺旋线的曲率半径 $\rho$.
solution:
解 图 1-29 为 $R$ 圆柱面上等距螺旋线的正视图. 该曲线相对其中任意一点 $P$,具有左上、左下对称性, 因此 $P$ 点附近无穷小曲线段确定的极限平面 $\sigma$, 必定是过 $P$ 点的圆柱斜截面. 这一无穷小曲线段逼近为无穷小圆弧段, 圆半径便是所求曲率半径 $\rho$.

设质点沿此曲线运动, 为方便, 将运动分解为 $R$ 圆周上的匀速圆周运动 (分速度记作 $\boldsymbol{v}_{R}$ ) 和平行于圆柱面中央轴线的匀速直线运动 (分速度记作 $\boldsymbol{v}_{H}$ ). 质点在 $P$ 处的速度为
$$
v=v_{R}+v_{H}
$$
由于对称性, $\rho$ 圆的圆心必定在 $P$ 点和 $R$ 圆圆心的连线 $M N$ 上, $v_{R}$对应的向心加速度 $a_{R C}$ 即为 $\rho$ 圆运动的向心加速度 $a_{\rho C}$. 即有
$$
v^{2} / \rho=a_{\rho C}=a_{R C}=v_{R}^{2} / R
$$
式中
$$
v^{2}=v_{R}^{2}+v_{H}^{2}
$$
将质点沿等距螺旋线轨道在 $R$ 圆柱面上绕行一周时间记为 $T$, 则有
$$
v_{R} T=2 \pi R, \quad v_{H} T=H
$$
得
$$
v_{H}=\frac{H}{2 \pi R} v_{R}, \quad v^{2}=\left(1+\frac{H^{2}}{4 \pi^{2} R^{2}}\right) v_{R}^{2}
$$
即有
$$
\rho=\frac{v^{2}}{v_{R}^{2}} R=\left(1+\frac{H^{2}}{4 \pi^{2} R^{2}}\right) R
$$

question:
Three points on a smoothly continuous spatial curve can determine a plane. The limiting plane determined by these three points as they become infinitely close is denoted as $\sigma$. The infinitesimal curve segment defined by the two endpoint positions of these three points on the curve must lie within the plane $\sigma$ and can be approximated as an infinitesimal circular arc. The radius of this circle is the radius of curvature of the spatial curve at this position.

The radius of curvature of an equidistant helical line must be the same everywhere. Using kinematic methods, solve for the radius of curvature $\rho$ of an equidistant helical line with a rotation circle radius and pitch of $R$ and $H$, respectively.
solution:
Solve Figure 1-29 for the front view of an equidistant helical line on the cylindrical surface with radius $R$. This curve has symmetry of upper left and lower left with respect to any point $P$ on it. Therefore, the limiting plane $\sigma$ determined by the infinitesimal curve segment near point $P$ must be an oblique section of the cylinder passing through point $P$. This infinitesimal curve segment approaches an infinitesimal circular arc, and the radius of the circle is the desired radius of curvature $\rho$.

Assume a particle moves along this curve. For convenience, decompose the motion into uniform circular motion on the circle with radius $R$ (with component velocity denoted as $\boldsymbol{v}_{R}$) and uniform linear motion parallel to the central axis of the cylindrical surface (with component velocity denoted as $\boldsymbol{v}_{H}$). The velocity of the particle at point $P$ is
$$
v = v_{R} + v_{H}
$$
Due to symmetry, the center of the circle with radius $\rho$ must lie on the line $MN$ connecting point $P$ and the center of the circle with radius $R$. The centripetal acceleration $a_{R C}$ corresponding to $v_{R}$ is the centripetal acceleration $a_{\rho C}$ of the circle with radius $\rho$. Thus,
$$
v^{2} / \rho = a_{\rho C} = a_{R C} = v_{R}^{2} / R
$$
where
$$
v^{2} = v_{R}^{2} + v_{H}^{2}
$$
Let the time for the particle to travel one complete loop along the equidistant helical path on the cylindrical surface with radius $R$ be $T$, then
$$
v_{R} T = 2 \pi R, \quad v_{H} T = H
$$
yielding
$$
v_{H} = \frac{H}{2 \pi R} v_{R}, \quad v^{2} = \left(1+\frac{H^{2}}{4 \pi^{2} R^{2}}\right) v_{R}^{2}
$$
Thus,
$$
\rho = \frac{v^{2}}{v_{R}^{2}} R = \left(1+\frac{H^{2}}{4 \pi^{2} R^{2}}\right) R
$$

question: 估算月球中心到地球中心的距离 $r$.
Estimate the distance $r$ from the center of the Moon to the center of the Earth.

半长轴为 $a$ 、半短轴为 $b$ 的椭圆，长轴端点处的曲率半径 $\rho=b^{2} / a$.
质量 $m$ 的人造卫星绕地球作椭圆运动，近地点离地面的高度为 $2 R$ ，远地点离地面的高度为 $3 R$ ，其中 $R$ 是地球半径。已知地球表面处重力加速度为 $g$ ，试求人造卫星从远地点到近地点运行过程中，地球万有引力给它的总冲量大小 $I$.
solution:
解 卫星椭圆轨道参量为
$$
a=\frac{7}{2} R, \quad c=\frac{1}{2} R, \quad b=\sqrt{a^{2}-c^{2}}=2 \sqrt{3} R
$$

近地点 1 处附近卫星小圆弧运动的向心力由地球引力提供，即有
$$
\frac{m v_{1}^{2}}{\rho}=\frac{G M m}{(a-c)^{2}}
$$
其中 $M$ 是地球质量，由此得
同样可求得
$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{1}=\frac{a+c}{b} \sqrt{\frac{G M}{a}} \\
& v_{2}=\frac{a-c}{b} \sqrt{\frac{G M}{a}}
\end{aligned}
$$
卫星所得冲量为
$$
I=m v_{1}+m v_{2}=2 m \sqrt{G M a} / b=m \sqrt{\frac{7 G M}{6 R}}
$$
将 $G M=g R^{2}$ 代入，即得
$$
I=m \sqrt{\frac{7}{6} g R}
$$

question: The semi-major axis is $a$, and the semi-minor axis is $b$ for an ellipse. The radius of curvature at the endpoints of the major axis is $\rho = b^{2} / a$. A satellite of mass $m$ moves in an elliptical orbit around the Earth, with the perigee at a height of $2 R$ from the Earth's surface and the apogee at a height of $3 R$ from the Earth's surface, where $R$ is the Earth's radius. Given that the gravitational acceleration at the Earth's surface is $g$, find the total impulse magnitude $I$ given to the satellite by Earth's gravity during its motion from the apogee to the perigee.
solution:
Solve for the parameters of the satellite's elliptical orbit:

$$
a=\frac{7}{2} R, \quad c=\frac{1}{2} R, \quad b=\sqrt{a^{2}-c^{2}}=2 \sqrt{3} R
$$

The centripetal force for the small arc motion of the satellite near perigee 1 is provided by Earth's gravity, which gives:

$$
\frac{m v_{1}^{2}}{\rho}=\frac{G M m}{(a-c)^{2}}
$$

where $M$ is the mass of the Earth. From this, we obtain:

Similarly, we can find:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{1}=\frac{a+c}{b} \sqrt{\frac{G M}{a}} \\
& v_{2}=\frac{a-c}{b} \sqrt{\frac{G M}{a}}
\end{aligned}
$$

The impulse obtained by the satellite is:

$$
I=m v_{1}+m v_{2}=2 m \sqrt{G M a} / b=m \sqrt{\frac{7 G M}{6 R}}
$$

Substituting $G M=g R^{2}$, we get:

$$
I=m \sqrt{\frac{7}{6} g R}
$$

question:
地震的里氏（Richter）震级 $M$ 与从其释放出来的能量 $E$之间的关系为

$$
\log E=5.24+1.44 M
$$

式中 $E$ 的单位为 J. 1679 年 9 月 2 日，北京地区发生过一次 8 级地震，试求该次地震释放的能量。

长江源头为青海高原昆仑山南麓的沱沱河，从这里经 5000 m 落差注入东海，它的水利资源的储存量按功率计为 $1.125 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~kW}$ 。试比较长江一天内所提供的水利资源能量与上述地震释放的能量哪一个大？估算长江的平均流量。
solution:
解 该次地震释放能量为

$$
E=10^{5.24+1.44 \times 8} \mathrm{~J}=5.75 \times 10^{16} \mathrm{~J}
$$

长江一天内所提供的水利资源能量为

$$
E_{\mathrm{p}}=1.125 \times 10^{8} \times 10^{3} \times 24 \times 3600 \mathrm{~J}=9.72 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~J}
$$

两者比较，该次地震释放能量大。
水流量 $Q$ 等于单位时间流过的水质量，即有

$$
Q g h=P=1.125 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~kW}
$$

可得

$$
Q=\frac{P}{g h}=\frac{1.125 \times 10^{8} \times 10^{3}}{10 \times 5000} \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{s} \sim 10^{6} \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{s}
$$

question:
The relationship between the Richter magnitude $M$ of an earthquake and the energy $E$ released by it is given by

$$
\log E=5.24+1.44 M
$$

where $E$ is in units of J. On September 2, 1679, an 8 magnitude earthquake occurred in the Beijing area. Calculate the energy released by this earthquake.

The source of the Yangtze River is the Tuotuo River on the southern slope of the Kunlun Mountains in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. From here, it flows with a drop of 5000 m into the East China Sea. The hydropower resource storage is calculated as $1.125 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~kW}$ in terms of power. Compare the energy provided by the Yangtze River in one day with the energy released by the aforementioned earthquake to determine which is greater. Estimate the average flow rate of the Yangtze River.
solution:
The energy released by the earthquake is

$$
E=10^{5.24+1.44 \times 8} \mathrm{~J}=5.75 \times 10^{16} \mathrm{~J}
$$

The energy provided by the hydropower resources of the Yangtze River in one day is

$$
E_{\mathrm{p}}=1.125 \times 10^{8} \times 10^{3} \times 24 \times 3600 \mathrm{~J}=9.72 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~J}
$$

In comparison, the energy released by the earthquake is greater. The water flow $Q$ is equal to the mass of water flowing per unit time, which is given by

$$
Q g h=P=1.125 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~kW}
$$

Thus, we have

$$
Q=\frac{P}{g h}=\frac{1.125 \times 10^{8} \times 10^{3}}{10 \times 5000} \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{s} \sim 10^{6} \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{s}
$$

question: 将劲度系数为 $k$ 、自由长度为 $L$ 、质量为 $m$ 的均匀柱形弹性体竖直朝下，上端固定，下端自由。开始时弹性体处处无形变，而后在重力作用下各部位发生运动和形变，因为空气阻力等作用，最后弹性体处于静止状态，试求弹性体的弹性势能和重力势能的各自增量。
solution:
解 将弹性势能增加量记为 $\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}$ ，重力势能增加量记为 $\Delta E_{\mathrm{pg}}$ 。
弹性势能的计算如下:
弹性体处于原长时，将悬挂点记为 $x=0$ ，弹性体沿长度方向各部位均可用坐标量 $x(0 \leqslant x \leqslant L)$ 标记. 取 $x$ 到 $x+\mathrm{d} x$ 段，劲度系数为
$$k_{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{L}{\mathrm{~d} x} k$$
放手后处于平衡态，该小段两端受拉力为
$$\text { 上端: } \frac{m}{L}[L-(x+\mathrm{d} x)] g, \quad \text { 下端: } \frac{m}{L}(L-x) g \text {, }$$
两者差无穷小量，可处理为两端各有 $\frac{m}{L}(L-x) g$ 拉力. 该小段伸长量为
$$\mathrm{d} l=\frac{m(L-x) g}{L k_{\mathrm{d} x}}=\frac{m g}{k L^{2}}(L-x) \mathrm{d} x$$
弹性体伸长量便是
$$\Delta L=\int_{0}^{L} \mathrm{~d} l=\frac{m g}{2 k}$$
$x$ 到 $x+\mathrm{d} x$ 段内弹性力处处相同，内含弹性势能
$$\mathrm{d} E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\frac{1}{2} k_{\mathrm{d} x}(\mathrm{~d} l)^{2}=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{2 k L^{2}}(L-x)^{2} \mathrm{~d} x$$
弹性体内含的弹性势能，即 $\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}$ 为
$$\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\int_{0}^{L} \mathrm{~d} E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{6 k}$$
重力势能减少量的计算:
弹性体从 $x=0$ 到原 $x$ 点之间的一段，质量为
$$m_{x}=\frac{x}{L} m$$
伸长量则是
$$\Delta L_{x}=\int_{0}^{x} \mathrm{~d} l=\frac{m g}{2 k L^{2}}(2 L-x) x$$
原 $x$ 到 $x+\mathrm{d} x$ 小段重力势能减少量为
$$\begin{aligned}
-\mathrm{d} E_{v g} & =\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{L} m\right) g\left(\Delta L_{x}\right)=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{2 L^{2} k}(2 L-x) x \mathrm{~d} x \\
\text { 积分得 } & -\Delta E_{v g}=\int_{0}^{L}\left(-\mathrm{d} E_{v g}\right)=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{3 k}
\end{aligned}$$
即有
$$\Delta E_{v g}=-\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{3 k}$$

question: A uniform cylindrical elastic body with a spring constant $k$, a natural length $L$, and a mass $m$ is vertically oriented downward, with the upper end fixed and the lower end free. Initially, the elastic body is undeformed throughout, and then, under the influence of gravity, each part undergoes motion and deformation. Due to the effects of air resistance and other factors, the elastic body eventually comes to a state of rest. Find the respective increments in the elastic potential energy and gravitational potential energy of the elastic body.
solution:
Translation:

Let the increase in elastic potential energy be denoted as $\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}$, and the increase in gravitational potential energy be denoted as $\Delta E_{\mathrm{pg}}$.

The calculation of elastic potential energy is as follows: 
When the elastic body is at its original length, the suspension point is denoted as $x=0$. The various parts of the elastic body along the length direction can be marked with the coordinate $x (0 \leqslant x \leqslant L)$. For the segment from $x$ to $x+\mathrm{d} x$, the stiffness coefficient is 
$$k_{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{L}{\mathrm{~d} x} k$$ 
After releasing, the small segment is in equilibrium, and the tensile forces at both ends of this segment are 
$$\text{Upper end: } \frac{m}{L}[L-(x+\mathrm{d} x)] g, \quad \text{Lower end: } \frac{m}{L}(L-x) g \text{, }$$ 
The difference between the two is infinitesimal, and it can be treated as having a tensile force of $\frac{m}{L}(L-x) g$ at both ends. The elongation of this small segment is 
$$\mathrm{d} l=\frac{m(L-x) g}{L k_{\mathrm{d} x}}=\frac{m g}{k L^{2}}(L-x) \mathrm{d} x$$ 
The elongation of the elastic body is 
$$\Delta L=\int_{0}^{L} \mathrm{~d} l=\frac{m g}{2 k}$$ 
The elastic force within the segment from $x$ to $x+\mathrm{d} x$ is the same everywhere, containing elastic potential energy 
$$\mathrm{d} E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\frac{1}{2} k_{\mathrm{d} x}(\mathrm{~d} l)^{2}=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{2 k L^{2}}(L-x)^{2} \mathrm{~d} x$$ 
The elastic potential energy contained in the elastic body, i.e., $\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}$, is 
$$\Delta E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\int_{0}^{L} \mathrm{~d} E_{\mathrm{ps}}=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{6 k}$$ 

Calculation of the decrease in gravitational potential energy: 
For the segment of the elastic body from $x=0$ to the original $x$ point, the mass is 
$$m_{x}=\frac{x}{L} m$$ 
The elongation is 
$$\Delta L_{x}=\int_{0}^{x} \mathrm{~d} l=\frac{m g}{2 k L^{2}}(2 L-x) x$$ 
The decrease in gravitational potential energy for the small segment from the original $x$ to $x+\mathrm{d} x$ is 
$$\begin{aligned} 
-\mathrm{d} E_{v g} & =\left(\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{L} m\right) g\left(\Delta L_{x}\right)=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{2 L^{2} k}(2 L-x) x \mathrm{~d} x \\ 
\text{Integrating gives } & -\Delta E_{v g}=\int_{0}^{L}\left(-\mathrm{d} E_{v g}\right)=\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{3 k} 
\end{aligned}$$ 

Thus, we have 
$$\Delta E_{v g}=-\frac{m^{2} g^{2}}{3 k}$$.

question:
动能为 $E_{0}$ 的 ${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}$ 核轰击静止的 ${ }^{7} \mathrm{Li}$ 核，作完全非弹性碰撞后成为复合核 ${ }^{11} \mathrm{~B}$ ，后者进一步分裂成 ${ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}$ 和中子 ${ }^{1} \mathrm{n}$ 。上述核反应过程需消耗能量 $\theta=2.8 \mathrm{MeV}$ ，反应方程为

$${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}+{ }^{7} \mathrm{Li} \longrightarrow\left({ }^{11} \mathrm{~B}\right) \longrightarrow{ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}+{ }^{1} \mathrm{n}-2.8 \mathrm{MeV}$$

试求上述核反应过程所需的 $E_{0}$ 最小值及对应的中子动能值.
solution:
解 核反应损失的机械能属于粒子间内力消耗的机械能，在任一参考系中是相同的，较方便的是在质心参考系中处理。

实验室参考系中 ${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}$ 初动能为 $E_{0}$ ，速度为

$$
v_{0}=\sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}}
$$

系统质心速度便是

$$
v_{C}=m_{\mathrm{He}} v_{0} /\left(m_{\mathrm{He}}+m_{\mathrm{Li}}\right)=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}}
$$

'He，'Li 植在质心系中的速度大小以及它们的动能之和依次为

$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{\mathrm{He}}^{\prime}=v_{0}-v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{7}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
& v_{\mathrm{Li}}^{\prime}=v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
& E_{\mathrm{k}}(0)=\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{He}} v_{\mathrm{He}}^{\prime 2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{Li}} v_{\mathrm{Li}}^{\prime 2}=\frac{7}{11} E_{0}
\end{aligned}
$$

核反应后生成的 ${ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}$ 核和 ${ }^{1} \mathrm{n}$ 中子在质心系中的速度分别记为 $v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime}$ 和 $v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}$ ，则有

$$
\frac{7}{11} E_{0}=E_{\mathrm{k}}(0) \geqslant\left(\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{B}} v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime 2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{n}} v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime 2}\right)+Q
$$

即得

$$
\underset{\text { 当 }}{\text { 当 }} v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime}=0, v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}=0 \text { 时, } E_{0}=E_{0, \min }=\frac{11}{7} Q=4.4 \mathrm{MeV}
$$

此时质心系中中子速度 $v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}=0$ ，在实验室参考系中，中子速度和动能便分别为

$$
\begin{gathered}
v_{\mathrm{n}}=v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
E_{\mathrm{k}, \mathrm{n}}=\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{n}} v_{\mathrm{C}}^{2}=\frac{4}{121} E_{0}=0.15 \mathrm{MeV}
\end{gathered}
$$

question:
The ${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}$ nucleus with kinetic energy $E_{0}$ bombards a stationary ${ }^{7} \mathrm{Li}$ nucleus, resulting in a completely inelastic collision that forms a compound nucleus ${ }^{11} \mathrm{~B}$. The latter further splits into ${ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}$ and a neutron ${ }^{1} \mathrm{n}$. This nuclear reaction process requires an energy expenditure of $\theta=2.8 \mathrm{MeV}$, and the reaction equation is:

$${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}+{ }^{7} \mathrm{Li} \longrightarrow\left({ }^{11} \mathrm{~B}\right) \longrightarrow{ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}+{ }^{1} \mathrm{n}-2.8 \mathrm{MeV}$$

Try to find the minimum value of $E_{0}$ required for the above nuclear reaction process and the corresponding neutron kinetic energy.
solution:
Solve: The mechanical energy lost in a nuclear reaction belongs to the mechanical energy consumed by the internal forces between particles, which is the same in any reference frame. It is more convenient to handle this in the center-of-mass reference frame.

In the laboratory reference frame, the initial kinetic energy of ${ }^{4} \mathrm{He}$ is $E_{0}$, and the velocity is

$$
v_{0}=\sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}}
$$

The velocity of the center of mass of the system is

$$
v_{C}=m_{\mathrm{He}} v_{0} /\left(m_{\mathrm{He}}+m_{\mathrm{Li}}\right)=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}}
$$

The magnitudes of the velocities of 'He' and 'Li' in the center-of-mass system and their total kinetic energy are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{\mathrm{He}}^{\prime}=v_{0}-v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{7}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
& v_{\mathrm{Li}}^{\prime}=v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
& E_{\mathrm{k}}(0)=\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{He}} v_{\mathrm{He}}^{\prime 2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{Li}} v_{\mathrm{Li}}^{\prime 2}=\frac{7}{11} E_{0}
\end{aligned}
$$

After the nuclear reaction, the velocities of the resulting ${ }^{10} \mathrm{~B}$ nucleus and the ${ }^{1} \mathrm{n}$ neutron in the center-of-mass system are denoted as $v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime}$ and $v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}$, respectively, thus:

$$
\frac{7}{11} E_{0}=E_{\mathrm{k}}(0) \geqslant\left(\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{B}} v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime 2}+\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{n}} v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime 2}\right)+Q
$$

This yields

$$
\underset{\text { when }}{\text { when }} v_{\mathrm{B}}^{\prime}=0, v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}=0 \text {, } E_{0}=E_{0, \min }=\frac{11}{7} Q=4.4 \mathrm{MeV}
$$

At this point, the velocity of the neutron in the center-of-mass system $v_{\mathrm{n}}^{\prime}=0$, and in the laboratory reference frame, the velocity and kinetic energy of the neutron are:

$$
\begin{gathered}
v_{\mathrm{n}}=v_{\mathrm{C}}=\frac{4}{11} \sqrt{2 E_{0} / m_{\mathrm{He}}} \\
E_{\mathrm{k}, \mathrm{n}}=\frac{1}{2} m_{\mathrm{n}} v_{\mathrm{C}}^{2}=\frac{4}{121} E_{0}=0.15 \mathrm{MeV}
\end{gathered}
$$

question: 将两个半径同为 $R=20 \mathrm{~cm}$ 的半球壳，合成"马德堡球"，估算两侧各需施加多大的力方可将球拉成两半？
solution:
解 结合立体解析几何知识，可知大气对半个球面的合压力等于大气对半径为 $R$ 的圆平面的压力. 因此, 所求拉力为

$$
F=p_{0} \pi R^{2} \sim 1.0 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{~N}
$$

question: Combine two hemispherical shells with the same radius $R=20 \mathrm{~cm}$ to form a "Magdeburg sphere." Estimate how much force needs to be applied on each side to pull the sphere into two halves.
solution:
Solution: By using the knowledge of solid analytic geometry, it is known that the total pressure exerted by the atmosphere on a hemispherical surface is equal to the pressure exerted by the atmosphere on a circular plane with radius $R$. Therefore, the required tensile force is

$$
F=p_{0} \pi R^{2} \sim 1.0 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{~N}
$$.

question: 人眼所能见到的光的波长范围是 $400 \sim 760 \mathrm{~nm}$, 求可见光的频率范围. 人眼最敏感的光是黄绿色光, 波长为 550 nm , 求黄绿光波的频率.
solution:
解 由 $
u=u / \lambda=c / \lambda, c=3 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, 得可见光频率范围为
$$7.5 \times 10^{14} \sim 3.9 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~Hz}$$
黄绿光波频率为
$$5.5 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~Hz}$$

question: The wavelength range of light visible to the human eye is $400 \sim 760 \mathrm{~nm}$. Find the frequency range of visible light. The light most sensitive to the human eye is yellow-green light, with a wavelength of 550 nm. Find the frequency of yellow-green light.
solution:
Solution: Given $u=u / \lambda=c / \lambda, c=3 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, the visible light frequency range is
$$7.5 \times 10^{14} \sim 3.9 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~Hz}$$
The frequency of yellow-green light is
$$5.5 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~Hz}$$.

question: 一粒子在 $S^{\prime}$ 系的 $x^{\prime} y^{\prime}$ 平面内以 $\frac{c}{2}$ 的恒定速度作直线运动，运动方向与 $x^{\prime}$ 轴的夹角 $\theta^{\prime}=60^{\circ}$. 已知 $S^{\prime}$ 系相对 $S$ 系以速度 $v=0.6 c$沿 $x$ 轴运动，试据洛伦兹变换式求出粒子在 $S$ 系 $x y$ 平面上的运动轨迹，若为直线，再求出此直线的斜率。
solution:
解 粒子在 $S^{\prime}$ 系中的运动方程为
$$
x^{\prime}=\frac{c t^{\prime}}{2} \cos \theta^{\prime}, \quad y^{\prime}=\frac{c t^{\prime}}{2} \sin \theta^{\prime}
$$
据洛伦兹变换式，有
$$
\begin{array}{ll}
x^{\prime}=(x-v t) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}, & y^{\prime}=y \\
t^{\prime}=\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}, & \beta=\frac{v}{c}
\end{array}
$$
联立上述诸式，可得
$$
\begin{aligned}
& x=\frac{c}{2} \cos \theta^{\prime}\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right)+v t \\
& y=\frac{c}{2} \sin \theta^{\prime}\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}
\end{aligned}
$$
计算后，即得粒子在 $x y$ 平面上的运动方程：
$$
x=0.74 c t, \quad y=0.30 c t
$$
运动轨迹方程为
$$
y=\frac{15}{37} x
$$
是一条直线，其斜率为
$$
\tan \theta=\frac{15}{37}=0.405\left(\theta=22^{\circ}\right)
$$

question: A particle is moving in a straight line at a constant speed of $\frac{c}{2}$ in the $x^{\prime} y^{\prime}$ plane of the $S^{\prime}$ system. The direction of motion forms an angle $\theta^{\prime}=60^{\circ}$ with the $x^{\prime}$ axis. It is known that the $S^{\prime}$ system is moving relative to the $S$ system at a speed of $v=0.6 c$ along the $x$ axis. Using the Lorentz transformation equations, determine the trajectory of the particle in the $x y$ plane of the $S$ system. If it is a straight line, also find the slope of this line.
solution:
Solve the equation of motion of the particle in the $S^{\prime}$ system as
$$
x^{\prime}=\frac{c t^{\prime}}{2} \cos \theta^{\prime}, \quad y^{\prime}=\frac{c t^{\prime}}{2} \sin \theta^{\prime}
$$
According to the Lorentz transformation, we have
$$
\begin{array}{ll}
x^{\prime}=(x-v t) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}, & y^{\prime}=y \\
t^{\prime}=\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}, & \beta=\frac{v}{c}
\end{array}
$$
By combining the above equations, we obtain
$$
\begin{aligned}
& x=\frac{c}{2} \cos \theta^{\prime}\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right)+v t \\
& y=\frac{c}{2} \sin \theta^{\prime}\left(t-\frac{v}{c^{2}} x\right) / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}
\end{aligned}
$$
After calculation, we get the equation of motion of the particle in the $xy$ plane:
$$
x=0.74 c t, \quad y=0.30 c t
$$
The equation of the trajectory is
$$
y=\frac{15}{37} x
$$
which is a straight line with a slope of
$$
\tan \theta=\frac{15}{37}=0.405\left(\theta=22^{\circ}\right)
$$

question:
一艘宇宙飞船以 $0.8 c$ 的速度于中午飞经地球，此时飞船上和地球上的观察者都把自己的时钟拨到 12 点。
（1）按飞船上的时钟于午后 12 点 30 分飞船飞经一星际宇航站，该站相对地球固定，其时钟指示的是地球时间，试问按宇航站的时钟飞船何时到达该站?
（2）试问按地球上的坐标测量，宇航站离地球多远？
（3）于飞船时间午后 12 点 30 分从飞船向地球发送无线电信
号，试问地球上的观察者何时（按地球时间）接收到信号？
（4）若地球上的观察者在接收到信号后立即发出应答信号，试问飞船何时（按飞船时间）接收到应答信号？
solution:
解 （1）飞船测得的 $\tau_{0}=30 \mathrm{~min}$ 为本征时间，据运动时钟计时率变慢公式，可得地球系测得的时间间隔为

$$\tau=\tau_{0} / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}=50 \mathrm{~min}$$

即宇航站时钟读数为 12 点 50 分时，飞船到达该站。
（2）地球系测得宇航站与地球相距

$$l=v \tau=7.2 \times 10^{11} \mathrm{~m}$$

（3）对地球观察者来说，无线电信号发自宇航站所在地，故传至地球需时

$$l / c=40 \mathrm{~min}$$

飞船飞行时间加信号传播时间，共计（ $50+40$ ） min ，因此地球观察者于 1 点 30 分接收到信号。
（4）有两种解法。
方法一：从地球参考系来考察。设飞船向地球发出信号至接收到地球应答信号共需时间（地球时间） $t$ ，在这段时间内飞船信号传播了 $l$ 距离，应答信号传播了 $l+0.8 c t$ 距离，故有

$$t=\frac{0.8 c t+2 l}{c}=\frac{2 l}{0.2 c}=400 \mathrm{~min}$$

将上述时间变换到飞船系，对应的飞船时间（本征时间）为

$$t^{\prime}=\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}} t=240 \mathrm{~min}$$

考虑到飞船发信号时刻为 12 点 30 分，故飞船于
午后 4 点 30 分
按收到应答信号。
方法二：从飞船参考系来考察。飞船系认为发出的信号需经时

$$\Delta t^{\prime}=\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}} l /(c-0.8 c)=120 \mathrm{~min}$$

方被地球接收，地球应答信号也需经时 $\Delta t^{\prime}$ 被飞船接收，共计经时

$$t^{\prime}=2 \Delta t^{\prime}=240 \mathrm{~min}$$

与第一种解法结果相同。

question:
A spaceship passes by Earth at a speed of $0.8 c$ at noon. At this moment, both the observers on the spaceship and on Earth set their clocks to 12 o'clock.  
(1) According to the spaceship's clock, the spaceship passes an interstellar station at 12:30 PM. The station is fixed relative to Earth, and its clock indicates Earth time. What time does the station's clock show when the spaceship arrives?  
(2) According to Earth's coordinate measurement, how far is the interstellar station from Earth?  
(3) At 12:30 PM spaceship time, a radio signal is sent from the spaceship to Earth. When (in Earth time) does the observer on Earth receive the signal?  
(4) If the observer on Earth immediately sends a reply signal upon receiving the signal, when does the spaceship receive the reply signal (in spaceship time)?
solution:
Solution: (1) The proper time measured by the spaceship is $\tau_{0}=30 \mathrm{~min}$. According to the time dilation formula, the time interval measured in the Earth frame is

$$\tau=\tau_{0} / \sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}=50 \mathrm{~min}$$

Thus, when the clock at the space station reads 12:50 PM, the spaceship reaches the station. (2) The distance between the space station and Earth, as measured in the Earth frame, is

$$l=v \tau=7.2 \times 10^{11} \mathrm{~m}$$

(3) For an observer on Earth, the radio signal is sent from the location of the space station, so the time taken to travel to Earth is

$$l / c=40 \mathrm{~min}$$

The total time, including the spaceship's travel time and the signal transmission time, is $(50+40)$ min, so the observer on Earth receives the signal at 1:30 PM. (4) There are two methods to solve this.

Method 1: Consider from the Earth reference frame. Suppose the total time for the spaceship to send a signal to Earth and receive a response (Earth time) is $t$. During this time, the spaceship's signal travels a distance $l$, and the response signal travels a distance of $l+0.8 c t$. Therefore, we have

$$t=\frac{0.8 c t+2 l}{c}=\frac{2 l}{0.2 c}=400 \mathrm{~min}$$

Transforming this time to the spaceship's frame, the corresponding proper time is

$$t^{\prime}=\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}} t=240 \mathrm{~min}$$

Considering the spaceship sends the signal at 12:30 PM, the spaceship receives the response signal at 4:30 PM.

Method 2: Consider from the spaceship reference frame. In the spaceship's frame, the time taken for the signal to reach Earth is

$$\Delta t^{\prime}=\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}} l /(c-0.8 c)=120 \mathrm{~min}$$

The response signal from Earth also takes $\Delta t^{\prime}$ to be received by the spaceship, totaling

$$t^{\prime}=2 \Delta t^{\prime}=240 \mathrm{~min}$$

The result is the same as the first method.

question: 质点 $p$ 沿半径为 $R$ 的圆周逆时针方向运动，转过的圆心角对时间的变化率称为角速度，记作 $\omega$ ，角速度对时间的变化率称为角加速度，记作 $\beta$ 。任一时刻质点的加速度 $a$ 可分解为沿圆运动切线方向的分量 $a_{\text {III }}$ 和指向圆心的分量 $a_{\diamond}$ ，试求 $a_{\text {III }}$ 与 $a_{\diamond}$ 。
solution:
解 以圆心为原点，在圆平面上建立 $O x y$ 坐标系。任一时刻质点 $P$ 的矢径 $r$ 与 $x$ 轴夹角记作 $\theta$ ，则有
$$
\omega=\mathrm{d} \theta / \mathrm{d} t, \quad \beta=\mathrm{d} \omega / \mathrm{d} t
$$
$r$ 可分解为
$$
\begin{gathered}
\boldsymbol{r}=x \boldsymbol{i}+y \boldsymbol{j} \\
x=R \cos \theta, \quad y=R \sin \theta
\end{gathered}
$$
$P$ 的速度 $\boldsymbol{v}$ 可分解为
$$
\boldsymbol{v}=v_{x} \boldsymbol{i}+v_{y} \boldsymbol{j}
$$
$\boldsymbol{v}_{x}$ 的正方向沿 $x$ 轴方向，考虑到 $P$ 的真实运动方向，在第 I 参照中， $v_{x}$ 实与 $x$ 轴反向，为在图附-8 中能与真实感觉一致，故沿 $x$ 轴负方向画出，于是在数学上应标成一 $v_{x}$ 。继而有
$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{x}=\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} t}=(-R \sin \theta) \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{\mathrm{~d} t}=-\omega R \sin \theta \\
& v_{y}=\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{~d} t}=(R \cos \theta) \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\omega R \cos \theta \\
& v=\sqrt{v_{x}^{2}+v_{y}^{2}}=\omega R \\
& \tan \alpha=\frac{v_{y}}{-v_{x}}=\cot \theta \Rightarrow \alpha=\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta \\
& \boldsymbol{v}:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\text { 方向：圆切线方向， } \\
\text { 大小: } v=\omega R .
\end{array}\right.
\end{aligned}
$$
关于 $P$ 的加速度 $a$ ，参照图附-9，有
![img-339.jpeg](images/img-339.jpeg)

图 附-8
$$
\begin{aligned}
a & =a_{x} i+a_{y} j \\
a_{x} & =\frac{\mathrm{d} v_{x}}{\mathrm{~d} t}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} t} R \sin \theta-\omega(\omega R \cos \theta) \\
& =-\beta R \sin \theta-\omega^{2} R \cos \theta \\
a_{y} & =\frac{\mathrm{d} v_{y}}{\mathrm{~d} t}=\frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} t} R \cos \theta+\omega(-\omega R \sin \theta) \\
& =\beta R \cos \theta-\omega^{2} R \sin \theta
\end{aligned}
$$
或
$$
\begin{aligned}
& a=a_{\text {III }}+a_{\text {心 }}, \\
& a_{\text {III }}=-a_{x} \sin \theta-\left(-a_{y} \cos \theta\right)=\beta R(\text { 带正负号 }), \\
& a_{\text {心 }}=-a_{x} \cos \theta+\left(-a_{y} \sin \theta\right)=\omega^{2} R .
\end{aligned}
$$
即得
$$
\begin{aligned}
& a_{\text {III }}:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\text { 方向: } \beta>0 \text { 时与 } v \text { 同向, } \beta<0 \text { 时与 } v \text { 反向, } \\
\text { 带正负号的大小: } a_{\text {四 }}=\beta R,
\end{array}\right. \\
& a_{\text {心 }}:\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\text { 方向: 指向圆心, } \\
\text { 大小: } a_{\text {心 }}=\omega^{2} R .
\end{array}\right.
\end{aligned}
$$

question: A particle $p$ moves counterclockwise along a circle with radius $R$. The rate of change of the central angle with respect to time is called angular velocity, denoted as $\omega$. The rate of change of angular velocity with respect to time is called angular acceleration, denoted as $\beta$. The acceleration $a$ of the particle at any given moment can be decomposed into a component $a_{\text{III}}$ along the tangent direction of the circular motion and a component $a_{\diamond}$ pointing towards the center of the circle. Find $a_{\text{III}}$ and $a_{\diamond}$.
solution:
Solution: Establish an $Oxy$ coordinate system on the circular plane with the center of the circle as the origin. At any moment, the angle between the position vector $r$ of the particle $P$ and the $x$-axis is denoted as $\theta$, then we have
$$
\omega = \mathrm{d} \theta / \mathrm{d} t, \quad \beta = \mathrm{d} \omega / \mathrm{d} t.
$$
$r$ can be decomposed as
$$
\begin{gathered}
\boldsymbol{r} = x \boldsymbol{i} + y \boldsymbol{j} \\
x = R \cos \theta, \quad y = R \sin \theta.
\end{gathered}
$$
The velocity $\boldsymbol{v}$ of $P$ can be decomposed as
$$
\boldsymbol{v} = v_{x} \boldsymbol{i} + v_{y} \boldsymbol{j}.
$$
The positive direction of $\boldsymbol{v}_{x}$ is along the $x$-axis direction. Considering the actual motion direction of $P$, in Reference I, $v_{x}$ is actually opposite to the $x$-axis. To align with the real sense in Figure Attachment-8, it is drawn along the negative $x$-axis direction, and thus mathematically should be labeled as $v_{x}$. Therefore, we have
$$
\begin{aligned}
& v_{x} = \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} t} = (-R \sin \theta) \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{\mathrm{~d} t} = -\omega R \sin \theta, \\
& v_{y} = \frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{~d} t} = (R \cos \theta) \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{\mathrm{~d} t} = \omega R \cos \theta, \\
& v = \sqrt{v_{x}^{2} + v_{y}^{2}} = \omega R, \\
& \tan \alpha = \frac{v_{y}}{-v_{x}} = \cot \theta \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{\pi}{2} - \theta, \\
& \boldsymbol{v} : \left\{ \begin{array}{l} 
\text{Direction: tangent to the circle,} \\ 
\text{Magnitude: } v = \omega R. 
\end{array} \right.
\end{aligned}
$$
Regarding the acceleration $a$ of $P$, refer to Figure Attachment-9, we have
$$
\begin{aligned}
a & = a_{x} i + a_{y} j, \\
a_{x} & = \frac{\mathrm{d} v_{x}}{\mathrm{~d} t} = -\frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} t} R \sin \theta - \omega(\omega R \cos \theta) \\
& = -\beta R \sin \theta - \omega^{2} R \cos \theta, \\
a_{y} & = \frac{\mathrm{d} v_{y}}{\mathrm{~d} t} = \frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} t} R \cos \theta + \omega(-\omega R \sin \theta) \\
& = \beta R \cos \theta - \omega^{2} R \sin \theta.
\end{aligned}
$$
Or
$$
\begin{aligned}
& a = a_{\text{III}} + a_{\text{center}}, \\
& a_{\text{III}} = -a_{x} \sin \theta - \left(-a_{y} \cos \theta\right) = \beta R (\text{with sign}), \\
& a_{\text{center}} = -a_{x} \cos \theta + \left(-a_{y} \sin \theta\right) = \omega^{2} R.
\end{aligned}
$$
Thus, we get
$$
\begin{aligned}
& a_{\text{III}} : \left\{ \begin{array}{l} 
\text{Direction: same as } v \text{ when } \beta > 0, \text{ opposite when } \beta < 0, \\ 
\text{Magnitude with sign: } a_{\text{III}} = \beta R, 
\end{array} \right. \\
& a_{\text{center}} : \left\{ \begin{array}{l} 
\text{Direction: towards the center of the circle,} \\ 
\text{Magnitude: } a_{\text{center}} = \omega^{2} R. 
\end{array} \right.
\end{aligned}
$$
