\mu_{\mathrm{B}} = \frac{e}{2m_{e}}\left(\frac{h}{2\pi}\right) = \frac{eh}{4\pi m_{e}}
$$

This is the smallest unit of orbital magnetic moment (known as the Bohr magneton). Substituting $e = 1.602 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}$, $m_{e} = 9.11 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{kg}$, and Planck's constant $h = 6.626 \times 10^{-34} \mathrm{J} \cdot \mathrm{s}$, we can calculate

$$
\mu_{\mathrm{B}} = 9.273 \times 10^{-24} \mathrm{A} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{2}
$$

In addition to moving along the orbit, electrons in atoms also have spin. Electron spin is also a quantum phenomenon, and it has its own magnetic moment and angular momentum. The magnitude of the electron's spin magnetic moment is equal to the Bohr magneton.

question: 若上例中磁介质的磁导率 $\mu=5.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~Wb} /(\mathrm{A} \cdot \mathrm{m})$ ，单位长度内的匝数 $n=1000$ 匝/ m ，绕组中通有电流 $I=2.0 \mathrm{~A}$ 。再计算环内的（1）磁场强度 $\boldsymbol{H}$ ，（2）磁感应强度 $\boldsymbol{B}$ ，（3）磁介质的磁化强度 $\boldsymbol{M}$ 。
solution:
解 （1）利用以上计算结果，可得
$$H=n I=2.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m}$$
（2）根据 $H$ 和 $B$ 的关系式
$$B=\mu H=\mu n I=1 \mathrm{~Wb} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$$
$H$ 与 $B$ 的方向与电流流向构成右手螺旋关系。
（3）由 $\boldsymbol{M}, \boldsymbol{H}$ 和 $\boldsymbol{B}$ 的普遍关系式
$$M=\frac{B-\mu_{0} H}{\mu_{0}}=7.9 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m}$$

question: If in the above example the permeability of the magnetic medium $\mu=5.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~Wb} /(\mathrm{A} \cdot \mathrm{m})$, the number of turns per unit length $n=1000$ turns/m, and a current $I=2.0 \mathrm{~A}$ flows through the winding, then calculate the (1) magnetic field strength $\boldsymbol{H}$, (2) magnetic flux density $\boldsymbol{B}$, and (3) magnetization $\boldsymbol{M}$ of the magnetic medium.
solution:
Solution: 

(1) Using the above calculation results, we obtain 
$$H = nI = 2.0 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m}$$ 

(2) According to the relationship between $H$ and $B$, 
$$B = \mu H = \mu nI = 1 \mathrm{~Wb} / \mathrm{m}^{2}$$ 
The directions of $H$ and $B$ form a right-hand screw relationship with the direction of current flow.

(3) From the general relationship of $\boldsymbol{M}, \boldsymbol{H}$, and $\boldsymbol{B}$, 
$$M = \frac{B - \mu_{0} H}{\mu_{0}} = 7.9 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~A} / \mathrm{m}$$

question:
在 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 和 1 atm 下，空气的密度为 $1.29 \mathrm{~kg} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$ ，比热 $C_{p}=9.963 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ ， $\gamma=C_{p} / C_{V}=1.41$. 现有 $27 \mathrm{~m}^{3}$ 的空气，分别进行下列过程，求所需的热量：
（a）空气的体积不变，将它从 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 加热到 $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ；
（b）空气的压强不变，将它从 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 加热到 $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ；
（c）若容器有裂缝，外界压力为 1 atm ，使空气从 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 缓慢加热到 $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 。
solution:
解 (a) $W=0$
空气吸收的热量： $Q_{1}=\Delta U=m C_{V} \Delta T=V \rho \frac{C_{p}}{\gamma} \Delta T$

$$
Q_{1}=27 \times 1.29 \times \frac{9.963 \times 10^{2}}{1.41} \times 20=4.92 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
$$

（b） $Q_{2}=m C_{p} \Delta T=V \rho C_{p} \Delta T=27 \times 1.29 \times 9.963 \times 10^{2} \times 20=6.94 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})$

（c）由于 $p 、 V$ 恒定，所以随温度升高，空气的密度 $\rho=\rho(T)$ 下降，由状态方程得

$$
\begin{gathered}
\rho(T)=\frac{p \mu}{R T}, \quad m(T)=V \rho(T)=\frac{p V \mu}{R T} \\
\mathrm{~d} Q=m(T) C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R T} \mathrm{~d} T \\
Q=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R} \int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} \frac{\mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R} \ln \frac{T_{i}}{T_{i}} \\
=\frac{1.013 \times 10^{5} \times 27 \times 29 \times 10^{-3} \times 9.963 \times 10^{2}}{8.31} \times \ln \frac{293}{273}=6.72 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
\end{gathered}
$$

Solution (a) \( W=0 \)

Heat absorbed by air: \( Q_{1}=\Delta U=m C_{V} \Delta T=V \rho \frac{C_{p}}{\gamma} \Delta T \)

\[ 
Q_{1}=27 \times 1.29 \times \frac{9.963 \times 10^{2}}{1.41} \times 20=4.92 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
\]

(b) \( Q_{2}=m C_{p} \Delta T=V \rho C_{p} \Delta T=27 \times 1.29 \times 9.963 \times 10^{2} \times 20=6.94 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J}) \)

(c) Since \( p, V \) are constant, as the temperature increases, the density of air \( \rho=\rho(T) \) decreases. From the equation of state, we have

\[ 
\begin{gathered}
\rho(T)=\frac{p \mu}{R T}, \quad m(T)=V \rho(T)=\frac{p V \mu}{R T} \\
\mathrm{~d} Q=m(T) C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R T} \mathrm{~d} T \\
Q=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R} \int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} \frac{\mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\frac{p V \mu C_{p}}{R} \ln \frac{T_{i}}{T_{i}} \\
=\frac{1.013 \times 10^{5} \times 27 \times 29 \times 10^{-3} \times 9.963 \times 10^{2}}{8.31} \times \ln \frac{293}{273}=6.72 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
\end{gathered}
\]

question: 1 mol 范德瓦耳斯气体的内能为 $u=c T-a / V(a, c$ 为常数), 计算 $C_{V}$ 和 $C_{p}$ 。
solution:
解 $C_{V}=\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=c$
$$
C_{p}=\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{p}+p\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+p\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}
$$
从范氏物态方程 $\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)(V-b)=R T$ 求 $\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}, p$ 不变对物态方程两边求偏微商
$$
\begin{gathered}
-\frac{2 a}{V^{3}}\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}(V-b)+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=R \\
\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=\frac{R}{p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}-\frac{2 a}{V^{3}}(V-b)}=\frac{R}{p-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}} \\
p=\frac{R T}{(V-b)}-\frac{a}{V^{2}} \\
C_{p}=c+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+\frac{R\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)}{p-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}}=c+\frac{R\left(\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)}{\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}} \\
=c+\frac{R \cdot \frac{R T}{V-b}}{\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{2 a V-2 a b}{V^{3}}}=c+\frac{R}{1-\frac{2 a(V-b)^{2}}{R T V^{3}}}
\end{gathered}
$$

question: The internal energy of 1 mol of van der Waals gas is $u = c T - a / V$ (where $a$ and $c$ are constants). Calculate $C_{V}$ and $C_{p}$.
solution:
Solve for $C_{V}=\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=c$.

$$
C_{p}=\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{p}+p\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+p\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}
$$

From the Van der Waals equation of state $\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)(V-b)=R T$, find $\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}$ by taking the partial derivative of both sides of the equation with respect to $T$, keeping $p$ constant.

$$
\begin{gathered}
-\frac{2 a}{V^{3}}\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}(V-b)+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=R \\
\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=\frac{R}{p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}-\frac{2 a}{V^{3}}(V-b)}=\frac{R}{p-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}} \\
p=\frac{R T}{(V-b)}-\frac{a}{V^{2}} \\
C_{p}=c+\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=c+\frac{R\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)}{p-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}}=c+\frac{R\left(\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)}{\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}+\frac{2 a b}{V^{3}}} \\
=c+\frac{R \cdot \frac{R T}{V-b}}{\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{2 a V-2 a b}{V^{3}}}=c+\frac{R}{1-\frac{2 a(V-b)^{2}}{R T V^{3}}}
\end{gathered}
$$

question: 对理想顺磁体, 试求其比热差 $C_{H}-C_{M}$, 其中 $C_{H}$ 和 $C_{M}$ 为磁场强度不变和磁化强度不变的比热。

For an ideal paramagnet, find the difference in specific heat $C_{H}-C_{M}$, where $C_{H}$ and $C_{M}$ are the specific heats at constant magnetic field strength and constant magnetization, respectively.
有一热泵在温度为 $T$ 的物体和温度为 $T_{0}$ 的热源间工作，热泵消耗功率为 $W$, 物体每秒散热为 $\alpha\left(T-T_{0}\right)$, 求平衡温度 ( $\alpha$ 为常数).
solution:
解 热机从 $T_{0}$ 的热源吸热，向物体放热，每秒放出的热量为

$$Q=\frac{W}{\eta}=\frac{W}{1-\frac{T_{0}}{T}}$$

平衡时 $Q_{\mathrm{e}}=\alpha\left(T_{\mathrm{e}}-T_{0}\right), \frac{W}{1-\frac{T_{0}}{T_{\mathrm{e}}}}=\alpha\left(T_{\mathrm{e}}-T_{0}\right)$,

$$\begin{gathered}
\alpha T_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}-\left(W+2 \alpha T_{0}\right) T_{\mathrm{e}}+\alpha T_{0}^{2}=0 \\
T_{\mathrm{e}}=\frac{W+2 \alpha T_{0} \pm \sqrt{W^{2}+4 \alpha W T_{0}}}{2 \alpha}=T_{0} \pm \frac{W}{2 \alpha}\left(1 \pm \sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)
\end{gathered}$$

平衡时 $T_{\mathrm{e}}>T_{0}$, 要求 $\left(1 \pm \sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)>0, \quad\left(\sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)>1$, 取加号, 则

$$T_{\mathrm{e}}=T_{0}+\frac{W}{2 \alpha}\left(1+\sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)$$

question: A heat pump operates between an object at temperature $T$ and a heat source at temperature $T_{0}$. The heat pump consumes power $W$, and the object dissipates heat at a rate of $\alpha\left(T-T_{0}\right)$ per second. Find the equilibrium temperature (where $\alpha$ is a constant).
solution:
Solve: A heat engine absorbs heat from a heat source at $T_{0}$ and releases heat to an object, with the heat released per second being

$$Q=\frac{W}{\eta}=\frac{W}{1-\frac{T_{0}}{T}}$$

At equilibrium, $Q_{\mathrm{e}}=\alpha\left(T_{\mathrm{e}}-T_{0}\right), \frac{W}{1-\frac{T_{0}}{T_{\mathrm{e}}}}=\alpha\left(T_{\mathrm{e}}-T_{0}\right)$,

$$\begin{gathered}
\alpha T_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}-\left(W+2 \alpha T_{0}\right) T_{\mathrm{e}}+\alpha T_{0}^{2}=0 \\
T_{\mathrm{e}}=\frac{W+2 \alpha T_{0} \pm \sqrt{W^{2}+4 \alpha W T_{0}}}{2 \alpha}=T_{0} \pm \frac{W}{2 \alpha}\left(1 \pm \sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)
\end{gathered}$$

At equilibrium $T_{\mathrm{e}}>T_{0}$, it requires $\left(1 \pm \sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)>0, \quad\left(\sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)>1$, take the positive sign, then

$$T_{\mathrm{e}}=T_{0}+\frac{W}{2 \alpha}\left(1+\sqrt{1+\frac{4 \alpha T_{0}}{W}}\right)$$.

question: 1 mol 范德瓦耳斯气体，体积从 $V_{1}$ 等温膨胀到 $V_{2}$ ，求其内能的变化.
solution:
解 $\mathrm{d} U=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_{T} \mathrm{~d} V=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\left[T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p\right] \mathrm{d} V$
对于等温膨胀过程， $\Delta U=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}}\left[T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p\right] \mathrm{d} V$ ，

$$
p=\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}, \quad \Delta U=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}} \frac{a}{V^{2}} \mathrm{~d} V=a\left(\frac{1}{V_{1}}-\frac{1}{V_{2}}\right)
$$

question: 1 mol of van der Waals gas expands isothermally from $V_{1}$ to $V_{2}$. Find the change in its internal energy.
solution:
Solve $\mathrm{d} U=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_{T} \mathrm{~d} V=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\left[T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p\right] \mathrm{d} V$.

For an isothermal expansion process, $\Delta U=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}}\left[T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p\right] \mathrm{d} V$,

$$
p=\frac{R T}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}, \quad \Delta U=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}} \frac{a}{V^{2}} \mathrm{~d} V=a\left(\frac{1}{V_{1}}-\frac{1}{V_{2}}\right)
$$.

question: 1 mol 某气体的物态方程为 $p V=R T-\frac{a}{V}$ ，其摩尔比热 $c_{V}$ 为常数，求该气体的摩尔内能 $u$ 。
solution:
解 $\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial V}\right)_{T}=T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p=\frac{a}{V^{2}},\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=C_{V}$

$$
\mathrm{d} u=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\frac{a}{V^{2}} \mathrm{~d} V, \quad u(T, V)=C_{V} T-\frac{a}{V}+u_{0}
$$

question: The equation of state for 1 mol of a certain gas is $p V=R T-\frac{a}{V}$, and its molar heat capacity at constant volume $c_{V}$ is constant. Find the molar internal energy $u$ of this gas.
solution:
Solve $\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial V}\right)_{T}=T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-p=\frac{a}{V^{2}},\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=C_{V}$

$$
\mathrm{d} u=C_{V} \mathrm{~d} T+\frac{a}{V^{2}} \mathrm{~d} V, \quad u(T, V)=C_{V} T-\frac{a}{V}+u_{0}
$$.

question: 1 kg 温度为 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 的水与温度为 $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 的大热源接触，使其达到 $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ，计算水的熵变、热源的熵变以及两者的总熵变。水的定压比热为 $4187 \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ 。
solution:
解 设水等压准静态地由 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \rightarrow 100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ，水的熵变： 

$$
\Delta S=\int_{237.15}^{373.15} \frac{m C_{\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}} \mathrm{d} T}{T}=1 \times 4187 \times \ln \frac{373.15}{273.15}=1350\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

热源总放热： 

$$
\Delta Q=m C_{\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}}(100-0)=1 \times 4187 \times 100=4.187 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
$$

热源的熵变： 

$$
\Delta S=-\frac{\Delta Q}{T_{0}}=-\frac{4.187 \times 10^{5}}{373.15}=-1121\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

总熵变： 

$$
\Delta S=\Delta S_{\text {未 }}+\Delta S_{\text {热源 }}=184\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

question: 1 kg of water at a temperature of $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ is in contact with a large heat source at a temperature of $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, causing it to reach $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the change in entropy of the water, the change in entropy of the heat source, and the total change in entropy of both. The specific heat capacity of water at constant pressure is $4187 \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$.
solution:
Solution: Assume water undergoes an isobaric quasi-static process from $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \rightarrow 100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, the change in entropy of water is:

$$
\Delta S=\int_{237.15}^{373.15} \frac{m C_{\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}} \mathrm{d} T}{T}=1 \times 4187 \times \ln \frac{373.15}{273.15}=1350\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

Total heat released by the heat source:

$$
\Delta Q=m C_{\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}}(100-0)=1 \times 4187 \times 100=4.187 \times 10^{5}(\mathrm{~J})
$$

Change in entropy of the heat source:

$$
\Delta S=-\frac{\Delta Q}{T_{0}}=-\frac{4.187 \times 10^{5}}{373.15}=-1121\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

Total change in entropy:

$$
\Delta S=\Delta S_{\text {universe}}+\Delta S_{\text {heat source}}=184\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
$$

question: 在大气压且温度略低于 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 时, 水的比热容为 $C_{p}=4222-22.6 t \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$,冰的比热容为 $C_{p}=2112+7.5 t \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$. 试计算 $1 \mathrm{~kg} \sim-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 的过冷水变为 $-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 的冰时, 熵的增加量为多少?
solution:
解 其过程可分为 3 步: $-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 过冷水 $\rightarrow 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 水 $\rightarrow 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 冰 $\rightarrow-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 水, 3 个过程的熵增分别为

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Delta S_{1} & =\int_{-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}^{0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}} \frac{C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\int_{263}^{273} \frac{(4222-22.6(T-273)) \mathrm{d} T}{T}=\int_{263}^{273}\left(\frac{10392}{T}-22.6\right) \mathrm{d} T \\
& =10392 \times \ln \frac{273}{263}-22.6 \times 10=161.8\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right) \\
\Delta S_{2} & =-\frac{\Delta Q}{T_{0}}=-\frac{80 \times 4.18 \times 10^{3}}{273}=-1225\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Delta S_{3} & =\int_{0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}} \frac{C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\int_{273}^{263} \frac{(2112+7.5(T-273)) \mathrm{d} T}{T}=\int_{273}^{263}\left(\frac{64.5}{T}+7.5\right) \mathrm{d} T \\
& =64.5 \times \ln \frac{263}{273}+7.5 \times(-10)=-77.4\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right) \\
\Delta S & =\Delta S_{1}+\Delta S_{2}+\Delta S_{3}=-1140.6\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

question: At atmospheric pressure and at a temperature slightly below $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, the specific heat capacity of water is $C_{p}=4222-22.6 t \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$, and the specific heat capacity of ice is $C_{p}=2112+7.5 t \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$. Try to calculate the increase in entropy when $1 \mathrm{~kg}$ of supercooled water at $\sim-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ turns into ice at $-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$.
solution:
Solution: The process can be divided into 3 steps: $-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ supercooled water $\rightarrow 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ water $\rightarrow 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ice $\rightarrow -10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ water. The entropy changes for the 3 processes are:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Delta S_{1} & =\int_{-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}^{0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}} \frac{C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\int_{263}^{273} \frac{(4222-22.6(T-273)) \mathrm{d} T}{T}=\int_{263}^{273}\left(\frac{10392}{T}-22.6\right) \mathrm{d} T \\
& =10392 \times \ln \frac{273}{263}-22.6 \times 10=161.8\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right) \\
\Delta S_{2} & =-\frac{\Delta Q}{T_{0}}=-\frac{80 \times 4.18 \times 10^{3}}{273}=-1225\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Delta S_{3} & =\int_{0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}} \frac{C_{p} \mathrm{~d} T}{T}=\int_{273}^{263} \frac{(2112+7.5(T-273)) \mathrm{d} T}{T}=\int_{273}^{263}\left(\frac{64.5}{T}+7.5\right) \mathrm{d} T \\
& =64.5 \times \ln \frac{263}{273}+7.5 \times(-10)=-77.4\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right) \\
\Delta S & =\Delta S_{1}+\Delta S_{2}+\Delta S_{3}=-1140.6\left(\mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~kg}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{~K}^{-1}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 试估算立方晶体中原子的振动频率 $v$ ，设立方体的点阵常数为 $a \approx 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$ ，原子质量 $m \approx 10^{-26} \mathrm{~kg}$ ，晶体的体积弹性模量 $B \approx 10^{11} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{-2}$ 。
solution: 解 体积弹性模量 $B=-V\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial V}\right)_{T}$ ，因此晶体在压强 $p$ 的作用下，晶体体积的相对变化为 $\frac{\Delta V}{V}$ ，则 $p=-B \frac{\Delta V}{V}=-B \frac{3 \Delta a}{a^{3}}$ ，原子所受的力为 $$ f=p a^{2}=-3 B a \Delta a $$ 此力为恢复力，弹性常数 $k=3 B a$ ，所以它使原子在平衡位置附近振动，振动频率为 $$ \begin{gathered} \omega^{2}=\frac{k}{m}=\frac{3 B a}{m} \\ v=\frac{\omega}{2 \pi}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \sqrt{\frac{3 B a}{m}} \approx \frac{1}{2 \pi} \sqrt{\frac{3 \times 10^{11} \times 10^{-10}}{10^{-26}}}=8.7 \times 10^{12}(\mathrm{~Hz}) \approx 10^{13}(\mathrm{~Hz}) \end{gathered} $$

question: Estimate the vibrational frequency $v$ of atoms in a cubic crystal, assuming the lattice constant of the cube is $a \approx 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$, the atomic mass is $m \approx 10^{-26} \mathrm{~kg}$, and the bulk modulus of the crystal is $B \approx 10^{11} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{-2}$.
solution: Solution: The bulk modulus $B=-V\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial V}\right)_{T}$, thus the relative change in volume of the crystal under pressure $p$ is $\frac{\Delta V}{V}$, then $p=-B \frac{\Delta V}{V}=-B \frac{3 \Delta a}{a^{3}}$. The force on the atom is $$ f=p a^{2}=-3 B a \Delta a $$ This force is a restoring force, with an elastic constant $k=3 B a$, so it causes the atom to vibrate near the equilibrium position, with a vibration frequency of $$ \begin{gathered} \omega^{2}=\frac{k}{m}=\frac{3 B a}{m} \\ v=\frac{\omega}{2 \pi}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \sqrt{\frac{3 B a}{m}} \approx \frac{1}{2 \pi} \sqrt{\frac{3 \times 10^{11} \times 10^{-10}}{10^{-26}}}=8.7 \times 10^{12}(\mathrm{~Hz}) \approx 10^{13}(\mathrm{~Hz}) \end{gathered} $$

question: 当铅在大气压下熔解时, 熔点为 600 K , 密度从 $11.01 \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ (固体) 减少到 $10.65 \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ (液体), 熔解热为 $24.5 \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~g}^{-1}$, 求: 在 $1.01 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~Pa}$ 压强下熔点是多少?
solution:
解 由克拉珀龙方程 $\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{\mathrm{~d} T}=\frac{L}{T\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}$

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d} T}{T}=\frac{\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}{L} \mathrm{~d} p, T=T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{V_{2}-V_{1}}{L}\left(p-p_{0}\right)}
$$

代入 $T_{0}=600 \mathrm{~K}, p_{0}=$ latm,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}{L} & =\frac{1}{L}\left(\frac{1}{\rho_{1}}-\frac{1}{\rho_{\mathrm{s}}}\right)=\frac{\rho_{\mathrm{s}}-\rho_{1}}{L \rho_{1} \rho_{\mathrm{s}}}=\frac{(11.01-10.65) \times 10^{3}}{24.5 \times 10^{3} \times 11.01 \times 10.65 \times 10^{6}} \\
& =1.25 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}^{2} \cdot \mathrm{~N}^{-1} \\
T & =T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{1.25 \times 10^{-10}\left(p-p_{0}\right)}=600 \mathrm{e}^{1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}}=600.75(\mathrm{~K})
\end{aligned}
$$

或由于 $\frac{\left(V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}\right)}{L} \Delta p \ll 1$,

$$
\Delta T=T_{0}\left(\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L}\right) \Delta p=600 \times 1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}=0.75
$$

或 $T=T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p} \approx T_{0}\left(1+\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p\right)=T_{0}+T_{0} \frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p$,

$$
\Delta T=T_{0}\left(\frac{V_{2}-V_{1}}{L}\right) \Delta p=600 \times 1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}=0.75
$$

均得 $T=T_{0}+\Delta T=600.75(\mathrm{~K})$.

question: When lead melts at atmospheric pressure, the melting point is 600 K, and the density decreases from $11.01 \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ (solid) to $10.65 \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ (liquid). The heat of fusion is $24.5 \mathrm{~J} \cdot \mathrm{~g}^{-1}$. Question: What is the melting point under a pressure of $1.01 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~Pa}$?
solution:
Solution: By the Clapeyron equation $\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{\mathrm{~d} T}=\frac{L}{T\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}$

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d} T}{T}=\frac{\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}{L} \mathrm{~d} p, T=T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{V_{2}-V_{1}}{L}\left(p-p_{0}\right)}
$$

Substituting $T_{0}=600 \mathrm{~K}, p_{0}=$ latm,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)}{L} & =\frac{1}{L}\left(\frac{1}{\rho_{1}}-\frac{1}{\rho_{\mathrm{s}}}\right)=\frac{\rho_{\mathrm{s}}-\rho_{1}}{L \rho_{1} \rho_{\mathrm{s}}}=\frac{(11.01-10.65) \times 10^{3}}{24.5 \times 10^{3} \times 11.01 \times 10.65 \times 10^{6}} \\
& =1.25 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}^{2} \cdot \mathrm{~N}^{-1} \\
T & =T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{1.25 \times 10^{-10}\left(p-p_{0}\right)}=600 \mathrm{e}^{1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}}=600.75(\mathrm{~K})
\end{aligned}
$$

Or since $\frac{\left(V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}\right)}{L} \Delta p \ll 1$,

$$
\Delta T=T_{0}\left(\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L}\right) \Delta p=600 \times 1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}=0.75
$$

Or $T=T_{0} \mathrm{e}^{\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p} \approx T_{0}\left(1+\frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p\right)=T_{0}+T_{0} \frac{V_{1}-V_{\mathrm{s}}}{L} \Delta p$,

$$
\Delta T=T_{0}\left(\frac{V_{2}-V_{1}}{L}\right) \Delta p=600 \times 1.25 \times 10^{-10} \times 1.0 \times 10^{7}=0.75
$$

Both give $T=T_{0}+\Delta T=600.75(\mathrm{~K})$.

question: 一容器内贮有氧气，其压强为 $p=1.0 \mathrm{~atm}$ ，温度 $t=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ，求： (1) 单位体积内的分子数; (2) 分子间的平均距离; (3) 分子的平均平均动能.
solution:
解 (1) 把氧气看成理想气体, 状态方程为 $p=n k T$

$$
n=\frac{p}{k T}=\frac{1.013 \times 10^{5}}{1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300}=2.45 \times 10^{25}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{-3}\right)
$$

(2) 分子间的平均距离

$$
\bar{t}=\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(2.45 \times 10^{25}\right)^{-\frac{1}{3}}=3.44 \times 10^{-9}(\mathrm{~m})
$$

(3) 分子的平均平均动能

$$
\bar{\varepsilon}_{\mathrm{k}}=\frac{3}{2} k T=\frac{3}{2} \times 1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300=6.21 \times 10^{-21}(\mathrm{~J})
$$

question: A container holds oxygen gas with a pressure of $p=1.0 \mathrm{~atm}$ and a temperature of $t=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Find: (1) the number of molecules per unit volume; (2) the average distance between molecules; (3) the average kinetic energy of the molecules.
solution:
Solution: 

(1) Consider oxygen as an ideal gas, the state equation is $p=n k T$

$$
n=\frac{p}{k T}=\frac{1.013 \times 10^{5}}{1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300}=2.45 \times 10^{25}\left(\mathrm{~m}^{-3}\right)
$$

(2) The average distance between molecules

$$
\bar{t}=\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}=\left(2.45 \times 10^{25}\right)^{-\frac{1}{3}}=3.44 \times 10^{-9}(\mathrm{~m})
$$

(3) The average kinetic energy of the molecules

$$
\bar{\varepsilon}_{\mathrm{k}}=\frac{3}{2} k T=\frac{3}{2} \times 1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300=6.21 \times 10^{-21}(\mathrm{~J})
$$

question: 一容器中存有分子质量为 $m$, 数密度为 $n$ 的理想气体, 在壁上贴有一吸附气体分子的固体. 若气体分子对此固体的法向速度小于 $v_{0}$ 的分子不能被吸附, 试求单位时间内，在吸附固体的单位表面积上能吸附多少分子？
solution: 解 单位时间内速度为 $v \sim v+\mathrm{d} v$ 的分子碰到法线方向为 $x$ 方向的固体表面单位面积上的分子数为$$\mathrm{d} N_{v}=n f(v) \mathrm{d} \omega \mathrm{~d} \tau=n f(v) \mathrm{d} v v_{x} \cdot 1 \cdot 1=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{y} \mathrm{~d} v_{z}$$对 $v_{y}, v_{z}$ 从 $-\infty$ 到 $+\infty$ 积分, 对 $v_{x}$ 从 $v_{0} \rightarrow \infty$ 积分, 得到在吸附固体的单位表面积上能吸附的分子数为$$\mathrm{d} N_{v}=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \int_{v_{0}}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x}=\frac{n \sqrt{\frac{2 k T}{m}}}{2 \sqrt{\pi}} \int_{\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-t} \mathrm{~d} t=n \sqrt{\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}$$
answer: n \sqrt{\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}

question: A container contains an ideal gas with molecular mass $m$ and number density $n$. A solid that adsorbs gas molecules is attached to the wall. If gas molecules with a normal velocity less than $v_{0}$ cannot be adsorbed by this solid, find how many molecules can be adsorbed per unit time on the unit surface area of the adsorbing solid.
solution: The number of molecules with velocity in the range $v \sim v+\mathrm{d} v$ that collide with a unit area of a solid surface with a normal direction in the $x$ direction per unit time is given by $$\mathrm{d} N_{v}=n f(v) \mathrm{d} \omega \mathrm{~d} \tau=n f(v) \mathrm{d} v v_{x} \cdot 1 \cdot 1=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{y} \mathrm{~d} v_{z}$$. Integrating over $v_{y}, v_{z}$ from $-\infty$ to $+\infty$, and over $v_{x}$ from $v_{0} \rightarrow \infty$, the number of molecules that can be adsorbed per unit surface area of the solid is given by $$\mathrm{d} N_{v}=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \int_{v_{0}}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x}=\frac{n \sqrt{\frac{2 k T}{m}}}{2 \sqrt{\pi}} \int_{\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-t} \mathrm{~d} t=n \sqrt{\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}$$.
answer: n \sqrt{\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{0}^{2}}{2 k T}}

question: 已知平均日-地距离为 $d_{1}=1.5 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~km}$, 平均日-海王星距离为 $d_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~km}$, 太阳到地球的辐射通量 $w=1.35 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~W} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{-2} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$, 试作出合理的假设, 以估计海王星的表面温度。
solution:
解 设地球和海王星均为黑体, 它们吸收太阳辐射到星体的全部能量, 并向周围辐射能量, 平衡时它们吸收的能量和辐射的能量相等.
设太阳的辐射通量为 $j_{\mathrm{s}}$, 则地球接收太阳的辐射通量为
$$
W=j_{\mathrm{s}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2}}{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}}
$$
海王星接收太阳的辐射通量为
$$
W_{\text {海 }}=j_{\mathrm{s}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2}}{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}}
$$
由海王星吸收能量与辐射能量相等得
$$
W_{\text {海 }} \pi R_{\text {海 }}^{2}=\sigma T^{4} 4 \pi R_{\text {海 }}^{2}
$$
式中, $T$ 为海王星的表面温度,
$$
T=\left(\frac{W_{\text {海 }}}{4 \sigma}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}=\left[\frac{j_{\mathrm{s}}}{4 \sigma}\left(\frac{R_{\mathrm{s}}}{d_{2}}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}}=\left[\frac{W}{4 \sigma}\left(\frac{d_{1}}{d_{2}}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}}=\left[\frac{1.35 \times 10^{3}}{4 \times 5.67 \times 10^{-8}}\left(\frac{1.5}{45}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}}=50.7(\mathrm{~K})
$$

question: Given that the average Sun-Earth distance is $d_{1}=1.5 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~km}$, the average Sun-Neptune distance is $d_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~km}$, and the solar radiation flux to Earth is $w=1.35 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~W} \cdot \mathrm{~m}^{-2} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$, make reasonable assumptions to estimate the surface temperature of Neptune.
solution:
Solution: Assume that both Earth and Neptune are black bodies, absorbing all the solar radiation that reaches them and radiating energy to their surroundings. At equilibrium, the energy they absorb equals the energy they radiate. 

Let the solar radiation flux be $j_{\mathrm{s}}$. Then, the radiation flux received by Earth is 
$$
W = j_{\mathrm{s}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2}}{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}}
$$ 

The radiation flux received by Neptune is 
$$
W_{\text{Neptune}} = j_{\mathrm{s}} \cdot \frac{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2}}{4 \pi R_{\mathrm{e}}^{2}}
$$ 

From the equality of absorbed and radiated energy for Neptune, we have 
$$
W_{\text{Neptune}} \pi R_{\text{Neptune}}^{2} = \sigma T^{4} 4 \pi R_{\text{Neptune}}^{2}
$$ 

where $T$ is the surface temperature of Neptune. 

Thus, 
$$
T = \left(\frac{W_{\text{Neptune}}}{4 \sigma}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} = \left[\frac{j_{\mathrm{s}}}{4 \sigma}\left(\frac{R_{\mathrm{s}}}{d_{2}}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}} = \left[\frac{W}{4 \sigma}\left(\frac{d_{1}}{d_{2}}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}} = \left[\frac{1.35 \times 10^{3}}{4 \times 5.67 \times 10^{-8}}\left(\frac{1.5}{45}\right)^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{4}} = 50.7 \, \mathrm{K}
$$

question: 设一个双原子分子具有电偶极矩 $p_{0}$ ，在电场 $E$ 中分子的转动能 $\varepsilon_{r}=$ $\frac{1}{2 I}\left(p_{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{\sin ^{2} \theta} p_{\varphi}^{2}\right)-p_{0} E \cos \theta$ ，其中 $\theta$ 为电偶极矩与电场方向的夹角，已知分子的数密度为 $n$ ，求转动配分函数 $Z_{r}$ 和电极化强度 $P$ 。
solution: 解（1）转动配分函数 $Z_{r}$ $$Z_{r} =\frac{1}{\hbar^{2}} \int \mathrm{e}^{-\beta \varepsilon_{r}} \mathrm{~d} \omega=\frac{1}{\hbar^{2}} \int_{0}^{2 \pi} \mathrm{~d} \varphi \int_{0}^{\pi} \mathrm{e}^{\beta p_{0} E \cos \theta} \mathrm{~d} \theta \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{\beta}{2 I}\left(p_{\theta}^{2}+\frac{p_{\varphi}^{2}}{\sin ^{2} \theta}\right)} \mathrm{d} p_{\theta} \mathrm{d} p_{\varphi} =\frac{2 \pi}{\hbar^{2}} \int_{0}^{\pi} \mathrm{e}^{\beta p_{0} E \cos \theta} \pi \frac{2 I \sin \theta}{\beta} \mathrm{~d} \theta=\frac{I}{\hbar^{2} \beta^{2} p_{0} E} \int_{-\beta p_{0} E}^{\beta p_{0} E} \mathrm{e}^{x} \mathrm{~d} x=\frac{2 I}{\hbar^{2} \beta^{2} p_{0} E} \sinh \beta p_{0} E$$ （2）电极化强度 $P$ 为 $$P=n \overline{p_{z}}=n\left(\frac{1}{\beta} \frac{\partial \ln Z_{r}}{\partial E}\right)=n\left(p_{0} \operatorname{coth} \beta p_{0} E-\frac{1}{\beta E}\right)=n p_{0}\left(\operatorname{coth} \frac{p_{0} E}{k T}-\frac{k T}{p_{0} E}\right)$$
answer: n p_{0}\left(\operatorname{coth} \frac{p_{0} E}{k T}-\frac{k T}{p_{0} E}\right)

question: Consider a diatomic molecule with an electric dipole moment $p_{0}$. In an electric field $E$, the rotational energy of the molecule is given by $\varepsilon_{r} = \frac{1}{2 I}\left(p_{\theta}^{2}+\frac{1}{\sin ^{2} \theta} p_{\varphi}^{2}\right) - p_{0} E \cos \theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle between the dipole moment and the direction of the electric field. Given the molecular number density $n$, find the rotational partition function $Z_{r}$ and the polarization $P$.
solution:
Solution (1) The rotational partition function \( Z_{r} \) is given by:

\[ 
Z_{r} = \frac{1}{\hbar^{2}} \int \mathrm{e}^{-\beta \varepsilon_{r}} \mathrm{~d} \omega = \frac{1}{\hbar^{2}} \int_{0}^{2 \pi} \mathrm{~d} \varphi \int_{0}^{\pi} \mathrm{e}^{\beta p_{0} E \cos \theta} \mathrm{~d} \theta \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{\beta}{2 I}\left(p_{\theta}^{2}+\frac{p_{\varphi}^{2}}{\sin^{2} \theta}\right)} \mathrm{d} p_{\theta} \mathrm{d} p_{\varphi} 
\]

\[
= \frac{2 \pi}{\hbar^{2}} \int_{0}^{\pi} \mathrm{e}^{\beta p_{0} E \cos \theta} \pi \frac{2 I \sin \theta}{\beta} \mathrm{~d} \theta = \frac{I}{\hbar^{2} \beta^{2} p_{0} E} \int_{-\beta p_{0} E}^{\beta p_{0} E} \mathrm{e}^{x} \mathrm{~d} x = \frac{2 I}{\hbar^{2} \beta^{2} p_{0} E} \sinh \beta p_{0} E 
\]

(2) The polarization \( P \) is:

\[
P = n \overline{p_{z}} = n\left(\frac{1}{\beta} \frac{\partial \ln Z_{r}}{\partial E}\right) = n\left(p_{0} \operatorname{coth} \beta p_{0} E - \frac{1}{\beta E}\right) = n p_{0}\left(\operatorname{coth} \frac{p_{0} E}{k T} - \frac{k T}{p_{0} E}\right) 
\]
answer: n p_{0}\left(\operatorname{coth} \frac{p_{0} E}{k T}-\frac{k T}{p_{0} E}\right)

question:
氢分子中两个氢原子的相互作用势由下列经验公式给出
$$V=D\left\{\mathrm{e}^{-2 a\left(r-r_{0}\right)}-2 \mathrm{e}^{-a\left(r-r_{0}\right)}\right\}$$
式中，$r$ 为原子间距，$D=7 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{erg}, a=2 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~cm}^{-1}, r_{0}=7.4 \times 10^{-9} \mathrm{~cm}$. (1) 计算转动和振动自由度开始对热容量有贡献时的温度值. (2) 求出在下列温度时氢气的摩尔定容热容量 $C_{V}$ 和摩尔定压热容量 $C_{p}$ 的近似值：$T_{1}=25 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{2}=250 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{3}=2500 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{4}=10000 \mathrm{~K}$ 。假设氢分子的离解可以忽略.
solution:
解 （1）两原子之间的平衡距离 $d$ 由下式确定
$$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d} V}{\mathrm{~d} r}\right|_{r=d}=0$$
由此得到平衡距离 $d=r_{0}$ 。两原子之间径向振动的圆频率 $\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{\mu}}$ 。其中 $\mu=\frac{m_{\mathrm{p}}}{2}$ 为氢分子的折合质量，弹性系数 $k=\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} V}{\mathrm{~d} r^{2}}\right|_{r=d}=2 a^{2} D$ ，故得圆频率
$$\omega=\sqrt{\frac{4 a^{2} D}{m_{\mathrm{p}}}}$$
氢分子的振动和转动能级的特征温度分别为
$$\begin{gathered}
\Theta_{c}=\frac{1}{k} \hbar \omega=\frac{2 a \hbar}{k} \sqrt{\frac{D}{m_{p}}}=6250 \mathrm{~K} \\
\Theta_{s}=\frac{1}{k} \frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 I}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{k m_{0} t_{0}^{2}}=87 \mathrm{~K}
\end{gathered}$$
所以，在 $T=87 \mathrm{~K}$ 时转动开始对比热容有贡献；在 $T=6250 \mathrm{~K}$ 时振动开始对比热容有贡献。

（2）若一个分子有 $t$ 个平动自由度， $r$ 个转动自由度和 $v$ 个振动自由度，由能量均分定理得到，1 mol 氢气的内能和定容比热容分别为
$$U=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) N_{0} k T=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) R T, \quad C_{V}=\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) R$$
其中， $N_{0}$ 是阿伏伽德罗常数， $R$ 为气体常数。定压比热容 $C_{p}=C_{V}+R$ 。由此可得在各种不同温度下气体的定容和定压比热容。

在 $T_{1}=25 \mathrm{~K}$ 时，只有平动对比热容有贡献，因此， $C_{V}=\frac{3}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{5}{2} R$ ；
在 $T_{2}=250 \mathrm{~K}$ 时，平动和转动对比热容有贡献，因此， $C_{V}=\frac{5}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R$ ；
在 $T_{3}=2500 \mathrm{~K}$ 时，仍只有平动和转动对比热容有贡献，因此， $C_{V}=\frac{5}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R$ ；
在 $T_{4}=10000 \mathrm{~K}$ 时，平动、转动和振动都对比热容有贡献，因此， $C_{V}=\frac{7}{2} R$ ， $C_{p}=\frac{9}{2} R$.

question:
The interaction potential between two hydrogen atoms in a hydrogen molecule is given by the following empirical formula:

$$V=D\left\{\mathrm{e}^{-2 a\left(r-r_{0}\right)}-2 \mathrm{e}^{-a\left(r-r_{0}\right)}\right\}$$

where $r$ is the interatomic distance, $D=7 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{erg}, a=2 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~cm}^{-1}, r_{0}=7.4 \times 10^{-9} \mathrm{~cm}$. 

(1) Calculate the temperature at which rotational and vibrational degrees of freedom begin to contribute to the heat capacity. 

(2) Determine the approximate values of the molar constant-volume heat capacity $C_{V}$ and the molar constant-pressure heat capacity $C_{p}$ of hydrogen at the following temperatures: $T_{1}=25 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{2}=250 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{3}=2500 \mathrm{~K} ; T_{4}=10000 \mathrm{~K}$. Assume that the dissociation of hydrogen molecules can be neglected.
solution:
Solution (1) The equilibrium distance $d$ between two atoms is determined by the following equation:
$$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d} V}{\mathrm{~d} r}\right|_{r=d}=0$$
From this, the equilibrium distance is $d=r_{0}$. The angular frequency of radial vibration between two atoms is $\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{\mu}}$, where $\mu=\frac{m_{\mathrm{p}}}{2}$ is the reduced mass of the hydrogen molecule, and the elastic constant $k=\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} V}{\mathrm{~d} r^{2}}\right|_{r=d}=2 a^{2} D$. Thus, the angular frequency is given by
$$\omega=\sqrt{\frac{4 a^{2} D}{m_{\mathrm{p}}}}$$
The characteristic temperatures of the vibrational and rotational energy levels of a hydrogen molecule are
$$\begin{gathered}
\Theta_{c}=\frac{1}{k} \hbar \omega=\frac{2 a \hbar}{k} \sqrt{\frac{D}{m_{p}}}=6250 \mathrm{~K} \\
\Theta_{s}=\frac{1}{k} \frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 I}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{k m_{0} t_{0}^{2}}=87 \mathrm{~K}
\end{gathered}$$
Therefore, at $T=87 \mathrm{~K}$, rotation begins to contribute to the heat capacity, and at $T=6250 \mathrm{~K}$, vibration begins to contribute to the heat capacity.

(2) If a molecule has $t$ translational degrees of freedom, $r$ rotational degrees of freedom, and $v$ vibrational degrees of freedom, according to the equipartition theorem, the internal energy and constant-volume heat capacity of 1 mol of hydrogen gas are
$$U=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) N_{0} k T=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) R T, \quad C_{V}=\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=\frac{1}{2}(t+r+2 v) R$$
where $N_{0}$ is Avogadro's number, and $R$ is the gas constant. The constant-pressure heat capacity is $C_{p}=C_{V}+R$. Thus, the constant-volume and constant-pressure heat capacities of the gas can be determined at various temperatures.

At $T_{1}=25 \mathrm{~K}$, only translation contributes to the heat capacity, so $C_{V}=\frac{3}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{5}{2} R$;
At $T_{2}=250 \mathrm{~K}$, both translation and rotation contribute to the heat capacity, so $C_{V}=\frac{5}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R$;
At $T_{3}=2500 \mathrm{~K}$, still only translation and rotation contribute to the heat capacity, so $C_{V}=\frac{5}{2} R, C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R$;
At $T_{4}=10000 \mathrm{~K}$, translation, rotation, and vibration all contribute to the heat capacity, so $C_{V}=\frac{7}{2} R$, $C_{p}=\frac{9}{2} R$.

question:
（1）导出黑体辐射的谱辐射强度 $I(\lambda)$ 与波长 $\lambda$ 的关系；
（2）导出谱辐射强度的极大值的位置 $\lambda_{\max }$ 与温度 $T$ 的关系；
（3）如果太阳像一个直径为 $10^{6} \mathrm{~km}$ 、温度为 6000 K 的黑体，它在波长 3 cm 处的每兆周带宽内发射的微波功率是多少?
solution:
解 光子的圆频率在 $\omega \sim \omega+\mathrm{d} \omega$ 范围内的状态数为
$$
g(\omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{V}{\pi^{2} c^{3}} \omega^{2} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$
光子气体服从玻色分布，光子的化学势 $\mu=0$ 。因此，光子的圆频率在 $\omega \sim \omega+\mathrm{d} \omega$ 范围内的辐射能量为
$$
U(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\hbar \omega f_{\mathrm{B}} g(\omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{V}{\pi^{2} c^{3}} \frac{\hbar \omega^{3}}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\hbar \omega}{k T}}-1} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$
（1）光子气体的谱辐射强度
$$
I(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{1}{4} \frac{c}{V} U(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega==\frac{1}{4 \pi^{2} c^{2}} \frac{\hbar \omega^{3}}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\hbar \omega}{k T}}-1} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$
波长和圆频率之间的关系为 $\omega=\frac{2 \pi c}{\lambda}$ ，因此，谱辐射强度 $I(\lambda)$ 与波长 $\lambda$ 的关系为
$$
I(T, \lambda)=I(T, \omega) \frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} \lambda}=\frac{2 \pi h c^{2}}{\lambda^{5}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k T \lambda}}-1}
$$
（2）令 $x=\lambda T$ ，则有
$$
I(T, \lambda)=I(T, x)=\frac{2 \pi h c^{2} T^{5}}{x^{5}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x}}-1}
$$
使 $I$ 取极大值的 $x_{\mathrm{m}}$ 由方程
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} x}\left[x^{5}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x}}-1\right)\right] \|_{x=x_{\mathrm{m}}}=0
$$
确定。得到决定 $x_{\mathrm{m}}$ 的方程 $\left(5-\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}\right) \mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}}=5$ ，由此解得 $\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}=4.9651$ 。因此，谱辐射强度的极大值的位置 $\lambda_{\max }$ 与温度 $T$ 的关系为
$$
x_{\mathrm{m}}=\lambda_{\max } T=\frac{h c}{4.9651 k}=2.898 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m} \cdot \mathrm{~K}
$$
这就是维恩位移定律.
（3）太阳在 $\lambda=3 \mathrm{~cm}$ 的微波段处 $\frac{h v}{k T}=\frac{h c}{k T \lambda} \ll 1$ ，故在每兆周带宽内发射的微波功率为
$$
\begin{aligned}
4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} I(T, v) \Delta v & =4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi h v^{3}}{c^{2}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{h v / k T}-1} \Delta v \approx 4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi k T v^{2}}{c^{2}} \Delta v \\
& =4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi k T}{\lambda^{2}} \Delta v=1.82 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~W}
\end{aligned}
$$
式中， $R_{\mathrm{s}}=0.5 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~m}, T=6000 \mathrm{~K}, \lambda=3 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~m}, \Delta v=10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ 。

question:
(1) Derive the relationship between the spectral radiance $I(\lambda)$ of blackbody radiation and the wavelength $\lambda$.

(2) Derive the relationship between the position of the maximum spectral radiance $\lambda_{\max}$ and the temperature $T$.

(3) If the Sun is modeled as a blackbody with a diameter of $10^{6} \mathrm{~km}$ and a temperature of 6000 K, what is the microwave power it emits per megahertz bandwidth at a wavelength of 3 cm?
solution:
The number of states of photons with angular frequency in the range $\omega \sim \omega+\mathrm{d} \omega$ is given by

$$
g(\omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{V}{\pi^{2} c^{3}} \omega^{2} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$

Photon gas follows the Bose distribution, and the chemical potential of photons $\mu=0$. Therefore, the radiation energy of photons with angular frequency in the range $\omega \sim \omega+\mathrm{d} \omega$ is

$$
U(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\hbar \omega f_{\mathrm{B}} g(\omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{V}{\pi^{2} c^{3}} \frac{\hbar \omega^{3}}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\hbar \omega}{k T}}-1} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$

(1) The spectral radiation intensity of the photon gas is

$$
I(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{1}{4} \frac{c}{V} U(T, \omega) \mathrm{d} \omega=\frac{1}{4 \pi^{2} c^{2}} \frac{\hbar \omega^{3}}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\hbar \omega}{k T}}-1} \mathrm{~d} \omega
$$

The relationship between wavelength and angular frequency is $\omega=\frac{2 \pi c}{\lambda}$, therefore, the relationship between the spectral radiation intensity $I(\lambda)$ and wavelength $\lambda$ is

$$
I(T, \lambda)=I(T, \omega) \frac{\mathrm{d} \omega}{\mathrm{~d} \lambda}=\frac{2 \pi h c^{2}}{\lambda^{5}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k T \lambda}}-1}
$$

(2) Let $x=\lambda T$, then

$$
I(T, \lambda)=I(T, x)=\frac{2 \pi h c^{2} T^{5}}{x^{5}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x}}-1}
$$

The value of $x_{\mathrm{m}}$ that makes $I$ reach its maximum is determined by the equation

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{~d} x}\left[x^{5}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x}}-1\right)\right] \|_{x=x_{\mathrm{m}}}=0
$$

The equation that determines $x_{\mathrm{m}}$ is $\left(5-\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}\right) \mathrm{e}^{\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}}=5$, from which we solve $\frac{h c}{k x_{\mathrm{m}}}=4.9651$. Therefore, the relationship between the position of the maximum spectral radiation intensity $\lambda_{\max}$ and temperature $T$ is

$$
x_{\mathrm{m}}=\lambda_{\max} T=\frac{h c}{4.9651 k}=2.898 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m} \cdot \mathrm{~K}
$$

This is the Wien's displacement law.

(3) For the Sun at a microwave band of $\lambda=3 \mathrm{~cm}$, where $\frac{h v}{k T}=\frac{h c}{k T \lambda} \ll 1$, the microwave power emitted per megahertz bandwidth is

$$
\begin{aligned}
4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} I(T, v) \Delta v & =4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi h v^{3}}{c^{2}} \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{h v / k T}-1} \Delta v \approx 4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi k T v^{2}}{c^{2}} \Delta v \\
& =4 \pi R_{\mathrm{s}}^{2} \frac{2 \pi k T}{\lambda^{2}} \Delta v=1.82 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~W}
\end{aligned}
$$

where $R_{\mathrm{s}}=0.5 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{~m}, T=6000 \mathrm{~K}, \lambda=3 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~m}, \Delta v=10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$.

question: 设系统由近独立粒子组成，利用巨正则分布导出非局域系的热力学函数 $\bar{E}, \bar{N}, p, S$ （分玻色分布和费米分布两种情况来讨论）。
solution:
解 系统的巨配分函数
$$\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right) \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}$$
其中， $\sum_{s}$ 表示 $N$ 一定时对量子态 $s$ 求和， $\sum_{l}$ 表示 $N$ 一定时对能级 $l$ 求和， $C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right)$ 是能级 $E_{l}$ 的简并度。对于近独立子系组成的系统
$$C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right)=W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)$$
且满足约束条件 $\sum_{i} a_{i}=N, \sum_{i} a_{i} \varepsilon_{i}=E_{l}, \sum_{i}$ 表示对单粒子能级 $i$ 求和。
（1）玻色统计。
$$\begin{gathered}
W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)=\prod_{i} \frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \\
\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} \prod_{i} \frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{\left\{a_{i}\right\}} \prod_{i}\left\{\frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\} \\
=\prod_{i} \sum_{a_{i}=1}^{\infty}\left\{\frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\}=\prod_{i}\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right)^{-a_{i}} \\
\ln \Xi=-\sum_{i} \omega_{i} \ln \left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}\right)
\end{gathered}$$
（2）费米统计。
$$\begin{gathered}
W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)=\prod_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \\
\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} \prod_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{\left\{a_{i}\right\}} \prod_{i}\left\{\frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\} \\
=\prod_{i} \sum_{a_{i}=1}^{\omega_{i}}\left\{\frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\}=\prod_{i}\left(1+\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right)^{\omega_{i}} \\
\ln \Xi=\sum_{i} \omega_{i} \ln \left(1+\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}\right)
\end{gathered}$$
在巨正则系综中，出现粒子数为 $N$ ，量子态为 $s$ 的概率为
$$\rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}$$
热力学函数 $\bar{E}, \bar{N}, p, S$ 分别为
$$\begin{gathered}
\bar{E}=\sum_{N} \sum_{s} E_{s} \rho_{N s}=\left.\frac{1}{\Xi}\left\{-\frac{\partial}{\partial \beta}\left(\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right)\right\}\right|_{\beta \mu, V}=-\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \beta}\right)_{\beta \mu, V}=\sum \frac{\omega_{i} \varepsilon_{i}}{\mathrm{e}^{\beta\left(E_{i}-\mu\right)} \pm 1} \\
\bar{N}=\left.\sum_{N} N \sum_{s} \rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi} \frac{\partial}{\beta \partial \mu}\left\{\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right\}\right|_{\beta, V}=\frac{1}{\beta}\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \mu}\right)_{\beta, V}=\sum_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}}{\mathrm{e}^{\beta\left(E_{i}-\mu\right)} \pm 1} \\
p=-\left.\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \frac{\partial E_{s}}{\partial V} \rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi}\left\{\frac{1}{\beta} \frac{\partial}{\partial V}\left(\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right)\right\}\right|_{\beta, \beta \mu}=\frac{1}{\beta}\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial V}\right)_{\beta, \beta \mu} \\
S=k\left\{\ln \Xi-\beta \frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \beta}-\mu \frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \mu}\right\}=k \ln \Xi+\frac{\bar{E}}{T}-\frac{\bar{N} \mu}{T}
\end{gathered}$$
其中，" $\pm$ "号中，" + "号对应费米分布，" - "号对应玻色分布。

question: Consider a system composed of nearly independent particles. Use the grand canonical ensemble to derive the thermodynamic functions $\bar{E}, \bar{N}, p, S$ for non-local systems (discuss separately for Bose-Einstein distribution and Fermi-Dirac distribution).
solution:
Solve the grand partition function of the system
$$\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right) \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}$$
where $\sum_{s}$ denotes summation over quantum states $s$ for a fixed $N$, $\sum_{l}$ denotes summation over energy levels $l$ for a fixed $N$, and $C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right)$ is the degeneracy of energy level $E_{l}$. For a system composed of nearly independent subsystems
$$C\left(N, E_{l}, V\right)=W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)$$
and satisfies the constraints $\sum_{i} a_{i}=N, \sum_{i} a_{i} \varepsilon_{i}=E_{l}, \sum_{i}$ denotes summation over single-particle energy levels $i$.
(1) Bose statistics.
$$\begin{gathered}
W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)=\prod_{i} \frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \\
\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} \prod_{i} \frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{\left\{a_{i}\right\}} \prod_{i}\left\{\frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\} \\
=\prod_{i} \sum_{a_{i}=1}^{\infty}\left\{\frac{\left(a_{i}+\omega_{i}-1\right)!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-1\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\}=\prod_{i}\left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right)^{-a_{i}} \\
\ln \Xi=-\sum_{i} \omega_{i} \ln \left(1-\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}\right)
\end{gathered}$$
(2) Fermi statistics.
$$\begin{gathered}
W\left(N, E_{l}, V,\left\{a_{i}\right\}\right)=\prod_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \\
\Xi=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty} \sum_{l} \prod_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{l}-\mu N\right)}=\sum_{\left\{a_{i}\right\}} \prod_{i}\left\{\frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\} \\
=\prod_{i} \sum_{a_{i}=1}^{\omega_{i}}\left\{\frac{\omega_{i}!}{a_{i}!\left(\omega_{i}-a_{i}\right)!} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right\}=\prod_{i}\left(1+\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}}\right)^{\omega_{i}} \\
\ln \Xi=\sum_{i} \omega_{i} \ln \left(1+\mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(\varepsilon_{i}-\mu\right) a_{i}\right)
\end{gathered}$$
In the grand canonical ensemble, the probability of having particle number $N$ and quantum state $s$ is
$$\rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}$$
The thermodynamic functions $\bar{E}, \bar{N}, p, S$ are respectively
$$\begin{gathered}
\bar{E}=\sum_{N} \sum_{s} E_{s} \rho_{N s}=\left.\frac{1}{\Xi}\left\{-\frac{\partial}{\partial \beta}\left(\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right)\right\}\right|_{\beta \mu, V}=-\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \beta}\right)_{\beta \mu, V}=\sum \frac{\omega_{i} \varepsilon_{i}}{\mathrm{e}^{\beta\left(E_{i}-\mu\right)} \pm 1} \\
\bar{N}=\left.\sum_{N} N \sum_{s} \rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi} \frac{\partial}{\beta \partial \mu}\left\{\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right\}\right|_{\beta, V}=\frac{1}{\beta}\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \mu}\right)_{\beta, V}=\sum_{i} \frac{\omega_{i}}{\mathrm{e}^{\beta\left(E_{i}-\mu\right)} \pm 1} \\
p=-\left.\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \frac{\partial E_{s}}{\partial V} \rho_{N s}=\frac{1}{\Xi}\left\{\frac{1}{\beta} \frac{\partial}{\partial V}\left(\sum_{N} \sum_{s} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta\left(E_{s}-\mu N\right)}\right)\right\}\right|_{\beta, \beta \mu}=\frac{1}{\beta}\left(\frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial V}\right)_{\beta, \beta \mu} \\
S=k\left\{\ln \Xi-\beta \frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \beta}-\mu \frac{\partial \ln \Xi}{\partial \mu}\right\}=k \ln \Xi+\frac{\bar{E}}{T}-\frac{\bar{N} \mu}{T}
\end{gathered}$$
where the " $\pm$ " sign corresponds to the Fermi distribution with "+" and the Bose distribution with "-".

question: 在真空管中, 坦热的灯丝产生一个温度为 $T$ 、粒子数密度为 $n$ 的电子气体, 电子气经一截面为 $A$ 的小孔形成电子束, 进入一电势为 $U$ 的减速电场. 试求在单位时间内能穿过减速电场的电子数。
solution:
解 设小孔的线度小于电子气体的平均自由程, 因此, 可以认为电子气体始终处于平衡态. 在单位体积和单位速度间隔内, 速度为 $v$ 的电子数由麦克斯韦速度分布律给出
$$
f(v)=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}}
$$
其中, $n$ 为电子的数密度. 设减速电场沿 $x$ 方向, 则只有动能 $\frac{1}{2} m v_{x}^{2}>e U$ 的电子才能穿过电势为 $U$ 的减速电场. 令 $\frac{1}{2} m v_{x 0}^{2}=e U$, 则在单位时间内能穿过减速电场的电子数为
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d} N}{\mathrm{~d} t}=n A\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \int_{v_{x 0}}^{\infty} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{d} v_{y} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{d} v_{z} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}}=n A\left(\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{x 0}^{2}}{2 k T}}=\frac{1}{4} n \bar{v} A \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{e U}{k T}}
$$
其中, $\bar{v}=\sqrt{\frac{8 k T}{\pi m}}$ 是电子气体的平均速率.

question: In a vacuum tube, a heated filament generates an electron gas with a temperature of $T$ and a particle number density of $n$. The electron gas forms an electron beam through a small aperture with a cross-sectional area of $A$ and enters a decelerating electric field with a potential of $U$. Find the number of electrons that can pass through the decelerating electric field per unit time.
solution:
Solution: Assume the dimensions of the small hole are less than the mean free path of the electron gas, so the electron gas can be considered to be always in equilibrium. The number of electrons with velocity $v$ per unit volume and per unit velocity interval is given by the Maxwell velocity distribution law:

$$
f(v)=n\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}}
$$

where $n$ is the number density of electrons. Assume the decelerating electric field is along the $x$ direction, then only electrons with kinetic energy $\frac{1}{2} m v_{x}^{2}>e U$ can pass through the decelerating electric field with potential $U$. Let $\frac{1}{2} m v_{x 0}^{2}=e U$, then the number of electrons that can pass through the decelerating electric field per unit time is

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d} N}{\mathrm{~d} t}=n A\left(\frac{m}{2 \pi k T}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}} \int_{v_{x 0}}^{\infty} v_{x} \mathrm{~d} v_{x} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{d} v_{y} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \mathrm{d} v_{z} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v^{2}}{2 k T}}=n A\left(\frac{k T}{2 \pi m}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{m v_{x 0}^{2}}{2 k T}}=\frac{1}{4} n \bar{v} A \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{e U}{k T}}
$$

where $\bar{v}=\sqrt{\frac{8 k T}{\pi m}}$ is the average speed of the electron gas.

question: 在介质中静止的质量为 $m$ 的物体, 能从周围介质中吸取能量, 因而进入运动状态, 计算当它运动时所产生的熵变, 熵是增加还是减少?
solution: 解 把物体和周围介质组成一个孤立系. 周围介质与物体不断发生碰撞, 使物体进入运动状态. 平衡时, 质量为 $m$ 的物体具有平均动能 $$\overline{\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}}=\frac{3}{2} k T=\Delta U$$由于物体的体积没有变化, 物体吸收的热量 $\Delta Q=T \Delta S=\Delta U$, 因此, 物体的熵变 $$\Delta S=\frac{\Delta U}{T}=\frac{3}{2} k$$即物体的熵增加了 $\frac{3}{2} k$ 。讨论：当物体静止时，只有一种位置状态。当它受到周围介质的作用而开始运动后, 它可以处于空间的不同位置上, 物体的状态数增加了, 因此, 熵也增加了.

question: A mass $m$ object at rest in a medium can absorb energy from the surrounding medium and thus enter a state of motion. Calculate the change in entropy produced when it is in motion. Does the entropy increase or decrease?
solution:
Solution: Consider the object and the surrounding medium as an isolated system. The surrounding medium continuously collides with the object, putting it into motion. At equilibrium, the object with mass $m$ has an average kinetic energy $$\overline{\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}}=\frac{3}{2} k T=\Delta U.$$ Since the volume of the object does not change, the heat absorbed by the object $\Delta Q=T \Delta S=\Delta U$. Therefore, the change in entropy of the object is $$\Delta S=\frac{\Delta U}{T}=\frac{3}{2} k.$$ Thus, the entropy of the object increases by $\frac{3}{2} k$.

Discussion: When the object is at rest, it has only one positional state. When it starts moving due to the effect of the surrounding medium, it can occupy different positions in space, increasing the number of states of the object. Therefore, the entropy also increases.

question: 求均匀电场 $\boldsymbol{E}_{0}$ 的电势。
Find the electric potential of a uniform electric field $\boldsymbol{E}_{0}$.
一个内径和外径分别为 $R_{2}$ 和 $R_{3}$ 的导体球壳, 带电荷 $Q$, 同心地包围着一个半径为 $R_{1}$ 的导体球 $\left(R_{1}<R_{2}\right)$. 使这个导体球接地, 求空间各点的电势和这个导体球的感应电荷.
solution:
解 这问题有球对称性, 电势 $\varphi$ 不依赖于角度 $\theta$ 和 $\phi$, 因此可以只取 (3.3) 式的 $n=0$ 项. 设导体壳外和壳内的电势为
$$
\begin{gathered}
\varphi_{1}=a+\frac{b}{R} \quad\left(R>R_{3}\right) \\
\varphi_{2}=c+\frac{d}{R} \quad\left(R_{2}>R>R_{1}\right)
\end{gathered}$$

边界条件为：
(1) 因内导体球接地,故有

$$
\left.\varphi_{2}\right|_{R=R_{1}}=\left.\varphi_{1}\right|_{R \rightarrow \infty}=0
$$

（2）因整个导体球壳为等势体，故有

$$
\left.\varphi_{2}\right|_{R=R_{2}}=\left.\varphi_{1}\right|_{R=R_{2}}
$$

（3）球壳带总电荷 $Q$ ，因而

$$
-\oint_{R=R_{3}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{1}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega+\oint_{R=R_{2}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{2}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega=\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_{0}}
$$

把（3.4）式代入这些边界条件中，得

$$
\begin{gathered}
a=0, \quad c+\frac{d}{R_{1}}=0 \\
c+\frac{d}{R_{2}}=\frac{b}{R_{3}}, \quad b-d=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}
\end{gathered}$$

由此解出

$$
\begin{gathered}
d=\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}, \quad b=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}+\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \\
c=-\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1}}
\end{gathered}$$

其中

$$
Q_{1}=-\frac{R_{3}^{-1}}{R_{1}^{-1}-R_{2}^{-1}+R_{3}^{-1}} Q
$$

把这些值代入（3.4）式中，得电势的解

$$
\begin{gathered}
\varphi_{1}=\frac{Q+Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R} \quad\left(R>R_{3}\right) \\
\varphi_{2}=\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}\left(\frac{1}{R}-\frac{1}{R_{1}\right)} \quad\left(R_{2}>R>R_{1}\right)
\end{gathered}$$

导体球上的感应电荷为

$$
-\varepsilon_{0} \int_{R=R_{1}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{2}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega=Q_{1}
$$

question: A conductor spherical shell with an inner diameter and outer diameter of $R_{2}$ and $R_{3}$, respectively, carries a charge $Q$ and concentrically surrounds a conductor sphere with a radius of $R_{1}$ $\left(R_{1}<R_{2}\right)$. Ground this conductor sphere and find the electric potential at various points in space and the induced charge on this conductor sphere.
solution:
Solution: This problem has spherical symmetry, and the potential $\varphi$ does not depend on the angles $\theta$ and $\phi$, so only the $n=0$ term of equation (3.3) needs to be considered. Let the potential outside and inside the conducting shell be

$$
\begin{gathered}
\varphi_{1}=a+\frac{b}{R} \quad\left(R>R_{3}\right) \\
\varphi_{2}=c+\frac{d}{R} \quad\left(R_{2}>R>R_{1}\right)
\end{gathered}
$$

The boundary conditions are:
(1) Since the inner conducting sphere is grounded, we have

$$
\left.\varphi_{2}\right|_{R=R_{1}}=\left.\varphi_{1}\right|_{R \rightarrow \infty}=0
$$

(2) Since the entire conducting spherical shell is an equipotential body, we have

$$
\left.\varphi_{2}\right|_{R=R_{2}}=\left.\varphi_{1}\right|_{R=R_{2}}
$$

(3) The spherical shell carries a total charge $Q$, therefore

$$
-\oint_{R=R_{3}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{1}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega+\oint_{R=R_{2}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{2}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega=\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_{0}}
$$

Substituting equation (3.4) into these boundary conditions, we obtain

$$
\begin{gathered}
a=0, \quad c+\frac{d}{R_{1}}=0 \\
c+\frac{d}{R_{2}}=\frac{b}{R_{3}}, \quad b-d=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}
\end{gathered}
$$

From this, we solve

$$
\begin{gathered}
d=\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}, \quad b=\frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}}+\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \\
c=-\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1}}
\end{gathered}
$$

where

$$
Q_{1}=-\frac{R_{3}^{-1}}{R_{1}^{-1}-R_{2}^{-1}+R_{3}^{-1}} Q
$$

Substituting these values into equation (3.4), we get the solution for the potential

$$
\begin{gathered}
\varphi_{1}=\frac{Q+Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R} \quad\left(R>R_{3}\right) \\
\varphi_{2}=\frac{Q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}\left(\frac{1}{R}-\frac{1}{R_{1}\right)} \quad\left(R_{2}>R>R_{1}\right)
\end{gathered}
$$

The induced charge on the conducting sphere is

$$
-\varepsilon_{0} \int_{R=R_{1}} \frac{\partial \varphi_{2}}{\partial R} R^{2} \mathrm{~d} \Omega=Q_{1}
$$

question: 半径为 $a$ 的无限长圆柱导体上有恒定电流 $\boldsymbol{J}$ 均匀分布于截面上, 试解矢势 $\boldsymbol{A}$ 的微分方程，设导体的磁导率为 $\mu_{0}$ ，导体外的磁导率为 $\mu$ 。
solution:
解: $$ \boldsymbol{A}_{\theta_{1}}=\frac{1}{4} \mu_{0} \boldsymbol{J}\left(a^{2}-r^{2}\right) $$
$$ \boldsymbol{A}_{\theta_{2}}=\frac{\mu a^{2}}{2} \boldsymbol{J} \ln \frac{a}{r} $$

question: An infinite cylindrical conductor with a radius of $a$ has a constant current $\boldsymbol{J}$ uniformly distributed over its cross-section. Solve the differential equation for the vector potential $\boldsymbol{A}$, assuming the permeability of the conductor is $\mu_{0}$ and the permeability outside the conductor is $\mu$.
solution:
Solution: $$ \boldsymbol{A}_{\theta_{1}}=\frac{1}{4} \mu_{0} \boldsymbol{J}\left(a^{2}-r^{2}\right) $$
$$ \boldsymbol{A}_{\theta_{2}}=\frac{\mu a^{2}}{2} \boldsymbol{J} \ln \frac{a}{r} $$.

question:
考虑两列振幅相同、偏振方向相同、频率分别为 $\omega+\mathrm{d} \omega$ 和 $\omega-\mathrm{d} \omega$ 的线偏振平面波，它们都沿 $z$ 轴方向传播。
(1) 求合成波，证明波的振幅不是常数，而是一个波；
(2) 求合成波的相位传播速度和振幅传播速度。
solution:
答案：
(1) $\boldsymbol{A}=\boldsymbol{A}_{0} \cdot 2 \cos \left(\mathrm{~d} k \cdot z-\mathrm{d} \omega \cdot t\right) \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}(\boldsymbol{k} t-\omega)}$。
(2) 相速 $v_{o}=\omega / k$ ，群速 $v_{k}=\mathrm{d} \omega / \mathrm{d} k$。

The answer is:  
(1) $\boldsymbol{A}=\boldsymbol{A}_{0} \cdot 2 \cos \left(\mathrm{~d} k \cdot z-\mathrm{d} \omega \cdot t\right) \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}(\boldsymbol{k} t-\omega)}$.  
(2) Phase velocity $v_{o}=\omega / k$, group velocity $v_{k}=\mathrm{d} \omega / \mathrm{d} k$.

question: 有一可见平面光波由水入射到空气，入射角为 $60^{\circ}$ 。证明这时将会发生全反射，并求折射波沿表面传播的相速度和透入空气的深度。设该波在空气中的波长为 $\lambda_{0}=6.28 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ ，水的折射率为 $n=1.33$ 。
solution: 答案: $v_{p}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} c$ ，穿透深度 $\kappa^{-1}=1.7 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 。

question: A visible plane light wave is incident from water into air, with an incident angle of $60^{\circ}$. Prove that total internal reflection will occur, and calculate the phase velocity of the refracted wave along the surface and the penetration depth into the air. Assume the wavelength of the wave in air is $\lambda_{0}=6.28 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$, and the refractive index of water is $n=1.33$.
solution: The answer is: $v_{p}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} c$, penetration depth $\kappa^{-1}=1.7 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$.

question: 一对无限大的平行理想导体板, 相距为 $b$, 电磁波沿平行于板面的 $z$ 方向传播, 设波在 $x$ 方向是均匀的, 求可能传播的波模和每种波模的截止频率.
solution:
答案:
$$
\begin{gathered}
E_{x}=A_{1} \sin \left(\frac{n \pi}{b} y\right) \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{x} x-\omega t)} \\
E_{y}=A_{2} \cos \left(\frac{n \pi}{b} y\right) \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{y} x-\omega t)} \\
E_{x}=A_{3} \sin \left(\frac{n \pi}{b} y\right) \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i} k_{x} x-\omega t)} \\
k_{x}^{2}=\frac{\omega^{2}}{c^{2}}-\left(\frac{n \pi}{b}\right)^{2} \\
\frac{n \pi}{b} A_{3}=\mathrm{i} k_{x} A_{3}, \quad A_{1} \text { 独立 } \\
\text { 截止频率 } \omega_{c}=\frac{n \pi c}{b}
\end{gathered}
$$

question: Two infinitely large parallel ideal conductor plates are separated by a distance of $b$. An electromagnetic wave propagates in the $z$ direction parallel to the plates. Assume the wave is uniform in the $x$ direction. Find the possible propagating wave modes and the cutoff frequency for each wave mode.
静止长度为 $l_{0}$ 的车厢，以速度 $v$ 相对于地面运行，车厢的后壁以速度 $u_{0}$ 向前推出一个小球，求地面观察者看到小球从后壁到前壁的运动时间。
solution: 答案: $\Delta t=\frac{l_{0}\left(1+\frac{u_{0} v}{c^{2}}\right)}{u_{0} \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}$

question: The translation you requested is: A carriage with a rest length of $l_{0}$ is moving at a speed $v$ relative to the ground. The rear wall of the carriage pushes a small ball forward at a speed $u_{0}$. Find the time it takes for an observer on the ground to see the ball move from the rear wall to the front wall.
solution: The answer is: $\Delta t=\frac{l_{0}\left(1+\frac{u_{0} v}{c^{2}}\right)}{u_{0} \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}$.

question: 一辆以速度 $v$ 运动的列车上的观察者，在经过某一高大建筑物时，看见其避雷针上跳起一脉冲电火花，电光迅速传播，先后照亮了铁路沿线上的两铁塔。求列车上观察者看到的两铁塔被电光照亮的时刻差。设建筑物及两铁塔都在一直线上，与列车前进方向一致。铁塔到建筑物的地面距离已知都是 $l_{0}$ 。
solution: 答案: $\Delta t=\frac{2 v l_{0}}{c^{2} \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}$

question: An observer on a train moving at a speed $v$ sees a pulse of electric spark jump from the lightning rod of a tall building as the train passes by. The light quickly spreads and illuminates two towers along the railway line one after the other. Find the time difference observed from the train for the two towers being illuminated by the light. Assume that the building and the two towers are all on a straight line, aligned with the train's direction of travel. The ground distance from the towers to the building is known to be $l_{0}$.
solution: The answer is: $\Delta t=\frac{2 v l_{0}}{c^{2} \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}$.

question: 在参考系 $\Sigma$ 中, 有两个物体都以速度 $u$ 沿 $x$ 轴运动, 在 $\Sigma$ 系看来, 它们一直保持距离 $l$不变. 今有一观察者以速度 $v$ 沿 $x$ 轴运动, 他看到这两个物体的距离是多少?
solution: 答案: $l^{\prime}=\frac{l \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}{1-\frac{u v}{c^{2}}}$

question: In the reference frame $\Sigma$, there are two objects both moving with velocity $u$ along the $x$-axis. In the $\Sigma$ frame, they maintain a constant distance $l$. Now, an observer is moving with velocity $v$ along the $x$-axis. What is the distance between these two objects as observed by him?
solution: Answer: $l^{\prime}=\frac{l \sqrt{1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}}}{1-\frac{u v}{c^{2}}}$.

question: 试用位力定理推导理想气体的压强方程。
solution: 解: 对于理想气体，只需考虑容器壁对气体的压力的位力。总的均位力积是 $$ -\frac{1}{2}\left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \boldsymbol{F}_{i} \cdot \boldsymbol{r}_{i}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} p V $$ 由位力定理式（7.3.4），得 $$ \left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{2} m_{i} v_{i}^{2}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} p V $$ 化简后得 $$ p=\frac{2}{3} \frac{1}{V}\left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{2} m_{i} v_{i}^{2}\right\rangle $$ 再结合每个气体分子的平均动能与绝对温度 $T$ 的关系 $$ \left\langle\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} k T $$ 化简后得 $$ p=\frac{n k}{V} T $$ 这正是理想气体的物态方程 $p V=n k T$ 。

question: Use the virial theorem to derive the pressure equation of an ideal gas.
solution: Solution: For an ideal gas, only the potential energy due to the pressure of the container walls on the gas needs to be considered. The total mean potential energy is $$ -\frac{1}{2}\left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \boldsymbol{F}_{i} \cdot \boldsymbol{r}_{i}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} p V $$. According to the virial theorem equation (7.3.4), we have $$ \left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{2} m_{i} v_{i}^{2}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} p V $$. Simplifying this gives $$ p=\frac{2}{3} \frac{1}{V}\left\langle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{2} m_{i} v_{i}^{2}\right\rangle $$. Combining this with the relationship between the average kinetic energy of each gas molecule and the absolute temperature $T$, $$ \left\langle\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}\right\rangle=\frac{3}{2} k T $$. Simplifying further gives $$ p=\frac{n k}{V} T $$, which is precisely the equation of state for an ideal gas, $p V=n k T$.

question:
求平方反比的有心吸引力作用下的质点作周期运动的频率，这问题的哈密顿函数是
$$H=\frac{1}{2 m}\left(p_{\rho}^{2}+\frac{1}{\rho^{2}} p_{\varphi}^{2}\right)-\frac{m k^{2}}{\rho}$$
solution:
解：本例的哈密顿特征函数 $W$ 由 $\S 9.2$ 例 2 的式（6）给出，
$$W=C_{2} \varphi+\int \sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}} \mathrm{~d} \rho$$
先计算广义动量 $p_{\varphi}$ 和 $p_{\rho}$ 。
$$\left\{\begin{array}{l}p_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}=C_{2} \\ p_{\rho}=\frac{\partial W}{\partial \rho}=\sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}}\end{array}\right.$$接着计算作用量
$$\begin{gathered}J_{\varphi}=\oint p_{\varphi} \mathrm{d} \varphi=C_{2} \oint \mathrm{~d} \varphi=2 \pi C_{2} \\ J_{\rho}=\oint p_{\rho} \mathrm{d} \rho=\oint \sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}} \mathrm{~d} \rho\end{gathered}$$
$E=0$ 和 $E>0$ 分别对应于抛物线轨道和双曲线轨道，它们都不是周期运动，这里不予考虑。我们只考虑 $E<0$ 的椭圆轨道。式（3）的被积函数必须是实的，在 $E<0$ 的情况下，这意味着
$$\rho_{1}<\rho<\rho_{2}$$
这里 $\rho_{1}$ 和 $\rho_{2}$ 是 $2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}=0$ 的两个根，
$$\left\{\begin{array}{l}\rho_{1}=\frac{m k^{2}}{2|E|}-\frac{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}{2|E|} \\ \rho_{2}=\frac{m k^{2}}{2|E|}+\frac{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}{2|E|}\end{array}\right.$$于是
$$\begin{aligned}J_{\rho}= & 2 \int_{\rho_{1}}^{\rho_{2}} \frac{1}{\rho} \sqrt{2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}} \mathrm{~d} \rho \\= & 2\left[\sqrt{2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}}\right. \\& \left.+\frac{m^{2} k^{2}}{\sqrt{2 m|E|}} \arcsin \left(\frac{2|E| \rho-m k^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}\right)\right. \\& \left.-C_{2} \arcsin \left(\frac{m k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2} / m}{\rho \sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}\right)\right]_{\rho_{1}}^{\rho_{2}} \\= & 2\left[0+\frac{m^{2} k^{2}}{\sqrt{2 m|E|}} \pi-C_{2} \pi\right] \\= & -2 \pi C_{2}+\pi m k^{2} \sqrt{\frac{2 m}{|E|}}\end{aligned}$$
为了应用 (9.3.7) 求出频率, 需要用 $J_{\varphi}$ 和 $J_{\rho}$ 表出 $E$. 为此, 从式 (2) 和式 (6) 消去 $C_{2}$并稍加整理, 得
$$E=-\frac{2 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{2}}$$
于是, 应用 (9.3.7) 求得 $\rho$ 和 $\varphi$ 的变化频率 $f_{\rho}$ 和 $f_{\varphi}$, 即
$$f_{\rho}=\frac{\partial E}{\partial J_{\rho}}=\frac{4 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{3}}, \quad f_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial E}{\partial J_{\varphi}}=\frac{4 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{3}}$$
如果用能量 $E$ 来表示, 则
$$f_{\rho}=f_{\varphi}=\frac{1}{\pi k^{2}} \sqrt{-\frac{2 E^{3}}{m^{3}}}$$
频率 $f_{\rho}$ 和 $f_{\varphi}$ 相等, 这表明轨道在空间中是稳定不变的.

question: The frequency of periodic motion of a particle under a central attractive force with an inverse square law is sought. The Hamiltonian function for this problem is $$H=\frac{1}{2 m}\left(p_{\rho}^{2}+\frac{1}{\rho^{2}} p_{\varphi}^{2}\right)-\frac{m k^{2}}{\rho}$$.
solution:
Solution: The Hamilton characteristic function $W$ in this example is given by equation (6) from Example 2 in §9.2,

$$W=C_{2} \varphi+\int \sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}} \mathrm{~d} \rho$$

First, calculate the generalized momenta $p_{\varphi}$ and $p_{\rho}$.

$$\left\{\begin{array}{l}p_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial W}{\partial \varphi}=C_{2} \\ p_{\rho}=\frac{\partial W}{\partial \rho}=\sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}}\end{array}\right.$$

Next, calculate the action

$$\begin{gathered}J_{\varphi}=\oint p_{\varphi} \mathrm{d} \varphi=C_{2} \oint \mathrm{~d} \varphi=2 \pi C_{2} \\ J_{\rho}=\oint p_{\rho} \mathrm{d} \rho=\oint \sqrt{2 m E+\frac{2 m^{2} k^{2}}{\rho}-\frac{C_{2}^{2}}{\rho^{2}}} \mathrm{~d} \rho\end{gathered}$$

$E=0$ and $E>0$ correspond to parabolic and hyperbolic orbits, respectively, neither of which are periodic, and thus are not considered here. We only consider elliptical orbits with $E<0$. The integrand in equation (3) must be real, which implies for $E<0$ that

$$\rho_{1}<\rho<\rho_{2}$$

where $\rho_{1}$ and $\rho_{2}$ are the two roots of $2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}=0$,

$$\left\{\begin{array}{l}\rho_{1}=\frac{m k^{2}}{2|E|}-\frac{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}{2|E|} \\ \rho_{2}=\frac{m k^{2}}{2|E|}+\frac{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}{2|E|}\end{array}\right.$$

Thus,

$$\begin{aligned}J_{\rho}= & 2 \int_{\rho_{1}}^{\rho_{2}} \frac{1}{\rho} \sqrt{2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}} \mathrm{~d} \rho \\= & 2\left[\sqrt{2 m E \rho^{2}+2 m^{2} k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2}}\right. \\& \left.+\frac{m^{2} k^{2}}{\sqrt{2 m|E|}} \arcsin \left(\frac{2|E| \rho-m k^{2}}{\sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}\right)\right. \\& \left.-C_{2} \arcsin \left(\frac{m k^{2} \rho-C_{2}^{2} / m}{\rho \sqrt{m^{2} k^{4}-2|E| C_{2}^{2} / m}}\right)\right]_{\rho_{1}}^{\rho_{2}} \\= & 2\left[0+\frac{m^{2} k^{2}}{\sqrt{2 m|E|}} \pi-C_{2} \pi\right] \\= & -2 \pi C_{2}+\pi m k^{2} \sqrt{\frac{2 m}{|E|}}\end{aligned}$$

To apply (9.3.7) and find the frequency, $E$ needs to be expressed in terms of $J_{\varphi}$ and $J_{\rho}$. By eliminating $C_{2}$ from equations (2) and (6) and rearranging, we obtain

$$E=-\frac{2 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{2}}$$

Thus, applying (9.3.7), we find the frequencies of variation for $\rho$ and $\varphi$, $f_{\rho}$ and $f_{\varphi}$, respectively,

$$f_{\rho}=\frac{\partial E}{\partial J_{\rho}}=\frac{4 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{3}}, \quad f_{\varphi}=\frac{\partial E}{\partial J_{\varphi}}=\frac{4 \pi^{2} m^{3} k^{4}}{\left(J_{\rho}+J_{\varphi}\right)^{3}}$$

If expressed in terms of energy $E$, then

$$f_{\rho}=f_{\varphi}=\frac{1}{\pi k^{2}} \sqrt{-\frac{2 E^{3}}{m^{3}}}$$

The frequencies $f_{\rho}$ and $f_{\varphi}$ are equal, indicating that the orbit is stable and invariant in space.

question: 例求得扭转的圆杆中的胁变张量 $e_{11}=0, e_{22}=0, e_{33}=0, e_{12}=e_{21}=0, e_{13}=e_{31}=-\frac{\theta y}{2 l}, e_{23}=e_{32}=\frac{\theta x}{2 l}$, 式中 $\theta$ 是杆的扭转角, $l$ 是杆长, 坐标系的原点在上端面的中心, $z$ 轴从上端面中心指向下端面的中心. 试计算扭转的圆杆中的胁强张量.
solution:
解 应用式 (11.6.12), 容易求得
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
p_{11}=0, p_{22}=0, p_{33}=0 \\
p_{12}=p_{21}=0 \\
p_{13}=p_{31}=-\frac{n \theta}{l} y \\
p_{23}=p_{32}=\frac{n \theta}{l} x
\end{array}\right.
$$
这就是说，圆杆扭转时，在横截面上和轴上都没有张胁强，在横截面上没有切胁强，至于横截面与横截面之间则是有切胁强的.

question: To find the strain tensor in a twisted circular rod, we have $e_{11}=0, e_{22}=0, e_{33}=0, e_{12}=e_{21}=0, e_{13}=e_{31}=-\frac{\theta y}{2 l}, e_{23}=e_{32}=\frac{\theta x}{2 l}$, where $\theta$ is the twist angle of the rod, $l$ is the length of the rod, and the origin of the coordinate system is at the center of the upper end face, with the $z$-axis pointing from the center of the upper end face to the center of the lower end face. Try to calculate the stress tensor in the twisted circular rod.
solution:
By solving Application (11.6.12), it is easy to obtain

$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
p_{11}=0, p_{22}=0, p_{33}=0 \\
p_{12}=p_{21}=0 \\
p_{13}=p_{31}=-\frac{n \theta}{l} y \\
p_{23}=p_{32}=\frac{n \theta}{l} x
\end{array}\right.
$$

This means that when the circular rod is twisted, there is no normal stress on the cross-section and along the axis, and there is no shear stress on the cross-section. However, there is shear stress between the cross-sections.
