question: In a uniform gravity field, a particle of mass $m$ moves without friction on the inner surface of a paraboloid of revolution $x^{2}+y^{2}=a z$. Find the motion equations.
solution:
Proof The system has three degrees of freedom, $n=3$. The system configuration and axial symmetry with respect to the $Z$ axis lead to the choice of cylindrical coordinates $(\rho, \varphi, z)$ as generalized coordinates (Fig. 1.2). The system is subject to
 
 Fig. 1.2 Particle inside a paraboloid
 ![img-3.jpeg](images/img-3.jpeg)
 
 one constraint $(c=1)$ : the mass point $m$ must move on the inner surface of the paraboloid of equation $x^{2}+y^{2}=a z$ in Cartesian coordinates or, as $\rho^{2}=x^{2}+y^{2}$
 
 $$
 \rho^{2}=a z
 $$
 
 in cylindrical coordinates. Differentiating (1.24) yields
 
 $$
 2 \varrho \delta \varrho-a \delta z=0
 $$
 
 which, from (1.11), gives $C_{1, \rho}=2 \rho, C_{1, \varphi}=0, C_{1, z}=-a$ et $C_{1, t}=0$.
 The kinetic energy, potential and Lagrangian read respectively
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & T=\frac{m}{2}\left(\dot{\rho}^{2}+\rho^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right) \\
 & V=m g z \\
 & L=\frac{m}{2}\left(\dot{\rho}^{2}+\rho^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)-m g z
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Lagrange equations (1.13) are then written
 
 $$
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}_{\alpha}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial q_{\alpha}}=\lambda_{1} C_{1, \alpha}
 $$
 
 For $q_{\alpha}=\rho$,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\rho}} & =m \dot{\rho} \\
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\rho}}\right) & =m \ddot{\rho} \\
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \varrho} & =m \rho \dot{\varphi}^{2}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 yielding
 
 $$
 m \ddot{\rho}-m \rho \dot{\varphi}^{2}=2 \rho \lambda_{1}
 $$
 
 For $q_{\alpha}=\varphi$,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}} & =m \rho^{2} \dot{\varphi} \\
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}}\right) & =m \rho^{2} \ddot{\varphi}+2 m \rho \dot{\rho} \dot{\varphi} \\
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \varphi} & =0
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 yielding
 
 $$
 m \rho^{2} \ddot{\varphi}+2 m \rho \dot{\rho} \dot{\varphi}=0
 $$
 
 For $q_{\alpha}=z$,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}} & =m \dot{z} \\
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}}\right) & =m \ddot{z} \\
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \varphi} & =-m g
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 yielding
 
 $$
 m \ddot{z}+m g=-a \lambda_{1}
 $$
 
 To these three Lagrange equations with four variables, one adds the constraint equation (1.24) derived with respect to time
 
 $$
 2 \rho \dot{\rho}-a \dot{z}=0
 $$
 
 This gives four equations in $\rho, \varphi, z$ et $\lambda_{1}$.

question: 在均匀重力场中，质量为 $m$ 的粒子在旋转抛物面的内表面上无摩擦地运动，旋转抛物面的方程为 $x^{2}+y^{2}=a z$。求运动方程。
solution:
证明该系统具有三个自由度，$n=3$。系统的构型和相对于$Z$轴的轴对称性导致选择圆柱坐标$(\rho, \varphi, z)$作为广义坐标（图1.2）。系统受到一个约束$(c=1)$：质点$m$必须在抛物面内表面上运动，其方程在笛卡尔坐标系中为$x^{2}+y^{2}=a z$，或者在圆柱坐标系中为$\rho^{2}=x^{2}+y^{2}$

$$
\rho^{2}=a z
$$

对(1.24)进行微分得到

$$
2 \varrho \delta \varrho-a \delta z=0
$$

由此，从(1.11)得出$C_{1, \rho}=2 \rho, C_{1, \varphi}=0, C_{1, z}=-a$和$C_{1, t}=0$。
动能、势能和拉格朗日函数分别为

$$
\begin{aligned}
& T=\frac{m}{2}\left(\dot{\rho}^{2}+\rho^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right) \\
& V=m g z \\
& L=\frac{m}{2}\left(\dot{\rho}^{2}+\rho^{2} \dot{\varphi}^{2}+\dot{z}^{2}\right)-m g z
\end{aligned}
$$

拉格朗日方程(1.13)写为

$$
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}_{\alpha}}\right)-\frac{\partial L}{\partial q_{\alpha}}=\lambda_{1} C_{1, \alpha}
$$

对于$q_{\alpha}=\rho$，

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\rho}} & =m \dot{\rho} \\
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\rho}}\right) & =m \ddot{\rho} \\
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \varrho} & =m \rho \dot{\varphi}^{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

得到

$$
m \ddot{\rho}-m \rho \dot{\varphi}^{2}=2 \rho \lambda_{1}
$$

对于$q_{\alpha}=\varphi$，

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}} & =m \rho^{2} \dot{\varphi} \\
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\varphi}}\right) & =m \rho^{2} \ddot{\varphi}+2 m \rho \dot{\rho} \dot{\varphi} \\
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \varphi} & =0
\end{aligned}
$$

得到

$$
m \rho^{2} \ddot{\varphi}+2 m \rho \dot{\rho} \dot{\varphi}=0
$$

对于$q_{\alpha}=z$，

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}} & =m \dot{z} \\
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{z}}\right) & =m \ddot{z} \\
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \varphi} & =-m g
\end{aligned}
$$

得到

$$
m \ddot{z}+m g=-a \lambda_{1}
$$

对于这三个含有四个变量的拉格朗日方程，添加相对于时间的约束方程(1.24)的导数

$$
2 \rho \dot{\rho}-a \dot{z}=0
$$

这给出关于$\rho, \varphi, z$和$\lambda_{1}$的四个方程。

question:
A truck with four identical wheels runs down a slope freewheeling, i.e. with the motor disengaged, without braking or slipping. Each wheel is considered to be a homogeneous disc of radius $r$ and mass $m$. The rest of the truck, i.e. wheels not included, has a mass $M$. To a point $A$ of the truck is suspended an object of non-negligible mass $m^{\prime}$, and of moment of inertia $I$ with respect to a horizontal axis perpendicular to the velocity of $A$ and passing through $A$. All considered movements are frictionless and parallel to the plane of the Figure.
 (1) Give the Lagrange equations of the system.
 (2) Give a first integral of the system.
 (3) Show that the system can take, for appropriate initial conditions, a movement in which the inclination of the object of mass $m^{\prime}$ and the truck acceleration remain both constant.
 (4) Calculate this angle of inclination in case 3 and show that it is not zero or equal to a right angle if the road followed by the truck is neither horizontal nor vertical.
 (5) Show that, if the wheel mass can be neglected, the angle of inclination in case 3 can be equal to the slope inclination.
solution:
Proof (1) Let $\gamma$ be the slope angle with the horizontal, and $l$ the distance from the centre of inertia $G$ of the object of mass $m^{\prime}$ to the suspension point $A$ (Fig. 1.4).
 
 The system has two degrees of freedom $(n=2)$ : the linear displacement of the truck and the oscillation of the suspended object. Given the system configuration, one chooses as generalized coordinates $x$, the abscissa $C$ of the hub of a rear wheel along an axis parallel to the slope and counted from a point $O$ of reference, and $\theta$, the angle made by $A G$ with the downward vertical.
 
 The kinetic energy consists of three terms: the first for the rotational movement of the four wheels of the truck, the second for the linear displacement of the truck and the third for the oscillation movement of the suspended object, i.e.
 
 Fig. 1.4 Truck descending a slope
 ![img-5.jpeg](images/img-5.jpeg)
 
 $$
 T=T_{4 \text { wheels }}+T_{\text {truck }}+T_{\text {object }}
 $$
 
 The kinetic energy of the four wheels is obviously four times the kinetic energy of a wheel, which consists of two terms: the first due to the inertia of the wheel in its rotation movement around the hub and the second due to the linear displacement of the wheel (more precisely, the linear displacement of the centre of mass of the wheel supposed to be in the middle of the wheel), i. e.
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 T_{4 \text { wheels }} & =4 T_{1 \text { wheel }} \\
 & =4\left(\frac{I_{\text {wheel }} \dot{\omega}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right)
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 where $\dot{\omega}$ is the instantaneous angular velocity of the wheel rotation and $I_{\text {wheel }}$ is the moment of inertia with respect to the centre of the wheel considered as a homogeneous disc of radius $r$ and mass $m$, i.e. $I_{\text {wheel }}=\frac{m r^{2}}{2}$. It then comes from (1.45)
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 T_{4 \text { wheels }} & =4\left(\frac{m r^{2} \dot{\omega}^{2}}{4}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right) \\
 & =4\left(\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right) \\
 & =3 m \dot{x}^{2}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 where one used in (1.46) the fact that $\dot{x}=r \dot{\omega}$, which is the condition of rolling without slipping.
 
 The truck's kinetic energy is simply
 
 $$
 T_{\text {truck }}=\frac{M \dot{x}^{2}}{2}
 $$
 
 and the kinetic energy of the suspended object also comprises two terms: the first due to the inertia of the object in its oscillation movement and the second due to the linear displacement of the centre of inertia of the object, i.e.
 
 $$
 T_{\text {object }}=\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime} v_{\text {object }}^{2}}{2}
 $$
 
 The velocity $v_{\text {object }}$ of the object is that of the object's centre of mass which can be assumed to be identical to the centre of inertia $G$ of the object. It is found by deriving with respect to time the coordinate along the $X$ axis of the $G$ point, i.e.
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 v_{\text {object }}=\frac{d x_{O G}}{d t} & =\frac{d}{d t}\left(x_{O C}+x_{C A}+x_{A G}\right) \\
 & =\frac{d}{d t}\left(x+x_{C A}+l \sin (\theta+\gamma)\right) \\
 & =\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 where the distance $x_{C A}$ between the rear wheel hub and the suspension point of the object is assumed to be constant. It then comes from (1.50) with (1.53)
 
 $$
 T_{\text {objet }}=\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime}}{2}(\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma))^{2}
 $$
 
 which gives for total kinetic energy (1.43)
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 T & =3 m \dot{x}^{2}+\frac{M \dot{x}^{2}}{2}+\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime}}{2}(\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma))^{2} \\
 & =\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 The potential has also three terms and is written
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 V & =\left(V_{4 \text { wheels }}+V_{\text {track }}\right)+V_{\text {object }} \\
 & =-(4 m+M) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g(x \sin \gamma+l \cos \theta) \\
 & =-\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 The Lagrangian reads then
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 L= & \left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
 & +\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma+m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 For the generalized coordinate $x$, we find
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}} & =\left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \dot{x}+m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \\
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}}\right) & =\left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \ddot{x}+m^{\prime} l \ddot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta}^{2} \sin (\theta+\gamma) \\
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial x} & =\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g \sin \gamma
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Lagrange's first equation reads
 
 $$
 \left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \ddot{x}+m^{\prime} l \ddot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta}^{2} \sin (\theta+\gamma)-\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g \sin \gamma=0
 $$
 
 For the generalized coordinate $\theta$, we find
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}= & m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+\dot{\theta}^{2} m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \dot{\theta} \\
 \frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}\right)= & m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \sin (\theta+\gamma) \\
 & +\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta}-2 m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
 \frac{\partial L}{\partial \theta}= & -m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \sin (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Lagrange's second equation reads
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta} \\
 & -m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2}+m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta=0
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 (2) A first integral of the movement is given by $T+V=E$ where $E$ is a constant, the total energy of the system as there is no friction or other energy losses, which yields
 
 $$
 \begin{gathered}
 \left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
 -\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta=E
 \end{gathered}
 $$
 
 (3) For $\theta$ constant, i.e. $\dot{\theta}=\ddot{\theta}=0$, Lagrange's first equation (1.64) yields
 
 $$
 \ddot{x}=\left(\frac{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right) g \sin \gamma
 $$
 
 The acceleration of the truck and the inclination of the object can therefore be constant together.
 (4) In this case 3, Lagrange's second equation reduces to
 
 $$
 \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+g \sin \theta=0
 $$
 
 By replacing $\ddot{x}$ by (1.73), one obtains
 
 $$
 \left(\frac{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right) \sin \gamma \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\sin \theta=0
 $$
 
 or
 
 $$
 \theta=\arctan \left(\frac{\sin \gamma \cos \gamma}{\sin ^{2} \gamma-\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right)}\right)
 $$
 
 As the road taken by the truck is neither horizontal nor vertical, i.e. $0<\gamma<\frac{\pi}{2}, \theta$ can't be nil or equal to $\frac{\pi}{2}$.
 (5) If the wheels have a negligible mass in front of those of the truck and the suspended object, i.e. $m \ll M+m^{\prime}$, we have from (1.76)
 
 $$
 \tan \theta \approx \frac{\sin \gamma \cos \gamma}{\sin ^{2} \gamma-1}=-\tan \gamma
 $$
 
 and $\theta \approx-\gamma$. The inclination of the object can therefore be (almost) equal to the slope.
answer: m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta} -m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2}+m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta=0

\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} -\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta=E

question:
一辆装有四个相同车轮的卡车在斜坡上自由滑行，即发动机脱开，不刹车也不打滑。每个车轮被视为半径为 $r$、质量为 $m$ 的均匀圆盘。卡车的其余部分，即不包括车轮，具有质量 $M$。在卡车的某一点 $A$ 悬挂着一个具有不可忽略质量 $m^{\prime}$ 的物体，其相对于一个水平轴的转动惯量为 $I$，该水平轴垂直于 $A$ 的速度并通过 $A$。所有考虑的运动都是无摩擦的，并且与图中的平面平行。
(1) 给出系统的拉格朗日方程。
(2) 给出系统的一个第一积分。
(3) 证明在适当的初始条件下，系统可以进行一种运动，其中质量为 $m^{\prime}$ 的物体的倾角和卡车的加速度都保持不变。
(4) 计算情形3中的这个倾角，并证明如果卡车行驶的道路既不是水平也不是垂直的，则这个角度既不为零也不等于直角。
(5) 证明如果可以忽略车轮的质量，则在情形3中的倾角可以等于斜坡的倾角。
solution:
证明 (1) 设 $\gamma$ 为与水平面的倾斜角，$l$ 为从质量为 $m^{\prime}$ 的物体的重心 $G$ 到悬挂点 $A$ 的距离（图1.4）。

该系统有两个自由度 $(n=2)$：卡车的线性位移和悬挂物体的振荡。根据系统配置，选择广义坐标 $x$，即后轮轮毂沿平行于斜坡的轴线的横坐标 $C$，从参考点 $O$ 开始计算，以及 $\theta$，即 $A G$ 与向下垂直方向形成的角度。

动能由三部分组成：第一部分是卡车四个车轮的旋转运动，第二部分是卡车的线性位移，第三部分是悬挂物体的振荡运动，即

图1.4 卡车下坡

$$
T=T_{4 \text { wheels }}+T_{\text {truck }}+T_{\text {object }}
$$

四个车轮的动能显然是一个车轮动能的四倍，后者由两个部分组成：第一部分是由于轮子绕轮毂旋转运动的惯性，第二部分是由于轮子的线性位移（更确切地说，是假设在轮子中间的轮子重心的线性位移），即

$$
\begin{aligned}
T_{4 \text { wheels }} & =4 T_{1 \text { wheel }} \\
& =4\left(\frac{I_{\text {wheel }} \dot{\omega}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

其中 $\dot{\omega}$ 是轮子旋转的瞬时角速度，$I_{\text {wheel }}$ 是相对于轮子中心的惯性矩，考虑为半径为 $r$、质量为 $m$ 的均匀圆盘，即 $I_{\text {wheel }}=\frac{m r^{2}}{2}$。根据 (1.45)

$$
\begin{aligned}
T_{4 \text { wheels }} & =4\left(\frac{m r^{2} \dot{\omega}^{2}}{4}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right) \\
& =4\left(\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{m \dot{x}^{2}}{2}\right) \\
& =3 m \dot{x}^{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

在 (1.46) 中使用了 $\dot{x}=r \dot{\omega}$，这是无滑动滚动的条件。

卡车的动能简单为

$$
T_{\text {truck }}=\frac{M \dot{x}^{2}}{2}
$$

悬挂物体的动能也包括两部分：第一部分是由于物体在振荡运动中的惯性，第二部分是由于物体重心的线性位移，即

$$
T_{\text {object }}=\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime} v_{\text {object }}^{2}}{2}
$$

物体的速度 $v_{\text {object }}$ 是物体重心的速度，可以假设与物体的重心 $G$ 相同。通过对 $G$ 点沿 $X$ 轴的坐标对时间求导得到，即

$$
\begin{aligned}
v_{\text {object }}=\frac{d x_{O G}}{d t} & =\frac{d}{d t}\left(x_{O C}+x_{C A}+x_{A G}\right) \\
& =\frac{d}{d t}\left(x+x_{C A}+l \sin (\theta+\gamma)\right) \\
& =\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)
\end{aligned}
$$

假设后轮轮毂与物体悬挂点之间的距离 $x_{C A}$ 是常数。根据 (1.50) 和 (1.53)

$$
T_{\text {objet }}=\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime}}{2}(\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma))^{2}
$$

总动能为 (1.43)

$$
\begin{aligned}
T & =3 m \dot{x}^{2}+\frac{M \dot{x}^{2}}{2}+\frac{I \dot{\theta}^{2}}{2}+\frac{m^{\prime}}{2}(\dot{x}+l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma))^{2} \\
& =\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

势能也有三项，写作

$$
\begin{aligned}
V & =\left(V_{4 \text { wheels }}+V_{\text {track }}\right)+V_{\text {object }} \\
& =-(4 m+M) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g(x \sin \gamma+l \cos \theta) \\
& =-\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta
\end{aligned}
$$

拉格朗日函数为

$$
\begin{aligned}
L= & \left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
& +\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma+m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta
\end{aligned}
$$

对于广义坐标 $x$，我们得到

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}} & =\left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \dot{x}+m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \\
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{x}}\right) & =\left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \ddot{x}+m^{\prime} l \ddot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta}^{2} \sin (\theta+\gamma) \\
\frac{\partial L}{\partial x} & =\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g \sin \gamma
\end{aligned}
$$

拉格朗日的第一方程为

$$
\left(6 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) \ddot{x}+m^{\prime} l \ddot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{\theta}^{2} \sin (\theta+\gamma)-\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g \sin \gamma=0
$$

对于广义坐标 $\theta$，我们得到

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}= & m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+\dot{\theta}^{2} m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \dot{\theta} \\
\frac{d}{d t}\left(\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\theta}}\right)= & m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \sin (\theta+\gamma) \\
& +\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta}-2 m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
\frac{\partial L}{\partial \theta}= & -m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \sin (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} l^{2} \dot{\theta}^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma)-m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta
\end{aligned}
$$

拉格朗日的第二方程为

$$
\begin{aligned}
& m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta} \\
& -m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2}+m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta=0
\end{aligned}
$$

(2) 运动的第一个积分由 $T+V=E$ 给出，其中 $E$ 是常数，是系统的总能量，因为没有摩擦或其他能量损失，这导致

$$
\begin{gathered}
\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} \\
-\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta=E
\end{gathered}
$$

(3) 对于常数 $\theta$，即 $\dot{\theta}=\ddot{\theta}=0$，拉格朗日的第一方程 (1.64) 给出

$$
\ddot{x}=\left(\frac{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right) g \sin \gamma
$$

因此，卡车的加速度和物体的倾斜可以一起保持不变。
(4) 在这种情况下，拉格朗日的第二方程简化为

$$
\ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+g \sin \theta=0
$$

通过用 (1.73) 替换 $\ddot{x}$，得到

$$
\left(\frac{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right) \sin \gamma \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\sin \theta=0
$$

或

$$
\theta=\arctan \left(\frac{\sin \gamma \cos \gamma}{\sin ^{2} \gamma-\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{4 m+M+m^{\prime}}\right)}\right)
$$

由于卡车行驶的道路既不水平也不垂直，即 $0<\gamma<\frac{\pi}{2}, \theta$ 不能为零或等于 $\frac{\pi}{2}$。
(5) 如果轮子的质量相对于卡车和悬挂物体的质量可以忽略不计，即 $m \ll M+m^{\prime}$，根据 (1.76)

$$
\tan \theta \approx \frac{\sin \gamma \cos \gamma}{\sin ^{2} \gamma-1}=-\tan \gamma
$$

且 $\theta \approx-\gamma$。因此，物体的倾斜可以（几乎）等于斜坡。
answer: m^{\prime} l \ddot{x} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)\right) \ddot{\theta} -m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos (\theta+\gamma) \sin (\theta+\gamma) \dot{\theta}^{2}+m^{\prime} g l \sin \theta=0

\left(\frac{6 m+M+m^{\prime}}{2}\right) \dot{x}^{2}+m^{\prime} l \dot{x} \dot{\theta} \cos (\theta+\gamma)+\left(\frac{I+m^{\prime} l^{2} \cos ^{2}(\theta+\gamma)}{2}\right) \dot{\theta}^{2} -\left(4 m+M+m^{\prime}\right) g x \sin \gamma-m^{\prime} g l \cos \theta=E

question:
A charged particle of unknown mass $M$ and momentum $|\mathbf{p}|$ much larger than the electron mass $m_{e}$, crosses a detector. At a certain depth inside the active material, an atomic electron is knocked out by the incoming particle, for which the polar angle $\theta_{e}$ with respect to $\mathbf{p}$ and the energy $E_{e}$ are measured. Show that the mass $M$ can be estimated from the following formula:

$$
M=|\mathbf{p}|\left[\frac{E_{e}+m_{e}}{E_{e}-m_{e}} \cos ^{2} \theta_{e}-1\right]^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$

一个带电粒子，质量 $M$ 未知，动量 $|\mathbf{p}|$ 远大于电子质量 $m_{e}$，穿过一个探测器。在活性材料的某个深度，一个原子电子被入射粒子击出，其相对于 $\mathbf{p}$ 的极角 $\theta_{e}$ 和能量 $E_{e}$ 被测量。证明质量 $M$ 可以通过以下公式估算：

$$
M=|\mathbf{p}|\left[\frac{E_{e}+m_{e}}{E_{e}-m_{e}} \cos ^{2} \theta_{e}-1\right]^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$。

Given the Boltzman constant $k_{\mathrm{B}}=8.6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{eV} \mathrm{K}^{-1}$, estimate the typical wavelength of the cosmic background radiation. Which part of the EM spectrum does it belong to?
给定玻尔兹曼常数 $k_{\mathrm{B}}=8.6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{eV} \mathrm{K}^{-1}$，估算宇宙背景辐射的典型波长。它属于电磁波谱的哪个部分？

solution:
From Problem 1.19 and (1.109), we know that the energy of the neutrino in the laboratory frame is uniformly distributed in the range $E_{v}^{*}\left(\gamma \pm \sqrt{\gamma^{2}-1}\right)$, where $E_{v}^{*}=\left(m_{\pi}^{2}-m_{\mu}^{2}\right) / 2 m_{\pi}$ is the centre-of-mass energy of the neutrino in the most probable decay $\pi^{+} \rightarrow \mu^{+} \nu_{\mu}$, and $\gamma=E_{\pi} / m_{\pi}$. The mean energy is therefore:

$$
\left\langle E_{v}\right\rangle=\gamma E_{v}^{*}=\left(\frac{E_{\pi}}{m_{\pi}}\right) \frac{m_{\pi}^{2}-m_{\mu}^{2}}{2 m_{\pi}} \Rightarrow E_{\pi}=\frac{2\left\langle E_{v}\right\rangle}{1-\left(m_{\mu} / m_{\pi}\right)^{2}}=96 \mathrm{GeV}
$$

For a massless neutrino, the polar angle in the laboratory frame can range up to $\pi$ radians. However, for large boosts, the probability of decaying at an angle $\theta \gg 1 / \gamma$ is negligible. Since $\gamma \approx 670 \gg 1$, we can make use of Eqs. (1.73) and (1.76) to obtain:

$$
\langle\theta\rangle \approx 2.3 \times 10^{-3}, \quad \sigma_{\theta} \approx 4.9 \times 10^{-3}, \quad \theta_{90 \%} \approx 4.5 \times 10^{-3}
$$

Taking the $90 \%$ quantile as an estimator of the beam divergence of the far-end detector located at $d=100 \mathrm{~km}$, we get a beam spread of about 450 m along the transverse coordinate.

The charged-current (CC) neutrino cross section on an isoscalar target in the deep inelastic scattering (DIS) regime, appropriate for this value of the neutrino energy, can be computed by using the effective Fermi Lagrangian of Eq. (2.82), giving:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{v d} & =\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{4 \pi^{2}}, \quad \sigma_{v \bar{u}}=\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{4 \pi^{2}} \frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{4} \\
& \Rightarrow \quad \sigma_{v N}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\sigma_{v p}+\sigma_{v n}\right)=\frac{G_{F}^{2}}{\pi} M E_{v}\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

where $Q=\int d x x q(x)(\tilde{Q}=\int d x x \tilde{q}(x))$ is the average momentum carried by quarks (antiquarks) inside the proton, and $M$ indicates the average nucleon mass. See e.g. Ref. [4] for more informations. For anti-neutrinos, one needs to swap $Q \leftrightarrow \tilde{Q}$. Taking $M=0.938 \mathrm{GeV}$, and using Eq. (1.9) to convert the result into SI, we get:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{v N} & =\frac{\left(1.166 \mathrm{GeV}^{-2}\right)^{2}}{\pi} \cdot 0.938 \mathrm{GeV} \cdot E_{v}\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right] \\
& \approx 1.56 \times 10^{-38} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(\frac{E_{v}}{\mathrm{GeV}}\right)\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

The mean free-path for neutrinos in a medium of density $\rho=1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ is given by Eq. (1.291). From DIS experiments, one measures $\tilde{Q} \ll Q \approx 0.5$, see e.g. Problem 5.20. Thus, we get:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\lambda & =\frac{A}{\sigma \rho N_{\mathrm{A}}}=\frac{18 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}}{1.56 \times 10^{-38} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \cdot 20 \cdot 0.5 \cdot 1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \cdot 6.02 \times 10^{23} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}} \\
& \approx 2 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~m}
\end{aligned}
$$

The same effective theory predicts the total cross section of the CC interaction $v_{\mu} e^{-} \rightarrow \mu^{-} v_{e}$ to be as the first of Eq. (1.353):

$$
\sigma_{v e}=\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{\pi}=\frac{2 G_{F}^{2}}{\pi} m_{e} E_{v} \quad \Rightarrow \quad \frac{\sigma_{v e}}{\sigma_{v N}}=\frac{2 m_{e}}{M[Q+\bar{Q} / 3]} \approx 2 \times 10^{-3}
$$

question:
一个平均能量为$\left\langle E_{\nu}\right\rangle=20 \mathrm{GeV}$的中微子束是通过带电介子的衰变产生的。估算：

- 产生该中微子束的介子束的能量（假设为单色）；
- 在位于光束管下游距离$d=100 \mathrm{~km}$的远端探测器处中微子束的发散；
- 中微子-核子截面的数量级；
- 在密度为水的探测器中，中微子的平均自由程；
- 在质子和电子上截面的比值。
solution:
从问题1.19和(1.109)中，我们知道在实验室参考系中，中微子的能量在范围$E_{v}^{*}\left(\gamma \pm \sqrt{\gamma^{2}-1}\right)$内均匀分布，其中$E_{v}^{*}=\left(m_{\pi}^{2}-m_{\mu}^{2}\right) / 2 m_{\pi}$是中微子在最可能衰变$\pi^{+} \rightarrow \mu^{+} \nu_{\mu}$中的质心系能量，而$\gamma=E_{\pi} / m_{\pi}$。因此，平均能量为：

$$
\left\langle E_{v}\right\rangle=\gamma E_{v}^{*}=\left(\frac{E_{\pi}}{m_{\pi}}\right) \frac{m_{\pi}^{2}-m_{\mu}^{2}}{2 m_{\pi}} \Rightarrow E_{\pi}=\frac{2\left\langle E_{v}\right\rangle}{1-\left(m_{\mu} / m_{\pi}\right)^{2}}=96 \mathrm{GeV}
$$

对于无质量的中微子，在实验室参考系中的极角可以达到$\pi$弧度。然而，对于大的推动，衰变在角度$\theta \gg 1 / \gamma$的概率可以忽略不计。由于$\gamma \approx 670 \gg 1$，我们可以利用公式(1.73)和(1.76)得到：

$$
\langle\theta\rangle \approx 2.3 \times 10^{-3}, \quad \sigma_{\theta} \approx 4.9 \times 10^{-3}, \quad \theta_{90 \%} \approx 4.5 \times 10^{-3}
$$

将$90 \%$分位数作为远端探测器（位于$d=100 \mathrm{~km}$）的束发散的估计值，我们得到横向坐标上的束扩展约为450米。

在适合该中微子能量值的深度非弹性散射（DIS）范围内，使用公式(2.82)的有效费米拉格朗日量，可以计算出在等标靶上的带电流（CC）中微子截面：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{v d} & =\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{4 \pi^{2}}, \quad \sigma_{v \bar{u}}=\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{4 \pi^{2}} \frac{(1+\cos \theta)^{2}}{4} \\
& \Rightarrow \quad \sigma_{v N}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\sigma_{v p}+\sigma_{v n}\right)=\frac{G_{F}^{2}}{\pi} M E_{v}\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

其中$Q=\int d x x q(x)(\tilde{Q}=\int d x x \tilde{q}(x))$是质子内夸克（反夸克）携带的平均动量，$M$表示平均核子质量。更多信息请参见例如参考文献[4]。对于反中微子，需要交换$Q \leftrightarrow \tilde{Q}$。取$M=0.938 \mathrm{GeV}$，并使用公式(1.9)将结果转换为SI单位，我们得到：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{v N} & =\frac{\left(1.166 \mathrm{GeV}^{-2}\right)^{2}}{\pi} \cdot 0.938 \mathrm{GeV} \cdot E_{v}\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right] \\
& \approx 1.56 \times 10^{-38} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(\frac{E_{v}}{\mathrm{GeV}}\right)\left[Q+\frac{\tilde{Q}}{3}\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

中微子在密度为$\rho=1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$的介质中的平均自由程由公式(1.291)给出。从DIS实验中测得$\tilde{Q} \ll Q \approx 0.5$，例如参见问题5.20。因此，我们得到：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\lambda & =\frac{A}{\sigma \rho N_{\mathrm{A}}}=\frac{18 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}}{1.56 \times 10^{-38} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \cdot 20 \cdot 0.5 \cdot 1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \cdot 6.02 \times 10^{23} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}} \\
& \approx 2 \times 10^{14} \mathrm{~m}
\end{aligned}
$$

同样的有效理论预测CC相互作用$v_{\mu} e^{-} \rightarrow \mu^{-} v_{e}$的总截面为公式(1.353)的第一个：

$$
\sigma_{v e}=\frac{G_{F}^{2} s}{\pi}=\frac{2 G_{F}^{2}}{\pi} m_{e} E_{v} \quad \Rightarrow \quad \frac{\sigma_{v e}}{\sigma_{v N}}=\frac{2 m_{e}}{M[Q+\bar{Q} / 3]} \approx 2 \times 10^{-3}
$$

question: In an electromagnetic calorimeter, the stochastic contribution to the resolution is $0.07 / \sqrt{E}$. Can we conclude that the energy resolution for an electron of energy $E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$ is $1 \%$ ?
solution: To find the energy resolution, we need to calculate the stochastic contribution for $E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$. The stochastic contribution to the resolution is given by $\frac{0.07}{\sqrt{E}}$. Substituting $E = 50 \mathrm{GeV}$, we have: $$\text{Resolution} = \frac{0.07}{\sqrt{50}}.$$ Calculating the value: $$\sqrt{50} \approx 7.071.$$ Therefore, $$\text{Resolution} \approx \frac{0.07}{7.071} \approx 0.0099.$$ Converting to percentage: $$0.0099 \times 100\% \approx 0.99\%.$$ Thus, the energy resolution for an electron of energy $E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$ is approximately $0.99\%$, which is indeed close to $1\%$. Therefore, we can conclude that the energy resolution is approximately $1\%$.

question: 在电磁量能器中，随机贡献对能量分辨率的影响是 $0.07 / \sqrt{E}$。我们能否得出结论，认为能量为 $E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$ 的电子的能量分辨率是 $1 \%$？
solution: 要找到能量分辨率，我们需要计算$E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$时的随机贡献。分辨率的随机贡献由$\frac{0.07}{\sqrt{E}}$给出。代入$E = 50 \mathrm{GeV}$，我们有：$$\text{Resolution} = \frac{0.07}{\sqrt{50}}.$$ 计算该值：$$\sqrt{50} \approx 7.071.$$ 因此，$$\text{Resolution} \approx \frac{0.07}{7.071} \approx 0.0099.$$ 转换为百分比：$$0.0099 \times 100\% \approx 0.99\%.$$ 因此，能量为$E=50 \mathrm{GeV}$的电子的能量分辨率约为$0.99\%$，这确实接近于$1\%$。因此，我们可以得出结论，能量分辨率约为$1\%$。

question: A depleted microstrip silicon detector has a strip pitch of $50 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ and operates without charge division. What is its spatial resolution?
solution: The spatial resolution of a microstrip detector that operates without charge division is typically given by the strip pitch divided by the square root of 12. Therefore, the spatial resolution $\sigma$ can be calculated as: $$ \sigma = \frac{50 \mu \mathrm{~m}}{\sqrt{12}} \approx 14.43 \mu \mathrm{~m}. $$

question: 一个耗尽的微条硅探测器的条带间距为$50 \mu \mathrm{~m}$，并且在没有电荷分配的情况下运行。它的空间分辨率是多少？
solution: 在不进行电荷分割操作的情况下，微条探测器的空间分辨率通常由条间距除以12的平方根给出。因此，空间分辨率$\sigma$可以计算为：$$ \sigma = \frac{50 \mu \mathrm{~m}}{\sqrt{12}} \approx 14.43 \mu \mathrm{~m}. $$。

question: A proportional cylindrical tube has inner radius $R$, wire radius $r$, and anodic tension $V_{0}$. What is the value of the electric field at a distance $d \leq R$ from the anode?
solution: Let's assume that the anode is connected to a potential $V_{0}>0$ and that the cathode is grounded. The wire acquires a charge with uniform linear density. By using the cylindrical symmetry of this configuration, it is easy to prove that the electric field must be radial, i.e. $\mathbf{E}=E(d) \mathbf{e}_{r}$. By virtue of Gauss law, the field intensity $E(r)$ must scale as $d^{-1}$, i.e. $$ E(d)=\frac{c_{0}}{d} $$ where $c_{0}$ is a constant that depends on the boundary conditions. Since $E=-\nabla V$, the electric potential $V(d)$ must be proportional to $\ln d$. Together with the boundary conditions at the two electrodes, this fully determines the potential to be: $$ V(d)=\frac{V_{0}}{\ln (r / R)} \ln (d / R) $$ from which we get the result: $$ E(d)=-\frac{\partial V}{\partial d}=\frac{V_{0}}{\ln (R / r)} \frac{1}{d} $$

question: 一个比例圆柱管的内半径为 $R$，电线半径为 $r$，阳极电压为 $V_{0}$。在距离阳极 $d \leq R$ 处，电场的值是多少？
solution: 假设阳极连接到电势 $V_{0}>0$，阴极接地。导线获得了具有均匀线性密度的电荷。利用这种配置的圆柱对称性，很容易证明电场必须是径向的，即 $\mathbf{E}=E(d) \mathbf{e}_{r}$。根据高斯定律，场强 $E(r)$ 必须随着 $d^{-1}$ 缩放，即 $$ E(d)=\frac{c_{0}}{d} $$ 其中 $c_{0}$ 是一个依赖于边界条件的常数。由于 $E=-\nabla V$，电势 $V(d)$ 必须与 $\ln d$ 成正比。结合两个电极的边界条件，这完全确定了电势为：$$ V(d)=\frac{V_{0}}{\ln (r / R)} \ln (d / R) $$ 从中我们得到结果：$$ E(d)=-\frac{\partial V}{\partial d}=\frac{V_{0}}{\ln (R / r)} \frac{1}{d} $$。

question: A mass spectrometer consists of a pair of electrodes kept at a potential difference $\left|V_{0}\right|=1 \mathrm{MV}$, followed by a magnetic analyzer of length $L=1 \mathrm{~m}$ and uniform magnetic field with intensity $|\mathbf{B}|=1 \mathrm{kG}$. Positive ions are produced at rest at the grounded electrode and accelerated by the electric field towards the cathode. The position of arrival $y$ at the opposite side of the spectrometer is measured with an uncertainty $\sigma_{y}$. The beam to be composed of ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}$and ${ }^{13} \mathrm{C}^{+}$ions in unknown proportion. What is the minimum resolution $\sigma_{y}$ necessary to identify the correct mass number to better than $3 \sigma$ per incident ion?
solution:
The kinetic energy of the ion at the entrance of the spectrometer is $T=q V_{0}=$ $|\mathbf{p}|^{2} / 2 m$. We can assume classical kinematics since $q V_{0}=1 \mathrm{MeV}$ is small compared to the mass of carbon ions. The radius of curvature $R$ is then given by Eq. (3.40):

$$
R=\frac{|\mathbf{p}|}{q B}=\frac{\sqrt{2 m q V_{0}}}{q B}
$$

Replacing the symbols by their values, we get for the ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}$population:

$$
R\left({ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}\right)=\sqrt{\frac{2 \cdot 10^{6} \mathrm{~V}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}} \frac{12 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~kg}}{6.0 \times 10^{23}}} \frac{1}{0.1 \mathrm{~T}}=5.0 \mathrm{~m}
$$

In Eq. (3.55), we have use the fact that one mole of ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}$ weighs exactly 12 g . The apparatus measures the lateral displacement $y$ with respect to the initial beam position. Since $L / R \approx 0.2$, we can approximate the ion trajectory with a parabola to yield:

$$
y \approx \frac{L^{2}}{2 R}=\sqrt{\frac{q}{2 m V_{0}}} \frac{|\mathbf{B}| L^{2}}{2}
$$

which is accurate to the percent level. For ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}, y \approx 10 \mathrm{~cm}$, which is small compared to $L$, thus justifying the use of Eq. (3.56). Since $\Delta m=1$ a.u. is small compared to the ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}$ mass, we can approximate:

$$
\frac{\Delta y}{y} \approx \frac{1}{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m} \quad \Rightarrow \quad \Delta y \approx \frac{y}{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m}
$$

In order to separate the two mass numbers to better than $N_{\sigma}$ standard deviations per ion, the position resolution needs to satisfy:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{y}<\frac{\Delta y}{N_{\sigma}} & =\frac{1}{4 N_{\sigma}} \sqrt{\frac{q}{2 m V_{0}}}|\mathbf{B}| L^{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m}= \\
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 一个质谱仪由一对电极组成，其电势差为$\left|V_{0}\right|=1 \mathrm{MV}$，后接长度为$L=1 \mathrm{~m}$的磁分析器，具有强度为$|\mathbf{B}|=1 \mathrm{kG}$的均匀磁场。正离子在接地电极处静止产生，并被电场加速朝向阴极。在质谱仪的另一侧测量到达位置$y$的不确定性为$\sigma_{y}$。束流由未知比例的${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}$和${ }^{13} \mathrm{C}^{+}$离子组成。为了使每个入射离子的质量数识别正确优于$3 \sigma$，所需的最小分辨率$\sigma_{y}$是多少？
solution:
离子在进入光谱仪时的动能为 $T=q V_{0}=$ $|\mathbf{p}|^{2} / 2 m$。我们可以假设经典运动学，因为 $q V_{0}=1 \mathrm{MeV}$ 相对于碳离子的质量来说是小的。曲率半径 $R$ 由方程 (3.40) 给出：

$$
R=\frac{|\mathbf{p}|}{q B}=\frac{\sqrt{2 m q V_{0}}}{q B}
$$

用其数值代替符号，对于 ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}$种群，我们得到：

$$
R\left({ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}\right)=\sqrt{\frac{2 \cdot 10^{6} \mathrm{~V}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{C}} \frac{12 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~kg}}{6.0 \times 10^{23}}} \frac{1}{0.1 \mathrm{~T}}=5.0 \mathrm{~m}
$$

在方程 (3.55) 中，我们使用了一个事实，即一摩尔 ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}$ 恰好重 12 克。该装置测量相对于初始光束位置的横向位移 $y$。由于 $L / R \approx 0.2$，我们可以用抛物线近似离子轨迹以得到：

$$
y \approx \frac{L^{2}}{2 R}=\sqrt{\frac{q}{2 m V_{0}}} \frac{|\mathbf{B}| L^{2}}{2}
$$

其精确度达到百分之一的水平。对于 ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}^{+}, y \approx 10 \mathrm{~cm}$，这相对于 $L$ 来说是小的，因此可以合理使用方程 (3.56)。由于 $\Delta m=1$ a.u. 相对于 ${ }^{12} \mathrm{C}$ 的质量来说是小的，我们可以近似：

$$
\frac{\Delta y}{y} \approx \frac{1}{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m} \quad \Rightarrow \quad \Delta y \approx \frac{y}{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m}
$$

为了将两个质量数分离到每个离子优于 $N_{\sigma}$ 标准偏差的位置分辨率，需要满足：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sigma_{y}<\frac{\Delta y}{N_{\sigma}} & =\frac{1}{4 N_{\sigma}} \sqrt{\frac{q}{2 m V_{0}}}|\mathbf{B}| L^{2} \frac{\Delta m}{m}= \\
\end{aligned}
$$

question: The surface of a given detector is irradiated by a uniform flux. The counting rate on a single channel is $v$. Let the sampling time be $T$. Determine the probability of having empty events and the probability of having single events.
solution:
To determine the probabilities, we use the Poisson distribution, which describes the probability of a given number of events occurring in a fixed interval of time. The Poisson distribution is given by: $$ P(n; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^n}{n!} $$ where $n$ is the number of events, and $\lambda$ is the average number of events in the interval. 

In this case, the average number of events $\lambda$ is equal to the product of the counting rate $v$ and the sampling time $T$, i.e., $\lambda = vT$. 

1. **Probability of having empty events (n=0):** 
   $$ P(0; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^0}{0!} = e^{-\lambda} $$
   Substituting $\lambda = vT$, the probability of having zero events is $P(0; vT) = e^{-vT}$. 

2. **Probability of having single events (n=1):** 
   $$ P(1; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^1}{1!} = \lambda e^{-\lambda} $$
   Substituting $\lambda = vT$, the probability of having one event is $P(1; vT) = vT e^{-vT}$. 

Thus, the probability of having empty events is $e^{-vT}$, and the probability of having single events is $vT e^{-vT}$.

question: 给定探测器的表面被均匀的流量照射。单个通道上的计数率为$v$。设采样时间为$T$。确定出现空事件的概率和出现单事件的概率。
solution:
为了确定概率，我们使用泊松分布，它描述了在固定时间间隔内发生给定数量事件的概率。泊松分布由以下公式给出：$$ P(n; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^n}{n!} $$ 其中，$n$ 是事件的数量，$\lambda$ 是该时间间隔内事件的平均数量。

在这种情况下，事件的平均数量 $\lambda$ 等于计数率 $v$ 和采样时间 $T$ 的乘积，即 $\lambda = vT$。

1. **发生空事件的概率 (n=0)：**
   $$ P(0; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^0}{0!} = e^{-\lambda} $$
   代入 $\lambda = vT$，发生零事件的概率是 $P(0; vT) = e^{-vT}$。

2. **发生单个事件的概率 (n=1)：**
   $$ P(1; \lambda) = \frac{e^{-\lambda} \lambda^1}{1!} = \lambda e^{-\lambda} $$
   代入 $\lambda = vT$，发生一个事件的概率是 $P(1; vT) = vT e^{-vT}$。

因此，发生空事件的概率是 $e^{-vT}$，发生单个事件的概率是 $vT e^{-vT}$。

question: An experiment measures events containing a pair of particles reconstructed as electrons. The collected data sample, denoted by PP, is affected by two sources of background: the first consists of one real electron and one pion misidentified as an electron; the second consists of two mis-identified pions. The pion mis-identification probability $f_{1,2}^{i}$ for both reconstructed objects and for each event $i$ is known from simulation. Two independent data samples, containing, respectively, exactly one (PF) and exactly zero (FF) reconstructed electrons are also measured. Assume a perfect identification probability for real electrons. Estimate the total background yield in the PP sample.
solution:
Under the assumption that the electron identification probability is perfect, the PF sample is contaminated by both one- and two-pion events, whereas the FF sample contains only two-pion events. The probabilities for all possible combinations of wrong and correct identification of a background events are:

$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{FF} \mid \pi \pi]=\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right)\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right) \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PF} \mid \pi \pi]=f_{1}^{i}\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right)+\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right) f_{2}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PP} \mid \pi \pi]=f_{1}^{i} f_{2}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PF} \mid \pi e]=1-f_{a}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PP} \mid \pi e]=f_{a}^{i}
\end{array}\right.
$$

where the index $a=1,2$ refers to the particle not-reconstructed as an electron. We can express the number of background events in the PP region per event falling in the FF or PF region by taking the ratio between the respective probabilities. The number of two-pion events in the PP sample can be therefore estimated as

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}=\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i} f_{2}^{i}}{\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right)\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right)}
$$

Since the PF sample contains both one- and two-pion events, the quantity

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}^{\pi e+\pi \pi}=\sum_{j \in \mathrm{PF}} \frac{f_{a}^{j}}{1-f_{a}^{j}}
$$

where the sum runs over the PF sample, provides the correct background yield in the PP sample from one-pion events, but it underestimates the contribution from two-pion events. In particular, by summing together Eqs. (4.68) and (4.69), the contribution from two-pion events would be overestimated because some events get double-counted. The contribution of two-pion events to the sum in Eq. (4.69) can be however estimated from the FF sample to be

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}=\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}+\underbrace{\frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}=2 \sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}} \frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}
$$

The total background yield in the PP region is therefore given by:

$$
\underbrace{N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}}_{\pi \pi}+\underbrace{N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}^{\pi e+\pi \pi}-\underset{\pi e}{\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}}}=\sum_{j \in \mathrm{PF}} \frac{f_{a}^{j}}{1-f_{a}^{j}}-\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}} \frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}
$$

Notice that we made the assumption that the mis-identification probabilities factorise. This exercise illustrates an example of a data-driven technique for estimating the background contamination in events with mis-identified particles.

question: 一个实验测量了一对被重建为电子的粒子事件。收集到的数据样本，记作PP，受到两种背景的影响：第一种背景包含一个真实的电子和一个被误识别为电子的介子；第二种背景包含两个被误识别的介子。通过模拟已知每个事件$i$中两个重建对象的介子误识别概率$f_{1,2}^{i}$。另外，测量了两个独立的数据样本，分别包含恰好一个（PF）和恰好零个（FF）重建电子。假设真实电子的识别概率是完美的。估计PP样本中的总背景产量。
solution:
在假设电子识别概率完美的情况下，PF样本被一-和两-π介子事件污染，而FF样本仅包含两-π介子事件。所有可能的错误和正确识别背景事件的组合的概率为：

$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{FF} \mid \pi \pi]=\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right)\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right) \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PF} \mid \pi \pi]=f_{1}^{i}\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right)+\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right) f_{2}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PP} \mid \pi \pi]=f_{1}^{i} f_{2}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PF} \mid \pi e]=1-f_{a}^{i} \\
\operatorname{Prob}[\mathrm{PP} \mid \pi e]=f_{a}^{i}
\end{array}\right.
$$

其中，索引 $a=1,2$ 指的是未被重建为电子的粒子。我们可以通过分别计算概率的比值来表示每个事件中FF或PF区域内PP区域的背景事件数量。因此，PP样本中两-π介子事件的数量可以估计为：

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}=\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i} f_{2}^{i}}{\left(1-f_{1}^{i}\right)\left(1-f_{2}^{i}\right)}
$$

由于PF样本同时包含一-和两-π介子事件，该量

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}^{\pi e+\pi \pi}=\sum_{j \in \mathrm{PF}} \frac{f_{a}^{j}}{1-f_{a}^{j}}
$$

其中求和遍历PF样本，提供了来自一-π介子事件的PP样本中正确的背景产额，但低估了来自两-π介子事件的贡献。特别是，通过将公式(4.68)和(4.69)相加，两-π介子事件的贡献会被高估，因为某些事件被重复计算。然而，可以从FF样本中估计公式(4.69)中两-π介子事件对总和的贡献为：

$$
N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}=\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}+\underbrace{\frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}} \underbrace{\frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}}}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}=2 \sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}} \frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}
$$

因此，PP区域的总背景产额为：

$$
\underbrace{N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{FF}}^{\pi \pi}}_{\pi \pi}+\underbrace{N_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF}}^{\pi e+\pi \pi}-\underset{\pi e}{\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{PP} \mid \mathrm{PF} \mid \mathrm{FF}}}=\sum_{j \in \mathrm{PF}} \frac{f_{a}^{j}}{1-f_{a}^{j}}-\sum_{i \in \mathrm{FF}} \frac{f_{1}^{i}}{1-f_{1}^{i}} \frac{f_{2}^{i}}{1-f_{2}^{i}}
$$

注意，我们假设误识别概率是可分解的。这个练习展示了一个基于数据的技术示例，用于估计事件中被误识别粒子的背景污染。

question: A radioactive source emits two kinds of uncorrelated radiation A and B. This radiation is observed through a counter which is able to distinguish A from B. In a given time interval, the countings are $N_{\mathrm{A}}=200$ and $N_{\mathrm{B}}=1000$. What is the statistical uncertainty on the ratio $R=N_{\mathrm{A}} / N_{\mathrm{B}}$? In case the observation time were reduced by a factor of 250, do you think that the new ratio $r=n_{\mathrm{A}} / n_{\mathrm{B}}$ would represent an unbiased estimator of the true ratio between the two activities? In case of negative answer, how would you correct for it?
solution:
The variable $R$ thus defined coincides with the ML estimator for the parameter $\rho=\mu_{\mathrm{A}} / \mu_{\mathrm{B}}$. This can be easily verified. Indeed, the likelihood of the two observations can be parametrised in terms of $\rho$ and one of the two mean counting rates, e.g. $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}$, as:

$$
L\left(N_{\mathrm{A}}, N_{\mathrm{B}} ; \rho, \mu_{\mathrm{B}}\right)=\frac{e^{-\mu_{\mathrm{B}}(1+\rho)} \rho^{N_{\mathrm{A}}} \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{N_{\mathrm{A}}+N_{\mathrm{B}}}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}!N_{\mathrm{B}}!}
$$

Setting the derivatives of $L$ with respect to both parameters to zero, one gets the expected result for the ML estimators:

$$
\hat{R}=N_{\mathrm{A}} / N_{\mathrm{B}}, \quad \hat{\mu}_{\mathrm{B}}=N_{\mathrm{B}}
$$

The asymptotic properties of the ML estimator guarantee that $\hat{R}$ is an unbiased estimator, if a large number of observations are made. For just one experiment, this is in general not the case. However, since the variance of the individual rates is known, it is possible to estimate the variance of $R$ by standard error propagation, which gives the result:

$$
\frac{\sigma_{R}}{R}=\sqrt{\left(\frac{\sigma_{\mathrm{A}}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\sigma_{\mathrm{B}}}{N_{\mathrm{B}}}\right)^{2}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{A}}}+\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{B}}}}=7.7 \%
$$

This result assumes that the function $R\left(N_{\mathrm{A}}, N_{\mathrm{B}}\right)$ can be expanded around the mean values $\mu_{\mathrm{A}}$ and $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}$, and that the relative variations of the countings of order $\sigma_{\mathrm{A}} / A$ and $\sigma_{\mathrm{B}} / B$ around these values are small. This assumption breaks up if at least one of the two countings is small. In particular, if the observation time gets reduced by a factor of 250, the mean counting rates for A and B will be of order 1 and 4, respectively, thus invalidating the estimate of Eq. (4.90). The variance of the estimator $r$ will be larger.

A possible way to overcome this problem is to repeat the measurements $N \gg 1$ times, which reduces the uncertainty on the estimator of the mean number of decays $n_{\mathrm{A}}$ and $n_{\mathrm{B}}$ by a factor of $1 / \sqrt{N}$: for sufficiently large values of $N$, the ratio $r=n_{\mathrm{A}} / n_{\mathrm{B}}$ becomes again well behaved.

question: 一个放射性源发射出两种不相关的辐射A和B。通过一个能够区分A和B的计数器观察这种辐射。在给定的时间间隔内，计数为$N_{\mathrm{A}}=200$和$N_{\mathrm{B}}=1000$。比率$R=N_{\mathrm{A}} / N_{\mathrm{B}}$的统计不确定性是多少？如果观察时间减少250倍，你认为新的比率$r=n_{\mathrm{A}} / n_{\mathrm{B}}$会是两个活动之间真实比率的无偏估计量吗？如果答案是否定的，你会如何纠正它？
solution:
因此定义的变量 $R$ 与参数 $\rho=\mu_{\mathrm{A}} / \mu_{\mathrm{B}}$ 的最大似然估计相符。这可以很容易地验证。实际上，两个观测值的似然可以用 $\rho$ 和两个平均计数率之一（例如 $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}$）来参数化，如下所示：

$$
L\left(N_{\mathrm{A}}, N_{\mathrm{B}} ; \rho, \mu_{\mathrm{B}}\right)=\frac{e^{-\mu_{\mathrm{B}}(1+\rho)} \rho^{N_{\mathrm{A}}} \mu_{\mathrm{B}}^{N_{\mathrm{A}}+N_{\mathrm{B}}}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}!N_{\mathrm{B}}!}
$$

将 $L$ 对这两个参数的导数设为零，可以得到最大似然估计的预期结果：

$$
\hat{R}=N_{\mathrm{A}} / N_{\mathrm{B}}, \quad \hat{\mu}_{\mathrm{B}}=N_{\mathrm{B}}
$$

最大似然估计的渐近性质保证了如果进行大量观测，$\hat{R}$ 是一个无偏估计。然而，对于单次实验，这通常不是这种情况。然而，由于已知个体速率的方差，可以通过标准误差传播来估计 $R$ 的方差，得到的结果是：

$$
\frac{\sigma_{R}}{R}=\sqrt{\left(\frac{\sigma_{\mathrm{A}}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\sigma_{\mathrm{B}}}{N_{\mathrm{B}}}\right)^{2}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{A}}}+\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{B}}}}=7.7 \%
$$

这一结果假设函数 $R\left(N_{\mathrm{A}}, N_{\mathrm{B}}\right)$ 可以在平均值 $\mu_{\mathrm{A}}$ 和 $\mu_{\mathrm{B}}$ 附近展开，并且在这些值附近计数的相对变化 $\sigma_{\mathrm{A}} / A$ 和 $\sigma_{\mathrm{B}} / B$ 是小的。如果至少一个计数较小，这一假设就会失效。特别地，如果观测时间减少250倍，A和B的平均计数率将分别为1和4，这将使公式(4.90)的估计失效。估计量 $r$ 的方差将更大。

克服此问题的一种可能方法是重复测量 $N \gg 1$ 次，这将使平均衰变数 $n_{\mathrm{A}}$ 和 $n_{\mathrm{B}}$ 的估计不确定性减少 $1 / \sqrt{N}$ 倍：对于足够大的 $N$ 值，比例 $r=n_{\mathrm{A}} / n_{\mathrm{B}}$ 将再次表现良好。

question: Which of the following electromagnetic transitions: $$ \frac{1^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} \quad 0^{+} \rightarrow 0^{-} \quad \frac{3^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} \quad 2^{+} \rightarrow 1^{+} \quad 1^{+} \rightarrow 0^{+} $$ are allowed in electric dipole (E1) or magnetic dipole (B1) approximation?
solution: The allowed transitions in electric dipole (E1) or magnetic dipole (B1) approximation are determined by the selection rules. For E1 transitions, the selection rules are: $\Delta J = 0, \pm 1$ (but $J = 0 \nrightarrow J = 0$) and parity changes. For B1 transitions, the selection rules are: $\Delta J = 0, \pm 1$ and parity does not change. Based on these rules, the allowed transitions are: $$ \frac{1^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} $$ (E1 allowed), $$ 0^{+} \rightarrow 0^{-} $$ (not allowed), $$ \frac{3^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} $$ (E1 allowed), $$ 2^{+} \rightarrow 1^{+} $$ (B1 allowed), and $$ 1^{+} \rightarrow 0^{+} $$ (B1 allowed).

question: 以下哪些电磁跃迁：$$ \frac{1^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} \quad 0^{+} \rightarrow 0^{-} \quad \frac{3^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} \quad 2^{+} \rightarrow 1^{+} \quad 1^{+} \rightarrow 0^{+} $$ 在电偶极（E1）或磁偶极（B1）近似中是允许的？
solution: 在电偶极子（E1）或磁偶极子（B1）近似中，允许的跃迁由选择规则决定。对于E1跃迁，选择规则是：$\Delta J = 0, \pm 1$（但$J = 0 \nrightarrow J = 0$）且宇称改变。对于B1跃迁，选择规则是：$\Delta J = 0, \pm 1$且宇称不变。根据这些规则，允许的跃迁是：$$ \frac{1^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} $$（E1允许），$$ 0^{+} \rightarrow 0^{-} $$（不允许），$$ \frac{3^{+}}{2} \rightarrow \frac{1^{-}}{2} $$（E1允许），$$ 2^{+} \rightarrow 1^{+} $$（B1允许），以及$$ 1^{+} \rightarrow 0^{+} $$（B1允许）。

question: The $\rho^{+}$ and $K^{+}$ mesons can both decay into $\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$. What is the total isospin of the $\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$ state for the two decays?
solution: The composition of two isospin-1 particles can give $I=0,1,2$. However, the state $I=0$ cannot contribute since $I_{3}=+1$ for a $\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$ state. For the $\rho$ decay, conservation of isospin by the strong interaction implies $I=1$. The $K^{+} \rightarrow \pi^{+} \pi^{0}$ is instead an electroweak transition, since $\Delta S=1$, which does not conserve isospin. However, the final state is made of two bosons, hence its wave function must be symmetric under exchange of the two particle indices. Since the symmetry of the spatial component of the wavefunction is $(-1)^{L}=+1$, the isospin component has to be symmetric under $\pi^{+} \leftrightarrow \pi^{0}$ exchange, hence $I=2$.

question: $\rho^{+}$ 和 $K^{+}$ 介子都可以衰变为 $\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$。对于这两种衰变，$\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$ 状态的总同位旋是多少？
solution: 两个同位旋为1的粒子组合可以得到$I=0,1,2$。然而，对于$\pi^{+} \pi^{0}$态来说，$I=0$不能贡献，因为$I_{3}=+1$。对于$\rho$衰变，由于强相互作用的同位旋守恒意味着$I=1$。$K^{+} \rightarrow \pi^{+} \pi^{0}$则是一个电弱跃迁，因为$\Delta S=1$，这不守恒同位旋。然而，最终态由两个玻色子组成，因此它的波函数在两个粒子指标交换下必须是对称的。由于波函数空间部分的对称性是$(-1)^{L}=+1$，同位旋部分在$\pi^{+} \leftrightarrow \pi^{0}$交换下必须是对称的，因此$I=2$。

question: Example 1: The position of a point in the frame $S^{\prime}$ moving relative to $S$, with a constant velocity of 10 $\mathrm{cm} / \mathrm{sec}$ along the $X$-axis is given by (11, 9, 8). Calculate its position with respect to the frame $S$, if the two frames were in coincidence only 0.5 second before.
solution:
If the co-ordinates of a point in frame $S^{\prime}$ moving with velocity $\vec{v}$ along $X$-axis relative to a frame $S$ at rest are $\left(x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}\right)$ and $(x, y, z)$ respectively, then the position of the point in stationary frame $S$ are
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & x=x^{\prime}+v t=11+10 \times 0.5=11+5=16 \\
 & y=y^{\prime}=9 \text { and } z=z^{\prime}=8
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Hence in stationary frame $S$ the position of the particle is given by $(16,9,8)$.

question: 例 1: 在以恒定速度 10 $\mathrm{cm} / \mathrm{sec}$ 沿 $X$ 轴相对于 $S$ 移动的 $S^{\prime}$ 参考系中，一个点的位置为 (11, 9, 8)。如果两个参考系在 0.5 秒前重合，计算该点相对于 $S$ 参考系的位置。
solution:
如果在相对于静止参考系 $S$ 沿 $X$ 轴以速度 $\vec{v}$ 运动的参考系 $S^{\prime}$ 中，一个点的坐标分别为 $\left(x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}\right)$ 和 $(x, y, z)$，那么该点在静止参考系 $S$ 中的位置为

$$
\begin{aligned}
& x=x^{\prime}+v t=11+10 \times 0.5=11+5=16 \\
& y=y^{\prime}=9 \text{，} z=z^{\prime}=8
\end{aligned}
$$

因此，在静止参考系 $S$ 中，粒子的位置为 $(16,9,8)$。

question:
Example 10: If at the time $t=t^{\prime}=0$, the origins of systems $S$ and $S^{\prime}$ just coincide and a spherical pulse of light is produced at the common origin, show that the speed of propagation of the spherical wavefront is the same in both systems-namely c. (where system $S^{\prime}$ is moving relative to stationary system $S$ ). or
 Show that the velocity of light is an absolute constant.
 [U.P.T.U, B.Tech I Sem (old) 2009]
solution:
According to the problem, the origin of two systems $S$ and $S^{\prime}$ just coincide at $t=t^{\prime}=0$. The system $S$ is at rest while $S^{\prime}$ is moving with fixed velocity $v$ relative to $S$. Let spherical pulse start from a point where co-ordinates relative to $S$ and $S^{\prime}$ are $(x, y, z, t)$ and $\left(x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}, t^{\prime}\right)$ respectively. We know that
 
 $$
 x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=c^{2} t^{2} \text { and } x^{\prime 2}+y^{\prime 2}+z^{\prime 2}=c^{\prime 2} t^{\prime 2}
 $$
 
 The Lorentz transformation equations are
 
 $$
 x^{\prime}=\frac{x-v t}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}, y^{\prime}=y, z^{\prime}=z \quad \text { and } \quad t^{\prime}=\frac{t-\left(v x / c^{2}\right)}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}
 $$
 
 From equation (1), we have
 
 $$
 c=\frac{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{t} \text { and } c^{\prime}=\frac{\left(x^{\prime 2}+y^{\prime 2}+z^{\prime 2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{t^{\prime}}
 $$
 
 Substituting the values of $x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}$ and $t^{\prime}$ in equation (3) from equation (2), we get
 or
 
 $$
 c^{\prime}=\frac{\left\{\left[(x-v t)^{2} /\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)\right]+y^{2}+z^{2}\right\}^{1 / 2}}{\left[\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right) / \sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}\right]}
 $$
 
 $$
 c^{\prime}=\frac{\left[\left(x-v t)^{2}+\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right)}
 $$
 
 Adding and subtracting a factor of $x^{2}\left(1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)$ in the numerator of equation (4), we get
 
 But,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 c^{\prime} & =\frac{\left[\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)+\left(v^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\left(v^{2} / c^{2}\right) \cdot x^{2}\right)\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right)} \\
 x^{2} & +y^{2}+z^{2}=c^{2} t^{2}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 c^{\prime} & =\frac{\left[c^{2} t^{2}\left(1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)+v^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}} x^{2}\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)} \\
 & =\frac{\left(c^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}} x^{2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)}=\frac{\left[c^{2}\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)^{2}\right]}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)} \text { or } c^{\prime}=c
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Thus, the velocity of light is an absolute constant and is same in both systems or the speed of propagation of the spherical wavefront is same in both systems.

question:
例10：如果在时间 $t=t^{\prime}=0$ 时，系统 $S$ 和 $S^{\prime}$ 的原点恰好重合，并且在共同的原点产生一个球形光脉冲，证明球形波前的传播速度在两个系统中都是相同的，即 $c$。（其中系统 $S^{\prime}$ 相对于静止系统 $S$ 运动）。或者证明光速是一个绝对常数。
[U.P.T.U, B.Tech I Sem (old) 2009]
solution:
根据题目，两个系统 $S$ 和 $S^{\prime}$ 的原点在 $t=t^{\prime}=0$ 时重合。系统 $S$ 静止，而系统 $S^{\prime}$ 以固定速度 $v$ 相对于 $S$ 运动。让球面脉冲从一个点开始，该点相对于 $S$ 和 $S^{\prime}$ 的坐标分别是 $(x, y, z, t)$ 和 $\left(x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}, t^{\prime}\right)$。我们知道

$$
x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=c^{2} t^{2} \text { 和 } x^{\prime 2}+y^{\prime 2}+z^{\prime 2}=c^{\prime 2} t^{\prime 2}
$$

洛伦兹变换方程为

$$
x^{\prime}=\frac{x-v t}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}, y^{\prime}=y, z^{\prime}=z \quad \text { 和 } \quad t^{\prime}=\frac{t-\left(v x / c^{2}\right)}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}
$$

从方程 (1)，我们有

$$
c=\frac{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{t} \text { 和 } c^{\prime}=\frac{\left(x^{\prime 2}+y^{\prime 2}+z^{\prime 2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{t^{\prime}}
$$

将方程 (2) 中 $x^{\prime}, y^{\prime}, z^{\prime}$ 和 $t^{\prime}$ 的值代入方程 (3)，得到

$$
c^{\prime}=\frac{\left\{\left[(x-v t)^{2} /\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)\right]+y^{2}+z^{2}\right\}^{1 / 2}}{\left[\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right) / \sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}\right]}
$$

$$
c^{\prime}=\frac{\left[\left(x-v t)^{2}+\left(y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right)}
$$

在方程 (4) 的分子中加上和减去一个 $x^{2}\left(1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)$ 因子，我们得到

但是，

$$
\begin{aligned}
c^{\prime} & =\frac{\left[\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right)\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)+\left(v^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\left(v^{2} / c^{2}\right) \cdot x^{2}\right)\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-v x / c^{2}\right)} \\
x^{2} & +y^{2}+z^{2}=c^{2} t^{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
c^{\prime} & =\frac{\left[c^{2} t^{2}\left(1-\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}}\right)+v^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}} x^{2}\right]^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)} \\
& =\frac{\left(c^{2} t^{2}-2 x v t+\frac{v^{2}}{c^{2}} x^{2}\right)^{1 / 2}}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)}=\frac{\left[c^{2}\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)^{2}\right]}{\left(t-\frac{v x}{c^{2}}\right)} \text { 或 } c^{\prime}=c
\end{aligned}
$$

因此，光速是一个绝对常数，并且在两个系统中是相同的，或者球面波前的传播速度在两个系统中是相同的。

question: Example 66: A charged particle shows an acceleration of $4.2 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}^{2}$ under an electric field at low speed. Compute the acceleration of the particle under the same field when the speed has reached a value $2.88 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$. The speed of light is $3.0 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$.
solution:
The force acting on a charged particle due to an electric field $E$ is given by
 
 $$
 F=q E
 $$
 
 At low speed $(v \ll c)$ the effective mass of the particle is equal to its rest mass $m_{0}$.
 Therefore, acceleration at low speed is
 
 $$
 a_{0}=\frac{F}{m_{0}}=\frac{q E}{m_{0}}=4.2 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}^{2}
 $$
 
 When the speed of the particle has reached a value $2.88 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$, its mass increases with velocity to an effective value $m$, because $v$ is comparable to $c$. Therefore,
 
 $$
 m=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{\left[1-\left(\frac{2.88 \times 10^{10}}{3.00 \times 10^{10}}\right)^{2}\right]}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{1-0.92}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{0.08}}=\frac{m_{0}}{0.28}
 $$
 
 Therefore, the acceleration at high speed $(v \approx c), a=\frac{F}{m}=\frac{F}{\left(m_{0} / 0.28\right)}=\frac{0.28 F}{m_{0}}$
 Substituting the value of $F / m_{0}$ from equation (2), we get
 
 $$
 a=0.28 \times 4.2 \times 10^{12}=1.176 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{cms}^{-2}
 $$

question: 例66：一个带电粒子在低速下在电场中显示出$4.2 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}^{2}$的加速度。计算当速度达到$2.88 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$时，在相同电场下粒子的加速度。光速为$3.0 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$。
solution:
由于电场 $E$ 作用于带电粒子的力为

$$
F=q E
$$

在低速 $(v \ll c)$ 时，粒子的有效质量等于其静止质量 $m_{0}$。因此，低速时的加速度为

$$
a_{0}=\frac{F}{m_{0}}=\frac{q E}{m_{0}}=4.2 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}^{2}
$$

当粒子的速度达到 $2.88 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{sec}$ 时，由于 $v$ 与 $c$ 相当，其质量随着速度增加到一个有效值 $m$。因此，

$$
m=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{\left(1-v^{2} / c^{2}\right)}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{\left[1-\left(\frac{2.88 \times 10^{10}}{3.00 \times 10^{10}}\right)^{2}\right]}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{1-0.92}}=\frac{m_{0}}{\sqrt{0.08}}=\frac{m_{0}}{0.28}
$$

因此，高速时的加速度 $(v \approx c), a=\frac{F}{m}=\frac{F}{\left(m_{0} / 0.28\right)}=\frac{0.28 F}{m_{0}}$。
从方程 (2) 中代入 $F / m_{0}$ 的值，我们得到

$$
a=0.28 \times 4.2 \times 10^{12}=1.176 \times 10^{12} \mathrm{cms}^{-2}
$$。

question: For $l=50 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $v=1000 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{sec}$, calculate the path difference $\Delta$ between longitudinal and lateral journeys in Michelson-Morley experiment, in terms of wavelength of visible light $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$.
solution: To find the path difference $\Delta$, we use the formula for the Michelson-Morley experiment: $$ \Delta = \frac{2l}{\lambda} \left(\frac{v^2}{c^2}\right), $$ where $c$ is the speed of light, approximately $3 \times 10^8 \mathrm{~m/s}$. First, we need to convert $v$ from meters per second to centimeters per second: $$ v = 1000 \mathrm{~m/s} = 1000 \times 100 \mathrm{~cm/s} = 10^5 \mathrm{~cm/s}. $$ Next, we calculate $\frac{v^2}{c^2}$: $$ \frac{v^2}{c^2} = \left(\frac{10^5}{3 \times 10^{10}}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{3 \times 10^5}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ Then, we plug in the values into the path difference formula: $$ \Delta = \frac{2 \times 50}{5 \times 10^{-5}} \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = \frac{100}{5 \times 10^{-5}} \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ Simplifying further: $$ \Delta = \frac{100}{5} \times 10^5 \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = 20 \times 10^5 \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = \frac{20 \times 10^5}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ Finally, we find: $$ \Delta = \frac{20}{9} \times 10^{-5}. $$ Hence, the path difference $\Delta$ is approximately $2.22 \times 10^{-5}$ wavelengths of visible light.

question: 对于 $l=50 \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $v=1000 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{sec}$，计算在迈克尔逊-莫雷实验中纵向和横向路径之间的光程差 $\Delta$，以可见光的波长 $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 表示。
solution: 为了找到光程差 $\Delta$，我们使用迈克尔逊-莫雷实验的公式：$$ \Delta = \frac{2l}{\lambda} \left(\frac{v^2}{c^2}\right), $$ 其中 $c$ 是光速，大约为 $3 \times 10^8 \mathrm{~m/s}$。首先，我们需要将 $v$ 从米每秒转换为厘米每秒：$$ v = 1000 \mathrm{~m/s} = 1000 \times 100 \mathrm{~cm/s} = 10^5 \mathrm{~cm/s}. $$ 接下来，我们计算 $\frac{v^2}{c^2}$：$$ \frac{v^2}{c^2} = \left(\frac{10^5}{3 \times 10^{10}}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{3 \times 10^5}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ 然后，将这些值代入光程差公式：$$ \Delta = \frac{2 \times 50}{5 \times 10^{-5}} \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = \frac{100}{5 \times 10^{-5}} \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ 进一步简化：$$ \Delta = \frac{100}{5} \times 10^5 \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = 20 \times 10^5 \times \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{10}} = \frac{20 \times 10^5}{9 \times 10^{10}}. $$ 最后，我们得到：$$ \Delta = \frac{20}{9} \times 10^{-5}. $$ 因此，光程差 $\Delta$ 约为 $2.22 \times 10^{-5}$ 个可见光的波长。

question: A projectile is projected with a velocity $v$ at angle $\theta$ from the horizontal in a frame $S$. Show that in another frame $S^{\prime}$ moving with velocity $v \cos \theta$ relative to $S$ along the positive $X$-direction, the projectile will appear to have only vertical motion.
solution:
To solve this problem, we first need to analyze the motion of the projectile in frame $S$. In this frame, the projectile has an initial velocity $v$ with horizontal and vertical components given by $v_x = v \cos \theta$ and $v_y = v \sin \theta$, respectively.

Now, consider the frame $S^{\prime}$ which is moving with a velocity $v \cos \theta$ relative to frame $S$ in the positive $X$-direction. In this new frame, the relative horizontal velocity of the projectile is:

$$ v_x^{\prime} = v_x - v \cos \theta = v \cos \theta - v \cos \theta = 0 $$

Thus, in frame $S^{\prime}$, the projectile has no horizontal motion. The vertical component of the velocity remains unchanged because the relative motion between the frames is purely horizontal. Therefore, in frame $S^{\prime}$, the projectile's velocity is purely vertical with magnitude $v_y = v \sin \theta$.

Hence, in the frame $S^{\prime}$, the projectile appears to have only vertical motion.

question: 一个抛射体以速度 $v$ 以角度 $\theta$ 从水平面在参考系 $S$ 中被发射。证明在另一个相对于 $S$ 以速度 $v \cos \theta$ 沿正 $X$ 方向运动的参考系 $S^{\prime}$ 中，抛射体将显示为只有垂直运动。
solution:
要解决这个问题，我们首先需要分析在参考系 $S$ 中抛射体的运动。在这个参考系中，抛射体具有初速度 $v$，其水平和垂直分量分别为 $v_x = v \cos \theta$ 和 $v_y = v \sin \theta$。

现在，考虑参考系 $S^{\prime}$，它以速度 $v \cos \theta$ 相对于参考系 $S$ 沿正 $X$ 方向运动。在这个新参考系中，抛射体的相对水平速度为：

$$ v_x^{\prime} = v_x - v \cos \theta = v \cos \theta - v \cos \theta = 0 $$

因此，在参考系 $S^{\prime}$ 中，抛射体没有水平运动。由于参考系之间的相对运动是纯水平的，速度的垂直分量保持不变。因此，在参考系 $S^{\prime}$ 中，抛射体的速度是纯垂直的，其大小为 $v_y = v \sin \theta$。

因此，在参考系 $S^{\prime}$ 中，抛射体似乎只有垂直运动。

question:
Example 10: Prove that (i) div curl $\vec{A}=0$ and (ii) curl grad $S=0$ where $\vec{A}$ is a vector and $S$ is a scalar.
 
 #
例 10：证明 (i) div curl $\vec{A}=0$ 和 (ii) curl grad $S=0$，其中 $\vec{A}$ 是一个向量，$S$ 是一个标量。
What does Maxwell's Second Equation state about the divergence of the magnetic field $\vec{B}$?
solution: Maxwell's Second Equation states that the divergence of the magnetic field $\vec{B}$ is zero, i.e., $\operatorname{div} \vec{B}=0$. This implies that magnetic field lines are continuous and form closed loops or go off to infinity, and there is no isolated magnetic pole to serve as a source or sink for the line of magnetic induction $\vec{B}$. Therefore, the net magnetic flux of magnetic induction $\vec{B}$ through any closed Gaussian surface is always zero, as given by $\phi_{B}=\oint_{S} \vec{B} \cdot \overrightarrow{d S}=0$. This equation is analogous to Gauss's law in electrostatics and is true in both free space and material medium.

question: 麦克斯韦第二方程关于磁场 $\vec{B}$ 的散度说明了什么？
solution: 麦克斯韦第二方程指出，磁场 $\vec{B}$ 的散度为零，即 $\operatorname{div} \vec{B}=0$。这意味着磁场线是连续的，形成闭合回路或者延伸到无穷远处，并且没有孤立的磁极作为磁感应线 $\vec{B}$ 的源或汇。因此，通过任何闭合高斯面的磁感应 $\vec{B}$ 的净磁通量始终为零，如公式所示：$\phi_{B}=\oint_{S} \vec{B} \cdot \overrightarrow{d S}=0$。这个方程类似于静电学中的高斯定律，并且在自由空间和物质介质中都成立。

 $$

 $$

question:
Example 24 : If the earth receives $2 \mathrm{cal} \mathrm{min}^{-1} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}$ solar energy, what are the amplitudes of electric and magnetic fields of radiation?
 [UPTU, B.Tech. I Sem. 2007, I and II Sem. 2002]
solution:
The energy transported by an electromagnetic wave per unit area per sec during propagation is represented by Poynting vector $\vec{S}$ as
 
 $$
 \vec{S}=(\vec{E} \times \vec{H})
 $$
 
 The energy flux per unit area per second is
 
 $$
 |\vec{S}|=|\vec{E} \times \vec{H}|=E H \sin 90^{\circ}=E H \quad(\because E \text { is perpendicular to } H)
 $$
 
 The energy flux per unit area per second at the earth surface,
 
 $$
 |\vec{S}|=2 \mathrm{cal} \mathrm{~min}^{-1} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}=\frac{2 \times 4.2 \times 10^{4}}{60} \text { joule } \mathrm{m}^{-2} \sec ^{-1}
 $$
 
 (Given in the problem)
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & |S|=E H=\frac{2 \times 4.2 \times 10^{4}}{60}=1400 \\
 & \text { But, } \quad \frac{E}{H}=\sqrt{\frac{\mu_{0}}{\varepsilon_{0}}}=\sqrt{\frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7}}{8.85 \times 10^{-12}}}=376.72 \mathrm{ohms}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Multiplying equations (1) and (2), we get
 
 $$
 E H \times(E / H)=1400 \times 376.72 \text { or } E^{2}=5.274 \times 10^{5}
 $$
 
 or
 
 $$
 \mathbf{E}=726.2 \mathrm{Vm}^{-1}
 $$
 
 Substituting this value of $E$ in equation (1), we get
 
 $$
 (726.2) H=1400 \quad \text { or } \quad H=\frac{1400}{726.2}=1.928 \mathbf{A}-\text { turn } \mathbf{m}^{-1}
 $$
 
 Therefore, the amplitudes of electric and magnetic fields of radiation are
 
 $$
 E_{0}=E \sqrt{2}=726.2 \sqrt{2}=1026.8 \mathrm{Vm}^{-1} \text { and } H_{0}=H \sqrt{2}=1.928 \sqrt{2}=2.726 \mathbf{A}-\text { turn } \mathbf{m}^{-1}
 $$

question:
例题 24：如果地球接收到 $2 \mathrm{cal} \mathrm{min}^{-1} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}$ 的太阳能量，辐射的电场和磁场的振幅是多少？
 [UPTU, B.Tech. I Sem. 2007, I and II Sem. 2002]
solution:
电磁波在传播过程中每秒每单位面积传输的能量由坡印廷矢量 $\vec{S}$ 表示为

$$
\vec{S}=(\vec{E} \times \vec{H})
$$

每秒每单位面积的能流为

$$
|\vec{S}|=|\vec{E} \times \vec{H}|=E H \sin 90^{\circ}=E H \quad(\because E \text{ 与 } H \text{ 垂直})
$$

地表每秒每单位面积的能流为，

$$
|\vec{S}|=2 \mathrm{cal} \mathrm{~min}^{-1} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}=\frac{2 \times 4.2 \times 10^{4}}{60} \text{ 焦耳 } \mathrm{m}^{-2} \sec^{-1}
$$

（题目中给定）

$$
\begin{aligned}
& |S|=E H=\frac{2 \times 4.2 \times 10^{4}}{60}=1400 \\
& \text{但是，} \quad \frac{E}{H}=\sqrt{\frac{\mu_{0}}{\varepsilon_{0}}}=\sqrt{\frac{4 \pi \times 10^{-7}}{8.85 \times 10^{-12}}}=376.72 \mathrm{欧姆}
\end{aligned}
$$

将方程 (1) 和 (2) 相乘，我们得到

$$
E H \times(E / H)=1400 \times 376.72 \text{ 或 } E^{2}=5.274 \times 10^{5}
$$

或者

$$
\mathbf{E}=726.2 \mathrm{Vm}^{-1}
$$

将这个 $E$ 的值代入方程 (1)，我们得到

$$
(726.2) H=1400 \quad \text{ 或 } \quad H=\frac{1400}{726.2}=1.928 \mathbf{A}-\text{ 匝 } \mathbf{m}^{-1}
$$

因此，辐射的电场和磁场的振幅为

$$
E_{0}=E \sqrt{2}=726.2 \sqrt{2}=1026.8 \mathrm{Vm}^{-1} \text{ 和 } H_{0}=H \sqrt{2}=1.928 \sqrt{2}=2.726 \mathbf{A}-\text{ 匝 } \mathbf{m}^{-1}
$$

question: Example 30: A plane electromagnetic wave propagating in the $X$-direction has a wavelength 7.0 mm . The electric field is in the $Y$-direction and its maximum magnitude is $42 \mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}$. Write suitable equations for the electric and magnetic fields as a function of $x$ and $t$.
solution:
The equations of electric and magnetic fields of a plane electromagnetic wave propagating in $X$-direction is given by
 
 We know that,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & E=E_{0} \sin \omega(t-x / c) \text { and } B=B_{0} \sin \omega(t-x / c) \\
 & \omega=2 \pi v=\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda} c \\
 & E=E_{0} \sin \left[\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}(c t-x)\right] \quad \text { and } \quad B=B_{0} \sin \left[\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}(c t-x)\right] \\
 & E_{0}=42(\mathrm{~V} / \mathrm{m}) \text { and } \lambda=7.0 \mathrm{~mm} \\
 & \therefore \quad E=42 \sin \left[\frac{2 \pi}{7}(c t-x)\right]
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Here,
 The maximum magnetic field $B_{0}$ is
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & B_{0}=\frac{E_{0}}{c}=\frac{42}{3.0 \times 10^{8}}=1.4 \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{Weber} / \mathrm{m}^{2} \text { or } 1.4 \times 10^{-7} \text { tesla } \\
 & B=1.4 \times 10^{-7} \sin \left[\frac{2 \pi}{7}(c t-x)\right]
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Hence,
 
 The magnetic field is along $Z$-axis.

question:
Example 10: White light falls normally on a film of a soapy water whose thickness is $1.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ and refractive index 1.33. Which wavelength in the visible region will be reflected strongly?
 [GBTU, B.Tech I Sem 2012, I Sem (C.O.) 2012]
solution:
When light falls normally $\left(r=0^{\circ}\right)$ on a film the condition of maxima is,
 
 $$
 2 \mu t=(2 n+1) \lambda / 2, \text { where } n=0,1,2, \ldots
 $$
 
 Here
 
 $$
 t=1.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \text { and } \mu=1.33
 $$
 
 $\therefore \quad \lambda=\frac{4 \mu t}{(2 n+1)}=\frac{4 \times 1.33 \times 1.5 \times 10^{-5}}{(2 n+1)}=\frac{7.98 \times 10^{-5}}{(2 n+1)}$
 For
 
 $$
 \begin{array}{lll}
 n=0 & \lambda=\frac{7.98 \times 10^{-5}}{1} & \text { or } \quad \lambda=7.98 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \\
 n=1 & \lambda_{1}=\frac{7.98 \times 10^{-5}}{3} & \text { or } \quad \lambda_{1}=2.66 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 \end{array}
 $$
 
 $$
 \begin{array}{lll}
 n=2 & \lambda_{2}=\frac{7.98 \times 10^{-5}}{5} \text { or } & \lambda_{2}=1.596 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \\
 n=3 & \lambda_{3}=\frac{7.98 \times 10^{-5}}{7} \text { or } & \lambda_{3}=1.14 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 \end{array}
 $$
 
 Out of above wavelengths only $7.98 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ or $7980 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~cm}$ lies near the upper limit of visible region $\left(4.0 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right.$ to $\left.7.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right)$. Hence, wavelength $7980 \AA$ is most strongly reflected.

solution:

question: Determination of Wavelength of Sodium Light Using Newton's Ring
solution: To determine the wavelength of sodium light using Newton's rings, set up an experimental apparatus with a plano-convex lens placed on a flat glass plate. Illuminate the setup with sodium light. Observe the concentric rings formed due to the interference of light. Measure the diameter of several rings and use the formula for Newton's rings to calculate the wavelength: $$\lambda = \frac{D_m^2 - D_n^2}{4(m-n)R}$$ where \(D_m\) and \(D_n\) are the diameters of the m-th and n-th rings, respectively, and \(R\) is the radius of curvature of the lens.

question: 利用牛顿环测定钠光的波长。
solution: 为了利用牛顿环测定钠光的波长，搭建一个实验装置，将一个平凸透镜放置在一块平玻璃板上。用钠光照亮该装置。观察由于光的干涉而形成的同心环。测量几个环的直径，并使用牛顿环公式计算波长：$$\lambda = \frac{D_m^2 - D_n^2}{4(m-n)R}$$ 其中 \(D_m\) 和 \(D_n\) 分别是第 m 个和第 n 个环的直径，\(R\) 是透镜的曲率半径。

question:
Example 23: A square piece of cellophane film with index of refraction 1.5 has a wedge shaped section so that its thickness at two opposite sides is $t_{1}$ and $t_{2}$. If the number of fringes appearing with wavelength $\lambda=6000 \AA$ is 10 , calculate the difference $\left(t_{1}-t_{2}\right)$.
 [UPTU, B.Tech. II Sem. 2008]
solution:
If the order of the fringe appearing at one end of the film be $n$, then the order of the fringe appearing at other end will be $(n+10)$. For $n$th and $(n+10)$ th dark fringes.
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & 2 \mu t_{1} \cos r=n \lambda \\
 & 2 \mu t_{2} \cos r=(n+10) \lambda
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Subtracting equation (1) from equation (2), we get
 
 $$
 2 \mu\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right) \cos r=10 \lambda
 $$
 
 If the fringe is seen normally and the angle of wedge is very small, then $r=0$, so that
 
 $$
 \cos r=1
 $$
 
 Substituting the value of $\cos r$ from eqn. (4) to eqn. (3), we get
 
 $$
 2 \mu\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)=10 \lambda \text { or } t_{2}-t_{1}=\frac{10 \lambda}{2 \mu}=\frac{5 \lambda}{\mu}
 $$
 
 Here $\mu=1.5$ and $\lambda=6000 \AA=6000 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad t_{2}-t_{1}=\frac{5 \times 6000 \times 10^{-3}}{1.5}=2 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$

question:

$$

将方程 (1) 从方程 (2) 中减去，我们得到

$$
2 \mu\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right) \cos r=10 \lambda
$$

如果条纹是正常看到的，并且楔角非常小，那么 $r=0$，因此

\cos r=1
$$

将 $\cos r$ 的值从方程 (4) 代入方程 (3)，我们得到

这里 $\mu=1.5$ 且 $\lambda=6000 \AA=6000 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$

question: Example 29: The lower surface of a lens resting on a plane glass plate has a radius of curvature of 400 cm. When illuminated by monochromatic light, the arrangement produces Newton's rings and the $15^{\text {th }}$ bright ring has a diameter of 1.16 cm . Calculate the wavelength of the monochromatic light.
solution:
The diameter of $n^{\text {th }}$ bright ring is given by
 
 $$
 D_{n}^{2}=\frac{2(2 n-1) \lambda R}{\mu} \text { where } n=1,2,3, \ldots
 $$
 
 In the given problem, $n=15, D_{15}=1.16 \mathrm{~cm}, R=400 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $\mu=1$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad \lambda=\frac{D_{n}^{2}}{2(2 n-1) R}=\frac{1.16 \times 1.16}{2 \times 29 \times 400}=5429 \AA=5429 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$

question: 例29：一个透镜的下表面放在一个平面玻璃板上，其曲率半径为400 cm。当用单色光照射时，该装置产生牛顿环，并且第15个亮环的直径为1.16 cm。计算单色光的波长。

question: Example 35: A Newton's ring arrangement is used with a source emitting two wavelengths $\lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ and $\lambda_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ and it is found that the $n^{\text {th }}$ dark ring due to $\lambda_{1}$ coincides with $(n+1)^{\text {th }}$ dark ring due to $\lambda_{2}$. If the radius of curvature of the curved surface is 90 cm , find the diameter of the $n^{\text {th }}$ dark ring for $\lambda_{1}$.
solution:
Let $D_{n}$ be the diameter of $n^{\text {th }}$ dark ring and $D_{n+1}$ is that of $(n+1)^{\text {th }}$ dark ring, then
 
 $$
 D_{n}^{2}=\frac{4 n \lambda_{1} R}{\mu} \text { and } D^{2}{ }_{n+1}=\frac{4(n+1) \lambda_{2} R}{\mu}
 $$
 
 According to the problem, $n^{\text {th }}$ dark ring due to $\lambda_{1}$ coincides with $(n+1)^{\text {th }}$ dark ring due to $\lambda_{2}$. Thus
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 D_{n}^{2} & =D^{2}{ }_{n+1} \text { or } \frac{4 n \lambda_{1} R}{\mu}=\frac{4(n+1) \lambda_{2} R}{\mu} \\
 \therefore \quad n \lambda_{1} & =(n+1) \lambda_{2} \text { or } n\left(\lambda_{1}-\lambda_{2}\right)=\lambda_{2} \\
 n & =\frac{\lambda_{2}}{\left(\lambda_{1}-\lambda_{2}\right)} \text { Here } \lambda_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \text { and } \lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \\
 \therefore \quad n & =\frac{4.5 \times 10^{-5}}{(6-4.5) \times 10^{-5}}=\frac{4.5 \times 10^{-5}}{1.5 \times 10^{-5}}=3 \text { Here } R=90 \mathrm{~cm}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 The diameter of $n^{\text {th }}$ dark ring, $D_{n}{ }^{2}=\frac{4 \times 3 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 90}{\mu}$
 for air film $\mu=1, D_{n}=\sqrt{ }\left(4 \times 3 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 90\right)=0.2538 \mathrm{~cm}$

question: 例 35：在一个牛顿环装置中，使用一个发射两个波长 $\lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $\lambda_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 的光源，发现由于 $\lambda_{1}$ 产生的第 $n$ 个暗环与由于 $\lambda_{2}$ 产生的第 $(n+1)$ 个暗环重合。如果曲面半径为 90 cm，求出对于 $\lambda_{1}$ 的第 $n$ 个暗环的直径。
solution:
设 $D_{n}$ 为第 $n$ 个暗环的直径，$D_{n+1}$ 为第 $(n+1)$ 个暗环的直径，那么

$$
D_{n}^{2}=\frac{4 n \lambda_{1} R}{\mu} \text{ 且 } D^{2}_{n+1}=\frac{4(n+1) \lambda_{2} R}{\mu}
$$

根据题目，由于 $\lambda_{1}$ 的第 $n$ 个暗环与 $\lambda_{2}$ 的第 $(n+1)$ 个暗环重合。因此

$$
\begin{aligned}
D_{n}^{2} & =D^{2}_{n+1} \text{ 或 } \frac{4 n \lambda_{1} R}{\mu}=\frac{4(n+1) \lambda_{2} R}{\mu} \\
\therefore \quad n \lambda_{1} & =(n+1) \lambda_{2} \text{ 或 } n\left(\lambda_{1}-\lambda_{2}\right)=\lambda_{2} \\
n & =\frac{\lambda_{2}}{\left(\lambda_{1}-\lambda_{2}\right)} \text{ 这里 } \lambda_{2}=4.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \text{ 且 } \lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \\
\therefore \quad n & =\frac{4.5 \times 10^{-5}}{(6-4.5) \times 10^{-5}}=\frac{4.5 \times 10^{-5}}{1.5 \times 10^{-5}}=3 \text{ 这里 } R=90 \mathrm{~cm}
\end{aligned}
$$

第 $n$ 个暗环的直径，$D_{n}^{2}=\frac{4 \times 3 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 90}{\mu}$
对于空气膜 $\mu=1, D_{n}=\sqrt{}\left(4 \times 3 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 90\right)=0.2538 \mathrm{~cm}$

question: Example 39: A non- reflecting layer is to be deposited. What would be the necessary thickness for zero reflection at $5500 \AA$ ? The refractive index of layer is 1.334 .
solution:
Necessary thickness of the non-reflecting layer for zero reflection is given by
 
 $$
 t=\frac{\lambda}{4 \mu_{f}}
 $$
 
 Here $\lambda=5500 \AA$ and $\mu_{f}=1.334$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad t=\frac{5500 \times 10^{-8}}{4 \times 1.334}=1.0307 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
