question:
Example 13: A lens of focal length 100 cm forms Fraunhofer diffraction pattern of a single slit of width 0.04 cm in its focal plane. The incident light contains two wavelengths $\lambda_{1}$ and $\lambda_{2}$. It is found that the fourth minimum corresponding to $\lambda_{1}$ and the fifth minimum corresponding to $\lambda_{2}$ occur at the same point 0.5 cm from the central maximum. Compute $\lambda_{1}$ and $\lambda_{2}$.
 [M.T.U., B.Tech I Sem. 2012]
solution:
In the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern due to a single slit of width $a$, the directions of minima are given by
 
 $$
 a \sin \theta= \pm n \lambda
 $$
 
 For wavelength $\lambda_{1}$, the direction of fourth minimum $(n=4)$ is given by
 
 $$
 a \sin \theta_{1}=4 \lambda_{1}
 $$
 
 Similarly, for wavelength $\lambda_{2}$, the direction of fifth minimum $(n=5)$ is given by
 
 $$
 a \sin \theta_{2}=5 \lambda_{2}
 $$
 
 According to the problem, the direction of fourth minimum $\left(\theta_{1}\right)$ due to $\lambda_{1}$ and the fifth minimum $\left(\theta_{2}\right)$ due to $\lambda_{2}$ occur at the same point, that is, $\theta_{1}=\theta_{2}=\theta$
 
 Therefore,
 
 $$
 a \sin \theta=4 \lambda_{1}=5 \lambda_{2}
 $$
 
 [from eqn. (1) and (2)]...(3)
 If $x$ is the linear distance of fourth minimum for $\lambda_{1}$ or fifth minimum for $\lambda_{2}$, we have $\theta=x / f$ (as $\theta$ is small), where $f$ is the focal length of the lens.
 
 Here,
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & x=0.5 \mathrm{~cm} \text { and } f=100 \mathrm{~cm} \\
 & \therefore \quad \theta=0.5 / 100=0.005 \mathrm{rad}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 From eqn. (3), we have, $a \sin \theta=4 \lambda_{1}$
 or
 
 $$
 \lambda_{1}=\frac{a \sin \theta}{4}=\frac{a \theta}{4} \quad \text { (as } \theta \text { is small) }
 $$
 
 Here $a=0.04 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $\theta=0.005 \mathrm{rad}$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad \lambda_{1}=\frac{0.04 \times 0.005}{4}=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 Substituting value of $\lambda_{1}$ in eqn. (3), we have
 
 $$
 \lambda_{2}=\frac{4 \lambda_{1}}{5}=\frac{4 \times 5 \times 10^{-5}}{5}=4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$

solution:
The width of central maximum, $2 r=\frac{2 f \lambda}{a}$
 Here $f=100 \mathrm{~cm}, \lambda=4500 \AA=4500 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~cm}$ and $a=10^{-2} \mathrm{~cm}$
 $\therefore \quad$ width of central maximum, $2 r=\frac{2 \times 100 \times 4500 \times 10^{-8}}{10^{-2}}=0.9 \mathrm{~cm}$

question: 例 15：在获得单缝衍射的过程中，所用透镜的焦距为 100 cm，光的波长为 $4500 \AA$，缝宽为 $10^{-2} \mathrm{~cm}$。求中央极大值的宽度。
solution:
中央最大值的宽度，$2 r=\frac{2 f \lambda}{a}$。  
这里 $f=100 \mathrm{~cm}, \lambda=4500 \AA=4500 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~cm}$ 且 $a=10^{-2} \mathrm{~cm}$。  
$\therefore \quad$ 中央最大值的宽度，$2 r=\frac{2 \times 100 \times 4500 \times 10^{-8}}{10^{-2}}=0.9 \mathrm{~cm}$。

question: Example 22: In a plane transmission grating the angle of diffraction for the second order principal maxima for $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ is $30^{\circ}$. Calculate the number of lines in one cm of the grating surface.
solution:
The grating equation for normal incidence is given by $(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$ where $(a+b)$ is the grating element, $n$ is the order of maxima and $\theta$ the angle of diffraction
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad(a+b)=\frac{n \lambda}{\sin \theta}
 $$
 
 The number of lines in one $\mathrm{cm}=\frac{1}{(a+b)} \quad \therefore \quad \frac{1}{(a+b)}=\frac{\sin \theta}{n \lambda}$
 Here,
 
 $$
 n=2, \theta=30^{\circ} \text { and } \lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 $\therefore \quad \frac{1}{(a+b)}=\frac{\sin 30^{\circ}}{2 \times 5 \times 10^{-5}}=\frac{10^{5}}{2 \times 2 \times 5}=5000$
 Therefore, the number of lines in one cm of the grating surface is 5000 .

question: 例22：在一个平面光栅中，对于波长 $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 的二级主极大角的衍射角为 $30^{\circ}$。计算光栅表面每厘米的刻线数。
solution:
对于法向入射，光栅方程为 $(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$，其中 $(a+b)$ 是光栅元素，$n$ 是极大值的级数，$\theta$ 是衍射角。

$$
\therefore \quad(a+b)=\frac{n \lambda}{\sin \theta}
$$

每厘米的线数为 $\frac{1}{(a+b)} \quad \therefore \quad \frac{1}{(a+b)}=\frac{\sin \theta}{n \lambda}$
在此，

$$
n=2, \theta=30^{\circ} \text{ 且 } \lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
$$

$\therefore \quad \frac{1}{(a+b)}=\frac{\sin 30^{\circ}}{2 \times 5 \times 10^{-5}}=\frac{10^{5}}{2 \times 2 \times 5}=5000$
因此，光栅表面每厘米的线数为 5000。

question: Example 28: Parallel light consisting of two monochromatic irradiations of $\lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ and $\lambda_{2}=4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ falls normally on a plane transmission grating ruled with 5000 lines per cm . What is the angular separation of the second order spectra of the two wavelengths?
solution:
Positions of principle maxima are
 
 $$
 (a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda
 $$
 
 Here
 
 $$
 n=2, \lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \text { and } a+b=\frac{1}{5000} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 $\therefore \quad \sin \theta_{1}=2 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 5000=0.6 \quad$ or $\quad \theta_{1}=\sin ^{-1}(0.6)=36.87^{\circ}$
 Similarly, for second monochromatic radiation of wavelength $\lambda_{2}=4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$, we have
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & \sin \theta_{2}=\frac{n \lambda_{2}}{(a+b)}=2 \times 4 \times 10^{-5} \times 5000=0.4 \\
 & \therefore \quad \theta_{2}=\sin ^{-1}(0.4)=23.58^{\circ}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 Hence, angular separation, $\quad \theta_{2}-\theta_{1}=36.87^{\circ}-23.58^{\circ}=13.29^{\circ}$

question: 例 28：由两个单色光辐射组成的平行光，其波长为 $\lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $\lambda_{2}=4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$，垂直照射到每厘米刻有 5000 条线的平面透射光栅上。这两个波长的二级谱线的角分离是多少？
solution:
主极大值的位置是

$$(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$$

这里

$$n=2, \lambda_{1}=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm} \text { 和 } a+b=\frac{1}{5000} \mathrm{~cm}$$

因此，$\sin \theta_{1}=2 \times 6 \times 10^{-5} \times 5000=0.6 \quad$ 或 $\quad \theta_{1}=\sin ^{-1}(0.6)=36.87^{\circ}$。类似地，对于波长为 $\lambda_{2}=4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 的第二种单色辐射，我们有

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \sin \theta_{2}=\frac{n \lambda_{2}}{(a+b)}=2 \times 4 \times 10^{-5} \times 5000=0.4 \\
& \therefore \quad \theta_{2}=\sin ^{-1}(0.4)=23.58^{\circ}
\end{aligned}
$$

因此，角分离为，$\quad \theta_{2}-\theta_{1}=36.87^{\circ}-23.58^{\circ}=13.29^{\circ}$。

question: Example 37: What is the highest order spectrum which may be seen with light of wavelength $5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ by means of a grating with 3000 lines per centimetres. Calculate the wavelengths in the visible spectrum $\left(3.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}-7.0 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right)$ which coincide with the fifth spectrum of this light.
solution:
We know that,
 
 $$
 (a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda
 $$
 
 the maximum values of $\theta$ is $90^{\circ}$, that is, $\sin \theta=1$. Therefore the highest order visible with the grating will be given by
 
 $$
 n_{\max }=\frac{(a+b) \sin 90^{\circ}}{\lambda}=\frac{(a+b)}{\lambda}
 $$
 
 In the given problem, $(a+b)=1 / 3000 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad n_{\max }=\frac{(1 / 3000)}{\left(5 \times 10^{-5}\right)}=6.6
 $$
 
 Thus the highest order which may be visible with the grating is 6 .
 
 The direction of the fifth order $(n=5)$ spectrum of wavelength $\lambda$ is given by $(a+b) \sin \theta_{5}=5 \lambda$
 Let $\lambda^{\prime}$ be the other wavelength falling in the same direction $\theta_{5}$, then
 
 $$
 (a+b) \sin \theta_{5}=5 \lambda=(5 \pm n) \lambda^{\prime}, \text { where } n=1,2,3, \ldots
 $$
 
 $\therefore \quad 5 \lambda=(5 \pm n) \lambda^{\prime} \quad$ or $\lambda^{\prime}=\frac{5 \lambda}{(5 \pm n)} \quad$ Here $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$
 $\therefore \quad \lambda^{\prime}=\frac{5 \times 5 \times 10^{-5}}{(5 \pm n)}=\frac{25}{(5 \pm n)} \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$. Substituting $n=1,2,3, \ldots$ we get
 
 $$
 \lambda^{\prime}=(4.1,6.2,3.6,8.3,3.1,12.5, \ldots) \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 out of these, the wavelengths in the visible region $\left(3.5 \times 10^{-5}-7.0 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right)$ are $3.6 \times 10^{-5}$, $4.1 \times 10^{-5}$ and $6.2 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$.

question: 例37：使用光栅（每厘米3000条线）观察波长为$5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$的光时，可能看到的最高级数光谱是多少。计算在可见光谱范围内$\left(3.5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}-7.0 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right)$与该光的第五级光谱重合的波长。
solution:
我们知道，

$$(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$$

$\theta$ 的最大值是 $90^{\circ}$，即 $\sin \theta=1$。因此，光栅可见的最高级次由下式给出

$$n_{\max }=\frac{(a+b) \sin 90^{\circ}}{\lambda}=\frac{(a+b)}{\lambda}$$

在给定的问题中，$(a+b)=1 / 3000 \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$

$$\therefore \quad n_{\max }=\frac{(1 / 3000)}{\left(5 \times 10^{-5}\right)}=6.6$$

因此，光栅可见的最高级次是 6。

波长为 $\lambda$ 的第五级 $(n=5)$ 光谱的方向由 $(a+b) \sin \theta_{5}=5 \lambda$ 给出。设 $\lambda^{\prime}$ 为落在相同方向 $\theta_{5}$ 的另一个波长，则

$$(a+b) \sin \theta_{5}=5 \lambda=(5 \pm n) \lambda^{\prime}, \text { 其中 } n=1,2,3, \ldots$$

$\therefore \quad 5 \lambda=(5 \pm n) \lambda^{\prime} \quad$ 或 $\lambda^{\prime}=\frac{5 \lambda}{(5 \pm n)} \quad$ 这里 $\lambda=5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$

$\therefore \quad \lambda^{\prime}=\frac{5 \times 5 \times 10^{-5}}{(5 \pm n)}=\frac{25}{(5 \pm n)} \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$。代入 $n=1,2,3, \ldots$ 我们得到

$$\lambda^{\prime}=(4.1,6.2,3.6,8.3,3.1,12.5, \ldots) \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$$

在这些波长中，可见光区域 $\left(3.5 \times 10^{-5}-7.0 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}\right)$ 内的波长是 $3.6 \times 10^{-5}$, $4.1 \times 10^{-5}$ 和 $6.2 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$。

question: What other spectral lines in the range $4000 \AA$ to $7000 \AA$ will coincide with the fifth order line of $6000 \AA$ in a grating spectrum?
solution:
To find the spectral lines that coincide with the fifth order line of $6000 \AA$, we use the grating equation: $m \lambda = d \sin \theta$, where $m$ is the order, $\lambda$ is the wavelength, $d$ is the grating spacing, and $\theta$ is the angle of diffraction.

For the fifth order line of $6000 \AA$, we have:
$$
m = 5, \lambda = 6000 \AA
$$
We are looking for other wavelengths $\lambda'$ that coincide with this line in different orders $m'$:
$$
m' \lambda' = 5 \times 6000 \AA
$$
Thus,
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{m'}
$$
We need $\lambda'$ to be within the range $4000 \AA$ to $7000 \AA$. Solving for $m'$:

For $\lambda' = 4000 \AA$:
$$
\frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{4000 \AA} = 7.5
$$
Since $m'$ must be an integer, this is not possible.

For $\lambda' = 7000 \AA$:
$$
\frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{7000 \AA} \approx 4.29
$$
Since $m'$ must be an integer, this is also not possible.

Checking for integer values of $m'$ within this range:
- For $m' = 6$:
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{6} = 5000 \AA
$$
- For $m' = 4$:
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{4} = 7500 \AA
$$
Since $7500 \AA$ is outside the given range, it is not possible.

Thus, the only spectral line within the range $4000 \AA$ to $7000 \AA$ that coincides with the fifth order line of $6000 \AA$ is at $5000 \AA$ in the sixth order.

question: 在光栅光谱中，$4000 \AA$ 到 $7000 \AA$ 范围内的其他哪些谱线会与 $6000 \AA$ 的五级谱线重合？
solution:
为了找到与$6000 \AA$的五级谱线重合的谱线，我们使用光栅方程：$m \lambda = d \sin \theta$，其中$m$是级数，$\lambda$是波长，$d$是光栅间距，$\theta$是衍射角。

对于$6000 \AA$的五级谱线，我们有：
$$
m = 5, \lambda = 6000 \AA
$$
我们寻找在不同级数$m'$下与此谱线重合的其他波长$\lambda'$：
$$
m' \lambda' = 5 \times 6000 \AA
$$
因此，
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{m'}
$$
我们需要$\lambda'$在$4000 \AA$到$7000 \AA$的范围内。求解$m'$：

对于$\lambda' = 4000 \AA$：
$$
\frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{4000 \AA} = 7.5
$$
由于$m'$必须是整数，这是不可能的。

对于$\lambda' = 7000 \AA$：
$$
\frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{7000 \AA} \approx 4.29
$$
由于$m'$必须是整数，这也是不可能的。

检查此范围内$m'$的整数值：
- 对于$m' = 6$：
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{6} = 5000 \AA
$$
- 对于$m' = 4$：
$$
\lambda' = \frac{5 \times 6000 \AA}{4} = 7500 \AA
$$
由于$7500 \AA$超出给定范围，这是不可能的。

因此，唯一在$4000 \AA$到$7000 \AA$范围内与$6000 \AA$的五级谱线重合的谱线是在第六级的$5000 \AA$。

question: Example 40: For a grating with grating element $(a+b)=18000 \AA$, calculate the dispersive powers in the first and third order spectra around $\lambda=5000 \AA$, assuming normal incidence.
例40：对于光栅元素为 $(a+b)=18000 \AA$ 的光栅，计算在 $\lambda=5000 \AA$ 附近的第一和第三级光谱的色散能力，假设为垂直入射。

Example 42: A set of 10 parallel equidistant slits of width 0.50 cm and opaque space 1.4 cm are used to study Fraunhofer diffraction of $\lambda=0.6 \mathrm{~cm}$, falling normally on the planes of the slits. Calculate:
 (i) angular position and half width of first maximum.
 (ii) the effect of covering up alternative slits on angular position and width of first maximum.
solution:
(i) The position of principle maxima is given by
 
 $$
 (a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda \text { or } \sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{a+b}
 $$
 
 Here
 
 $$
 \begin{gathered}
 n=1, \lambda=0.6 \mathrm{~cm} \text { and }(a+b)=0.5+1.4=1.9 \mathrm{~cm} \\
 \sin \theta=\frac{1 \times 0.6}{1.9}=0.3158 \text { or } \theta=\sin ^{-1}(0.3158)=18.41^{\circ}
 \end{gathered}
 $$
 
 Half angular width of first maxima is given by
 
 $$
 d \theta_{n}=\frac{\lambda}{N(a+b) \cos \theta_{n}}
 $$
 
 Here
 
 $$
 N=10, a+b=1.9 \mathrm{~cm}, \cos \theta_{n}=\cos \left(18.41^{\circ}\right)=0.9488
 $$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad d \theta_{n}=\frac{0.6}{10 \times 1.9 \times 0.9488} \mathrm{rad}=\left(\frac{0.6 \times 180}{10 \times 1.9 \times 0.9488 \times 3.14}\right)^{\circ}=19^{\circ}
 $$
 
 (ii) When alternate slits are covered the grating element becomes,
 
 $$
 a+b=1.0+2.8=3.8 \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 However, $N(a+b)$ remain unchanged
 Therefore, the direction of principle maxima
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & \sin \theta=\frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\frac{0.6}{3.8}=0.1579 \\
 & \therefore \quad \theta=\sin ^{-1}(0.1579)=9.08^{\circ} \\
 & \text { Here } \quad \cos \theta_{n}=\cos \left(9.08^{\circ}\right)=0.9874
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 The width of first maximum, $2 d \theta_{n}=\frac{\lambda}{N(a+b) \cos \theta_{n}}=\frac{2 \times 0.6 \times 180}{5 \times 3.8 \times 0.9874 \times 3.14}=3.66^{\circ}$

question:
例42：一组10个平行等距的狭缝，宽度为0.50 cm，不透明间隔为1.4 cm，用于研究波长$\lambda=0.6 \mathrm{~cm}$的夫琅禾费衍射，光线垂直入射到狭缝平面上。计算：
(i) 第一个极大值的角位置和半宽度。
(ii) 覆盖交替狭缝对第一个极大值的角位置和宽度的影响。
solution:
(i) 主极大值的位置由以下公式给出

$$
(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda \text { 或 } \sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{a+b}
$$

这里

$$
\begin{gathered}
n=1, \lambda=0.6 \mathrm{~cm} \text { 且 }(a+b)=0.5+1.4=1.9 \mathrm{~cm} \\
\sin \theta=\frac{1 \times 0.6}{1.9}=0.3158 \text { 或 } \theta=\sin ^{-1}(0.3158)=18.41^{\circ}
\end{gathered}
$$

第一个极大值的半角宽度由以下公式给出

$$
d \theta_{n}=\frac{\lambda}{N(a+b) \cos \theta_{n}}
$$

这里

$$
N=10, a+b=1.9 \mathrm{~cm}, \cos \theta_{n}=\cos \left(18.41^{\circ}\right)=0.9488
$$

$$
\therefore \quad d \theta_{n}=\frac{0.6}{10 \times 1.9 \times 0.9488} \mathrm{rad}=\left(\frac{0.6 \times 180}{10 \times 1.9 \times 0.9488 \times 3.14}\right)^{\circ}=19^{\circ}
$$

(ii) 当交替的狭缝被覆盖时，光栅元件变为

$$
a+b=1.0+2.8=3.8 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

然而，$N(a+b)$ 保持不变
因此，主极大值的方向

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \sin \theta=\frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\frac{0.6}{3.8}=0.1579 \\
& \therefore \quad \theta=\sin ^{-1}(0.1579)=9.08^{\circ} \\
& \text { 这里 } \quad \cos \theta_{n}=\cos \left(9.08^{\circ}\right)=0.9874
\end{aligned}
$$

第一个极大值的宽度，$2 d \theta_{n}=\frac{\lambda}{N(a+b) \cos \theta_{n}}=\frac{2 \times 0.6 \times 180}{5 \times 3.8 \times 0.9874 \times 3.14}=3.66^{\circ}$

question: Example 43: A diffraction grating having 15000 lines to an inch is used to photograph a spectrum. Calculate the angular dispersion in the second order spectrum of wavelength region $5.9 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$. If the focal length of convex lens is 25 cm , calculate the linear dispersion in the spectrograph and also the separation between the spectral lines $5890 \AA$ and $5896 \AA$ in second order.
solution:
The grating equation is $(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$ or $\sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{(a+b)}$
 Here
 
 $$
 (a+b)=\frac{2.54}{15000} \mathrm{~cm}=17 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}, n=2 \text { and } \lambda=5.9 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}
 $$
 
 $\therefore \quad \sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{(a+b)}=\frac{2 \times 5.9 \times 10^{-5}}{(2.54 / 15000)}=0.69$
 Hence
 
 $$
 \cos \theta=\sqrt{ }\left(1-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)=\sqrt{ }\left[1-(0.69)^{2}\right]=0.72
 $$
 
 The angular dispersion produced by the grating is given by
 or
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 & \frac{d \theta}{d \lambda}=\frac{n}{(a+b) \cos \theta}=\frac{2}{17 \times 10^{-3} \times 0.72}=1.6 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{rad} / \mathrm{cm} \\
 & 1.6 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad}(\AA)^{-1}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 If $f$ is the focal length of the camera lens, then the linear dispersion is given by $\frac{d x}{d \lambda}=f \frac{d \theta}{d \lambda}$
 $\therefore \quad \frac{d x}{d \lambda}=25 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad} / \AA=4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}(\AA)^{-1} \quad[f=25 \mathrm{~cm}($ given $)]$
 The separation between the spectral lines $5896 \AA$ and $5890 \AA$ is $(d \lambda=5896-5890=6 \AA)$
 $\therefore \quad d x=4 \times 10^{-3} \times d \lambda=4 \times 10^{-3} \times 6=2.4 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~cm}$

question: 例43：一个具有每英寸15000条线的光栅用于拍摄光谱。计算波长区域$5.9 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$在二级光谱中的角色散。如果凸透镜的焦距为25 cm，计算分光计中的线性色散以及在二级光谱中光谱线$5890 \AA$和$5896 \AA$之间的间隔。
solution:
光栅方程是 $(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda$ 或 $\sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{(a+b)}$

这里

$$(a+b)=\frac{2.54}{15000} \mathrm{~cm}=17 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}, n=2 \text{ 和 } \lambda=5.9 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$$

$\therefore \quad \sin \theta=\frac{n \lambda}{(a+b)}=\frac{2 \times 5.9 \times 10^{-5}}{(2.54 / 15000)}=0.69$

因此

$$\cos \theta=\sqrt{ }\left(1-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)=\sqrt{ }\left[1-(0.69)^{2}\right]=0.72$$

光栅产生的角色散由以下公式给出

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{d \theta}{d \lambda}=\frac{n}{(a+b) \cos \theta}=\frac{2}{17 \times 10^{-3} \times 0.72}=1.6 \times 10^{4} \mathrm{rad} / \mathrm{cm} \\
& 1.6 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad}(\AA)^{-1}
\end{aligned}
$$

如果 $f$ 是相机镜头的焦距，则线性色散由 $\frac{d x}{d \lambda}=f \frac{d \theta}{d \lambda}$ 给出

$\therefore \quad \frac{d x}{d \lambda}=25 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{rad} / \AA=4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}(\AA)^{-1} \quad[f=25 \mathrm{~cm}($ 给定 $)]$

光谱线 $5896 \AA$ 和 $5890 \AA$ 之间的间隔是 $(d \lambda=5896-5890=6 \AA)$

$\therefore \quad d x=4 \times 10^{-3} \times d \lambda=4 \times 10^{-3} \times 6=2.4 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~cm}$

question: Example 45: A parallel beam of light having the wavelength range $4500 \AA$ to $6500 \AA$ falls normally on a transmission grating when grating space is 0.0150 cm . What focal length lens, placed just beyond the grating, will cause the first order spectrum to have a width 0.5 cm in the focal plane of the lens?
solution:
When light falls normally on a grating, the directions $\theta$ of the maximum intensity in the diffracted light are given by
 
 $$
 (a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda
 $$
 
 For first order maximum $n=1$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad \sin \theta=\frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\theta
 $$
 
 If $x$ be the linear distance and $f$ the focal length of the lens then we have
 
 $$
 \theta=\frac{x}{f}
 $$
 
 Equating the above two value of $\theta$, we get
 
 $$
 \frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\frac{x}{f}
 $$
 
 If $x_{1}$ is the linear distance for $\lambda=\lambda_{1}$ and $x_{2}$ that for $\lambda=\lambda_{2}$ then
 
 $$
 \frac{\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{1}}{f} \quad \text { and } \quad \frac{\lambda_{2}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}}{f}
 $$
 
 or
 
 $$
 \frac{\lambda_{2}}{a+b}-\frac{\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}}{f}-\frac{x_{1}}{f} \text { or } \frac{\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}-x_{1}}{f}
 $$
 
 Here $\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}=6500 \AA-4500 \AA=2000 \AA=2 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}, a+b=0.015 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $x_{2}-x_{1}=0.5 \mathrm{~cm}$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad f=\frac{\left(x_{2}-x_{1}\right)(a+b)}{\left(\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}\right)}=\frac{0.5 \times 0.015}{2 \times 10^{-5}}=375 \mathrm{~cm}
 $$

question: 例45：一束波长范围为 $4500 \AA$ 到 $6500 \AA$ 的平行光垂直照射在光栅上，光栅的间距为 0.0150 cm 。在光栅之后放置一个透镜，该透镜的焦距是多少，才能使得在透镜的焦平面上，一级光谱的宽度为 0.5 cm？
solution:
当光垂直入射到光栅上时，衍射光中最大强度的方向 $\theta$ 由下式给出：

$$
(a+b) \sin \theta=n \lambda
$$

对于一级最大值 $n=1$，

$$
\therefore \quad \sin \theta=\frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\theta
$$

如果 $x$ 是线性距离，$f$ 是透镜的焦距，那么我们有

$$
\theta=\frac{x}{f}
$$

将上述两个 $\theta$ 的值相等，我们得到

$$
\frac{\lambda}{a+b}=\frac{x}{f}
$$

如果 $x_{1}$ 是 $\lambda=\lambda_{1}$ 时的线性距离，而 $x_{2}$ 是 $\lambda=\lambda_{2}$ 时的线性距离，那么

$$
\frac{\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{1}}{f} \quad \text{和} \quad \frac{\lambda_{2}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}}{f}
$$

或者

$$
\frac{\lambda_{2}}{a+b}-\frac{\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}}{f}-\frac{x_{1}}{f} \text{ 或 } \frac{\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}}{a+b}=\frac{x_{2}-x_{1}}{f}
$$

这里 $\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}=6500 \AA-4500 \AA=2000 \AA=2 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}, a+b=0.015 \mathrm{~cm}$ 且 $x_{2}-x_{1}=0.5 \mathrm{~cm}$

$$
\therefore \quad f=\frac{\left(x_{2}-x_{1}\right)(a+b)}{\left(\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}\right)}=\frac{0.5 \times 0.015}{2 \times 10^{-5}}=375 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

question:
Example 49: What must be minimum number of lines per cm. in a half inch width grating to resolve the wavelength 5890 and $5896 \AA$ ?
 [G.B.T.U., B.Tech. I Sem 2012, M.T.U. I Sem. (C.O.) 2012]
solution:
The resolving power of a grating is given by,
 
 $$
 \frac{\lambda}{d \lambda}=n N
 $$
 
 where $N$ is the number of lines per inch in the grating
 Here
 
 $$
 \lambda=\frac{\lambda_{1}+\lambda_{2}}{2}=\frac{(5890+5896) \AA}{2}=5893 \AA
 $$
 
 and
 
 $$
 d \lambda=\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}=(5896-5890) \AA=6 \AA
 $$
 
 In this problem order is not given, therefore we consider the case of first order, that is for $n=1$. Thus
 
 $$
 N=\frac{1}{n}\left(\frac{\lambda}{d \lambda}\right)=\frac{1}{1}\left(\frac{5893 \AA}{6 \AA}\right)=982
 $$
 
 Since the grating is half inch wide, therefore the number of lines per inch $=982 \times 2$
 Hence, the minimum number of lines per $\mathrm{cm}=\frac{982 \times 2}{2.54}=773$

question:
例49：要分辨波长5890和$5896 \AA$，半英寸宽的光栅最少需要多少条每厘米的线数？
[G.B.T.U., B.Tech. I Sem 2012, M.T.U. I Sem. (C.O.) 2012]
solution:
光栅的分辨能力由以下公式给出：

$$
\frac{\lambda}{d \lambda}=n N
$$

其中，$N$ 是光栅每英寸的线数。

这里

$$
\lambda=\frac{\lambda_{1}+\lambda_{2}}{2}=\frac{(5890+5896) \AA}{2}=5893 \AA
$$

并且

$$
d \lambda=\lambda_{2}-\lambda_{1}=(5896-5890) \AA=6 \AA
$$

在这个问题中，未给出级数，因此我们考虑一级的情况，即 $n=1$。因此

$$
N=\frac{1}{n}\left(\frac{\lambda}{d \lambda}\right)=\frac{1}{1}\left(\frac{5893 \AA}{6 \AA}\right)=982
$$

由于光栅宽半英寸，因此每英寸的线数 $=982 \times 2$

因此，每厘米的最小线数 $=\frac{982 \times 2}{2.54}=773$。

question: Derive an expression for the intensity distribution due to Fraunhofer's diffraction at a single slit. Show that the intensity of the first subsidiary maximum is about $4.5 \%$ of that of the principal maximum.
solution:
To derive the intensity distribution due to Fraunhofer's diffraction at a single slit, consider a slit of width $a$ illuminated by monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda$. The light waves emanating from the slit will interfere, and the resulting intensity distribution on a screen at distance $L$ (where $L \gg a$) can be described by the following equation:

$$ I(\theta) = I_0 \left( \frac{\sin(\beta)}{\beta} \right)^2 $$

where $\beta = \frac{\pi a \sin(\theta)}{\lambda}$ and $I_0$ is the maximum intensity at $\theta = 0$ (the principal maximum).

The first subsidiary maximum occurs at a value of $\beta$ such that $\sin(\beta) = \pm 0.5$. Solving for $\beta$, we find that $\beta \approx 1.43$ for the first subsidiary maximum. Substituting $\beta = 1.43$ into the intensity equation gives:

$$ I(\text{first subsidiary maximum}) = I_0 \left( \frac{\sin(1.43)}{1.43} \right)^2 $$

Evaluating the expression, $\sin(1.43) \approx 0.99$, so:

$$ I(\text{first subsidiary maximum}) = I_0 \left( \frac{0.99}{1.43} \right)^2 \approx 0.045 I_0 $$

Thus, the intensity of the first subsidiary maximum is about $4.5\%$ of that of the principal maximum.

question: 推导由单缝菲涅尔衍射引起的强度分布的表达式。证明第一个次极大值的强度约为主极大值的 $4.5 \%$。
solution:
为了推导出单缝菲涅尔衍射造成的光强分布，考虑一个宽度为 $a$ 的狭缝，被波长为 $\lambda$ 的单色光照射。来自狭缝的光波将会发生干涉，在距离为 $L$ 的屏幕上（其中 $L \gg a$）产生的光强分布可以通过以下方程描述：

$$ I(\theta) = I_0 \left( \frac{\sin(\beta)}{\beta} \right)^2 $$

其中 $\beta = \frac{\pi a \sin(\theta)}{\lambda}$，$I_0$ 是在 $\theta = 0$（主极大值）时的最大光强。

第一个次极大值出现在 $\beta$ 满足 $\sin(\beta) = \pm 0.5$ 的值处。通过求解 $\beta$，我们发现第一个次极大值的 $\beta \approx 1.43$。将 $\beta = 1.43$ 代入光强方程：

$$ I(\text{第一个次极大值}) = I_0 \left( \frac{\sin(1.43)}{1.43} \right)^2 $$

计算该表达式，$\sin(1.43) \approx 0.99$，所以：

$$ I(\text{第一个次极大值}) = I_0 \left( \frac{0.99}{1.43} \right)^2 \approx 0.045 I_0 $$

因此，第一个次极大值的光强约为主极大值的 $4.5\%$。

 $$

 0.75 I_{0}=I_{0} \cos ^{2} \theta \quad \text { or } \quad \cos \theta=\sqrt{ }(0.75) \quad \text { or } \quad \theta=\cos ^{-1}(0.75)^{1 / 2}=30^{\circ}

question: Example 14: Calculate the proportion of polarisation for a beam of light passing through a pile consisting of 8 plates of glass. Given refractive index of glass $=1.5$.
solution:
According to the expression for proportion of polarisation,
 
 $$
 P=\frac{n}{n+\left(\frac{2 \mu}{1-\mu^{2}}\right)^{2}}
 $$
 
 Here, $n=8$ and $\mu=1.5$
 
 $$
 \therefore \quad P=\frac{8}{8+\left(\frac{2 \times 1.5}{1-(1.5)^{2}}\right)^{2}}=0.581
 $$

question:
How many times larger is the unit size in the SI as compared with the unit size in the cgs system for each of the following physical quantities?

Enter the appropriate numbers in the blanks below.

(1) the unit of speed:
(2) the unit of acceleration:
(3) the unit of force:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& 10^{a} \text { times } a=\square \\
& 10^{i} \text { times } i=\square \\
& 10^{j} \text { times } j=\square \\
& 10^{k} \text { times } k=\square
\end{aligned}
$$

(4) the unit of energy: $\quad 10^{l}$ times $l=\square$
(5) the unit of pressure: $\quad 10^{m}$ times $m=\square$

Answer $i=2, j=2, k=5, l=7, m=1$
solution:
(1) The unit of speed in the SI is $\mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}$. The unit size of speed in the SI is $1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}$ (because $1 \mathrm{~m}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm}$ ). Therefore, it is $\underline{10}^{2}$ times the unit size of speed in the cgs system.

(2) The unit of the acceleration in the SI is $\mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}^{2} .1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$. Therefore, the answer is $\underline{10}^{2}$ times.

(3) Force is " (mass) $\times$ (acceleration)", therefore the unit of force in the SI is $\mathrm{N}=\mathrm{kg} \cdot \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}^{2} .1 \mathrm{~N}=1 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~g} \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}=10^{5} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$ $=10^{5}$ dyn (because $1 \mathrm{~kg}=10^{3} \mathrm{~g}$ ). Therefore, the answer is $\underline{10}^{5}$ times.

question:
在国际单位制中，每个以下物理量的单位大小相比厘米-克-秒制大多少倍？

(1) 速度的单位：
(2) 加速度的单位：
(3) 力的单位：

$$
\begin{aligned}
& 10^{a} \text { 倍 } a=\square \\
& 10^{i} \text { 倍 } i=\square \\
& 10^{j} \text { 倍 } j=\square \\
& 10^{k} \text { 倍 } k=\square
\end{aligned}
$$

(4) 能量的单位：$\quad 10^{l}$ 倍 $l=\square$
(5) 压力的单位：$\quad 10^{m}$ 倍 $m=\square$

答案 $i=2, j=2, k=5, l=7, m=1$。
solution:
(1) 在国际单位制中，速度的单位是 $\mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}$。在国际单位制中，速度的单位大小是 $1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}$（因为 $1 \mathrm{~m}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm}$）。因此，它是厘米-克-秒制中速度单位大小的 $\underline{10}^{2}$ 倍。

(2) 在国际单位制中，加速度的单位是 $\mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$。$1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}=1 \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$。因此，答案是 $\underline{10}^{2}$ 倍。

(3) 力是“（质量）$\times$（加速度）”，因此在国际单位制中，力的单位是 $\mathrm{N}=\mathrm{kg} \cdot \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$。$1 \mathrm{~N}=1 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~g} \times 10^{2} \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}=10^{5} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}^{2}=10^{5}$ dyn（因为 $1 \mathrm{~kg}=10^{3} \mathrm{~g}$）。因此，答案是 $\underline{10}^{5}$ 倍。

question:
A space probe launched to converge with the orbit of Pluto. Celestial bodies that are farther than Neptune and are classified as dwarf planets have been found, in addition to Pluto. We consider a space probe that is launched to the neighborhood of the orbit of Pluto. In the following discussion, it should be noted that all objects, including planets, revolving around the Sun obey Kepler's laws.

(1) In accurate terms, the orbit of the Earth is an ellipse, but it is approximately a circle. The radius of this circle is the astronomical unit. Pluto's semimajor axis is about 40 astronomical units. What is Pluto's orbital period? Choose the best values from the following (a) through (f).
(a) 10 years
(b) 40 years
(c) 180 years
(d) 250 years
(e) 640 years
(f) 1600 years
solution:
To find Pluto's orbital period, we use Kepler's third law which states that the square of the orbital period (T) of a planet is directly proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis (a) of its orbit, i.e., $T^2 \propto a^3$. Given that Earth's orbital period is 1 year and its semi-major axis is 1 astronomical unit (AU), we have $T^2 = a^3$.

For Pluto, $a = 40$ AU. Therefore, $T^2 = 40^3 = 64000$. Solving for $T$, we get $T = \sqrt{64000} \approx 250$ years.

Thus, the best answer is (d) 250 years.

question:
一颗太空探测器被发射以与冥王星的轨道相交。除了冥王星之外，还发现了比海王星更远并被归类为矮行星的天体。我们考虑一颗被发射到冥王星轨道附近的太空探测器。在下面的讨论中，需要注意的是，包括行星在内的所有绕太阳旋转的天体都遵循开普勒定律。

(1) 准确地说，地球的轨道是一个椭圆，但它近似于一个圆。这个圆的半径是一个天文单位。冥王星的半长轴约为40个天文单位。冥王星的轨道周期是多少？从以下(a)到(f)中选择最佳值。
(a) 10年
(b) 40年
(c) 180年
(d) 250年
(e) 640年
(f) 1600年。
solution:
要计算冥王星的轨道周期，我们使用开普勒第三定律，该定律指出行星轨道周期（T）的平方与其轨道半长轴（a）的立方成正比，即$T^2 \propto a^3$。已知地球的轨道周期为1年，其半长轴为1天文单位（AU），我们有$T^2 = a^3$。

对于冥王星，$a = 40$ AU。因此，$T^2 = 40^3 = 64000$。求解$T$，我们得到$T = \sqrt{64000} \approx 250$年。

因此，最佳答案是(d) 250年。

question: Find a bound on the possible values of the integral constant $C_{2}$ using the following conditions: $C_{1}=0$ and $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$ at $r=r_{1}$. Further, derive the following equation with appropriate positive constants $D$ and $\varepsilon$: $$ r=\frac{D}{1+\varepsilon \cos \phi} $$
solution:
To find a bound on the integral constant $C_{2}$, we start by considering the given condition $C_{1} = 0$ and $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$ at $r = r_{1}$. This indicates that the second derivative of $r$ with respect to $\phi$ is positive, which implies a concave upward curve at that point. 

The equation $r = \frac{D}{1 + \varepsilon \cos \phi}$ represents a conic section, specifically an ellipse if $0 < \varepsilon < 1$, a parabola if $\varepsilon = 1$, or a hyperbola if $\varepsilon > 1$. 

Given the form of $r$, we can differentiate it with respect to $\phi$ to find $\frac{dr}{d\phi}$ and $\frac{d^{2}r}{d\phi^{2}}$. The positivity condition $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$ will impose constraints on $C_{2}$ based on the specific form of these derivatives. 

The derivation of the equation $r = \frac{D}{1 + \varepsilon \cos \phi}$ involves using the laws of conic sections in polar coordinates. By assuming that $r$ is a function of $\phi$ and satisfies the given conditions, we can substitute the constants $D$ and $\varepsilon$ into the equation to match the specific conic section described by the problem. 

Thus, we derive the equation and find the bounds on $C_{2}$ by ensuring that the conditions for a specific conic section are satisfied, and $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}} > 0$ is maintained.

question: 根据以下条件，找到积分常数 $C_{2}$ 的可能取值范围：$C_{1}=0$ 且在 $r=r_{1}$ 时 $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$。进一步推导出以下方程，其中 $D$ 和 $\varepsilon$ 为适当的正常数：$$ r=\frac{D}{1+\varepsilon \cos \phi} $$。
solution:
为了找到积分常数 $C_{2}$ 的界限，我们首先考虑给定的条件 $C_{1} = 0$ 和 $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$ 在 $r = r_{1}$ 处。这表明 $r$ 关于 $\phi$ 的二阶导数为正，这意味着在该点曲线向上凹。

方程 $r = \frac{D}{1 + \varepsilon \cos \phi}$ 表示一个圆锥曲线，具体而言，当 $0 < \varepsilon < 1$ 时是椭圆，当 $\varepsilon = 1$ 时是抛物线，当 $\varepsilon > 1$ 时是双曲线。

鉴于 $r$ 的形式，我们可以对其关于 $\phi$ 求导以找到 $\frac{dr}{d\phi}$ 和 $\frac{d^{2}r}{d\phi^{2}}$。正值条件 $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}}>0$ 将根据这些导数的具体形式对 $C_{2}$ 施加约束。

方程 $r = \frac{D}{1 + \varepsilon \cos \phi}$ 的推导涉及使用极坐标中的圆锥曲线定律。通过假设 $r$ 是 $\phi$ 的一个函数并满足给定条件，我们可以将常数 $D$ 和 $\varepsilon$ 代入方程，以匹配问题所描述的特定圆锥曲线。

因此，我们通过确保满足特定圆锥曲线的条件并保持 $\frac{d^{2} r}{d \phi^{2}} > 0$，来推导方程并找到 $C_{2}$ 的界限。

question: Let us consider a rotational motion about a fixed axis. This motion has only one degree of freedom. We may model a rigid body as a collection of a large number of particles of masses $m_{i}(i=1,2, \ldots)$. We express the angular velocity of a particle about the rotational axis as $\boldsymbol{\omega}=\dot{\boldsymbol{\psi}}$ and the distance from the axis to the $i$ th particle as $r_{i}$. What is the angular momentum of the rigid body and the equation of the rotational motion?
solution: The angular momentum of the rigid body is given by $$\boldsymbol{L}=\sum_{i} m_{i} r_{i}^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}=I \boldsymbol{\omega}$$ where $I=\sum_{i} m_{i} r_{i}^{2}$ is the moment of inertia of the rigid body about the rotational axis. When we draw the $z$-axis along the fixed axis of the rotation and express the $z$-component of the moment of force as $N_{z}$, the equation of the rotational motion is $$I \frac{d \omega}{d t}=N_{z}$$.

question: 让我们考虑一个围绕固定轴的旋转运动。此运动只有一个自由度。我们可以将刚体建模为大量质量为$m_{i}(i=1,2, \ldots)$的粒子集合。我们将粒子相对于旋转轴的角速度表示为$\boldsymbol{\omega}=\dot{\boldsymbol{\psi}}$，并将从轴到第$i$个粒子的距离表示为$r_{i}$。刚体的角动量是什么以及旋转运动的方程是什么？
solution: 刚体的角动量由 $$\boldsymbol{L}=\sum_{i} m_{i} r_{i}^{2} \boldsymbol{\omega}=I \boldsymbol{\omega}$$ 给出，其中 $I=\sum_{i} m_{i} r_{i}^{2}$ 是刚体关于旋转轴的转动惯量。当我们将 $z$ 轴沿旋转的固定轴绘制，并将力矩的 $z$ 分量表示为 $N_{z}$ 时，旋转运动的方程为 $$I \frac{d \omega}{d t}=N_{z}$$。

question: Calculate the cyclotron radius of the electron when its velocity is $3.2 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ (which corresponds to the velocity of an electron accelerated by the electric voltage of about $3,000 \mathrm{~V}$ ). Further, calculate the ratio of this cyclotron radius to the radius of the earth, $6.4 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~m}$.
solution: To find the cyclotron radius $r$ of an electron moving in a magnetic field, we can use the formula $r = \frac{mv}{qB}$, where $m$ is the mass of the electron, $v$ is its velocity, $q$ is the charge of the electron, and $B$ is the magnetic field strength. Given $v = 3.2 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~m/s}$, we substitute the known values for $m$ and $q$: $m = 9.11 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$ and $q = 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{~C}$. Assuming a typical magnetic field $B = 1 \mathrm{~T}$ (Tesla) for calculation, we have $r = \frac{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 3.2 \times 10^{7}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1} = \frac{2.9152 \times 10^{-23}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19}} = 1.822 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}$. Next, to find the ratio of this cyclotron radius to the radius of the Earth, we calculate $\frac{1.822 \times 10^{-4}}{6.4 \times 10^{6}} = 2.847 \times 10^{-11}$. Therefore, the cyclotron radius is approximately $1.822 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}$ and the ratio to the Earth's radius is $2.847 \times 10^{-11}$.

question: 计算电子在其速度为 $3.2 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ （对应于被约 $3,000 \mathrm{~V}$ 的电压加速的电子的速度）时的回旋半径。此外，计算此回旋半径与地球半径 $6.4 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~m}$ 的比值。
solution: 要找到在磁场中运动的电子的回旋半径 $r$，我们可以使用公式 $r = \frac{mv}{qB}$，其中 $m$ 是电子的质量，$v$ 是其速度，$q$ 是电子的电荷，$B$ 是磁场强度。给定 $v = 3.2 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~m/s}$，我们代入已知的 $m$ 和 $q$ 的值：$m = 9.11 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$ 和 $q = 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{~C}$。假设计算中使用的典型磁场 $B = 1 \mathrm{~T}$（特斯拉），我们得到 $r = \frac{9.11 \times 10^{-31} \times 3.2 \times 10^{7}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 1} = \frac{2.9152 \times 10^{-23}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19}} = 1.822 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}$。接下来，为了找到这个回旋半径与地球半径的比率，我们计算 $\frac{1.822 \times 10^{-4}}{6.4 \times 10^{6}} = 2.847 \times 10^{-11}$。因此，回旋半径大约是 $1.822 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}$，与地球半径的比率是 $2.847 \times 10^{-11}$。

question: Using the concentration $n$ of the particles and the Boltzmann constant $k_{\mathrm{B}}$, what is the ideal gas equation?
solution: Solution: The ideal gas equation is given by $p=n k_{\mathrm{B}} T$, where $p$ is the pressure, $n$ is the concentration of particles, $k_{\mathrm{B}}$ is the Boltzmann constant, and $T$ is the temperature.

question: 使用粒子的浓度 $n$ 和玻尔兹曼常数 $k_{\mathrm{B}}$，理想气体方程是什么？
solution: 解答：理想气体方程为 $p=n k_{\mathrm{B}} T$，其中 $p$ 是压强，$n$ 是粒子浓度，$k_{\mathrm{B}}$ 是玻尔兹曼常数，$T$ 是温度。

question: Find the volume allotted to one molecule of a gas under the standard condition for temperature and pressure.
solution: Under standard conditions for temperature and pressure (STP), one mole of an ideal gas occupies 22.414 liters. Since one mole contains Avogadro's number of molecules, which is $6.022 \times 10^{23}$, the volume allotted to one molecule of the gas is $\frac{22.414 \text{ L}}{6.022 \times 10^{23}} \approx 3.72 \times 10^{-23} \text{ L}$. Therefore, the volume allotted to one molecule of a gas under standard conditions is approximately $3.72 \times 10^{-23}$ liters.

question: 求在标准温度和压力条件下分配给一个气体分子的体积。
solution: 在标准温度和压力（STP）条件下，一摩尔理想气体占据22.414升。由于一摩尔包含阿伏伽德罗常数个分子，即$6.022 \times 10^{23}$，因此分配给一个气体分子的体积是$\frac{22.414 \text{ L}}{6.022 \times 10^{23}} \approx 3.72 \times 10^{-23} \text{ L}$。因此，在标准条件下分配给一个气体分子的体积大约是$3.72 \times 10^{-23}$升。

question: Suppose a gaseous molecule is a rigid sphere whose radius is $r=1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$. What is the ratio of the volume allotted to one molecule in the standard condition of the gas to a molecule's own volume?
solution:
To find the ratio of the volume allotted to one molecule in standard conditions to the molecule's own volume, we first calculate the volume of the molecule and the volume allotted to it.

The volume $V_{molecule}$ of a sphere is given by the formula:
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 $$
Substituting $r = 1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$, we get:
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi (1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m})^3 $$
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi \times 1.0 \times 10^{-30} \mathrm{~m}^3 $$

In standard conditions (STP), one mole of gas occupies $22.4 \mathrm{~L} = 22.4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m}^3$ and contains $6.022 \times 10^{23}$ molecules (Avogadro's number). Thus, the volume allotted to one molecule, $V_{allotted}$, is:
$$ V_{allotted} = \frac{22.4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m}^3}{6.022 \times 10^{23}} $$
$$ V_{allotted} \approx 3.72 \times 10^{-26} \mathrm{~m}^3 $$

Finally, the ratio of the volume allotted to one molecule to the molecule's own volume is:
$$ \text{Ratio} = \frac{V_{allotted}}{V_{molecule}} $$
Substitute the values:
$$ \text{Ratio} = \frac{3.72 \times 10^{-26} \mathrm{~m}^3}{\frac{4}{3} \pi \times 1.0 \times 10^{-30} \mathrm{~m}^3} $$
$$ \text{Ratio} \approx \frac{3.72 \times 10^{-26}}{4.19 \times 10^{-30}} $$
$$ \text{Ratio} \approx 8.87 \times 10^3 $$

Thus, the ratio of the volume allotted to one molecule in the standard condition of the gas to a molecule's own volume is approximately $8.87 \times 10^3$.

question: 假设一个气态分子是一个半径为$r=1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$的刚性球体。在标准气体条件下，分子所占据的体积与分子自身体积的比值是多少？
solution:
要找到在标准条件下分配给一个分子的体积与分子自身体积的比率，我们首先计算分子的体积和分配给它的体积。

球体的体积 $V_{molecule}$ 由公式给出：
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 $$
代入 $r = 1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$，我们得到：
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi (1.0 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m})^3 $$
$$ V_{molecule} = \frac{4}{3} \pi \times 1.0 \times 10^{-30} \mathrm{~m}^3 $$

在标准条件（STP）下，一摩尔气体占据 $22.4 \mathrm{~L} = 22.4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m}^3$，包含 $6.022 \times 10^{23}$ 个分子（阿伏伽德罗常数）。因此，分配给一个分子的体积 $V_{allotted}$ 为：
$$ V_{allotted} = \frac{22.4 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~m}^3}{6.022 \times 10^{23}} $$
$$ V_{allotted} \approx 3.72 \times 10^{-26} \mathrm{~m}^3 $$

最后，分配给一个分子的体积与分子自身体积的比率为：
$$ \text{Ratio} = \frac{V_{allotted}}{V_{molecule}} $$
代入数值：
$$ \text{Ratio} = \frac{3.72 \times 10^{-26} \mathrm{~m}^3}{\frac{4}{3} \pi \times 1.0 \times 10^{-30} \mathrm{~m}^3} $$
$$ \text{Ratio} \approx \frac{3.72 \times 10^{-26}}{4.19 \times 10^{-30}} $$
$$ \text{Ratio} \approx 8.87 \times 10^3 $$

因此，在气体的标准条件下，分配给一个分子的体积与分子自身体积的比率大约是 $8.87 \times 10^3$。

question: A vehicle is moving and emits a sound from a loudspeaker. Determine the times $t_1$ and $t_2$ when the sound reaches the right and left loudspeakers, respectively, considering the speed of sound $V$ and the speed of the vehicle $v$. Also, determine the corresponding times $t_1'$ and $t_2'$ when the vehicle is stationary.
solution:
(1) Because the vehicle moves a distance $v t_{1}$ in time $t_{1}$, the position of the right loudspeaker at time $t_{1}$ is $v t_{1}+L$. For this period, the sound propagates the distance $V t_{1}$. Therefore, we have

$$
V t_{1}=v t_{1}+L
$$

By solving this relation for $t_{1}$, we find

$$
t_{1}=\frac{L / V}{\frac{1-v / V}{}}
$$

(2) During the time $t_{2}-t_{1}$, the vehicle moves rightward the distance $v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)$. For this period, the sound pulse propagates the distance $L-v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)$. Hence, we have

$$
V\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)=L-v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)
$$

Then we can obtain

$$
t_{2}-t_{1}=\frac{L / V}{1+v / V}
$$

We insert the expression for $t_{1}$ derived in part (1) into the left-hand side of this equation to find

$$
t_{2}=\frac{L / V}{1-v / V}+\frac{L / V}{1+v / V}=\underline{\underline{2 L / V}} \frac{1-(v / V)^{2}}{}
$$

(3) Because, during the time $t_{1}^{\prime}$, the sound propagates the distance $L$ at speed $V$, we have

$$
t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

(4) Because it takes the time $t_{2}^{\prime}-t_{1}^{\prime}$ for the sound to propagate the distance $L$ at speed $V$, we find

$$
t_{2}^{\prime}-t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

(5) Because the sound propagates at speed $V+v$ relative to the ground during the time $t_{1}$, we replace $V$ in the result of part (1) with $V+v$ to obtain

$$
t_{1}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

which is the same expression as that for $t_{1}^{\prime}$ derived in (3).

question: 一辆车正在移动，并从一个扬声器发出声音。确定声音分别到达右扬声器和左扬声器的时间$t_1$和$t_2$，考虑到声音速度$V$和车辆速度$v$。同时，确定当车辆静止时对应的时间$t_1'$和$t_2'$。
solution:
(1) 因为车辆在时间 $t_{1}$ 内移动的距离是 $v t_{1}$，所以在时间 $t_{1}$ 时右扬声器的位置是 $v t_{1}+L$。在这段时间内，声音传播的距离是 $V t_{1}$。因此，我们有

$$
V t_{1}=v t_{1}+L
$$

通过求解这个关于 $t_{1}$ 的关系，我们得到

$$
t_{1}=\frac{L / V}{\frac{1-v / V}{}}
$$

(2) 在时间 $t_{2}-t_{1}$ 内，车辆向右移动的距离是 $v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)$。在这段时间内，声波传播的距离是 $L-v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)$。因此，我们有

$$
V\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)=L-v\left(t_{2}-t_{1}\right)
$$

然后我们可以得到

$$
t_{2}-t_{1}=\frac{L / V}{1+v / V}
$$

我们将第 (1) 部分中得出的 $t_{1}$ 的表达式代入这个方程的左侧，得到

$$
t_{2}=\frac{L / V}{1-v / V}+\frac{L / V}{1+v / V}=\underline{\underline{2 L / V}} \frac{1-(v / V)^{2}}{}
$$

(3) 因为在时间 $t_{1}^{\prime}$ 内，声音以速度 $V$ 传播的距离是 $L$，所以我们有

$$
t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

(4) 因为声音以速度 $V$ 传播距离 $L$ 需要时间 $t_{2}^{\prime}-t_{1}^{\prime}$，所以我们得到

$$
t_{2}^{\prime}-t_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

(5) 因为在时间 $t_{1}$ 内，声音相对于地面以速度 $V+v$ 传播，我们将第 (1) 部分结果中的 $V$ 替换为 $V+v$，得到

$$
t_{1}=\frac{L}{V}
$$

这与在 (3) 中推导出的 $t_{1}^{\prime}$ 的表达式相同。

question:
(a) We repeated the measurements of the length of an object five times by using a caliper with the minimum division of 0.05 mm. The results are shown below in mm units. Calculate the average and error, and record the final result with error.

No. 1; 41.53, No. 2; 41.49, No. 3; 41.48,
No. 4; 41.51, No. 5; 41.47

(b) We continued the same measurements 15 times more, and obtained the results below. By using all of the data (20 data points in total including those in (a)), calculate the average and the error. Write down the final result with error.

No. 6; 41.50, No. 7; 41.49, No. 8; 41.49, No. 9; 41.52,
No. 10; 41.51, No. 11; 41.51, No. 12; 41.50, No. 13; 41.51,
No. 14; 41.50, No. 15; 41.49 No. 16; 41.51, No. 17; 41.48,
No. 18; 41.49, No. 19, 41.51, No. 20; 41.50
solution:
(a) The average is 41.496, and the error is 0.0108. Since the second decimal place contains an error, the significant figure is four digits. Then, the final results is $41.50 \pm 0.01 \mathrm{~mm}$. The error is only slightly smaller than the reading error of each measurement $(0.03 \mathrm{~mm})$ because there are only five measurements.

(b) The average is 41.499, and the error is 0.0033. Then, the result is $41.500 \pm 0.003 \mathrm{~mm}$, in which the error is smaller than in (a), because of the larger number of repeated measurements.

question:
(a) 我们使用最小刻度为0.05 mm的卡尺重复测量一个物体的长度五次。结果如下，以毫米为单位。计算平均值和误差，并记录带误差的最终结果。

第1次：41.53，第2次：41.49，第3次：41.48，
第4次：41.51，第5次：41.47

(b) 我们继续进行了相同的测量15次，并获得了以下结果。使用所有数据（总共包括(a)中的20个数据点），计算平均值和误差。写下带误差的最终结果。

第6次：41.50，第7次：41.49，第8次：41.49，第9次：41.52，
第10次：41.51，第11次：41.51，第12次：41.50，第13次：41.51，
第14次：41.50，第15次：41.49，第16次：41.51，第17次：41.48，
第18次：41.49，第19次：41.51，第20次：41.50。
solution:
(a) 平均值是41.496，误差是0.0108。由于第二位小数包含误差，有效数字是四位数。因此，最终结果是$41.50 \pm 0.01 \mathrm{~mm}$。误差仅略小于每次测量的读数误差$(0.03 \mathrm{~mm})$，因为只有五次测量。

(b) 平均值是41.499，误差是0.0033。因此，结果是$41.500 \pm 0.003 \mathrm{~mm}$，其中误差比(a)中的小，因为重复测量次数更多。

question: Suppose a planet, P, of mass $m$ moves around the Sun, S, which is of a larger mass, $M$, due to the universal gravitation $F=G \frac{M m}{r^{2}}$. Here, $r$ and $G$ denote the distance between the planet and the Sun and the gravitational constant, respectively. Since $M$ is large, the Sun can be considered at rest. (1) Show that the angular momentum $L=m r^{2} \dot{\theta}$ is conserved. (2) Find the total energy $E$ of the planet moving around the Sun in terms of $r$, its time derivative $\dot{r}$, $G$, and $L$. Find the condition for the total energy $E$ that the planet continues turning around the Sun and does not move from the Sun to an infinite distance away. Finally, supposing that the planet moves on a circular orbit around the Sun, find the relation between the radius of the planet orbit and the angular momentum $L$.
solution: (1) The universal gravitation has no $\theta$-direction component. Such a force is called the central force. The equation of motion in the $\theta$-direction is $$ m a_{\theta}=0 \quad \Rightarrow \quad 2 \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+r \ddot{\theta}=0 $$ Then, $$ \frac{d L}{d t}=\frac{d}{d t}\left(m r^{2} \dot{\theta}\right)=2 m r \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+m r^{2} \ddot{\theta}=m r(2 \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+r \ddot{\theta})=0 $$ Namely, $L$ is conserved in time. (2) Suppose the mechanical energy of the planet moving around the Sun under the universal gravitation. Let the potential energy be zero at $r=\infty$. The potential energy $U$ is obtained by the integration of the universal gravitation $-\frac{G M m}{r^{2}}$ from $r=r$ to $r=\infty$: $$ U=\int_{r}^{\infty}\left(-\frac{G M m}{r^{2}}\right) d r=-\frac{G M m}{r} $$ On the other hand, the kinetic energy $K$ can be written in terms of the polar coordinates as $$ \begin{aligned} K & =\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}=\frac{1}{2} m\left(v_{r}^{2}+v_{\theta}^{2}\right) \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left\{m \dot{r}^{2}+m(r \dot{\theta})^{2}\right\} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{m r^{2}}\right) \end{aligned} $$ Therefore, the total mechanical energy $E=K+U$ becomes $$ E=\frac{1}{\underline{2}} m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r} $$ The sum of the second term and the third term on the right hand side of Eq. (A.1) is called the effective potential: $$ U_{0}(r)=\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r} $$ Since the angular momentum of the planet, $L$, is constant, the right hand side of Eq. (A.1) is the sum of the kinetic energy in the $r$ direction, $\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}$, and the potential energy $U_{0}(r)$ which is determined by $r$. Hence Eq. (A.1) can be regarded as the mechanical energy of a one dimensional motion of a particle in the $r$ direction. Now, the derivative of the effective potential becomes $$ \frac{d U_{0}}{d r}=-\frac{L^{2}}{m r^{3}}+\frac{G M m}{r^{2}} $$ The effective potential $U_{0}(r)$ has its negative minimum at $r=$ $r_{0}=\frac{L^{2}}{G M m^{2}}$. Note that when the distance between the planet and the Sun is infinity, $r \rightarrow \infty$, the effective potential goes to zero, $U_{0}(r) \rightarrow 0$. Suppose the planet is moving away from the Sun $(\dot{r}>0)$ at some instant. If $E>0, \dot{r}$ continues to be positive as $r$ increases and the planet moves from the Sun to an infinite distance away. On the other hand, if $E<0$, as $r$ increases, $\dot{r}$ of the planet becomes zero, i.e., $\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}=0$. Thereafter, $\dot{r}<0$ and the planet approaches the Sun. The planet goes back and forth between two points of $\dot{r}=0$. Thereby the planet stays at a range of finite distance from the Sun. Therefore the condition that the planet continues turning around the Sun is given by $\underline{E}<\underline{0}$. Since $r$ is constant when the planet moves circularly, the radius should be $r=r_{0}$ in which effective potential $U_{0}(r)$ takes its minimum value. Hence, the relation between the radius $r$ and the angular momentum $L$ is $$ r=\frac{L^{2}}{\overline{G M m^{2}}} $$
answer: E=\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r}

question: 假设一个质量为 $m$ 的行星 P 因万有引力 $F=G \frac{M m}{r^{2}}$ 围绕质量更大的太阳 S 运动。其中，$r$ 和 $G$ 分别表示行星与太阳之间的距离和引力常数。由于 $M$ 很大，可以认为太阳是静止的。(1) 证明角动量 $L=m r^{2} \dot{\theta}$ 是守恒的。(2) 用 $r$、其时间导数 $\dot{r}$、$G$ 和 $L$ 表示行星围绕太阳运动的总能量 $E$。找出行星能继续围绕太阳转动而不从太阳移到无限远的条件。最后，假设行星在围绕太阳的圆形轨道上运动，找出行星轨道半径与角动量 $L$ 的关系。
solution:
(1) 万有引力没有$\theta$方向的分量。这种力称为中心力。$\theta$方向的运动方程是
$$ m a_{\theta}=0 \quad \Rightarrow \quad 2 \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+r \ddot{\theta}=0 $$
因此，
$$ \frac{d L}{d t}=\frac{d}{d t}\left(m r^{2} \dot{\theta}\right)=2 m r \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+m r^{2} \ddot{\theta}=m r(2 \dot{r} \dot{\theta}+r \ddot{\theta})=0 $$
也就是说，$L$在时间上是守恒的。

(2) 假设行星在万有引力作用下绕太阳运动的机械能。令势能在$r=\infty$时为零。势能$U$通过对万有引力$-\frac{G M m}{r^{2}}$从$r=r$到$r=\infty$的积分得到：
$$ U=\int_{r}^{\infty}\left(-\frac{G M m}{r^{2}}\right) d r=-\frac{G M m}{r} $$
另一方面，动能$K$可以用极坐标表示为
$$ \begin{aligned} K & =\frac{1}{2} m v^{2}=\frac{1}{2} m\left(v_{r}^{2}+v_{\theta}^{2}\right) \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left\{m \dot{r}^{2}+m(r \dot{\theta})^{2}\right\} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{m r^{2}}\right) \end{aligned} $$
因此，总机械能$E=K+U$变为
$$ E=\frac{1}{\underline{2}} m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r} $$
方程(A.1)右侧的第二项和第三项的和被称为有效势能：
$$ U_{0}(r)=\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r} $$
由于行星的角动量$L$是常数，方程(A.1)右侧是$r$方向的动能$\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}$和由$r$决定的势能$U_{0}(r)$的和。因此，方程(A.1)可以被视为粒子在$r$方向的一维运动的机械能。现在，有效势能的导数为
$$ \frac{d U_{0}}{d r}=-\frac{L^{2}}{m r^{3}}+\frac{G M m}{r^{2}} $$
有效势能$U_{0}(r)$在$r=r_{0}=\frac{L^{2}}{G M m^{2}}$处有其负的最小值。注意当行星与太阳之间的距离为无穷大时，$r \rightarrow \infty$，有效势能趋于零，$U_{0}(r) \rightarrow 0$。假设行星在某一时刻远离太阳$(\dot{r}>0)$。如果$E>0$，随着$r$的增加，$\dot{r}$继续为正，行星从太阳移动到无穷远的距离。另一方面，如果$E<0$，随着$r$的增加，行星的$\dot{r}$变为零，即$\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}=0$。之后，$\dot{r}<0$，行星接近太阳。行星在$\dot{r}=0$的两点之间来回运动。因此，行星保持在距离太阳有限的范围内。因此，行星持续绕太阳旋转的条件是$\underline{E}<\underline{0}$。由于行星圆周运动时$r$是常数，半径应为有效势能$U_{0}(r)$取得最小值的$r=r_{0}$。因此，半径$r$和角动量$L$之间的关系是
$$ r=\frac{L^{2}}{\overline{G M m^{2}}} $$。
answer: E=\frac{1}{2} m \dot{r}^{2}+\frac{L^{2}}{2 m r^{2}}-\frac{G M m}{r}

question: Let a molarity (the number of moles in the unit volume) at height $z$ be $\rho(z)$, the equation of state is $p(z)=\rho(z) R T$. Let the base area of the container be $A$, and consider the balance of forces acting on the gas inside the infinitesimal region $A \cdot \Delta z$. Derive the expression for pressure $p(z)$ at height $z$ in terms of $p_{0}$, $\mu$, $g$, $R$, and $T$.
solution: Let a molarity (the number of moles in the unit volume) at height $z$ be $\rho(z)$, the equation of state is $$p(z)=\rho(z) R T$$ Let the base area of the container be $A$, and consider the balance of forces acting on the gas inside the infinitesimal region $A \cdot \Delta z$. The molarity $\rho(z)$ inside this infinitesimal region can be treated to be constant, so that we have $$p(z) A=p(z+\Delta z) A+\mu[\rho(z) A \Delta z] g$$ Denoting the pressure change accompanied by the height difference $\Delta z$ by $\Delta p=p(z+\Delta z)-p(z)$, we substitute Eq. (A.18) into Eq. (A.19) and employ replacements, $\Delta z \rightarrow d z$ and $\Delta p \rightarrow d p$, to obtain $$\frac{\Delta p}{\Delta z}=-\mu \rho(z) g \quad \Rightarrow \frac{d p}{d z}=-\frac{\mu g}{R T} p(z)$$ Separating the variables (refer Sec A. 7 Differential Equation 1) and using $p(0)=p_{0}$, we have $$\int_{p_{0}}^{p} \frac{d p}{p}=-\int_{0}^{z} \frac{\mu g}{R T} d z \quad \Rightarrow \quad \log \frac{p}{p_{0}}=-\frac{\mu g}{R T} z$$ from which we finally obtain $$p(z)=p_{0} \exp \left(-\frac{\mu g}{R T} z\right)$$

question: 设高度 $z$ 处的摩尔浓度（单位体积中的摩尔数）为 $\rho(z)$，状态方程为 $p(z)=\rho(z) R T$。设容器的底面积为 $A$，考虑作用在微小区域 $A \cdot \Delta z$ 内气体上的力的平衡。在高度 $z$ 处，推导出压力 $p(z)$ 关于 $p_{0}$、$\mu$、$g$、$R$ 和 $T$ 的表达式。
solution: 设高度 $z$ 处的摩尔浓度（单位体积中的摩尔数）为 $\rho(z)$，状态方程为 $$p(z)=\rho(z) R T$$ 设容器的底面积为 $A$，考虑在微小区域 $A \cdot \Delta z$ 内作用于气体的力的平衡。可以认为该微小区域内的摩尔浓度 $\rho(z)$ 为常数，因此我们有 $$p(z) A=p(z+\Delta z) A+\mu[\rho(z) A \Delta z] g$$ 用高度差 $\Delta z$ 引起的压力变化表示为 $\Delta p=p(z+\Delta z)-p(z)$，将方程 (A.18) 代入方程 (A.19)，并进行替换，$\Delta z \rightarrow d z$ 和 $\Delta p \rightarrow d p$，得到 $$\frac{\Delta p}{\Delta z}=-\mu \rho(z) g \quad \Rightarrow \frac{d p}{d z}=-\frac{\mu g}{R T} p(z)$$ 分离变量（参见 A.7 节 微分方程 1）并使用 $p(0)=p_{0}$，我们有 $$\int_{p_{0}}^{p} \frac{d p}{p}=-\int_{0}^{z} \frac{\mu g}{R T} d z \quad \Rightarrow \quad \log \frac{p}{p_{0}}=-\frac{\mu g}{R T} z$$ 从中我们最终得到 $$p(z)=p_{0} \exp \left(-\frac{\mu g}{R T} z\right)$$。

question:
(1) Find the amplitude, frequency, wavelength, and speed of propagation of the wave described by the equation
 
 $$
 y=0.2 \cos [\pi(5 t-2 x)]
 $$
 
 Here, the units of length and time are taken to be meter and second, respectively.
 (2) When a sinusoidal wave of amplitude 0.1 m and frequency 2 Hz travels at a speed of $2 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ in the $-x$ direction, derive the expression for the displacement $y$ at position $x$ at time $t$ by using an integer, $n$. Here, we assume that the displacement at the origin $(x=0)$ at time $t=0$ is zero, i.e., $y=0$.

(1) 求由以下方程描述的波的振幅、频率、波长和传播速度：

$$
y=0.2 \cos [\pi(5 t-2 x)]
$$

这里，长度和时间的单位分别为米和秒。

(2) 当一个振幅为0.1米、频率为2赫兹的正弦波以 $2 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ 的速度在 $-x$ 方向传播时，推导在位置 $x$ 处时间 $t$ 的位移 $y$ 的表达式，使用一个整数 $n$。这里假设在原点 $(x=0)$ 处时间 $t=0$ 时的位移为零，即 $y=0$。

Example 3.3. We observed a sinusoidal wave travelling along the $x$-axis at two positions ( $x=0$ and $x=1 \mathrm{~m}$ ), and found the displacements of the wave at these two positions as follows:
 
 $$
 y(0, t)=0.2 \cos (3 \pi t), \quad y(1, t)=0.2 \cos (3 \pi t+\pi / 8)
 $$
 
 Find the frequency, wavelength and speed of propagation of this wave in both cases in which the wave travels in the $+x$ and $-x$ directions, using the appropriate integer, $n$. Enumerate all the possible values of the wavelength longer than 0.7 m .
solution:
A comparison of the observed data with Eq. (3.7) gives us the frequency, $f=\underline{1.5 \mathrm{~Hz}}$.
 
 At the position 1 m away from the origin, the phase of the wave is shifted by $\frac{\pi}{8} \pm 2 n \pi(n=0,1,2, \ldots)$ from that at the origin (we can add an arbitrary integer multiple of $2 \pi$ ). If this phase difference is negative, its wave equation corresponds to Eq. (3.10) and can be regarded as a wave travelling in the $+x$ direction. In comparsion, if this phase difference is positive, it is a wave travelling in the $-x$ direction.
 
 Therefore, in the case of the wave travelling in the $+x$ direction, we have from Eq. (3.10)
 
 $$
 -\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}=\frac{\pi}{8}-2 n \pi, \quad(n=1,2, \ldots)
 $$
 
 from which we get
 
 $$
 \lambda=\frac{16}{\underline{\underline{16 n-1}}} \mathrm{~m}=\underline{\underline{1.1 \mathrm{~m}}}, \quad V=f \lambda=\frac{24}{\underline{\underline{16 n-1}}} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=\underline{\underline{1.6 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}
 $$
 
 where we substituted $n=1$ from the condition that $\lambda>0.7 \mathrm{~m}$.
 
 In the case of the wave travelling in the $-x$ direction, we have from Eq. (3.10)
 
 $$
 \frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}=\frac{\pi}{8}+2 n \pi, \quad(n=0,1,2, \ldots)
 $$
 
 from which we get
 
 $$
 \begin{gathered}
 \lambda=\frac{16}{\underline{\underline{16 n+1}}} \mathrm{~m}=\underline{\underline{16 \mathrm{~m}}}, \quad \underline{\underline{0.94 \mathrm{~m}}} \\
 V=f \lambda=\frac{24}{\underline{\underline{16 n+1}}} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=\underline{\underline{24 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}, \underline{\underline{1.4 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}
 \end{gathered}
 $$
 
 where we substituted $n=0$ and $n=1$ from the condition that $\lambda>0.7 \mathrm{~m}$.

question:
例 3.3. 我们观察到一个沿 $x$ 轴传播的正弦波在两个位置（$x=0$ 和 $x=1 \mathrm{~m}$），并发现该波在这两个位置的位移如下：

$$
y(0, t)=0.2 \cos (3 \pi t), \quad y(1, t)=0.2 \cos (3 \pi t+\pi / 8)
$$

求出在波沿 $+x$ 和 $-x$ 方向传播的情况下，该波的频率、波长和传播速度，使用适当的整数 $n$。列举所有波长大于 0.7 m 的可能值。
solution:
将观测数据与方程 (3.7) 进行比较，我们得到频率 $f=\underline{1.5 \mathrm{~Hz}}$。

在距离原点1米的位置，波的相位相对于原点的相位发生了 $\frac{\pi}{8} \pm 2 n \pi(n=0,1,2, \ldots)$ 的偏移（我们可以加上任意整数倍的 $2 \pi$）。如果这个相位差为负值，其波动方程对应于方程 (3.10)，可以视为沿 $+x$ 方向传播的波。相比较而言，如果这个相位差为正值，则是沿 $-x$ 方向传播的波。

因此，在波沿 $+x$ 方向传播的情况下，根据方程 (3.10) 我们有

$$
-\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}=\frac{\pi}{8}-2 n \pi, \quad(n=1,2, \ldots)
$$

由此我们得到

$$
\lambda=\frac{16}{\underline{\underline{16 n-1}}} \mathrm{~m}=\underline{\underline{1.1 \mathrm{~m}}}, \quad V=f \lambda=\frac{24}{\underline{\underline{16 n-1}}} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=\underline{\underline{1.6 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}
$$

其中我们代入了条件 $\lambda>0.7 \mathrm{~m}$ 的 $n=1$。

在波沿 $-x$ 方向传播的情况下，根据方程 (3.10) 我们有

$$
\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}=\frac{\pi}{8}+2 n \pi, \quad(n=0,1,2, \ldots)
$$

由此我们得到

$$
\begin{gathered}
\lambda=\frac{16}{\underline{\underline{16 n+1}}} \mathrm{~m}=\underline{\underline{16 \mathrm{~m}}}, \quad \underline{\underline{0.94 \mathrm{~m}}} \\
V=f \lambda=\frac{24}{\underline{\underline{16 n+1}}} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}=\underline{\underline{24 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}, \underline{\underline{1.4 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}}}
\end{gathered}
$$

其中我们代入了条件 $\lambda>0.7 \mathrm{~m}$ 的 $n=0$ 和 $n=1$。

question:
Example 3.5. Let us discuss a sinusoidal wave moving in the $+x$ direction.
 
 $$
 y_{1}(x, t)=A \sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{x}{v}\right)
 $$
 
 A wall located at $x=L$ reflects this wave. Answer the following questions for each of the following two cases: (a) The wall is a fixed end. (b) The wall is a free end.
 (1) Find the expression for the reflected wave.
 (2) Find the expression for the resultant wave produced by the incident wave and the reflected wave.
 
 Note that a fixed end is an end where the amplitude of the resultant wave of the incident and reflected waves vanishes at all times, whereas a free end is an end where the displacement of the reflected wave is equal to that of the incident wave.
solution:
(1) The reflected wave moves in the $-x$ direction, and has the same amplitude, period, and velocity as the incident wave. Therefore, the reflected wave can be written as
 
 $$
 y_{2}(x, t)=A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}
 $$
 
 where $\beta$ is a constant that is to be determined by the condition that the wave should satisfy at the end $x=L$ (a boundary condition).
 
 (a) In the case where $x=L$ is a fixed end, the displacement $y$ must always satisfy the condition $y(L, t)=y_{1}(L, t)+$ $y_{2}(L, t)=0$. Therefore,
 
 $$
 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)+\sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{L}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}=0
 $$
 
 From this equation, $\beta$ is determined to be $\beta=\frac{T}{2}-\frac{2 L}{v}$, and we obtain
 
 $$
 \begin{aligned}
 y_{2}(x, t) & =A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)+\pi\right\} \\
 & =-A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)\right\}
 \end{aligned}
 $$
 
 (b) On the other hand, in the case where $x=L$ is a free end, the displacement $y$ must satisfy the condition. $y_{1}(L, t)=$ $y_{2}(L, t)$. Therefore,
 
 $$
 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)=\sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{L}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}
 $$
 
 From this equation, $\beta$ is determined to be $\beta=-\frac{2 L}{v}$, and we obtain
 
 $$
 y_{2}(x, t)=\underbrace{A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)\right\}}_{2}
 $$
 
 (2) The resultant wave is $y(x, t)=y_{1}(x, t)+y_{2}(x, t)$. Then, we have
 (a) $y(x, t)=\underbrace{2 A \sin \left(\frac{2 \pi}{T} \cdot \frac{L-x}{v}\right) \cdot \cos \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)\right]}$
 (b) $y(x, t)=\underbrace{2 A \cos \left(\frac{2 \pi}{T} \cdot \frac{L-x}{v}\right) \cdot \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)\right]}$
 
 We can see that these resultant waves are standing waves, oscillating independently in time and in space.

question:
例 3.5. 让我们讨论一个在 $+x$ 方向上移动的正弦波。

$$
y_{1}(x, t)=A \sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{x}{v}\right)
$$

位于 $x=L$ 的墙反射这个波。针对以下两种情况回答以下问题：（a）墙是固定端。（b）墙是自由端。
(1) 找到反射波的表达式。
(2) 找到由入射波和反射波产生的合成波的表达式。

注意，固定端是指入射波和反射波的合成波的振幅在任何时候都消失的端点，而自由端是指反射波的位移等于入射波的位移的端点。
solution:
(1) 反射波沿着 $-x$ 方向移动，并且具有与入射波相同的振幅、周期和速度。因此，反射波可以写成

$$
y_{2}(x, t)=A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}
$$

其中 $\beta$ 是一个常数，需要通过波在 $x=L$ 端满足的条件（边界条件）来确定。

(a) 当 $x=L$ 是固定端时，位移 $y$ 必须始终满足条件 $y(L, t)=y_{1}(L, t)+y_{2}(L, t)=0$。因此，

$$
\sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)+\sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{L}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}=0
$$

从这个方程可以确定 $\beta$ 为 $\beta=\frac{T}{2}-\frac{2 L}{v}$，于是我们得到

$$
\begin{aligned}
y_{2}(x, t) & =A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)+\pi\right\} \\
& =-A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)\right\}
\end{aligned}
$$

(b) 另一方面，当 $x=L$ 是自由端时，位移 $y$ 必须满足条件 $y_{1}(L, t)=y_{2}(L, t)$。因此，

$$
\sin \frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)=\sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{L}{v}+\beta\right)\right\}
$$

从这个方程可以确定 $\beta$ 为 $\beta=-\frac{2 L}{v}$，于是我们得到

$$
y_{2}(x, t)=\underbrace{A \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t+\frac{x-2 L}{v}\right)\right\}}_{2}
$$

(2) 合成波是 $y(x, t)=y_{1}(x, t)+y_{2}(x, t)$。那么，我们有

(a) $y(x, t)=\underbrace{2 A \sin \left(\frac{2 \pi}{T} \cdot \frac{L-x}{v}\right) \cdot \cos \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)\right]}$

(b) $y(x, t)=\underbrace{2 A \cos \left(\frac{2 \pi}{T} \cdot \frac{L-x}{v}\right) \cdot \sin \left\{\frac{2 \pi}{T}\left(t-\frac{L}{v}\right)\right]}$

我们可以看到这些合成波是驻波，在时间和空间上独立振荡。

question:
Find the unit vector parallel to the XY plane and perpendicular to the vector:

$$
\vec{A}=4 \vec{i}-3 \vec{j}+\vec{k}
$$
solution:
$\vec{u}=u_{x} \vec{i}+u_{y} \vec{j}+u_{z} \vec{k}$ with: $u_{z}=0$; and if: $/ / \vec{U} / /=1$ then:
$1=u_{x}^{2}+u_{y}^{2} ;$ \& if $\vec{u} \perp \vec{A}$ (perpendicular), then: $4 u_{x}-3 u_{y}=0$
In this way: $\vec{u}=\frac{3}{5} \vec{i}+\frac{4}{5} \vec{j}$

question: 找到与XY平面平行且与向量$$\vec{A}=4 \vec{i}-3 \vec{j}+\vec{k}$$垂直的单位向量。
solution: $\vec{u}=u_{x} \vec{i}+u_{y} \vec{j}+u_{z} \vec{k}$ 其中：$u_{z}=0$；如果：$/\ / \vec{U} / /=1$，那么：$1=u_{x}^{2}+u_{y}^{2}$；并且如果 $\vec{u} \perp \vec{A}$（垂直），那么：$4 u_{x}-3 u_{y}=0$。因此：$\vec{u}=\frac{3}{5} \vec{i}+\frac{4}{5} \vec{j}$。

$$

because: $\quad \vec{v}=3 \vec{i}+(4-10 t) \vec{j} \quad$ \& $\quad \vec{a}=-10 \vec{j}$, then:

question: What fraction of the total volume of an iceberg is out of the water? We know that the density of ice and seawater are 0.92 and 1.03 respectively.
solution:
$V_{t}=V^{\prime}+V$ where: $V^{\prime}=$ volume of the submerged part, \& $V=$ volume of the emerged part. On the other hand:
Weight $=P=d_{\text {ice }}-V_{t} g-d_{\text {water }} V^{\prime} g=E=$ Push $\Rightarrow \frac{V^{\prime}}{V}=\frac{d_{\text {ice }}}{d_{\text {water }}}=\frac{0.92}{1.03} \&$
$1=\frac{V_{t}}{V_{t}}=\frac{V+V^{\prime}}{V_{t}}=\frac{V}{V_{t}}+\frac{V^{\prime}}{V_{t}} \Rightarrow \frac{V}{V_{t}}=1-\frac{V^{\prime}}{V_{t}}=1-\frac{0.92}{1.03}=\frac{11}{103} \Rightarrow$
The fraction is: $11 \%$

$1=\frac{V_{t}}{V_{t}}=\frac{V+V^{\prime}}{V_{t}}=\frac{V}{V_{t}}+\frac{V^{\prime}}{V_{t}} \Rightarrow \frac{V}{V_{t}}=1-\frac{V^{\prime}}{V_{t}}=1-\frac{0.92}{1.03}=\frac{11}{103} \Rightarrow$

question: 一满水的水箱，其截面积为$10 \, \text{m}^{2}$，高度为1 m。计算当水通过位于底部且截面积为$100 \, \text{cm}^{2}$的孔排出时，水位降低一半所需的时间。
solution:
使用托里拆利定律来计算流速，$v = \sqrt{2gh}$，并应用体积流率的公式：

$\frac{dV}{dt} = s v$，其中$S$是水箱的截面积，$s$是孔的截面积，我们可以将时间表示为：

$t = 132 \, \text{s}$。

question: The oil from a $2,000 \mathrm{~m}$ deep well has a pressure of: $200 \mathrm{kp} / \mathrm{cm}^{2}$. Calculate the height of the mud column necessary to plug and compensate this pressure, knowing that $1 m^{3}$ of mud weighs 2.5 Tm.
solution: $$ (\text { s.w. })_{\text {mud }}=\frac{2.5}{1} \Rightarrow(\text { s.w. })_{\text {mud }}=2,500 \mathrm{kp} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \Rightarrow H=\frac{P}{s . w .}=\frac{200}{2,500} * 10^{4} \Rightarrow $$ $H=800 m$

question: 来自一个深度为$2,000 \mathrm{~m}$的油井的油的压力为：$200 \mathrm{kp} / \mathrm{cm}^{2}$。计算泥浆柱的高度，以堵住并补偿该压力，已知$1 m^{3}$的泥浆重2.5 Tm。
solution:
$$ (\text { s.w. })_{\text {mud }}=\frac{2.5}{1} \Rightarrow(\text { s.w. })_{\text {mud }}=2,500 \mathrm{kp} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \Rightarrow H=\frac{P}{s . w .}=\frac{200}{2,500} * 10^{4} \Rightarrow $$ $H=800 m$。翻译: 

$$ (\text { s.w. })_{\text {泥浆 }}=\frac{2.5}{1} \Rightarrow(\text { s.w. })_{\text {泥浆 }}=2,500 \mathrm{kp} / \mathrm{m}^{3} \Rightarrow H=\frac{P}{s . w .}=\frac{200}{2,500} * 10^{4} \Rightarrow $$ $H=800 m$。

question: Calculate the volume of water, which flows per minute, of a tank through a 2 cm diameter hole 5 m below the level of the water in the tank which remains constant.
solution: Applying Bernoulli's Theorem to liquid free surface points, (point: 1) & those of the hole (point: 2) & because: $P_{1}=P_{2}=P_{\text {atm }} \& v_{1} \approx 0$ Then :  $\frac{1}{2} d v_{1}^{2}=h_{1} d g=\frac{1}{2} d v_{2}^{2} \Rightarrow v_{2}^{2}=2 \mathrm{~g}\left(h_{1}-h_{2}\right)=2 \mathrm{gh} \Rightarrow v_{2}=\sqrt{2 \mathrm{gh}} \Rightarrow v_{2}=\sqrt{2 * 9.8 * 5}=9.9 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s} \Rightarrow$ Spenditure $=G=A_{2} v_{2}=\frac{\pi}{4}\left(2 * 10^{-2}\right)^{2} 9.9 * 60 \Rightarrow G=0.186 \mathrm{~m}^{3} / \mathrm{min}$

question: 计算水箱中通过一个直径为2 cm且位于水箱水面下5 m的孔每分钟流出的水的体积，水箱水位保持不变。
solution: 将伯努利定理应用于液体自由表面点（点：1）和孔的点（点：2），因为：$P_{1}=P_{2}=P_{\text {atm }} \& v_{1} \approx 0$，那么：$\frac{1}{2} d v_{1}^{2}=h_{1} d g=\frac{1}{2} d v_{2}^{2} \Rightarrow v_{2}^{2}=2 \mathrm{~g}\left(h_{1}-h_{2}\right)=2 \mathrm{gh} \Rightarrow v_{2}=\sqrt{2 \mathrm{gh}} \Rightarrow v_{2}=\sqrt{2 * 9.8 * 5}=9.9 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s} \Rightarrow$ 流量 $=G=A_{2} v_{2}=\frac{\pi}{4}\left(2 * 10^{-2}\right)^{2} 9.9 * 60 \Rightarrow G=0.186 \mathrm{~m}^{3} / \mathrm{min}$。

question: Determine the final result when 400gr of water and 100 gr of ice at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, which are contained in a calorimeter whose equivalent in water is 50 gr and to which 10 gr of water vapor is sent at $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$
solution: $Q_{\text {ceded }}=10 \mathrm{~L}_{v}+10 * 1(100-t)=5,400+10(100-t) \quad$ where: $L_{v}$ is the heat of vaporisation with: $L_{v}=540$ units  $Q_{\text {absorbed }}=400 * 1(t-0)+100 \mathrm{~L}_{f}+100 * 1(t-0)+w * 1(t-0) \quad$ where: $L_{f}$ melting heat of ice \& w the calorimeter equivalent $\Rightarrow$  $Q_{\text {absorbed }}=550 \mathrm{t}+8,000=Q_{\text {ceded }} \Rightarrow t=-2.8^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \quad$ therefore, not all ice melts, then:  $\left.\begin{array}{l}Q_{\text {ceded }}=m_{v} L_{v}+m_{v} c(100-0)=6,400 \mathrm{cal} \\ Q_{\text {absorbed }}=m^{\prime}{ }_{h} L_{f}\end{array}\right\} \Rightarrow m_{h}^{\prime}=\frac{6,400}{80}=80 \mathrm{gr} \quad \Rightarrow$ The final result is : 20gr of ice \& 490gr of water, all of them at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$

question: 确定当400克水和100克冰在$0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$时，它们被装在一个等效于50克水的量热计中，并向其中注入10克水蒸气在$100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$时的最终结果。
solution: $Q_{\text {ceded }}=10 \mathrm{~L}_{v}+10 * 1(100-t)=5,400+10(100-t) \quad$ 其中: $L_{v}$ 是汽化热，且: $L_{v}=540$ 单位  $Q_{\text {absorbed }}=400 * 1(t-0)+100 \mathrm{~L}_{f}+100 * 1(t-0)+w * 1(t-0) \quad$ 其中: $L_{f}$ 是冰的熔化热，$w$ 是量热计当量 $\Rightarrow$  $Q_{\text {absorbed }}=550 \mathrm{t}+8,000=Q_{\text {ceded }} \Rightarrow t=-2.8^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \quad$ 因此，并非所有的冰都融化，然后:  $\left.\begin{array}{l}Q_{\text {ceded }}=m_{v} L_{v}+m_{v} c(100-0)=6,400 \mathrm{cal} \\ Q_{\text {absorbed }}=m^{\prime}{ }_{h} L_{f}\end{array}\right\} \Rightarrow m_{h}^{\prime}=\frac{6,400}{80}=80 \mathrm{gr} \quad \Rightarrow$ 最终结果是: 20克冰和490克水，所有这些都在 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$。

question: Calculate the work done when a gas expands from the volume: $V_{1}$ to: $V_{2}$, being the relationship between pressure and volume the following: $$ \left(P+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)(V-b)=K \quad \text { where: } a, b \& K \text { are constants. } $$
solution: $D W=P * D V \Rightarrow W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2} P d V \quad$ where: $\quad P=\frac{K}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}} \quad \&$ so: $W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2}\left(\frac{K}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right) d V \Rightarrow W=(K \ln (V-b)+\frac{a}{V}) \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}$

question: 计算当气体从体积 $V_{1}$ 膨胀到 $V_{2}$ 时所做的功，其中压力和体积之间的关系如下：$$ \left(P+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)(V-b)=K \quad \text{其中：} a, b \& K \text{ 是常数。} $$。
solution: $D W=P * D V \Rightarrow W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2} P d V \quad$ 其中：$\quad P=\frac{K}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}} \quad \&$ 所以：$W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2}\left(\frac{K}{V-b}-\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right) d V \Rightarrow W=(K \ln (V-b)+\frac{a}{V}) \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}$。

question: They are mixed in a calorimeter of equivalent in water $10 \mathrm{gr}, 100 \mathrm{gr}$ of ice at $-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ with 200 gr of water at $80^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate: a) The final temperature of the mixture. b) The amount of water steam at $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ that would have to be entered for the final temperature to be $90^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Data: - Specific heat of ice: $\quad c_{h}=0.5 \mathrm{cal} \cdot \mathrm{gr}^{-1} \cdot{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}^{-1}$ - Latent heat of fusion: $\quad L_{f}=80 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{gr}$ - Latent heat of vaporization: $540 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{gr}$
solution: a) $$ D Q=m_{a} c_{a} D T \quad \& \quad m=200+100=210 \mathrm{gr} \text { with: } $$ $D Q_{1}=210 * 1 *(80-T)$ (heat yielded by water) $D Q_{2}=m_{b} c_{b} D T=100 * 0.5 *(0-(-10))=500 \mathrm{cal} \quad\left(\right.$ from $\left.-10\right.$ to $\left.0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ $D Q_{3}=m_{b} L_{f}=100 * 80=8,000 \mathrm{cal} \quad$ (from ice to water at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ) $D Q_{4}=m_{a} c_{a}(T-0)=100 * 1 *(T-0)=100 \mathrm{Tcal} \quad$ (water from 0 to $\left.T^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ And because: $D Q_{1}=D Q_{2}+D Q_{3}+D Q_{4} \Rightarrow T=26.8^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ b) $$ \left.\begin{array}{l} D Q_{1}=m_{c} L_{c}=m_{v} 540 \\ D Q_{2}=m_{v} c_{a}(100-90)=10 m_{v} \\ D Q_{3}=m c_{a}\left(T_{f}-T_{m}\right) \\ D Q_{4}=310 * 1 *(90-26.8)=19,562 \mathrm{cal}=D Q_{1}+D Q_{2} \end{array}\right\} \quad \Rightarrow $$ $$ 1,952=540 \mathrm{~m}_{v}+10 \mathrm{~m}_{v} \quad \Rightarrow \quad m_{v}=35.6 g r $$

question: 它们在一个等效于水的热量计中混合，$10 \mathrm{gr}$，$100 \mathrm{gr}$的冰在$-10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$与$200 \mathrm{gr}$的水在$80^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$中混合。计算：a) 混合物的最终温度。b) 需要加入多少在$100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$的水蒸气使最终温度达到$90^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$。数据：- 冰的比热容：$\quad c_{h}=0.5 \mathrm{cal} \cdot \mathrm{gr}^{-1} \cdot{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}^{-1}$ - 融化潜热：$\quad L_{f}=80 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{gr}$ - 汽化潜热：$540 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{gr}$。
solution:
a) $$ D Q=m_{a} c_{a} D T \quad \& \quad m=200+100=210 \mathrm{gr} \text { with: } $$ $D Q_{1}=210 * 1 *(80-T)$（水释放的热量）$D Q_{2}=m_{b} c_{b} D T=100 * 0.5 *(0-(-10))=500 \mathrm{cal} \quad\left(\right.$ 从 $\left.-10\right.$ 到 $\left.0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ $D Q_{3}=m_{b} L_{f}=100 * 80=8,000 \mathrm{cal} \quad$（从冰到 $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 的水）$D Q_{4}=m_{a} c_{a}(T-0)=100 * 1 *(T-0)=100 \mathrm{Tcal} \quad$（水从 0 到 $\left.T^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ 而且因为：$D Q_{1}=D Q_{2}+D Q_{3}+D Q_{4} \Rightarrow T=26.8^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$

b) $$ \left.\begin{array}{l} D Q_{1}=m_{c} L_{c}=m_{v} 540 \\ D Q_{2}=m_{v} c_{a}(100-90)=10 m_{v} \\ D Q_{3}=m c_{a}\left(T_{f}-T_{m}\right) \\ D Q_{4}=310 * 1 *(90-26.8)=19,562 \mathrm{cal}=D Q_{1}+D Q_{2} \end{array}\right\} \quad \Rightarrow $$ $$ 1,952=540 \mathrm{~m}_{v}+10 \mathrm{~m}_{v} \quad \Rightarrow \quad m_{v}=35.6 g r $$。

question:
A diatomic gas is enclosed at atmospheric pressure and at 300 K in a vertical cylinder covered by a 10 cm radius sliding piston.

Calculate:

a) What weights must be placed on the piston so that, heated the gas up to 400 K, it continues to occupy the same volume?
b) How many calories should it gives each mol of the gas to obtain this constant volume heating?
c) If the temperature increase were reached at constant pressure without putting weights, how many calories per mol would have been needed?
solution: $$ \frac{P_{A}}{T_{A}}=\frac{P_{B}}{T_{B}} \Rightarrow P_{B}=P_{A} \frac{T_{B}}{T_{A}}=\frac{1,400}{300}=1.33 \mathrm{~atm} \& \text { because: } \ D P=P_{B}-P_{A} $$ a) $D P=0.33 \mathrm{~atm}=3.34 * 10^{5} \mathrm{din} / \mathrm{cm}^{2} \ $ because: $\ D P=m \frac{g}{S} \Rightarrow$ $m g=D P * S=D P * 4 \pi r^{2}=1.05 * 10^{8} \mathrm{din} \Rightarrow$ $m g=1.07 * 10^{2} \mathrm{kp}$ $D Q_{v}=n C_{v} D T$ with: $C_{v}=\frac{5}{2} R$ (is a diatomic gas) \& so: b) $\frac{D Q_{v}}{R}=\frac{5}{2} R D T=\frac{5}{2} * 1.987 *(400-300)=498 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} \Rightarrow$ $$ \frac{D Q_{v}}{R}=498 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} $$ $$ \text { If: } P=\text { constant } \Rightarrow \frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=C_{p} R T \Rightarrow C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R \Rightarrow $$ c) $\frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=\frac{7}{2} * 1.987 *(400-300) \Rightarrow \frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=697 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} \ $ and also: $\frac{W}{R}=\frac{D Q_{p}}{R}-\frac{D Q_{v}}{R} \Rightarrow \frac{W}{R}=199 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol}$

question:
一个双原子气体在大气压和300 K的条件下被封闭在一个垂直圆柱中，顶部覆盖着一个半径为10 cm的滑动活塞。

计算：

a) 必须在活塞上放置多重的砝码，以便在将气体加热到400 K时，它继续占据相同的体积？
b) 为了获得这种恒定体积加热，每摩尔气体需要多少卡路里？
c) 如果温度增加是在不放置砝码的情况下以恒定压力达到的，每摩尔需要多少卡路里？
solution: $$ \frac{P_{A}}{T_{A}}=\frac{P_{B}}{T_{B}} \Rightarrow P_{B}=P_{A} \frac{T_{B}}{T_{A}}=\frac{1,400}{300}=1.33 \mathrm{~atm} \& \text { 因为: } \ D P=P_{B}-P_{A} $$ a) $D P=0.33 \mathrm{~atm}=3.34 * 10^{5} \mathrm{din} / \mathrm{cm}^{2} \ $ 因为: $\ D P=m \frac{g}{S} \Rightarrow$ $m g=D P * S=D P * 4 \pi r^{2}=1.05 * 10^{8} \mathrm{din} \Rightarrow$ $m g=1.07 * 10^{2} \mathrm{kp}$ $D Q_{v}=n C_{v} D T$ 其中: $C_{v}=\frac{5}{2} R$ (是一个双原子气体) \& 所以: b) $\frac{D Q_{v}}{R}=\frac{5}{2} R D T=\frac{5}{2} * 1.987 *(400-300)=498 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} \Rightarrow$ $$ \frac{D Q_{v}}{R}=498 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} $$ $$ \text { 如果: } P=\text { 常数 } \Rightarrow \frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=C_{p} R T \Rightarrow C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R \Rightarrow $$ c) $\frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=\frac{7}{2} * 1.987 *(400-300) \Rightarrow \frac{D Q_{p}}{R}=697 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} \ $ 并且: $\frac{W}{R}=\frac{D Q_{p}}{R}-\frac{D Q_{v}}{R} \Rightarrow \frac{W}{R}=199 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol}$。

question:
In an environment at $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}, \quad 100 \mathrm{~kg}$ of ice initially melts at $-5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, becoming water at that temperature.

Determine the variation of total entropy.
solution:
The process is:

$$
-5^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (ice) } \begin{aligned}
& D S_{1} \\
& =0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (ice) } \\
& 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (water) } \\
& 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (water) }
\end{aligned}
$$

Where: $\quad D S_{T}=D S_{1}+D S_{2}+D S_{3} \quad$ with:

$$
\left.\begin{array}{l}
D S_{1}=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{m c}{T} d T=m_{b} c_{b} \ln \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}=100 * 0.5 \ln \frac{273}{268}=0.9242 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K} \\
D S_{2}=\int_{2}^{3} \frac{\delta Q}{T}=\frac{1}{T} \int_{2}^{3} \delta Q=\frac{m_{b}}{T} L_{f}\left|\frac{3}{2}=\frac{m_{b}}{T} * \frac{L_{f}}{T_{2}-T_{3}}=29.30 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}\right\rangle \Rightarrow \\
D S_{3}=\int_{3}^{4} \frac{m c}{T} d T=m_{a} c_{a} \ln \frac{T_{3}}{T_{3}}=7.07 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}
\end{array}\right\} \Rightarrow
$$

So: $D S_{T}=0.92+29.30+7.07 \Rightarrow D S_{T}=37.29 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}$

question:
在$20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$的环境中，$100 \mathrm{~kg}$的冰最初在$-5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$融化，变成该温度下的水。

确定总熵的变化。
solution:
过程是：

$$
-5^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (冰) } \begin{aligned}
& D S_{1} \\
& =0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (冰) } \\
& 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (水) } \\
& 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \text { (水) }
\end{aligned}
$$

其中：$\quad D S_{T}=D S_{1}+D S_{2}+D S_{3} \quad$ 其中：

$$
\left.\begin{array}{l}
D S_{1}=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{m c}{T} d T=m_{b} c_{b} \ln \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}=100 * 0.5 \ln \frac{273}{268}=0.9242 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K} \\
D S_{2}=\int_{2}^{3} \frac{\delta Q}{T}=\frac{1}{T} \int_{2}^{3} \delta Q=\frac{m_{b}}{T} L_{f}\left|\frac{3}{2}=\frac{m_{b}}{T} * \frac{L_{f}}{T_{2}-T_{3}}=29.30 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}\right\rangle \Rightarrow \\
D S_{3}=\int_{3}^{4} \frac{m c}{T} d T=m_{a} c_{a} \ln \frac{T_{3}}{T_{3}}=7.07 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}
\end{array}\right\} \Rightarrow
$$

所以：$D S_{T}=0.92+29.30+7.07 \Rightarrow D S_{T}=37.29 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}$。

question: 1 mol of an ideal gas is heated from $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ to $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ as follows: a) At constant pressure of 1 atm b) At a constant volume of 22.41 Calculate in case: 1) The heat absorbed. 2) The work done by the gas. 3) The variation of internal energy. Data: $\quad C_{p}=10 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K} \& R=2,0 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K}$
solution: 1) $Q=n C_{p} d T=1 * 10 *(100-0) \Rightarrow Q=1,000 \mathrm{cal}$ a) 2) $W=P\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)$ with: $\quad V_{2}=n R \frac{T_{2}}{P_{2}}=1 * 0.082 * \frac{373}{1}=30.591 \Rightarrow$ $W=1 *(30.59-22,4) \Rightarrow W=198 \mathrm{cal}$ 3) $D U=n C_{v} d T=1 *(10-2) * 100 \Rightarrow D U=800 \mathrm{cal}$ 4) If $V=$ constant $\Rightarrow Q=n C_{v} d T=1 * 8 * 100 \quad \&$ so: $Q=800 \mathrm{cal}$ b) 5) If $V=$ constant $\Rightarrow D V=0 \Rightarrow W=0$ 6) If $V=$ constant $\Rightarrow D U=Q \Rightarrow D U=800 \mathrm{cal}$

question: 1摩尔理想气体从$0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$加热到$100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$，如下进行：a) 在恒压1 atm下 b) 在恒定体积22.41下 计算在以下情况下：1) 吸收的热量。2) 气体所做的功。3) 内能的变化。数据：$\quad C_{p}=10 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K} \& R=2,0 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K}$。
solution:
1) $Q=n C_{p} d T=1 * 10 *(100-0) \Rightarrow Q=1,000 \mathrm{cal}$ a)  
2) $W=P\left(V_{2}-V_{1}\right)$ 其中： $\quad V_{2}=n R \frac{T_{2}}{P_{2}}=1 * 0.082 * \frac{373}{1}=30.591 \Rightarrow$ $W=1 *(30.59-22,4) \Rightarrow W=198 \mathrm{cal}$  
3) $D U=n C_{v} d T=1 *(10-2) * 100 \Rightarrow D U=800 \mathrm{cal}$  
4) 如果 $V=$ 常量 $\Rightarrow Q=n C_{v} d T=1 * 8 * 100 \quad \&$ 因此: $Q=800 \mathrm{cal}$ b)  
5) 如果 $V=$ 常量 $\Rightarrow D V=0 \Rightarrow W=0$  
6) 如果 $V=$ 常量 $\Rightarrow D U=Q \Rightarrow D U=800 \mathrm{cal}$。

question:
64 $\mathrm{gr}$ of oxygen at the pressure of $P=4 \mathrm{atm}$ and $T=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ undergo the following processes:

1) Cooling to constant volume until the pressure is reduced by half.
2) Constant pressure heating to double its volume.
3) Isothermal compression until reaching the initial conditions.

Calculate the efficiency of a refrigerating machine that works according to that cycle.
solution:
We will start by making a graphical representation and a table of values:
![img-137.jpeg](images/img-137.jpeg)

The values in italics were calculated as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}
& n=\frac{64}{32}=2 \mathrm{~mol} \Rightarrow V_{a}=n R \frac{T_{a}}{P_{a}}=2 * 0.082 * \frac{300}{4}=12.31=V_{b} \\
& V_{c}=2 \mathrm{~V}_{a}=2 * 12.3=24.61 \text { \& on the other hand: } \\
& Q_{a b}=n C_{v}\left(T_{b}-T_{a}\right)=2 * \frac{5}{2} R(150-300)=-1,500 \mathrm{cal} \\
& Q_{b c}=n C_{p}\left(T_{c}-T_{b}\right)=2 * \frac{7}{2} R(300-150)=2,100 \mathrm{cal} \\
& Q_{c a}=n R T \ln \frac{V_{a}}{V_{c}}=2 * 2 * 300 \ln \frac{12.3}{24.6}=-831.7 \mathrm{cal}
\end{aligned}
$$

Gregorio Chenlo Romero (gregochenlo.blogspot.com)
effectiveness $=e=\frac{Q_{2}}{Q_{1}-Q_{2}} \quad$ where :
$Q_{1}$ : heat ceded to hot focus (negative heat
but taking its absolute value)
$Q_{2}$ : heat absorbed to cold focus ( heat with positive sign)
$Q_{1}=\left|Q_{a b}\right|+\left|Q_{c a}\right|=2,330.7$ cal $\quad$ where: $\quad e=\frac{2,100}{2,330.7-2,100} \Rightarrow$
Effectiveness $=9.14$

question:
64 $\mathrm{gr}$ 的氧气在压力 $P=4 \mathrm{atm}$ 和 $T=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 下经历以下过程：

1) 在恒定体积下冷却，直到压力减半。
2) 在恒定压力下加热至其体积的两倍。
3) 等温压缩直到达到初始条件。

计算根据该循环工作的制冷机的效率。
solution:
我们将首先制作一个图形表示和一个数值表：

斜体的数值是通过以下方式计算的：

$$
