question: If $m$ grams of water are mixed at $50^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ with $2m$ grams at $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the entropy variation of the system when equilibrium has been reached.
solution: Because: $Q_{\text {absorbed }}=Q_{\text {ceded }} \Rightarrow 1 \mathrm{~m}(50-T_{f})=2 \mathrm{~m}(T_{f}-20) \Rightarrow T_{f}=30^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \Rightarrow$ So the entropy variation of $m$ will be: $D S_{1}=\int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} m \frac{D T}{T}=\int_{323}^{303} m \frac{D T}{T}=m \ln \frac{303}{323} \Rightarrow D S_{1}=-0.064 \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{K} \&$ because: the entropy variation for $2m$ is: $D S_{2}=\int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} 2 \mathrm{~m} \frac{d T}{T}=\int_{323}^{303} 2 \mathrm{~m} \frac{d T}{T}=0.067 \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{K} \quad \&$ because: $\quad D S=D S_{1}+D S_{2}$: $D S=3 * 10^{-3} \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{k}$

question: 如果 $m$ 克的水在 $50^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 与 $2m$ 克的水在 $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ 混合。当达到平衡时，计算系统的熵变。
solution: 因为：$Q_{\text{吸收}} = Q_{\text{放出}} \Rightarrow 1 \mathrm{~m}(50-T_{f}) = 2 \mathrm{~m}(T_{f}-20) \Rightarrow T_{f} = 30^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \Rightarrow$ 所以$m$的熵变为：$D S_{1} = \int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} m \frac{D T}{T} = \int_{323}^{303} m \frac{D T}{T} = m \ln \frac{303}{323} \Rightarrow D S_{1} = -0.064 \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{K} \&$ 因为：$2m$的熵变为：$D S_{2} = \int_{T_{i}}^{T_{f}} 2 \mathrm{~m} \frac{d T}{T} = \int_{323}^{303} 2 \mathrm{~m} \frac{d T}{T} = 0.067 \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{K} \quad \&$ 因为：$\quad D S = D S_{1} + D S_{2}$：$D S = 3 * 10^{-3} \mathrm{mcal} / \mathrm{k}$。

question: 1mol of a perfect gas expands isothermally at $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ from an initial volume of 21 to a final volume of 81. Calculate the variation of internal energy, enthalpy and entropy knowing that $R=2 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K}$
solution: If the temperature remains constant: $\quad \boldsymbol{D} \boldsymbol{U}=\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{D H}$ $D S=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\delta Q}{T}=\frac{1}{T_{1}} \int_{1}^{2} \delta Q=\frac{Q_{1,2}}{T_{1}} \quad \&$ because: $Q_{1,2}=W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2} P d V=n R T_{1} \ln \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}} \Rightarrow D S=n R \ln \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}} \Rightarrow$ $\boldsymbol{D S}=2.76 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}$

question: 1摩尔的理想气体在$27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$下等温膨胀，其初始体积为21，最终体积为81。已知$R=2 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{mol} . \mathrm{K}$，计算内能、焓和熵的变化。
solution: 如果温度保持不变：$\quad \boldsymbol{D} \boldsymbol{U}=\boldsymbol{0}=\boldsymbol{D H}$，$D S=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\delta Q}{T}=\frac{1}{T_{1}} \int_{1}^{2} \delta Q=\frac{Q_{1,2}}{T_{1}} \quad \&$，因为：$Q_{1,2}=W_{1,2}=\int_{1}^{2} P d V=n R T_{1} \ln \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}} \Rightarrow D S=n R \ln \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}} \Rightarrow$ $\boldsymbol{D S}=2.76 \mathrm{cal} / \mathrm{K}$。

question:
Calculate the power required to compress, up to a pressure of: $5 \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{cm}^{2}$ a volume of $10 \mathrm{~m}^{3} / \mathrm{h}$ of air initially taken at the pressure of 760 mm of Hg and $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, in the following cases:

a) When the compression is isothermal.
b) When the compression is adiabatic.

Take: $\gamma=1,4 \& 1 \text{ atm}=1 \mathrm{~kg} / \mathrm{cm}^{2}$
solution:
a) $W=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}} P d V=n R T \ln \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}=P_{1} V_{1} \ln \frac{P_{1}}{P_{2}}=-16,077$ atm. $l=-1,626,992.4 \mathrm{~J}$

And because: $\quad P=\frac{W}{t}=\frac{1,626,992.4}{3,600} \Rightarrow P=451.94 w$
b)

$$\begin{aligned}
& W^{\prime}=\int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}} P d V=P V^{\mathrm{y}} \int_{V_{1}}^{V_{2}} \frac{d V}{V^{\mathrm{y}}}=P V^{\mathrm{y}} \frac{V_{2}^{1-\mathrm{y}}-V_{1}^{1-\mathrm{y}}}{1-\mathrm{y}}=\frac{P_{2} V_{2}-P_{1} V_{1}}{1-\mathrm{y}} \& \text { because: } \\
& P_{1} V_{1}^{\mathrm{y}}=P_{2} V_{2}^{\mathrm{y}} \Rightarrow V_{2}=V_{1}\left(\frac{P_{1}}{P_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{y}}=10^{4} *\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^{\frac{1}{1.4}}=3,130 l \quad \text { so: } \\
& W^{\prime}=\frac{5 * 3,130-10^{4}}{1-1.4}=-1,429,440 \mathrm{~J} \quad \text { because: } P^{\prime}=\frac{W^{\prime}}{t} \Rightarrow \\
& P^{\prime}=\frac{1,429,440}{3,600} \Rightarrow P^{\prime}=397.66 w
\end{aligned}$$

question:
Considering a spherical capacitor, of varying capacity, which is subject to a constant potential difference between its armors.

If the radius of the external armor is also constant. Calculate the ratio of radius so that the field on the surface of the internal armor is maximum.
solution:
If it calls: $R_{1} \& R_{2}$ to the radius of the inner and outer spheres respectively, then the capacity will be given by the expression:
$$C=4 \pi e_{o} \frac{R_{2}}{1 /(x-1)} \quad \text { with: } \quad x=\frac{R_{1}}{R_{2}} \Rightarrow C=4 \pi e_{o} R_{2} \frac{x}{1-x}=4 \pi e_{o} \frac{R_{1} R_{2}}{R_{2}-R_{1}}$$
Also, the field created by an spherical charge distribution is:
$E=k \frac{q}{r^{2}}$ and so, on the inner surface, the field will be:
$E=k \frac{q}{R_{1}^{2}}=k C \frac{V}{R_{1}^{2}}=4 \pi e_{o} R_{2} x \frac{V}{(1-x) 4 \pi e_{o} R_{1}^{2}} \&$ because: $R_{1}^{2}=R_{2}^{2} x^{2}$ so:
$E=\frac{V}{R_{2} x(1-x)}=\frac{V}{R_{2}\left(x-x^{2}\right)}$ which is maximum when $:\left(x-x^{2}\right)$ is minimum $\Rightarrow$
$d \frac{x-x^{2}}{d x}=0 \quad 1-2 x=0 \Rightarrow x=0.5$

question:
考虑一个球形电容器，其电容量是变化的，并且在其电极之间存在恒定的电势差。

如果外部电极的半径也是恒定的，计算内电极表面电场达到最大时的半径比。
solution:
如果将$R_{1}$和$R_{2}$分别称为内球和外球的半径，那么电容将由以下表达式给出：
$$C=4 \pi e_{o} \frac{R_{2}}{1 /(x-1)} \quad \text{其中:} \quad x=\frac{R_{1}}{R_{2}} \Rightarrow C=4 \pi e_{o} R_{2} \frac{x}{1-x}=4 \pi e_{o} \frac{R_{1} R_{2}}{R_{2}-R_{1}}$$
此外，由球形电荷分布产生的电场为：
$E=k \frac{q}{r^{2}}$，因此在内表面上，电场为：
$E=k \frac{q}{R_{1}^{2}}=k C \frac{V}{R_{1}^{2}}=4 \pi e_{o} R_{2} x \frac{V}{(1-x) 4 \pi e_{o} R_{1}^{2}}$，因为：$R_{1}^{2}=R_{2}^{2} x^{2}$，所以：
$E=\frac{V}{R_{2} x(1-x)}=\frac{V}{R_{2}\left(x-x^{2}\right)}$，当$:\left(x-x^{2}\right)$最小时，达到最大值$\Rightarrow$
$d \frac{x-x^{2}}{d x}=0 \quad 1-2 x=0 \Rightarrow x=0.5$。

question:
A fluorescent tube consumes 60 w at a high alternating voltage of $V_{e}=120 v \& 50 \mathrm{Hz}$

If the tube, due to its inductance, has a power factor of 0.5, what capacity must be placed in parallel so that the power factor is 1?
solution:
$$
\begin{aligned}
& P_{m}=V_{e} I_{e} \cos \Phi=I_{e}^{2} R \Rightarrow I_{e}=\frac{P_{m}}{V_{e} \cos \Phi} \Rightarrow I_{e}=\frac{60}{120 * 0,5}=1 \mathrm{~A} \text { also: } \\
& R=\frac{P}{I_{e}^{2}}=\frac{60}{1^{2}} \Rightarrow R=60 \Omega \quad \text { because: } \tan \Phi=\frac{L \omega}{R}=\frac{\sin \Phi}{\cos \Phi}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\cos ^{2} \Phi}}{\cos \Phi} \Rightarrow \\
& L=\frac{R}{\omega} * \frac{\sqrt{1-\cos ^{2} \Phi}}{\cos \Phi} \Rightarrow L=0.33 \text{Hy}
\end{aligned}
$$

Now, when connecting the circuit, it looks like the following:

![img-215.jpeg](images/img-215.jpeg)

Where: $I_{C}=\frac{V_{e}}{1 /(C \omega)}$ \& also: $I_{R L}=\frac{V_{e}}{\sqrt{R^{2}+L^{2} \omega^{2}}}$ so we've: $\cos \Phi=C \omega \sqrt{R^{2}+L^{2} \omega^{2}}$
Thus:

$$
C=\frac{0.5}{\sqrt{100 \pi *\left(60^{2}+0.33^{2} * 100^{2} * \pi^{2}\right)}} \Rightarrow C=1.33 * 10^{-5} \text{F}
$$

question: b. The amount of water in one layer covering the surface of all the particles in a 2 g sample of another soil is 0.02 g . Calculate the specific surface area of this soil sample.
solution: Mass of water in 1 g of soil $=0.02 / 2=0.01 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~g}^{-1}$ Volume of water in one layer covering the surface of 1 g soil $=0.01 / 1=$ $0.01 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ Number of water molecules covering the surface of 1 g soil $=$ $(0.01)(3.4)(10)^{22}=(3.4)(10)^{20}$ Area covered by $(3.4)(10)^{20}$ molecules of water $=(3.4)(10)^{20}(9)(10)^{-16}=$ $306000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ or $30.6 \mathrm{~m}^{2}$ resulting in a specific surface of $a_{\mathrm{m}}=30.6 \mathrm{~m}^{2} \mathrm{~g}^{-1}$

question: b. 覆盖在所有颗粒表面的单层水在另一个2 g土壤样本中的量为0.02 g。计算该土壤样本的比表面积。

The volumetric air content of a soil is $0.15 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$ and the bulk density is $1280 \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$. Calculate the volumetric and gravimetric water contents, and determine the soil's bulk dielectric constant.
solution: First we calculate the porosity. We assume a particle density of $\rho_{s}=2650$ $\mathrm{kg} \mathrm{m}^{-3}$. $\phi=1-\frac{\rho_{b}}{\rho_{s}}=1-\frac{1280}{2650}=0.52 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$ From porosity and known volumetric air content we can calculate the volumetric water content: $\theta=\phi-\theta_{a}=0.52-0.15=0.37 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$ Then we can convert volumetric to gravimetric water content using the relationship: $\theta=\theta_{m} \frac{\rho_{b}}{\rho_{w}} \rightarrow \theta_{m}=\theta \frac{\rho_{w}}{\rho_{b}}=0.37 \frac{1000}{1280}=0.29 \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~kg}^{-1}$ From known volumetric water content and porosity we can estimate the dielectric constant based on the dielectric mixing model used in the previous 2 problems (Roth et al., 1990): $\theta=\frac{\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}}-(2-\phi)}{8} \rightarrow \varepsilon_{b}=(8 \theta+2-\phi)^{2}=(2.96+2-0.52)^{2}=19.7$

question: 土壤的体积含气量为 $0.15 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$，体积密度为 $1280 \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$。计算体积含水量和重量含水量，并确定土壤的整体介电常数。
solution: 首先我们计算孔隙率。我们假设颗粒密度为 $\rho_{s}=2650$ $\mathrm{kg} \mathrm{m}^{-3}$。$\phi=1-\frac{\rho_{b}}{\rho_{s}}=1-\frac{1280}{2650}=0.52 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$。根据孔隙率和已知的体积空气含量，我们可以计算体积含水量：$\theta=\phi-\theta_{a}=0.52-0.15=0.37 \mathrm{~m}^{3} \mathrm{~m}^{-3}$。然后我们可以使用以下关系将体积含水量转换为重力含水量：$\theta=\theta_{m} \frac{\rho_{b}}{\rho_{w}} \rightarrow \theta_{m}=\theta \frac{\rho_{w}}{\rho_{b}}=0.37 \frac{1000}{1280}=0.29 \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~kg}^{-1}$。根据已知的体积含水量和孔隙率，我们可以基于前两个问题中使用的介电混合模型（Roth et al., 1990）估算介电常数：$\theta=\frac{\sqrt{\varepsilon_{b}}-(2-\phi)}{8} \rightarrow \varepsilon_{b}=(8 \theta+2-\phi)^{2}=(2.96+2-0.52)^{2}=19.7$。

question: c. What is the slope (gradient) of the Soil Water Characteristic (SWC) curve for the measured water content in both the wetted and front regions?
solution:
Diffusivity is defined as $D=K / C$ where $C$ is the specific water capacity given by $\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{d} \theta / \mathrm{d} h$. Hence, the slopes are
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \mathrm{d} h /\left.\mathrm{d} \theta\right|_{w}=\frac{D_{w}}{K}=\frac{3.75}{0.1875}=20 \mathrm{~cm} \\
& \left.\mathrm{~d} h /\left.\mathrm{d} \theta\right|_{t}=\frac{D_{t}}{K}=\frac{9.375}{0.1875}=50 \mathrm{~cm}\right.
\end{aligned}
$$

question: c. 测量的含水量在湿润区和前沿区的土壤水特征（SWC）曲线的斜率（梯度）是多少？
solution:
扩散率定义为 $D=K / C$，其中 $C$ 是由 $\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{d} \theta / \mathrm{d} h$ 给定的比水容量。因此，斜率为
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \mathrm{d} h /\left.\mathrm{d} \theta\right|_{w}=\frac{D_{w}}{K}=\frac{3.75}{0.1875}=20 \mathrm{~cm} \\
& \left.\mathrm{~d} h /\left.\mathrm{d} \theta\right|_{t}=\frac{D_{t}}{K}=\frac{9.375}{0.1875}=50 \mathrm{~cm}\right.
\end{aligned}
$$。

question: b. Calculate the flux density and the pore water velocity through column.
solution:

question:
Calculate the Henry's Law constant at $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ for benzene, toluene, and 1,1,2-TCE using the information provided in the table below.

Table 6-4: Organic liquid properties

| Compound | Molecular weight $\left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right)$ | Density $\left(20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ $\left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{cm}^{-3}\right)$ | Saturated vapor concentration $\left(20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)\left(\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}\right)$ | Aqueous solubility $\left(20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)\left(\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}\right)$ |
| :--: | :--: | :--: | :--: | :--: |
| Benzene | 78 | 0.878 | 300 | 1780 |
| Toluene | 92 | 0.867 | 130 | 515 |
| 1,1,2-TCE | 131 | 1.46 | 410 | 1100 |
solution:
At equilibrium, the distribution between the gas and liquid phase of a substance is described by Henry's law: $C_{g}=k_{\mathrm{H}} C$, where $C_{g}$ is the concentration of a chemical in the gas phase $\left(\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}\right)$ $C$ is its concentration in the aqueous or liquid phase $\left(\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}\right)$, and $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ is the Henry's law constant (dimensionless). The figure below depicts the relationship between $C_{g}$ and Cat equilibrium.

![img-113.jpeg](images/img-113.jpeg)

Fig. 6-19: Distribution between a gas and water phase

The $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ can be calculated by dividing the aqueous solubility ($\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}$) by the saturated vapor concentration $\left(\mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}\right)$ to give the following results:

$k_{\text {H,benzene }}=300 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1} / 1780 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}=0.17$

$k_{\text {H,toluene }}=130 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1} / 515 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}=0.25$

$k_{\mathrm{H}, \mathrm{TCE}}=410 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1} / 1100 \mathrm{mg} \mathrm{L}^{-1}=0.37$

question: Using the previous damping depth $d=0.074 \mathrm{~cm}$, find the time at which temperature reaches its maximum at the 5.5 cm depth.
solution: The amplitude at the 5.5 cm depth is $7.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, which means that the maximum temperature at this depth is $15+7.2=22.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Solving for the time until this temperature is reached is according to the following equation, $T(0.055, t)=22.2{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}=T_{\text {ave }}+A_{0} \sin \left[\omega t-\frac{z}{d}\right] \exp \left(-\frac{z}{d}\right)$ leads to, $t_{\max }=\frac{\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{T(0.055, t)-T_{\text {ave }}}{A_{0} \exp \left(-\frac{z}{d}\right)}\right)+\frac{z}{d}}{\omega}$ $t_{\max }=\frac{\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{22.2-15}{7.2}\right)+\frac{0.055}{0.074}}{7.3(10)^{-5}}=31699 \mathrm{~s}=8.8 \mathrm{~h}$

question: 使用之前的阻尼深度 $d=0.074 \mathrm{~cm}$，找到温度在 5.5 cm 深度达到最大值的时间。
solution: 在深度5.5厘米处的振幅为$7.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$，这意味着在此深度的最高温度是$15+7.2=22.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$。根据以下方程求解达到该温度所需的时间，$T(0.055, t)=22.2{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}=T_{\text {ave }}+A_{0} \sin \left[\omega t-\frac{z}{d}\right] \exp \left(-\frac{z}{d}\right)$，得到$t_{\max }=\frac{\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{T(0.055, t)-T_{\text {ave }}}{A_{0} \exp \left(-\frac{z}{d}\right)}\right)+\frac{z}{d}}{\omega}$，$t_{\max }=\frac{\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{22.2-15}{7.2}\right)+\frac{0.055}{0.074}}{7.3(10)^{-5}}=31699 \mathrm{~s}=8.8 \mathrm{~h}$。

question:
A paramagnetic salt containing ions with magnetic moment $\mu_{m j}= \pm \mu_{B}$ is placed in an external magnetic $B_{0}$. Each ion in the salt has one unpaired electron in the s-state.
a. Determine the number of energy states and the energy difference between the highest and lowest energy state.
b. For $20 \%$ of the ions to occupy the lowest energy state, what must be the applied magnetic field?
solution:
A. Each ion in this paramagnetic system has one unpaired electron in the s-state, which implies that the orbital angular momentum (L) is equal to 0. Consequently, the total angular momentum (J) is the same as the spin quantum number (S), which is $1 / 2$.

The formula to calculate the number of energy levels in this case is $2 \mathrm{~J}+1$. Since J is $1 / 2$, there are two energy states: one aligned parallel to the field and one aligned antiparallel to the field. Each of these states has an energy of $\pm \mu_{B} B_{o}$. Hence, the energy difference between the two states is $\Delta E=+\mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}-\left(-\mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}\right)=2 \mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}$.

B. For a two-level system, such as a paramagnetic ion with a magnetic moment in an external magnetic field, the ratio of the populations of the higher and lower energy states is given by:

$$\frac{N_{2}}{N_{1}}=e^{-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{F} T}\right)}$$

where $\mathrm{N}_{2}$ and $\mathrm{N}_{1}$ are the populations of the higher and lower energy states, respectively, $\Delta \mathrm{E}$ is the energy difference between the two states, k is the Boltzmann constant, and T is the temperature.

We want x percent of the ions to be in the lowest energy state, which means that $\mathrm{N}_{1}$ should be x percent of the total, and $\mathrm{N}_{2}$ should be $(1-\mathrm{x})$ percent of the total.

$$\begin{gathered}
\frac{1-x}{x}=e^{-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{B} T}\right)} \\
-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{B} T}\right)=\left|\ln \left(\frac{1-x}{x}\right)\right|=\ln (1-x)-\ln x \\
\frac{2 \mu_{B} B_{0}}{k_{B} T}=-\ln (1-x)+\ln x=\left|\ln \left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)\right| \\
B_{0}=\frac{k_{B} T}{2 \mu_{B}}\left|\ln \left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)\right|=\frac{k_{B} T}{2 \mu_{B}}\left|\ln \left(\frac{0.2}{0.8}\right)\right|=0.693 \frac{k_{B} T}{\mu_{B}}
\end{gathered}$$

question:
一个含有磁矩为 $\mu_{m j}= \pm \mu_{B}$ 的离子的顺磁性盐被置于外部磁场 $B_{0}$ 中。盐中的每个离子在 s 态有一个未成对的电子。
a. 确定能量态的数量以及最高能量态和最低能量态之间的能量差。
b. 若要使 $20\%$ 的离子占据最低能量态，必须施加多大的磁场？
solution:
A. 在这个顺磁系统中，每个离子在s态有一个未成对电子，这意味着轨道角动量（L）等于0。因此，总角动量（J）与自旋量子数（S）相同，为$1/2$。

在这种情况下，计算能级数目的公式是$2\mathrm{~J}+1$。由于J是$1/2$，所以有两个能态：一个与场平行排列，另一个与场反平行排列。每个状态的能量为$\pm \mu_{B} B_{o}$。因此，这两个状态之间的能量差是$\Delta E=+\mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}-\left(-\mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}\right)=2 \mu_{B} B_{\mathrm{o}}$。

B. 对于一个两能级系统，比如在外部磁场中的具有磁矩的顺磁离子，高能态与低能态的粒子数之比为：

$$\frac{N_{2}}{N_{1}}=e^{-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{F} T}\right)}$$

其中，$\mathrm{N}_{2}$和$\mathrm{N}_{1}$分别是高能态和低能态的粒子数，$\Delta \mathrm{E}$是两个状态之间的能量差，k是玻尔兹曼常数，T是温度。

我们希望x百分比的离子处于最低能量状态，这意味着$\mathrm{N}_{1}$应是总数的x百分比，而$\mathrm{N}_{2}$应是总数的$(1-\mathrm{x})$百分比。

$$\begin{gathered}
\frac{1-x}{x}=e^{-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{B} T}\right)} \\
-\left(\frac{\Delta E}{k_{B} T}\right)=\left|\ln \left(\frac{1-x}{x}\right)\right|=\ln (1-x)-\ln x \\
\frac{2 \mu_{B} B_{0}}{k_{B} T}=-\ln (1-x)+\ln x=\left|\ln \left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)\right| \\
B_{0}=\frac{k_{B} T}{2 \mu_{B}}\left|\ln \left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)\right|=\frac{k_{B} T}{2 \mu_{B}}\left|\ln \left(\frac{0.2}{0.8}\right)\right|=0.693 \frac{k_{B} T}{\mu_{B}}
\end{gathered}$$。

question:
The scale height of the atmosphere (change in altitude to cause a pressure drop by a factor of $e$ ) is 
 a. 4 km 
 b. 8 km 
 c. 12 km 
 d. 16 km 
 e. 20 km .
solution:
If we consider air near the Earth's surface as an isothermal layer, the pressure change with altitude is given by $p=p_{0} e^{-m g z / k_{\mathrm{B}} T}$. The scale height $z$ of the atmosphere is then given by $\frac{m g z}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}=1$. Thus

$$
z=\frac{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{m g}=\frac{1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300}{\frac{29 \times 10^{-3}}{6.02 \times 10^{23}} \times 9.8}=8.6 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~m}=8.6 \mathrm{~km}
$$

Hence the correct answer is (b).

question:
大气的尺度高度（高度变化使压力下降一个 $e$ 的因子）是 
 a. 4 km 
 b. 8 km 
 c. 12 km 
 d. 16 km 
 e. 20 km 。
solution:
如果我们将地球表面附近的空气视为一个等温层，则压力随高度的变化由 $p=p_{0} e^{-m g z / k_{\mathrm{B}} T}$ 给出。大气的尺度高度 $z$ 由 $\frac{m g z}{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}=1$ 给出。因此

$$
z=\frac{k_{\mathrm{B}} T}{m g}=\frac{1.38 \times 10^{-23} \times 300}{\frac{29 \times 10^{-3}}{6.02 \times 10^{23}} \times 9.8}=8.6 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~m}=8.6 \mathrm{~km}
$$

因此正确答案是 (b)。

question:
The Bohr radius of an atom of nuclear charge $Z$ is of order
a. $\frac{\hbar}{Z a m c}$,
b. $\frac{Z a \hbar}{m c}$,
c. $\frac{m c}{Z a \hbar}$.
solution: The Bohr radius for a hydrogen-like atom of nuclear charge $Z$ and one electron outside complete shells is $\frac{\hbar^{2}}{m e^{2} Z}=\frac{\hbar}{Z a m c}$. Thus the correct answer is (a).

question:
原子核电荷为 $Z$ 的原子的玻尔半径的量级是  
a. $\frac{\hbar}{Z a m c}$,  
b. $\frac{Z a \hbar}{m c}$,  
c. $\frac{m c}{Z a \hbar}$。
solution: 对于具有核电荷$Z$并且在完整电子层外有一个电子的类氢原子，玻尔半径是$\frac{\hbar^{2}}{m e^{2} Z}=\frac{\hbar}{Z a m c}$。因此，正确答案是(a)。

question:
A piece of organic material contains $N_{\mathrm{e}}$ electrons per gram. $N_{\mathrm{e}}$ is about
a. $3 \times 10^{22}$,
b. $3 \times 10^{23}$
c. $3 \times 10^{24}$
d. $3 \times 10^{25}$
e. $3 \times 10^{26}$.
solution:
One mole of a substance contains $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ molecules or atoms. The molecule of organic matter consists of carbon and hydrogen atoms for which the number of electrons is equal to the atomic number. As the molecular weight of organic matter is generally greater than 13, the number of electrons per gram is

$$N_{\mathrm{e}} \leq \frac{6.02 \times 10^{23}}{13}=4.6 \times 10^{22}$$

Hence the correct answer is (a).

question:
一克有机材料包含$N_{\mathrm{e}}$个电子。$N_{\mathrm{e}}$大约是
a. $3 \times 10^{22}$,
b. $3 \times 10^{23}$
c. $3 \times 10^{24}$
d. $3 \times 10^{25}$
e. $3 \times 10^{26}$.
solution:
一摩尔的物质包含$6.02 \times 10^{23}$个分子或原子。有机物的分子由碳和氢原子组成，其电子数等于原子序数。由于有机物的分子量通常大于13，每克的电子数为

$$N_{\mathrm{e}} \leq \frac{6.02 \times 10^{23}}{13}=4.6 \times 10^{22}$$

因此正确答案是(a)。

question:
Use the relevant definition and the result that $\mathbf{r}$ is a polar vector to determine whether the following vectors are polar or axial: (a) velocity $\mathbf{u}$, (b) linear momentum $\mathbf{p}$, (c) force $\mathbf{F}$, (d) electric field $\mathbf{E}$, (e) magnetic field $\mathbf{B}$ and (f) $\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}$.
(Assume that time, mass and charge are invariant quantities).
solution:
(a) $\mathbf{u}=d \mathbf{r} / d t$ is polar since $t$ is invariant and $\mathbf{r}$ is polar.
(b) $\mathbf{p}=m \mathbf{u}$ is polar since $m$ is invariant and $\mathbf{u}$ is polar.
(c) $\mathbf{F}=d \mathbf{p} / d t$ is polar since $t$ is invariant and $\mathbf{p}$ is polar.
(d) $\mathbf{E}=\mathbf{F} / q$ is polar since $q$ is invariant and $\mathbf{F}$ is polar.
(e) Apply the parity transformation to the force

$$
\mathbf{F} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{p}} \mathbf{F}^{\prime}=-\mathbf{F}=q \mathbf{u}^{\prime} \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}=q(-\mathbf{u}) \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}
$$

Clearly, $\mathbf{F}=q \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}$ requires $\mathbf{B}^{\prime}=\mathbf{B}$ which shows that $\mathbf{B}$ is axial.
(f) $\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{p}}(-\mathbf{E}) \times \mathbf{B}=-\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}$ which is polar. This vector represents the energy flux per unit time ${ }^{\ddagger}$ in the vacuum electromagnetic field (see (7) of Question 7.6).

question: 使用相关定义以及$\mathbf{r}$是极向量的结果来确定以下向量是极向量还是轴向量：（a）速度$\mathbf{u}$，（b）线动量$\mathbf{p}$，（c）力$\mathbf{F}$，（d）电场$\mathbf{E}$，（e）磁场$\mathbf{B}$和（f）$\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}$。（假设时间、质量和电荷是不变的量）。
solution:
(a) $\mathbf{u}=d \mathbf{r} / d t$ 是极性矢量，因为 $t$ 是不变的而 $\mathbf{r}$ 是极性矢量。

(b) $\mathbf{p}=m \mathbf{u}$ 是极性矢量，因为 $m$ 是不变的而 $\mathbf{u}$ 是极性矢量。

(c) $\mathbf{F}=d \mathbf{p} / d t$ 是极性矢量，因为 $t$ 是不变的而 $\mathbf{p}$ 是极性矢量。

(d) $\mathbf{E}=\mathbf{F} / q$ 是极性矢量，因为 $q$ 是不变的而 $\mathbf{F}$ 是极性矢量。

(e) 对力应用宇称变换

$$
\mathbf{F} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{p}} \mathbf{F}^{\prime}=-\mathbf{F}=q \mathbf{u}^{\prime} \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}=q(-\mathbf{u}) \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}
$$

显然，$\mathbf{F}=q \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{B}^{\prime}$ 要求 $\mathbf{B}^{\prime}=\mathbf{B}$，这表明 $\mathbf{B}$ 是轴性矢量。

(f) $\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{p}}(-\mathbf{E}) \times \mathbf{B}=-\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}$ 是极性矢量。这个矢量表示真空电磁场中每单位时间的能量流（见问题7.6的(7)）。

question:
Consider two four-vectors $a$ and $b$ whose components are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}
a^{\alpha} & =(-2,0,0,1) \\
b^{\alpha} & =(5,0,3,4)
\end{aligned}
$$

a) Is $a$ timelike, spacelike, or null? Is $b$ timelike, spacelike, or null?
b) Compute $\mathbf{a}-5 \mathbf{b}$.
c) Compute $a \cdot b$.
solution:
a)

$$
\begin{aligned}
& \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{a}=-2 \cdot 2+0 \cdot 0+0 \cdot 0+1 \cdot 1=-3 \\
& \mathbf{b} \cdot \mathbf{b}=-5 \cdot 5+0 \cdot 0+3 \cdot 3+4 \cdot 4=0
\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, $a$ is timelike, and $\mathbf{b}$ is null.

b)

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf{a}-5 \mathbf{b} & =(-2,0,0,1)+(-25,0,-15,-20) \\
& =(-27,0,-15,-19)
\end{aligned}
$$

c)

$$
\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b}=-(-2 \cdot 5)+0 \cdot 0+0 \cdot 3+1 \cdot 4=14
$$

c) 计算 $a \cdot b$。
solution:
a)

因此，$\mathbf{a}$ 是类时的，而 $\mathbf{b}$ 是零的。

question: The radio source 3C345 discussed in Box 4.3 has a redshift of $z=$ .595. The angular velocity of the outward moving cloud $C 2$ is approximately .47 mas/yr. Assuming (contrary to fact) that the cloud is moving transverse to the line of sight, what velocity would be seen by an observer on station at 3C345 assuming a flat $(k=0)$, matter dominated FRW model of the universe with $h=.72$?
solution:
As usual we denote quantities at the present by a subscript 0 and quantities at the event of emission by a subscript $e$. Assume we are at the origin $(r=0)$ of the spherical coordinates in the flat FRW line element (18.5) and that 3C345 is at a co-moving radius $R$. In these coordinates, transverse motion means that the cloud is moving on a circle of constant $R$. The angle $\Delta \phi$ moved in a time $\Delta t_{e}$ is connected to the distance moved $\Delta s$ by (19.11) (evaluated at $t_{e}$ not $t_{ls}$):

$$
\Delta \phi=(1+z) \frac{\Delta s}{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}
$$

The angle $\Delta \phi$ is the same as the angular separation observed by us because light rays from the cloud and source to us propagate along $\phi=$ const. curves by the symmetry of the geometry. Thus, the velocity $V_{e}=d s / d t_{e}$ observed by a nearby observer is:

$$
V_{e}=\frac{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}{(1+z)} \frac{d \phi}{d t_{e}}=\frac{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}{(1+z)}\left(\frac{d t_{0}}{d t_{e}}\right)\left(\frac{d \phi}{d t_{0}}\right)
$$

This relates $V_{e}$ to our observed rate of change of angle. The quantity $d t_{0} / d t_{e}$ is just $1+z$ [cf. (18.9), (18.11)]. The rate is slower now than then because of the redshift. The effective distance, for a matter-dominated, flat FRW model is given by (19.5):

$$
V_{e}=\frac{2}{H_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+z}}\right)\left(\frac{d \phi}{d t_{0}}\right)
$$

Evaluating with $1 / H_{0}=9.8 \times 10^{9} h^{-1} \mathrm{yr}, z=.595, d \phi / d t_{0}=.47 \mathrm{mas} / \mathrm{yr}$, and $h=72$ gives (in $c \neq 1$ units):

$$
\frac{V_{e}}{c}=9.3 h^{-1} \approx 13
$$

Superluminal motion indeed!

question: 射电源3C345在框4.3中讨论过，其红移为$z=$ .595。向外移动的云团$C 2$的角速度大约是.47 mas/yr。假设（与事实相反）云团横向于视线方向移动，那么在假设一个平坦的$(k=0)$、物质主导的FRW宇宙模型且$h=.72$的情况下，驻留在3C345的观察者会看到什么速度？
solution:
像往常一样，我们用下标 0 表示当前的量，用下标 $e$ 表示发射事件的量。假设我们位于平坦的FRW线元素(18.5)中的球面坐标系的原点 $(r=0)$，并且3C345位于共动半径 $R$。在这些坐标中，横向运动意味着云在一个恒定 $R$ 的圆上移动。在时间 $\Delta t_{e}$ 内移动的角度 $\Delta \phi$ 与移动的距离 $\Delta s$ 通过(19.11)连接（在 $t_{e}$ 而不是 $t_{ls}$ 进行计算）：

$$
\Delta \phi=(1+z) \frac{\Delta s}{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}
$$

由于光线从云和源到我们的传播沿着 $\phi=$ 常数曲线，由几何对称性决定，因此角度 $\Delta \phi$ 与我们观察到的角距离相同。因此，附近观察者观察到的速度 $V_{e}=d s / d t_{e}$ 为：

$$
V_{e}=\frac{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}{(1+z)} \frac{d \phi}{d t_{e}}=\frac{d_{\mathrm{eff}}}{(1+z)}\left(\frac{d t_{0}}{d t_{e}}\right)\left(\frac{d \phi}{d t_{0}}\right)
$$

这将 $V_{e}$ 与我们观察到的角变化率联系起来。量 $d t_{0} / d t_{e}$ 就是 $1+z$ [参见 (18.9), (18.11)]。由于红移的原因，现在的速率比那时慢。对于物质主导的平坦FRW模型，有效距离由(19.5)给出：

$$
V_{e}=\frac{2}{H_{0}}\left(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+z}}\right)\left(\frac{d \phi}{d t_{0}}\right)
$$

用 $1 / H_{0}=9.8 \times 10^{9} h^{-1} \mathrm{yr}, z=.595, d \phi / d t_{0}=.47 \mathrm{mas} / \mathrm{yr}$ 和 $h=72$ 进行计算（在 $c \neq 1$ 的单位下）：

$$
\frac{V_{e}}{c}=9.3 h^{-1} \approx 13
$$

果然是超光速运动！

question:
A regular octahedron is made by joining 12 equal conductors, each of resistance R. If a current enters into it from one vertex and comes out of the diagonally opposite vertex, show that the effective resistance of the network is $$R/2$$.

![](_page_306_Figure_11.jpeg)

Figure 4.4 A regular octahedron made of 12 equal length conductors.
solution:
An octahedron has 12 edges, 6 vertices and 8 faces. See Fig. 4.4.

A regular octahedron has all equilateral triangular faces like a regular tetrahedron.

In the present problem, O has been chosen as the entry point and O' as the exit point for the current, though we could have chosen any of the other pairs of points like A, C or B, D.

At the vertex O, there are 4 parallel paths OA, OB, OC and OD and at the exit point O', there are 4 parallel paths AO, BO', CO' and DO' meeting. Since A, B, C and D are at the same potential, no currents flow in the conductors AB, BC, CD and DA.

Hence the effective resistance of the network is

$$R\_{\rm eff} = \frac{R}{4} + \frac{R}{4} = \frac{R}{2}$$

solution:
一个八面体有12条边，6个顶点和8个面。见图4.4。

在顶点O，有4条并行路径OA, OB, OC和OD，在出口点O'，有4条并行路径AO, BO', CO'和DO'汇合。由于A, B, C和D处于相同的电势，导体AB, BC, CD和DA中没有电流流动。

因此，该网络的有效电阻为

question: Calculate the uncertainty in the momentum of a proton which is confined to a nucleus of radius equal to $10^{-13} \mathrm{~cm}$. From this result, estimate the kinetic energy of the proton inside the nucleus. What would be the kinetic energy for an electron if it had to be confined within a similar nucleus?
solution:
The uncertainty in the momentum $\Delta p$ of a proton inside a nucleus of radius $r_{0}$ is given as follows: $$ \Delta p = \frac{h}{2 \pi r_{0}} $$ Substitute $6.6 \times 10^{-27} \mathrm{erg} \cdot \mathrm{s}$ and $10^{-11} \mathrm{~cm}$ for $r_{0}$ in the above equation and solve for $\Delta p$: $$ \Delta p = \frac{6.6 \times 10^{-27}}{2 \pi \cdot 10^{-11}} = 1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s} $$ Thus, the uncertainty in momentum is $1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. 

The kinetic energy of the proton in the nucleus is given as follows: $$ E = \frac{\Delta p^2}{2 m_{p}} $$ Here, $m_{p}$ is the mass of the proton. Substitute $1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$ for $\Delta p$ and $1.67 \times 10^{-24} \mathrm{~g}$ for $m_{p}$: $$ E = \frac{(1.05 \times 10^{-14})^2}{2 \cdot 1.67 \times 10^{-24}} = 20 \mathrm{MeV} $$ Thus, the kinetic energy of the proton is $20 \mathrm{MeV}$. 

For the electron, the speed is very close to the speed of light because the mass of the electron is much smaller than that of the proton. The kinetic energy of the electron is given by: $$ E = c \Delta p $$ Here, $c$ is the speed of light. Substitute $3 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm/s}$ for $c$ and $1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$ for $\Delta p$: $$ E = (3 \times 10^{10})(1.05 \times 10^{-14}) = 200 \mathrm{MeV} $$ Thus, the kinetic energy of the electron is $200 \mathrm{MeV}$.

question: 计算被限制在半径为$10^{-13} \mathrm{~cm}$的原子核内的质子的动量不确定性。根据此结果，估算质子在原子核内的动能。如果电子也被限制在类似的原子核内，其动能会是多少？
solution:
质子在半径为$r_{0}$的原子核内的动量不确定性$\Delta p$如下所示：  
$$ \Delta p = \frac{h}{2 \pi r_{0}} $$  
将$6.6 \times 10^{-27} \mathrm{erg} \cdot \mathrm{s}$和$10^{-11} \mathrm{~cm}$代入上述公式中，求解$\Delta p$：  
$$ \Delta p = \frac{6.6 \times 10^{-27}}{2 \pi \cdot 10^{-11}} = 1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s} $$  
因此，动量的不确定性为$1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$。  

质子在原子核中的动能如下所示：  
$$ E = \frac{\Delta p^2}{2 m_{p}} $$  
这里，$m_{p}$是质子的质量。将$1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$代入$\Delta p$，将$1.67 \times 10^{-24} \mathrm{~g}$代入$m_{p}$：  
$$ E = \frac{(1.05 \times 10^{-14})^2}{2 \cdot 1.67 \times 10^{-24}} = 20 \mathrm{MeV} $$  
因此，质子的动能为$20 \mathrm{MeV}$。  

对于电子，由于电子的质量远小于质子的质量，速度非常接近光速。电子的动能由下式给出：  
$$ E = c \Delta p $$  
这里，$c$是光速。将$3 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm/s}$代入$c$，将$1.05 \times 10^{-14} \mathrm{~g} \cdot \mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$代入$\Delta p$：  
$$ E = (3 \times 10^{10})(1.05 \times 10^{-14}) = 200 \mathrm{MeV} $$  
因此，电子的动能为$200 \mathrm{MeV}$。

question: Using the equation $\alpha=10 \log \left(\frac{P_{\text {input }}}{P_{\text {output }}}\right)$, calculate the attenuation of an optical fiber when the input power is $P_{\text {input }}=2 \ \mathrm{mW}$, the output power is $P_{\text {output }}=15 \ \mu \mathrm{W}$, and the fiber length is $d=25 \ \mathrm{km}$.
solution:
Using the equation:
$$\alpha^{\prime}=\frac{10 \log \left(\frac{P_{\text {input }}}{P_{\text {output }}}\right)}{d}$$
Substitute $P_{\text {input }}=2 \ \mathrm{mW}$, $P_{\text {output }}=15 \ \mu \mathrm{W}$, and $d=25 \ \mathrm{km}$:
$$\alpha^{\prime}=\frac{10 \log \left(\frac{2 \mathrm{~mW} \left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~W}}{10^{3} \mathrm{~mW}}\right)}{15 \mu \mathrm{~W} \left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~W}}{10^{6} \mu \mathrm{~W}}\right)}\right)}{25 \mathrm{~km}}$$
$$\alpha^{\prime}=0.85 \mathrm{~dB} \cdot \mathrm{~km}^{-1}$$
Thus, the attenuation of the fiber is $0.85 \mathrm{~dB} \cdot \mathrm{~km}^{-1}$.

question:
(a) Calculate the frequency at which the penetration depth will be 10 cm.
(b) Show that for frequencies less than $100 \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$, it can be considered as a good conductor. [Ans (a) $-6 \times 10^6 \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$]
solution:
Step 1: The expression for penetration depth $\beta$ is given as follows:

$$\beta=\left(\frac{2}{\pi \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$$

Here, $\omega$ is the angular frequency, $\mu$ is the permeability of the medium, and $\sigma$ is the conductivity of the medium.

Step 2: The expression for angular frequency in terms of frequency $\nu$ is given as follows:

$$\omega=2 \pi v$$

Substitute $\omega=2 \pi v$ in the above equation $\beta=\left(\frac{2}{\pi \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$ and solve for $v$,

$$\beta=\left(\frac{2}{2 \pi \gamma \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$$
$$\beta^{2}=\frac{1}{\pi \gamma \mu \sigma}$$
$$v=\frac{1}{\pi \beta^{2} \mu \sigma}$$

Step 3: Substitute 10 cm for $\beta$, $4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{2} / \mathrm{C}^{2}$ for $\mu$, and $4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}$ for $\sigma$ in the above equation.

$$v=\frac{1}{\pi(10 \mathrm{~cm})^{2}\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~m}}{100 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}\left(4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{2} / \mathrm{C}^{2}\right)\left(4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}\right)}$$
$$=5.89 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$$

Thus, the frequency (rounding off to one significant figure) is $6 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$.

(b) The medium acts as a good conductor for $\frac{\sigma}{\omega c} \approx 1$.

Obtain the expression for $\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}$ in terms of frequency and dielectric constant as follows:

$$\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}=\frac{\sigma}{2 \pi v k c_{0}}$$

Substitute $10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ for $v$, 80 for $k$, and $8.854 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{C}^{2} / \mathrm{N} . \mathrm{m}^{2}$ for $c_{0}$ in the above equation.

$$\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}=\frac{4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}}{2 \pi\left(10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}\right)(80)\left(8.854 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{C}^{2} / \mathrm{N} . \mathrm{m}^{2}\right)}$$
$$=9.66$$
$$>1$$

question:
(a) 计算穿透深度为10厘米时的频率。  
(b) 证明对于频率小于$100 \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$的情况，它可以被视为一个良导体。 [答 (a) $-6 \times 10^6 \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$]。
solution:
步骤 1: 穿透深度 $\beta$ 的表达式如下所示：

$$\beta=\left(\frac{2}{\pi \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$$

这里，$\omega$ 是角频率，$\mu$ 是介质的磁导率，$\sigma$ 是介质的电导率。

步骤 2: 角频率关于频率 $\nu$ 的表达式如下所示：

$$\omega=2 \pi v$$

将 $\omega=2 \pi v$ 代入上述方程 $\beta=\left(\frac{2}{\pi \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$ 并解 $v$，

$$\beta=\left(\frac{2}{2 \pi \gamma \mu \sigma}\right)^{1 / 2}$$
$$\beta^{2}=\frac{1}{\pi \gamma \mu \sigma}$$
$$v=\frac{1}{\pi \beta^{2} \mu \sigma}$$

步骤 3: 在上述方程中，代入 $\beta=10 \mathrm{~cm}$，$\mu=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{2} / \mathrm{C}^{2}$，$\sigma=4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}$。

$$v=\frac{1}{\pi(10 \mathrm{~cm})^{2}\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~m}}{100 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}\left(4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{~N} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{2} / \mathrm{C}^{2}\right)\left(4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}\right)}$$
$$=5.89 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$$

因此，频率（四舍五入到一个有效数字）为 $6 \times 10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$。

(b) 当 $\frac{\sigma}{\omega c} \approx 1$ 时，介质表现为良导体。

根据频率和介电常数获得 $\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}$ 的表达式如下：

$$\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}=\frac{\sigma}{2 \pi v k c_{0}}$$

在上述方程中，代入 $v=10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$，$k=80$，$c_{0}=8.854 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{C}^{2} / \mathrm{N} . \mathrm{m}^{2}$。

$$\frac{\sigma}{\omega c}=\frac{4.3 \mathrm{mho} \cdot \mathrm{m}^{-1}}{2 \pi\left(10^{6} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}\right)(80)\left(8.854 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{C}^{2} / \mathrm{N} . \mathrm{m}^{2}\right)}$$
$$=9.66$$
$$>1$$。

question: The output of a me-4le laser ($\lambda=6526 \AA$) can be assumed to be Gaussian with plane phase front. For $w_0=1 \mathrm{~mm}$ and $w_0=0.2 \mathrm{~mm}$, calculate the beam diameter at $z=20 \mathrm{~m}$. (b) Repeat the calculation for $\lambda=5000 \AA$ and interpret the results physically.
solution:
For a Gaussian beam, the variation of spot size is,

$$
w(z)=w_{0}\left(1+\frac{\lambda^{2} z^{2}}{\pi^{2} w_{0}^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$

Here, $w_{0}$ is the spot size, $\lambda$ is the wavelength, and $z$ is the distance.

The beam diameter is,

$$
2 w=2 w_{0}\left(1+\frac{\lambda^{2} z^{2}}{\pi^{2} w_{0}^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$

For $w_{0}=1 \mathrm{~mm}$:

Substitute 1 mm for $w_{0}$, $6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$ for $\lambda$, and 20 m for $z$:

$$
2 w=2\left(11 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)\left(1+\frac{\left(6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}\right)^{2}\left(20 \mathrm{~m}\right)\left(\frac{100 \mathrm{~cm}}{1 \mathrm{~m}}\right)^{2}}{(3.14)^{2}\left(1 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}}\right)
$$

$$
2 w=0.83 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

For $w_{0}=0.2 \mathrm{~mm}$:

$$
2 w=2\left(0.2 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)\left(1+\frac{\left(6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}\right)^{2}\left(20 \mathrm{~m}\right)\left(\frac{100 \mathrm{~cm}}{1 \mathrm{~m}}\right)^{2}}{(3.14)^{2}\left(0.2 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}}\right)
$$

$$
2 w=4 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

The above result shows that the divergence increases as $w_{0}$ becomes smaller. Hence, the beam diameter is $0.83 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $4 \mathrm{~cm}$.

question: me-4le激光器的输出（$\lambda=6526 \AA$）可以假设为具有平面相位前的高斯分布。对于$w_0=1 \mathrm{~mm}$和$w_0=0.2 \mathrm{~mm}$，计算在$z=20 \mathrm{~m}$处的光束直径。(b) 对于$\lambda=5000 \AA$重复计算并从物理上解释结果。
solution:
对于高斯光束，光斑尺寸的变化为，

$$
w(z)=w_{0}\left(1+\frac{\lambda^{2} z^{2}}{\pi^{2} w_{0}^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$

这里，$w_{0}$ 是光斑尺寸，$\lambda$ 是波长，$z$ 是距离。

光束直径为，

$$
2 w=2 w_{0}\left(1+\frac{\lambda^{2} z^{2}}{\pi^{2} w_{0}^{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}
$$

对于 $w_{0}=1 \mathrm{~mm}$：

将 $w_{0}$ 代入 1 mm，$\lambda$ 代入 $6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$，$z$ 代入 20 m：

$$
2 w=2\left(11 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)\left(1+\frac{\left(6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}\right)^{2}\left(20 \mathrm{~m}\right)\left(\frac{100 \mathrm{~cm}}{1 \mathrm{~m}}\right)^{2}}{(3.14)^{2}\left(1 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}}\right)
$$

$$
2 w=0.83 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

对于 $w_{0}=0.2 \mathrm{~mm}$：

$$
2 w=2\left(0.2 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)\left(1+\frac{\left(6.328 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}\right)^{2}\left(20 \mathrm{~m}\right)\left(\frac{100 \mathrm{~cm}}{1 \mathrm{~m}}\right)^{2}}{(3.14)^{2}\left(0.2 \mathrm{~mm}\right)\left(\frac{1 \mathrm{~cm}}{10 \mathrm{~cm}}\right)^{2}}\right)
$$

$$
2 w=4 \mathrm{~cm}
$$

以上结果表明，当 $w_{0}$ 变小时，发散增加。因此，光束直径为 $0.83 \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $4 \mathrm{~cm}$。

question:
For $\Delta \ll 1$ the parameter $\Delta$ is given by the following expression.
$\Delta=\frac{n_{1}-n_{2}}{n_{1}}$
Here, $n_{1}$ and $n_{2}$ are the indices of refraction of the first and second media respectively.
solution:
Rearrange the above equation $\Delta=\frac{n_{1}-n_{2}}{n_{1}}$ for $n_{2}$:
$$n_{2}=n_{1}-\Delta n_{1}$$
Substitute 0.015 for $\Delta$ and 1.5 for $n_{1}$ into the above equation:
$$n_{2}=(1.5)-(0.015)(1.5)$$
$$=1.477$$
Thus, the value of $n_{2}$ is 1.477.

Consider a straight edge being illuminated by a parallel beam of light with $\lambda=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$. Calculate the positions of the first two maxima and minima on a screen at a distance of 50 cm from the edge.
solution:
Step-by-step calculation:

**Step 1:** The expression for the velocity is given as $v_{0}=-\sqrt{\frac{2}{\lambda d}} y$. Here, $\lambda$ is the wavelength, $d$ is the distance to the screen, and $y$ is the distance between the points.

**Step 2:** Substituting $\lambda=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ and $d=50 \mathrm{~cm}$:
$v_{0}=-\sqrt{\frac{2}{(6 \times 10^{-5})(50)}} y = -25.82 y$.

For the first two maxima:
$v_{0} = -1.22, -2.34$
$y = \frac{v_{0}}{-25.82}$
$y = 0.0473 \mathrm{~cm}, 0.0906 \mathrm{~cm}$.

**Step 3:** For the first two minima:
$v_{0} = -1.87, -2.74$
$y = \frac{v_{0}}{-25.82}$
$y = 0.0724 \mathrm{~cm}, 0.1061 \mathrm{~cm}$.

Hence, the positions of the first two maxima are $0.0473 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $0.0906 \mathrm{~cm}$, and the positions of the first two minima are $0.0724 \mathrm{~cm}$ and $0.1061 \mathrm{~cm}$.

question: 考虑一个被平行光束照亮的直边，其中光的波长为 $\lambda=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$。计算在距离边缘50 cm的屏幕上，前两个极大值和极小值的位置。
solution:

**步骤 2：** 代入 $\lambda=6 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $d=50 \mathrm{~cm}$：
$v_{0}=-\sqrt{\frac{2}{(6 \times 10^{-5})(50)}} y = -25.82 y$。

对于前两个极大值：
$v_{0} = -1.22, -2.34$
$y = \frac{v_{0}}{-25.82}$
$y = 0.0473 \mathrm{~cm}, 0.0906 \mathrm{~cm}$。

**步骤 3：** 对于前两个极小值：
$v_{0} = -1.87, -2.74$
$y = \frac{v_{0}}{-25.82}$
$y = 0.0724 \mathrm{~cm}, 0.1061 \mathrm{~cm}$。

因此，前两个极大值的位置是 $0.0473 \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $0.0906 \mathrm{~cm}$，前两个极小值的位置是 $0.0724 \mathrm{~cm}$ 和 $0.1061 \mathrm{~cm}$。

question: Transform the integrals over a closed surface ( $\vec{b}$ is a constant vector, and $\vec{n}$ is a unit vector normal to the surface) $$ \vec{I}=\oint \vec{n} \varphi d S, \quad \vec{I}=\oint[\vec{n} \times \vec{A}] d S, \quad \vec{I}=\oint(\vec{n} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{A} d S $$ into the integrals over the volume inside the surface.
solution: Answer. $$ \begin{aligned} \oint \vec{n} \varphi d S & =\int \operatorname{grad} \varphi d V, \quad \oint[\vec{n} \times \vec{A}] d S=\int \operatorname{rot} \vec{A} d V \\ \oint(\vec{n} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{A} d S & =\int(\vec{b} \cdot \nabla) \vec{A} d V \end{aligned} $$

question: 将闭合曲面上的积分（$\vec{b}$ 是一个常向量，$\vec{n}$ 是垂直于曲面的单位向量）$$ \vec{I}=\oint \vec{n} \varphi d S, \quad \vec{I}=\oint[\vec{n} \times \vec{A}] d S, \quad \vec{I}=\oint(\vec{n} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{A} d S $$ 转换为曲面内部体积上的积分。
solution: 答案。$$ \begin{aligned} \oint \vec{n} \varphi d S & =\int \operatorname{grad} \varphi d V, \quad \oint[\vec{n} \times \vec{A}] d S=\int \operatorname{rot} \vec{A} d V \\ \oint(\vec{n} \cdot \vec{b}) \vec{A} d S & =\int(\vec{b} \cdot \nabla) \vec{A} d V \end{aligned} $$。

question: Find the velocity $v$ of a particle with mass $m$ and charge $e$ undergoing the action of an accelerating potential difference $V$ (initial velocity is zero). Simplify the general formula in nonrelativistic and ultrarelativistic cases (take two terms of the expansion).
solution: $$v=\sqrt{\frac{2 e V}{m}} \frac{1+\frac{e V}{2 m c^{2}}}{\left(1+\frac{e V}{m c^{2}}\right)^{2}}$$ In the case where $e V \ll m c^{2}$, the velocity $v=\sqrt{\frac{2 e V}{m}} \left(1-\frac{3}{4} \frac{e V}{m c^{2}}\right) \ll c$. In the case where $e V \gg m c^{2}$, the velocity $v=c\left[1-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{m c^{2}}{e V}\right)^{2}\right] \approx c$.

question: 求质量为$m$且带电荷$e$的粒子在加速电势差$V$作用下的速度$v$（初速度为零）。在非相对论和超相对论情况下简化通用公式（取展开的前两项）。
solution: $$v=\sqrt{\frac{2 e V}{m}} \frac{1+\frac{e V}{2 m c^{2}}}{\left(1+\frac{e V}{m c^{2}}\right)^{2}}$$ 在 $e V \ll m c^{2}$ 的情况下，速度 $v=\sqrt{\frac{2 e V}{m}} \left(1-\frac{3}{4} \frac{e V}{m c^{2}}\right) \ll c$。在 $e V \gg m c^{2}$ 的情况下，速度 $v=c\left[1-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{m c^{2}}{e V}\right)^{2}\right] \approx c$。

question: A layer of a dielectric with a volume charge density $\rho$ is bounded by two parallel planes. The dielectric thickness is equal to $d$. Find the strengths of the electric field inside and outside the dielectric.
solution:
$$
\vec{E}=2 \pi \rho d \frac{\vec{z}}{|z|}(\text{ outside }), \quad \vec{E}=4 \pi \rho z(\text{ inside })
$$

question: Let a circuit be composed of two coils joined in series, whose inductances are $L_{1}$ and $L_{2}$. The mutual induction of the coils is $\mathfrak{M}$. Find the total inductance of the circuit. How will the total inductance be changed if one coil is wound in the reverse direction?
solution:
The total inductance of the circuit is given by: $$U=\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L}_{1} I_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L}_{2} I_{2}^{2}-\mathfrak{M} I_{1} I_{2}$$ where $I_{1}, I_{2}$ are the currents in the coils, and $\mathfrak{M}$ is the coefficient of mutual induction.

By condition, $I_{1}=I_{2}=I$. Therefore, the electric energy of the circuit can be presented in the form: $$U=\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L} I^{2}$$ where $\mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{2}-2 \mathfrak{M}$.

If the turns of one coil are rewound in the reverse direction, then the sign of $\mathfrak{M}$ is changed.

question: 设一个电路由两个串联的线圈组成，其电感分别为 $L_{1}$ 和 $L_{2}$。线圈之间的互感为 $\mathfrak{M}$。求电路的总电感。如果将其中一个线圈反向缠绕，总电感将如何变化？
solution:
电路的总电感由以下公式给出：$$U=\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L}_{1} I_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L}_{2} I_{2}^{2}-\mathfrak{M} I_{1} I_{2}$$ 其中，$I_{1}, I_{2}$ 是线圈中的电流，$\mathfrak{M}$ 是互感系数。

根据条件，$I_{1}=I_{2}=I$。因此，电路的电能可以表示为：$$U=\frac{1}{2} \mathcal{L} I^{2}$$ 其中，$\mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{2}-2 \mathfrak{M}$。

如果将一个线圈的匝数反向缠绕，则$\mathfrak{M}$的符号将改变。

question: A plane-polarized wave falls normally on the surface of a nonmagnetic medium with dielectric permeability $\varepsilon$ and conductance $\sigma^{*}$. Find the coefficient of reflection $R$.
solution: The coefficient of reflection $R$ is given by: $$R=\frac{(1-n)^{2}+\kappa^{2}}{(1+n)^{2}+\kappa^{2}}$$ where $$\begin{aligned} & n=\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon}{2}}\left[\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{\sigma^{*}}{\omega \varepsilon \varepsilon_{0}}\right)^{2}}+1\right]^{1 / 2} \\ & \kappa=\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon}{2}}\left[\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{\sigma^{*}}{\omega \varepsilon \varepsilon_{0}}\right)^{2}}-1\right]^{1 / 2} \end{aligned}$$

question: 一列平面偏振波垂直入射到具有介电常数 $\varepsilon$ 和导电率 $\sigma^{*}$ 的非磁性介质表面。求反射系数 $R$。
solution: 反射系数 $R$ 给出如下：$$R=\frac{(1-n)^{2}+\kappa^{2}}{(1+n)^{2}+\kappa^{2}}$$ 其中 $$\begin{aligned} & n=\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon}{2}}\left[\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{\sigma^{*}}{\omega \varepsilon \varepsilon_{0}}\right)^{2}}+1\right]^{1 / 2} \\ & \kappa=\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon}{2}}\left[\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{\sigma^{*}}{\omega \varepsilon \varepsilon_{0}}\right)^{2}}-1\right]^{1 / 2} \end{aligned}$$。

question: A bicycle is cruising in a horizontal motion with initial velocity $v_{0}$ under the influence of linear air drag. Analyze the motion, that is, find a) the velocity as a function of time and b) the position as a function of time. Neglect the friction forces.
solution:
a. The net force is only the linear air drag, acting horizontally in a direction opposite to the velocity of the bicycle. The vertical forces - the gravitational force and the normal force of the surface - yield a zero vertical force, as in Figure 2.2.

$$
\vec{F}_{\text {net }}=m \vec{g}+\vec{N}+\vec{f}_{\text {linear }}=\vec{f}_{\text {linear }}=-b \vec{v}
$$

From Newton's Second Law, $\vec{F}_{\text {net }}=m \vec{a}=m \vec{v}$, and considering only the $x$ direction,

$$
\begin{aligned}
m \dot{v} & =-b v \\
m \frac{d v}{d t} & =-b v
\end{aligned}
$$

Separation of variables,

$$
\frac{d v}{v}=-\frac{b}{m} d t
$$

The velocity is obtained by integrating on both sides the previous equation over velocity, from $v_{0}$ to $v$, and over time, from 0 to $t$.

$$
\int_{v_{0}}^{v} \frac{d v^{\prime}}{v^{\prime}}=-\frac{b}{m} \int_{0}^{t} d t
$$

![img-36.jpeg](images/img-36.jpeg)

FIGURE 2.2 Forces acting on the bicycle.

And from here it yields

$$
\ln v_{\nu_{0}}^{\nu}=-\frac{b t}{m}
$$

Using the properties of the logarithm, $\ln A-\ln B=\ln \frac{A}{B}$, yields

$$
\ln \frac{v}{v_{0}}=-\frac{b t}{m}
$$

And from here, the speed as a function of time is calculated:

$$
v(t)=v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}}
$$

Note that the velocity is exponentially decreasing to zero, reaching zero asymptotically as time approaches infinity.
b. The equation of motion can be obtained by integrating the speed obtained in part (a).

$$
\begin{aligned}
v & =\frac{d x}{d t} \\
v(t) & =v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}} \\
d x & =v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}} d t \\
\int_{x_{0}}^{x} d x^{\prime} & =v_{0} \int_{0}^{x} e^{-\frac{b t^{\prime}}{m}} d t^{\prime} \\
x-x_{0} & =-\left.\frac{m}{b} v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t^{\prime}}{m}}\right|_{0} ^{t}
\end{aligned}
$$

question: 一辆自行车在水平运动中以初速度 $v_{0}$ 巡航，受到线性空气阻力的影响。分析其运动，即找到 a) 速度随时间的函数和 b) 位置随时间的函数。不考虑摩擦力。
solution:
a. 合力仅是线性的空气阻力，水平作用于自行车速度的反方向。垂直方向上的力——重力和地面的法向力——产生零的垂直力，如图2.2所示。

$$
\vec{F}_{\text {net }}=m \vec{g}+\vec{N}+\vec{f}_{\text {linear }}=\vec{f}_{\text {linear }}=-b \vec{v}
$$

根据牛顿第二定律，$\vec{F}_{\text {net }}=m \vec{a}=m \vec{v}$，并且只考虑$x$方向，

$$
\begin{aligned}
m \dot{v} & =-b v \\
m \frac{d v}{d t} & =-b v
\end{aligned}
$$

变量分离，

$$
\frac{d v}{v}=-\frac{b}{m} d t
$$

通过对速度从$v_{0}$到$v$，时间从0到$t$两边积分来获得速度。

$$
\int_{v_{0}}^{v} \frac{d v^{\prime}}{v^{\prime}}=-\frac{b}{m} \int_{0}^{t} d t
$$

![img-36.jpeg](images/img-36.jpeg)

图2.2 作用于自行车上的力。

从这里得到

$$
\ln v_{\nu_{0}}^{\nu}=-\frac{b t}{m}
$$

利用对数的性质，$\ln A-\ln B=\ln \frac{A}{B}$，得到

$$
\ln \frac{v}{v_{0}}=-\frac{b t}{m}
$$

从这里，可以计算出速度随时间的函数：

$$
v(t)=v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}}
$$

注意速度是指数递减到零，随着时间趋于无穷大，速度渐近于零。

b. 运动方程可以通过对(a)部分得到的速度积分获得。

$$
\begin{aligned}
v & =\frac{d x}{d t} \\
v(t) & =v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}} \\
d x & =v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t}{m}} d t \\
\int_{x_{0}}^{x} d x^{\prime} & =v_{0} \int_{0}^{x} e^{-\frac{b t^{\prime}}{m}} d t^{\prime} \\
x-x_{0} & =-\left.\frac{m}{b} v_{0} e^{-\frac{b t^{\prime}}{m}}\right|_{0} ^{t}
\end{aligned}
$$
